name: Jace Beleren
description: A planeswalker and perhaps the most talented mind mage in the Multiverse, able to read thoughts, erase memories, induce sleep and create illusions.

name: Ravnica
description: A plane with a worldwide cityscape of grand halls, slums and ancient ruins, where ten guilds vie for power.

name: Chandra Nalaar
description: A free-spirited, impulsive and incredibly powerful fire-conjuring planeswalker still growing into the hero she is destined to become.

name: Nicol Bolas
description: A 25,000-year-old dragon planeswalker and extraordinary schemer who poses a greater threat to the Multiverse than almost any other creature alive.

name: Zendikar
description: A tumultuous plane of wild mana, unstable weather and floating terrain, wracked by the Roil.

name: Gideon Jura
description: A powerful warrior-mage and planeswalker who can make himself invulnerable and defends the innocent in combat.

name: Nissa Revane
description: A powerful elven animist and planeswalker who awakens the land to fight beside her and defends the natural world.

name: Liliana Vess
aliases: a pale woman in a violet dress
description: A master necromancer and planeswalker who commands the dead and manipulates the living for her own ends.

name: Ajani Goldmane
description: A leonin warrior and planeswalker with potent healing and protective powers, known as a noble hero and compassionate friend.

name: Innistrad
description: A plane where humanity is prey to werewolves, vampires, zombies, geists, demons and other horrors once the moon rises.

name: Phyrexians
description: Phyrexia's armies that fall into disarray.

name: Eldrazi
description: Three inscrutable entities of the Blind Eternities that devour worlds, once trapped in stasis on Zendikar and later released.

name: Vraska
aliases: a woman with hair like twisting vines
description: A gorgon planeswalker, an outcast turned revolutionary who can petrify enemies with a glance and leads the Golgari guild.

name: Gatewatch
description: The planeswalker group reassembling on Dominaria.

name: Kaya
description: An unconventional assassin for hire and planeswalker who kills ghosts for a living and can phase into the spirit realm.

name: New Phyrexia
description: The force that spread through and compleated Mirrodin, overwhelming the Mirrans.

name: Ugin
aliases: the beating heart of the world
description: An unfathomably old planeswalker dragon who has shaped entire planes, vanquished cataclysmic forces and been reborn at least twice.

name: Blind Eternities
description: The space between planes that the Theorist crosses.

name: Teferi
description: A centuries-old planeswalker hero and formidable time mage who saved his homeland by phasing it out of time.

name: Theros
description: A plane ruled by a pantheon of gods, filled with monsters, where mortals endure and thrive in walled city-states.

name: Dominaria
description: A plane of varied terrain and countless historic locations, birthplace of Urza and Mishra and epicenter of the temporal-planar fractures.

name: Strixhaven
description: The school where Tam and her friends return.

name: Tarkir
description: A plane whose present belongs to the dragons, ruled by five legendary dragonlords after Sarkhan Vol changed history.

name: Tezzeret
aliases: the man with the metal arm
the planeswalker with the metal arm
description: A devious inventor and planeswalker who manipulates metal to create complex devices and deadly mechanical servants.

name: Elspeth Tirel
description: A brave knight and planeswalker with a strong sense of duty and mastery of radiant magic, who searches for a new home and peace.

name: Nahiri
description: A bold, fearless and unpredictable planeswalker several thousand years old, a Kor from Zendikar who spent much of that time in stasis.

name: Sorin Markov
description: A powerful vampire and one of the oldest surviving planeswalkers, born over 7,000 years ago, who lorded over Innistrad.

name: Karn
description: A sentient silver golem and planeswalker with near-complete mastery over artifacts, created by Urza.

name: Amonkhet
description: A plane of dichotomy: a lush river valley and glorious city ringed by endless scorching desert, ruled by animal-headed gods and a God-Pharaoh.

name: Elesh Norn
description: The Phyrexian praetor who appears gargantuan beside Realmbreaker in an illusion; her nightmare image haunts Ajani.

name: Sea Gate
description: A port city whose marble columns are overrun by Phyrexian forces and falls.

name: Ral Zarek
description: A brilliant, unpredictable and daring planeswalker who harnesses the chaotic power of lightning and storms.

name: Avacyn
description: A powerful archangel created by Sorin Markov to safeguard humanity; she is trapped in the Helvault, released, then driven mad and unmade.

name: Azorius Senate
description: Lavinia's guild.

name: Saheeli Rai
description: A master inventor and planeswalker with magical command over metal and a bright, optimistic spirit.

name: Ghirapur
description: The city on Avishkar where the finish line is.

name: Ixalan
description: A plane with a verdant jungle continent where all peoples seek the Immortal Sun.

name: Ulamog
description: An Eldrazi titan that has devoured Bala Ged, leaving gray dust.

name: Urza
description: One of the most influential planeswalkers ever, a master of artifice with near-godlike power, curious and utterly callous, who planned years or centuries ahead.

name: Kaladesh
description: The plane of aether-powered invention, renamed Avishkar after the revolution.

name: Kellan
description: A young man with a whip of light magic who is courting Amalia and is haunted by dreams from Lorwyn after buying meadowsweet.

name: Boros Legion
description: The military red-white guild that believes righteousness is fire.

name: Kamigawa
description: A plane reminiscent of sengoku-era Japan with two symbiotic worlds, the material utsushiyo and the kami spirit realm kakuriyo.

name: Arcavios
description: The plane of oracles where Jadzi dies; the Theorist is thrown back to its creation.

name: Chain Veil
description: An artifact carried by Garruk's double that alarms Liliana.

name: Tamiyo
description: An intrepid researcher and planeswalker devoted to documenting the story of the Multiverse while trying not to interfere in history.

name: Tyvar Kell
aliases: Prince of the elves of Skemfar
description: A planeswalker, younger brother of the king of the elves on Kaldheim, overconfident and boastful but a respected ally.

name: Huatli
aliases: future warrior poet of the Sun Empire
description: A renowned Warrior Poet from Ixalan and planeswalker, master of mounted warfare who summons dinosaur allies.

name: Jaya Ballard
description: One of the oldest planeswalkers, born on Dominaria over 1,500 years ago, a hot-headed, sarcastic hero turned wiser mentor to pyromancers.

name: Kaito Shizuki
description: A master ninja and planeswalker with innate telekinetic powers who pursues technological progress on Kamigawa.

name: Kaldheim
description: A cold plane where Tyvar fights a wolf and Niko lives.

name: Pia Nalaar
description: Chandra's mother who joins Team Avishkar and is nearly killed by a guard.

name: Golgari Swarm
description: The undercity guild that sends Izoni.

name: Niv-Mizzet
description: The dragon on Ravnica who learns from Kaito that Jace left him.

name: Sarkhan Vol
description: A dragon-worshipping planeswalker native to Tarkir, a Mardu warrior whose spark ignited when a dragon spirit's spell unleashed a fire dragon.

name: Jeskai
description: A clan of Tarkir led by the waymaster, whose monks and skyriders defend Storm Crane.

name: Omenpath
description: Tunnels between planes, some visible only at the right angle, used by Stella Lee.

name: Malcolm
description: A siren whom Vraska recruits on Ixalan.

name: New Capenna
description: A city-plane ruled by five Families that was devastated by the Phyrexian Invasion.

name: The sylex
description: An ancient artifact that annihilates the Multiverse, which Jace attempts to use.

name: Ojutai
description: A dragon who assaults Dirgur Stronghold and accepts Shu Yun's terms.

name: Orzhov Syndicate
description: The guild led by Teysa, whose ghosts recognize Kaya's authority.

name: The Consulate
description: Avishkar's former governing body, which acted as an oppressive force trying to control aether technology and stifle innate magic.

name: Thraben
description: A city taken by Liliana's zombies and now ruled by Gisa, whose cathedral is her throne room.

name: Breeches
description: A goblin whom Vraska recruits on Ixalan.

name: Gruul Clans
description: The guild represented by Yarus.

name: Immortal Sun
description: An artifact of mythic power promising boundless wealth, strength of empire, command over nature and eternal life.

name: Izzet League
description: The guild whose researchers study the door under Niv-Mizzet.

name: Orazca
description: The ancient golden city in Ixalan's jungle where the Immortal Sun lies secure.

name: Rakdos
description: A giant demon who fights Akul and carries the crew away.

name: Atarka
description: The antlered Dragonlord who rules the Temur lands, who finds her broodling dead and eats Darka and the Ojutai dragon.

name: Dovin Baan
description: A planeswalker who sees the flaws in any system or machine and predicts exactly how and when it will fail.

name: Garruk Wildspeaker
description: A towering planeswalker huntsman and tracker who prefers a solitary life in the wilds and enlists beasts as allies.

name: Halo
description: A substance in a sword that lets Jace regain consciousness from phyresis.

name: Kiora
description: A cocky, brash merfolk planeswalker who wields a bident she once stole from a god and bonds with ocean creatures and leviathans.

name: Narset
description: A planeswalker whose spark has ignited but whose devotion is to her home plane of Tarkir and her clan; she patiently researches the mysterious past.

name: Selesnya Conclave
description: The guild of Trostani and Tolsimir.

name: Sultai
description: The clan that defeated Silumgar and now resurrects the honored dead as sibsig.

name: The Wanderer
aliases: Very pleasant swordswoman without a name
description: A cypher and traveling swordswoman of incredible skill who hides her features behind a wide-brimmed hat; secretly the lost empress of Kamigawa.

name: Jhoira
description: An artificer and old friend of Jodah, who talks with him through a cloud of shimmering mercury.

name: Mardu
description: The clan of the steppe that took in Paala's family and holds the Lightning Proving.

name: Sun Empire
description: The empire Saheeli now serves.

name: The Renegades
description: A rebel group that thwarted the Consulate's plan.

name: Weatherlight
description: An airship that the Phyrexians have compleated and use against the Mana Rig.

name: Abzan
description: The clan that stands together as a shield wall and that once communed with its ancestors.

name: Bala Ged
description: A continent of Zendikar devoured by Ulamog into gray dust.

name: Emrakul
aliases: the beast that lives within the moon
description: The Eldrazi titan Tam calls to devour the false Multiverse; she engulfs the sky and consumes the Echoverse.

name: House Dimir
description: The secretive blue-black guild of ghost stories, necromancer advisors and phantasmal assassins.

name: Kirol
description: A Strixhaven student who asks Tam who she is and introduces themself.

name: Koth
description: A planeswalker and freedom fighter waging war against an extra-planar evil that conquered his native plane.

name: Wrenn
aliases: the sprout that used to be Wrenn
description: A planeswalker who was once a dryad protecting a vast forest, now merged with a tree and seeking to rid herself of the fire she absorbed.

name: Abigale
description: A winged Strixhaven student who hugs Tam.

name: Jadzi
description: An oracle of Arcavios, held by the Theorist, who taunts him and cuts her own throat with a knife, her death hurling him back to the creation of Arcavios.

name: Kozilek
description: An Eldrazi titan lured to the valley, bound by the glyph, and destroyed by Chandra's fire.

name: Lavinia
description: An Azorius guild leader who studies the Guildpact to find a way to arrest Oba.

name: Lluwen
description: A Strixhaven student who refuses to join the hug.

name: Mirrodin
description: A plane where everything is made of metal, lit by five suns, one for each color of mana; created by Karn and infected by Phyrexian oil.

name: Ob Nixilis
description: A planeswalker who was a conquest-obsessed human warlord until an ancient artifact transformed him into a demon; he saps enemies' life force with deadly magic.

name: Oko
description: A charming, deceitful shapeshifting planeswalker and trickster who bears a grudge against authority and sows chaos.

name: Regatha
description: Chandra's home plane of volcanoes.

name: River Heralds
description: Merfolk who repel the fungal invasion at their city.

name: Tam
description: A being made by Jace to inherit his spark; she calls Emrakul to devour the Echoverse, gains his spark and memories, and planeswalks home as a real person.

name: Torrezon
description: The continent where Azor built the Immortal Sun.

name: Alquist Proft
description: A researcher whose mind magic holds the artificial Omenpath open and who is visited by a door at the end.

name: Arlinn Kord
description: A werewolf and planeswalker who can control her transformations and acts as an ambassador and protector of her kind.

name: Aurelia
description: The Boros angel guild leader, freed from the branches and determined to see someone arrested.

name: Samut
description: A renowned initiate, master of the double khopesh and a dependable leader among her crop; she later became a planeswalker.

name: Sanar
description: A Strixhaven student who hugs Tam.

name: Simic Combine
description: The guild of Zegana and Vannifar.

name: Tazri
description: A human adventurer and commander of Sea Gate's fighters who wears a halo and had a vision of the doom to come.

name: Urabrask
aliases: the praetor of the Quiet Furnace
description: A praetor tortured and dismembered on a machine before Elesh Norn.

name: Vivien Reid
description: A magical archer and conservationist planeswalker, last survivor of Skalla, with a strong connection to wild animals.

name: Etrata
description: Niv-Mizzet's associate who meets Kaito.

name: Heliod
description: A god of Theros corrupted by Phyrexia who is killed by Kaya.

name: Meletis
description: The polis of learning, progress, magic and devotion to the gods, hemmed in by golden wheat fields and the Siren Sea.

name: Realmbreaker
description: A great tree in a massive room, its roots straddled by Elesh Norn, pulsing with light.

name: Sheoldred
description: A Phyrexian thane stripped of her armor who is brought before Norn bound and executed by Ajani.

name: Sunstar Free Company
description: The Palatinate fleet attacking Infinite Guideline for the Endstone.

name: Teysa Karlov
description: The Orzhov guildmaster murdered by Oba, who returns as a ghost, attends her own funeral and continues to run the Syndicate.

name: The Cabal
description: A death cult led by Belzenlok that is crushed at the Stronghold.

name: Ashiok
description: An elegant being of nightmare and planeswalker who draws on fear to create manifestations of victims' darkest dreams; motives and origin unknown.

name: Brazen Coalition
description: A pirate fleet nation led by Admiral Brass.

name: Cathars
description: The guards who fought the raid and survive bruised and battered.

name: Dromoka
description: A dragon whose organized brood forces Daghatar to abandon ancestor worship.

name: Eye of Ugin
description: The chamber in Akoum at the heart of the hedron array that contained the Eldrazi, now collapsed.

name: Guildpact
description: An ancient agreement that kept each guild's power in check, now dissolving.

name: Hedrons
description: Massive stone formations made by Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri, used to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi.

name: Jori En
description: A merfolk ruin diver among the survivors.

name: Lorwyn
description: An idyllic world of perpetual midsummer where races of fable live together in harmony; it transforms into Shadowmoor every three centuries.

name: Markov Manor
description: Sorin's ruined castle with its intact family archives and the mausoleum of his grandfather.

name: Melira
description: A dying Mirran with a festering chest wound who proposes a plan to cleanse Nissa and Ajani at the cost of her life.

name: Naktamun
description: A healing city on Amonkhet from which Mahitab and the party set out.

name: Park Heights
description: The once-gilded upper city of New Capenna that the resistance brings down on Atraxa.

name: Riveteers
description: One of the five Families of New Capenna, who control the Caldaia and its industry and offer Eula an apprenticeship.

name: Rowan Kenrith
description: A knight-trained planeswalker who uses electrical magic and shares a Spark with her brother Will.

name: Sothera
description: The newborn supervoid at the heart of the system, which the Monoists made their thousandth.

name: Vitu-Ghazi
description: The great tree-city of the Selesnya Conclave and site of the Agency's meeting, where the fight with Oba takes place.

name: Yasova Dragonclaw
description: The former Temur chief who confesses she helped Bolas against Ugin, then outwits Bolas with a bluff about Ugin's trap.

name: Aether
description: A raw magical energy critical to Avishkar's ecosystem and culture of invention.

name: Belzenlok
description: The demon ruler of the Cabal who is drained and killed by the Blackblade wielded by Liliana.

name: Biblioplex
description: Strixhaven's vast library, overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree.

name: Hazoret
description: An Amonkhet god who leads Samut and Djeru to face the illusion.

name: Helvault
description: A forty-foot silver monolith made by Sorin as half of Innistrad's protection, which absorbs Nahiri and houses demons.

name: Himoto
aliases: Himoto, the Kami of the Spark
description: Kaito's mechanical-spirit companion that picks Jace's shackle locks.

name: Jodah
description: An archmage who survives the blast and stays to work on freeing Teferi.

name: Kavaron
description: The ruined Kav world and the site of the atrocity.

name: Kefnet
aliases: the keeper of the Hekma barrier
description: The ibis-headed God of Knowledge who tries to repair the Hekma and is killed by the scorpion god.

name: Kolaghan
description: A dragonlord whose skull was the Mardu khan's throne in the original timeline.

name: Kor
description: The people of Zendikar to whom Nahiri belongs, whose traditions survived the Eldrazi.

name: Legion of Dusk
description: The vampire conquistadors who seize the Immortal Sun.

name: Loot
description: A member of Ranna's household practicing the Ravnican alphabet.

name: Mezzio
description: The colorful district of New Capenna now ashen gray.

name: Nashi
description: A nezumi child who confronts his mother's scroll echo, frees her at her request, and returns to Kamigawa.

name: Oketra
description: A God-Eternal archer who shoots Gideon's pegasus and is obliterated by Bolas.

name: Olivia Voldaren
aliases: Lady of our most illustrious house
description: A vampire lady who drops the Moonsilver Key and flees through a window when the wolves arrive.

name: Pinnacle
description: The neutral station authority that releases its violence delegates against both faiths.

name: Quintorius Kand
description: A loxodon Lorehold student and recently sparked planeswalker who investigates the Fomori and returns to guide younger students at the Fields of Strife.

name: Tazeem
description: The Zendikari region that holds the Umara River Gorge.

name: Temur
description: The clan of the mountains, hardy survivors who now suffer a blue-veined sickness.

name: The Theorist
description: A slice of Jace's fractured personality that took over after his apparent death in the Meditation Realm, locking away his empathy and wisdom and monitoring the final step of his plan.

name: Venser
description: A brilliant inventor and planeswalker wielding blue and white magic, building artifacts with an emphasis on teleportation.

name: Alhammarret
description: The sphinx whose commands compel Vraska to step off the Vrynian rooftop; in Jace's past he gave the instruction that made the Soldier a killer.

name: Duskmourn
description: The nightmarish house beyond the door where most routes end in horrible fates.

name: Ezrim
description: The archon head of the Agency, pinned by roots and freed by Kaya.

name: Gavony
description: The region of Innistrad where the Betzold family lived.

name: Griselbrand
description: A demon who trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him.

name: Inti
description: Huatli's cousin and the Sun Empire's seneschal of the sun, killed in the battle and now an Echo in his sword's cosmium gem.

name: Jin-Gitaxias
description: A praetor who rides a war machine and turns on Norn; he is killed when a Zhalfirin warrior shatters his vat.

name: Judith
description: The Rakdos representative who flees the fight and is confronted by Massacre Girl.

name: Mirrans
description: Mirrodin's inhabitants, who fought many battles but were overwhelmed by the Phyrexian forces.

name: Moonsilver Key
description: One of Teferi's artifacts that receives the anchor's temporal energy.

name: Nephalia
description: The region of Innistrad where the Cecani family home stands and where Gisa raises ghouls on the coast.

name: Niko Aris
description: A young hero from Theros and new planeswalker, a master with the javelin who creates magical shards of mirror-glass that trap allies or adversaries.

name: Obscura
description: A family some of whose members, such as Kamiz, have been compromised by the Adversary.

name: Omenpaths
description: Rifts in the fabric of the plane that opened after the invasion, a phenomenon natural to Kaldheim, giving ways on and off Ravnica.

name: Oriq
description: A secret society of masked mages who recruit Silverquill students.

name: Oviya Pashiri
description: A lifecrafter who is struck by thopter lightning and left unconscious but alive.

name: Paliano
description: The capital of Fiora, where murder and subterfuge are common and political factions vie for control; its laws mystically bind the populace.

name: Rashmi
description: The aether-engineer who designed Hope of Ghirapur to undo her own earlier invention.

name: Rhonas
description: The dead God of Strength whose body lies in the street and whose staff a khenra reforges and wields.

name: Shandalar
description: An abnormally mana-rich plane where magic flows freely, threatened by the growing hive mind of the slivers.

name: Shanna
description: The captain of the Weatherlight and Sisay's descendant, who has magical immunity and who faces nightmares to save her crew.

name: Tannuk
description: A gentle Kav giant, former Kav Memorial Navy pilot dishonorably discharged and exiled for redirecting a falling chunk of the debris belt, and Sami's first mate.

name: Vryn
description: The plane of Jace's memories of Alhammarret and the camp of the dead soldiers.

name: Winter
description: A racer who tries to reach the finish line on a broken leg and is dragged back to hell.

name: Zimone Wola
description: A mathematical prodigy and Duskmourn survivor who graduated from Quandrix and begins a fellowship on Ravnica.

name: Akoum
description: A Zendikari continent of rock precipices and lava fields where the Skyclave rises.

name: Alpharael
description: A young Monoist acolyte plagued by dreams since his sister dove into the supervoid, tasked with a likely suicide mission against the Sunstar Free Company.

name: Ashaya
description: A giant four-armed elemental of roots and green buds who pins Jace and delivers the Core to Nissa.

name: Dina
description: A darkly humorous tea-obsessed dryad who was the sole survivor of a glade hit by the Brittleblight.

name: Eldraine
description: The fairy tale plane.

name: Erebos
description: A towering celestial being made of a starry night sky, with black horns and a skull-handled whip, who interrogates Gideon in a vision inside Jace's mind.

name: Geralf Cecani
description: A necromancer and medic.

name: Gonti
aliases: Gonti, lord of the Night Market
description: The night minister and grand marshal who fires the signal flare to start the race.

name: Inventors' Fair
description: A month-long fair across downtown Ghirapur where inventors race, battle and demonstrate their inventions.

name: Kessig
description: The region where the ritual is completed and the sun rises.

name: Kyodai
description: The guardian spirit of Kamigawa whose soul is bound to the emperor.

name: Mishra
description: Urza's brother, shown as a half-flesh half-steel grinning machine at the moment of the sylex's detonation.

name: Raff
description: An illusionist and wizard who flies the Weatherlight, senses the magic in the mountains and helps defeat Shard-Braids.

name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
description: The investigators led by Ezrim.

name: Saint Elenda
description: A living saint of the Church of Dusk with a glowing halo, who meets Caztaca and Brass at Sen Gael to prevent war and Aclazotz's return.

name: Sami
description: A young nonbinary freelance captain of the Seriema who lost their cat Mirri and most of their crew, and seeks the score that will restore their fortunes.

name: Seriema
description: Sami's ship, which escapes Sothera through the eternity column with a Pinnacle warp ferry.

name: Sigarda
aliases: archangel of the Host of Herons
description: An angel fighting in the ballroom who catches a demon swinging a column.

name: Silverquill
description: The college of language magic, expressed through spoken, written and signed word as ink and light.

name: The Belligerent
description: A Brazen Coalition ship captained by Vraska, wrecked on the shore of Ixalan.

name: The Raven Man
description: A pale figure in black with golden eyes who stalks Liliana across planes and refuses to undo Josu's fate.

name: Tiana
description: An angelic artificer of the Weatherlight crew who fears the disguised ship is breaking and cuts out its powerstone.

name: Trostani
description: The three-headed dryad leader of the Selesnya Conclave, made up of Ses, Cim and Oba.

name: Will Kenrith
description: An accomplished cryomancer and planeswalker who uses ice magic, compassionate and curious.

name: Witherbloom
description: The Strixhaven college of life, death and decay that all the students and Dina belong to.

name: Zhalfir
description: The plane where the survivors live and which at first does not answer Nissa.

name: Adeline
description: A cathar who fights in the ballroom beside Chandra and says a tender goodbye to her at the end.

name: Alara
description: A plane whose five shards, once separate worlds each flowing with three colors of mana, have converged into one plane flowing with all five colors.

name: Angrath
aliases: a man with the head of a bull
description: A minotaur planeswalker driven by restless impatience and a wild temper.

name: Annie Flash
description: A sharpshooter and seer of illusions who spares Kellan by deliberately missing Oko, and is put to sleep by Jace.

name: Arvad
description: A Weatherlight crew member left in charge during the mission, who survives the attack on the way back.

name: Azor
description: A 10,000-year-old sphinx hieromancer who severs his spark to create the Immortal Sun.

name: Baral
description: A scarred Consulate Chief of Compliance who killed Kiran Nalaar, imprisoned Pia and torments Chandra to draw her away from the Hub.

name: Bontu
description: A God-Eternal who bites Bolas and harvests all his Sparks, exploding in the process.

name: Brokers
description: A New Capennan family that hoarded Halo and led by Falco joins the plan.

name: Cabaretti
description: The family led by Jetmir that has held Giada.

name: Djeru
description: An Amonkhet resident who goes with Samut and Hazoret.

name: Edgar Markov
description: Sorin's grandfather, who fights for his marriage to Olivia and flees when he loses to Sorin.

name: Eriette
aliases: Eriette of the Court of the Ardent Queen
description: A wicked witch freed from an Eldraine jail by Jace as Ashiok.

name: Fiora
description: A plane of perpetual renaissance with beautiful cities, ingenious inventors and dangerous politics.

name: Fortune
description: An Endriders racer mind-controlled by Jace.

name: Gisa
description: A necromancer and Geralf's sister.

name: Hexhaven Academy
description: The Echoverse academy first built by Uldaros Theorix, with a Folioplex, protected from mage hunters.

name: Infinite Guideline
description: The Pinnacle station besieged by the Sunstar and Monoist fleets and invaded by elds.

name: Isilu
description: An elemental god, the incarnation of Shadowmoor; it wanders the plane while Eirdu sleeps.

name: Katilda
description: The witch whose spirit is bound to the Moonsilver Key until she returns to her body and leads the ritual.

name: Kiran Nalaar
description: Pia's husband, who died at the hands of the Consulate.

name: Lukka
description: A compleated Phyrexian evangel sent to Ikoria to bring the monsters into the fold.

name: Maestros
description: A New Capennan family of artists, most of whom have been Phyrexianized.

name: Mirri
description: Sami's orange and brown cat, found alive in a stasis cask on Infinite Guideline after years frozen in time.

name: Oona
aliases: queen and mother of all faeries
description: The queen of the faeries, who caused the plane's transformation.

name: Otawara
description: The gleaming Soratami stronghold in the sky of Kamigawa where recovered artifacts are kept.

name: Phyrexian invasion
description: The Phyrexian attack that damaged or destroyed much of Strixhaven's campus and killed faculty.

name: Planar Bridge
description: The artifact in Tezzeret's chest that is eating him alive.

name: Quandrix
description: The college of nature mathematicians who study fractals and patterns.

name: Silumgar
description: A dragon who accepts Tasigur's bargain and leads an assault on Dirgur Stronghold.

name: Taigam
description: A zealous Jeskai monk and loyalist who guides Sarkhan through a corrupted ritual of eating a dragon's heart.

name: Thassa
description: The sea god of Theros who fights Kiora with her kraken armies and her bident.

name: The Echoverse
description: A mirrored version of reality created by Jace Beleren in which history looks different and legends have different fates.

name: The Phyrexian Invasion
description: Elesh Norn's invasion of the Multiverse, begun through the branches of the World Tree.

name: The Travails
description: The near-apocalypse on Innistrad when a monster in the moon nearly ended the plane.

name: Thunder Junction
description: The plane where the Fomori vault stands and where Jace and Vraska meet with Loot.

name: Titan's Grave
description: The bone-filled caverns on Arcavios where the fight and the crisis take place.

name: Tomik
description: Ral's husband and a brilliant, loving partner.

name: Zegana
description: A Simic figure found dead, posed on a pile of coats with a black iris in her hand.

name: Aclazotz
description: The risen vampire god who escapes the Core on a ship to Torrezon.

name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
description: Kellan's partner, an explorer who surveys and who keeps his dream journal.

name: Anhelo
description: Errant's father, a former head of the Maestros who has been Phyrexianized and tries to convert her.

name: Atraxa
description: A corrupted angel leading Phyrexia's assault on New Capenna who is killed when Park Heights collapses on her.

name: Baishya
description: A young whisperer who wears Naiva's mantle to deceive Bolas and protects herself and Yasova with earth magic.

name: Caldaia
description: The lowest level of New Capenna, where the Riveteers hold sway and Eula's family now lives.

name: Caparocti
description: A Sun Empire champion appointed as the emperor's voice who clashes with Huatli over war.

name: Daretti
description: A goblin of uncommon intellect, talent and ambition, and a planeswalker who returned to Fiora to reshape Paliano's power structures.

name: Daxos
description: A friend of Elspeth on Theros whose warm voice guides her through the vision of Theros, now holding a new station.

name: Dragonstorms
description: Storms that keep producing more monstrous dragons.

name: Drix
description: The people who can walk the Weft unaided and remember the Eldrazi war.

name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
description: The race that ends in a showdown at the finish line.

name: Glen Elendra
description: The home of the faeries, unchanged between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

name: Haliya
description: A bright, eager squire in the Sunstar Free Company who arrived on the Dawnsire and serves Syr Vondam.

name: Hellspurs
description: Akul's gang who attack the crew inside the vault.

name: Josu Vess
description: Liliana's brother, a lich general of the Cabal in Caligo, who is laid to rest by the Chain Veil.

name: Killian Lu
description: A Silverquill graduate student mentoring younger students at the Forum of Amity, who supported allies during the invasion.

name: Mage hunters
description: Creatures circling the tower's base in search of magic, some clawing upward.

name: Maralen
description: An elf and former avatar of Oona who is now steward of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor alongside Eirdu and Isilu, ruling from Glen Elendra.

name: Naiva
description: A young Temur hunter who nearly kills her twin under Bolas's influence, then resists him and hides in the hedron during the confrontation.

name: Niambi
description: Teferi's daughter, a Speaker and dream interpreter of Femeref who tends the Efravan refugees and leads their escape into an old mine, then wins the magistrate over.

name: Prismari
description: The Strixhaven college of elemental artistry that Rootha, Nassari, Kahri and Glass belong to.

name: Professor Opal
description: The lich of Professor Opal that Liliana controls as her puppet and which fades from existence.

name: Razaketh
description: A reptilian demon who holds a contract on Liliana's soul and can control her body, killed at the Luxa River after bringing about the Hours.

name: Shadowmoor
description: The dark mirror-image of Lorwyn, in perpetual dusk and gloom, whose races are transformed into darker versions of themselves.

name: Starnheim
description: The golden realm of heroes, whose light shines above Istfell and which Valkyries grant entry to.

name: Stensia
description: The vampire-dominated region of Innistrad where Grigori lives.

name: Susur Secundi
description: A Monoist monastery-world, home of Alpharael, with a monastery in construction above it that the Dawnsire strikes.

name: Syr Vondam
description: A high-ranking Sunstar Free Company knight who commands a host defending the Dawnsire and trains Haliya.

name: Teyo Verada
description: A young, inexperienced shield mage and planeswalker, thrust into the chaos of war and still learning what it means to be a planeswalker.

name: Thaumatic Compass
description: A silver object Jace and Vraska used, which she keeps in her pocket and which points at Ral.

name: Tovolar
description: A werewolf who leads wolves to Voldaren Manor to help Arlinn against the vampires, though she says this changes nothing between them.

name: Ugin's grave
description: The canyon of hedrons holding Ugin's bones.

name: Uthros
description: A gas giant of colorful clouds and crushing gravity, ringed by refueling stations and salvage yards, with a secret research station in its core.

name: Vannifar
description: The Simic leader who reveals Zegana was seeking a cure for phyresis with her consent.

name: Vorinclex
description: A praetor beheaded by an Askari warrior's sword.

name: World Tree
description: The giant tree linking realms, whose pinnacle houses Starnheim.

name: Zurgo
description: The Mardu khan and Sarkhan's enemy who kills Narset in the original timeline; in the new one he is Kolaghan's herald and bell-striker.

name: Akiri
description: A kor line-slinger who searches for Nahiri, haunted by the loss of Zareth, and leads the party into the Skyclave.

name: Akros
description: The polis where martial prowess is held in highest esteem, centered on a cliff-top fortress.

name: Akul
description: The dragon leader of the Hellspurs, mind-controlled by Kellan and sealed in the collapsing vault.

name: Arcades Sabboth
description: A dragon who commands an army against Nicol on Jamuraa.

name: Avishkar
description: A plane of inspired invention, formerly known as Kaladesh, whose life depends on aether and which is now united under the Avishkar Assembly.

name: Blackblade
description: Gideon's sword that shatters against Bolas's brow.

name: Brigid Baeli
description: A kithkin who helped bring down Oona and now trains the city watch in Goldmeadow; once a pirate under Sygg.

name: Chamber of the Guildpact
description: A ruined chamber in a memory-prison where the Guildpact is held.

name: Custodi
description: Ghostly clergy who counsel Brago, crown Marchesa and accept her tithe.

name: Dawnsire
description: A vast javelin-shaped Sunstar ship carrying a horizon javelin that can unmake a supervoid into a star, and two laser batteries called Nacho and Nacha.

name: Doomskar
description: The catastrophe of rifts between realms, ended by Halvar with the Sword of the Realms.

name: Drana
description: A vampire leader among the survivors after the battle.

name: Dusk Legion
description: The vampires transformed by Aclazotz.

name: Eiko Shizuki
description: Kaito's sister, who defends Eiganjo and becomes a senior advisor.

name: Emeria
description: The crashed kor ruin where Nahiri was fused into the walls, now her dark workspace.

name: Emmara Tandris
description: Champion of the Selesnya Conclave who attends the ritual.

name: Fair Basilica
description: Elesh Norn's cathedral with aspirants, angels, chancellors and the Alabaster Host.

name: INEVITA
description: The Monoist deity of inevitability.

name: Imperials
description: The ruling authority of Kamigawa whose mechs and enforcers suppress unauthorized tech and food distribution.

name: Invasion Tree
description: The structure on New Phyrexia whose barbs retract and which becomes the site of the final battle.

name: Kasmina
description: A subtle, secretive planeswalker whose visions of the future warn of dark days ahead for the Multiverse.

name: Koma
description: A continent-sized serpent that tears open a rift in the sky and then dives into the rift to Karfell.

name: Kothophed
description: A demon who offered Garruk a way to suppress the beast within him with a powerful artifact in the Onakke Catacombs.

name: Krenko
description: A guild leader who is swallowed in a cocoon of roots and later dragged off by Aurelia to be arrested.

name: Leylines
description: Lines of a plane's energy that the plan depends on and that Emrakul's arrival has redirected.

name: Light-Paws
description: A kitsune advisor who is named the emperor's proxy and becomes the Regent of Kamigawa, growing a new tail.

name: Marchesa
description: The new queen of Paliano, who claims to be King Brago's designated heir and proclaims her rule to the High City.

name: Memnarch
description: Mirrodin's caretaker, who slowly went mad and abducted mortals from across the Multiverse to populate the plane.

name: Monoism
description: The Monoist forces whose paladins and war armor attack Infinite Guideline but are spared by the elds.

name: Morcant
description: An elf tyrant, de facto leader of the elves at Lys Alana, who secretly wants to subject Lorwyn to elvish rule again.

name: Munda
description: A kor ambusher among the gathered survivors.

name: Nyx
description: The starry realm in which the gods take form from mortal belief.

name: Odric
description: A legendary cathar commander in a Nearheath chapel, mourning Avacyn's death; he is turned into a vampire by Henrika but keeps his soul.

name: Pantlaza
description: Huatli's new quetzacama companion, a promising young raptor.

name: Queen Miralda
description: The queen of Torrezon.

name: Rhys
description: An elf of the group that defeated Oona, kept alive by a pact with Maralen and carrying a moonglove-laced dagger.

name: Shiv
description: Dominaria's red region where Phyrexian troops hide in the Cometia Crater cave complex.

name: Slats
aliases: Coronal-Captain Dark Fringes Upon Bands of Light Through a Narrow Slot
description: An Astelli captain of the Dawnsire and coronal of the faithful aboard, who foresaw Vondam's death and Alpharael, and spares the latter.

name: Sterling Company
description: The company whose army raids Tarnation and imprisons Kellan.

name: Tae Jin
description: A young Jeskai ghostfire warrior who rushes to Naiva's side and agrees to stay for some months to recite Ugin's story.

name: Tamira
description: A gorgon student from Shandalar who is healed after being shot.

name: Temporal Anchor
description: Saheeli's machine that projects Teferi's spirit into the past.

name: The Hekma
description: The barrier protecting Naktamun, eaten away by locusts until a quarter of it vanishes.

name: The Luxa
description: The river whose blood-stained water recedes and leaves an empty riverbed.

name: Tibalt
description: A sadistic interplanar menace and planeswalker who revels in the suffering of others; born human on Innistrad, transformed into a half-devil.

name: Tishana
description: A River Herald elder who, in the non-canon River Heralds ending, claims Orazca as the City of Golden Water.

name: Towashi
description: The neon-lit Kamigawan city being destroyed.

name: Valgavoth
description: The demon whose face is seen by those who walk into the light at the end of door forty.

name: Vampires
description: Olivia's vampire army allied with the living against the horrors.

name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
description: A transformed bat-like vampire who dreams of being made a saint and is killed by Huatli.

name: Wayta
description: A young Sun Empire warrior who receives Inti's sword.

name: Xenagos
description: A satyr planeswalker of the Skola Valley on Theros, epitome of satyr ideals of pleasure and revelry and de facto revelry host.

name: Anafenza
description: A Dromoka captain in the alternate timeline who calls ancestor spirits from a kin-tree, defeats a Kolaghan horde, and is executed for necromancy.

name: Angels of Innistrad
description: Avacyn's angels who guard the cathedral and are slain by Sorin.

name: Asari Uprisers
description: Rebels in Sokenzanshi who feed, house and school displaced people.

name: Ayagor
description: The mountaintop stone bowl where Atarka lounges and receives offerings.

name: Bant
description: A shard of Alara: an orderly, sunlit kingdom defended in the name of its guardian angels.

name: Bartolomé del Presidio
description: A vampire who speaks for the Legion, confides doubts about the church, and is killed by Vito.

name: Boulder
description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who returns to her side.

name: Bretagard
description: The human realm of Kaldheim where the battle is fought.

name: Chromium Rhuell
description: An elder dragon who takes human form to observe humans and recommends destroying the human chief; he flies off after rebuking Nicol.

name: Clavileño
description: Vito's soldier, transformed into a bat creature, who kills Inti.

name: Cult of Rakdos
description: The Rakdos guild whose guildmaster joins the battle.

name: Dragon tempests
description: The storms that birth dragons, still active in the new Tarkir.

name: Eiganjo
description: Konda's stronghold.

name: Eirdu
description: An elemental god, the incarnation of Lorwyn; with Isilu it forms the plane's twin worldsouls and keeps balance between light and dark.

name: Fec
aliases: Fec, of the line of Abek
description: An orc who carves scrimshaw records for the hidden collection.

name: Gate to the Afterlife
description: The gate that opens fully at the Hours, revealing the Necropolis rather than paradise.

name: Giada
description: The youngest angel of New Capenna, too newly formed to fight, who directs the angels through the portals to the Multiverse.

name: Guul Draz
description: The vampire continent being devoured by the Eldrazi.

name: Hekara
description: A resurrected Rakdos blood witch who fights bravely but no longer remembers or sees Rat.

name: High and Dry
description: A floating pirate town built from broken Brazen Coalition ships, a neutral ground for pirates.

name: Kaervek
description: A warlock who breaks the vault door's ward.

name: Keral Keep
description: A monastery on Regatha where Chandra once served as abbot.

name: King Brago
description: The ghost king of Paliano, paranoid and crueler in death than in life, who is assassinated by Kaya.

name: Kroog
description: The city Teferi visits twice in time, once as a lake city and once under siege.

name: Lazav
description: The Dimir shapeshifter guildmaster, who here disguises himself as Rai.

name: Mabel
description: A resident of Bloomburrow who sees a shadow of her home, of her littles, in the second world.

name: Massacre Girl
description: A Rakdos assassin who slips her chain and attacks Judith.

name: Mohar Varma
description: Sita's father who lectures her during his coup attempt and is later jailed.

name: Noyan Dar
description: A merfolk roilmage leader among the survivors after the battle.

name: Omenseekers
description: A crew led by Inga Rune-Eyes.

name: Patience
description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who returns to her side.

name: Phyresis
description: The Phyrexian oil-based transformation that reshapes minds and bodies.

name: Phyrexian Nissa Revane
description: A compleated version of Nissa, suspended with extra arms before Elesh Norn in an illusion.

name: Professor Fel
description: A Strixhaven professor who is trapped in amber while casting a spell at the archaic.

name: Qal Sisma
description: The mountain range where Ugin's grave lies.

name: Rakhan
description: A hunter of the party.

name: Ranna Beleren
description: Jace's mother, who shares tea with Vraska while mourning.

name: Razorkin
description: Hulking, masked hunters in leather aprons who play with their prey, serving a master in white leather.

name: Reckoners
description: Criminal henchmen who work with the chrome monster in the warehouse.

name: Redtooth
description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who returns to her side.

name: Roil
description: Zendikar's upheaval which shakes the Skyclave and which Nahiri believes fights her.

name: Rona
description: A Phyrexian in Jodah-like robes with a glaive and azure lightning who wounds Jodah and Elspeth, bearing a grudge from Yavimaya.

name: Rubblebelt
description: The ruined wild district of Ravnica that is weakening and dying.

name: Serra
description: A human planeswalker from the distant past, a powerful and benevolent healer who created Serra's Realm.

name: Seven
description: Wrenn's tree companion, torn apart by Phyrexian Nissa.

name: Sisay
description: Captain of the flying ship Weatherlight, who seeks the pieces of the Legacy and agrees to rescue Starke's daughter in exchange for information.

name: Sita Varma
description: The masked racer who injects aether and rescues the Nalaars, then becomes part of Team Avishkar.

name: Skalla
description: Vivien's home plane, where advocates of progress and guardians of nature failed to find balance.

name: Streak
description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who returns to her side.

name: Surrak
description: The former huntcaller and last man to lead the Temur, whom Eshki defeated; he lies bound by blue threads in Rainveil Forest.

name: Tarnation
description: The Hellspur city damaged by the vault's fall.

name: Taro-duend
description: The Kav settlement on Kavaron That Is that the Sundog destroys with lasers and a fusion burn.

name: Tawnos
description: Urza's former apprentice, who is released from his coffin and sent west to teach.

name: Thalia
aliases: Thalia of the Order of Saint Traft
description: An Echoverse spirit of Thalia, killed on Avacyn's order, who protects her cathedral for anyone seeking shelter.

name: The Aether Spire
description: The tower where Nissa and Chandra meet on its platform.

name: The Anointed
description: Mummified caretakers who keep performing their duties despite the chaos.

name: The Celestus
description: The ancient machine that roars to life and brings the sun back.

name: The Crescendo
description: The yearly gathering of the families, held at the Vantoleone, where the Cabaretti unveil the Font and the Adversary launches his attack.

name: The Eternals
description: Undead lazotep-covered soldiers of Bolas that roam Ravnica killing everyone outside buildings.

name: The Metalman
description: A metal-bodied being Sami calls a wizard, to whom Sami intends to give the stone in exchange for repairs.

name: The Sum
description: The Sunstar principle of maximizing life that Haliya says must account for her revolt.

name: The Temur
description: Yasova's clan that must survive and preserve its memories.

name: Tolaria West
description: The Tolarian mage academy on an island where nine people were murdered.

name: Uldaros Theorix
description: A sphinx who sought students with a thirst for knowledge, used reality-bending magic to build the first fortress of Hexhaven and adorns himself with chains of equations.

name: Urborg
description: The swampy region where the Stronghold is located.

name: Urza's tower
description: The tower where Teferi lies in the coffin and the Phyrexians attack.

name: Weldfast
description: Solidly renegade territory where the Heart of Kiran retreats.

name: Wurmwall
description: The edge-of-Sothera debris belt toward which the Endstone steers the Seriema.

name: Yavimaya
description: A jungle region where Jodah meets Meria in the ruins of Kroog.

name: Yawgmoth
description: Urza's millennia-long enemy tied to Phyrexia; he perished together with Urza.

name: Zareth
description: A merfolk scout, Akiri's love, who distrusts Nahiri and dies when she uses the Lithoform Core.

name: Zendikari army
description: The people and army of Zendikar, now dwindling as volunteers leave.

name: Adagia
description: A Summist colony under mirrorscapes.

name: Aether Rangers
description: Spitfire's team.

name: Aetherborn
description: Beings of aether, including Yahenni's family, whose life energy returns to the Multiverse.

name: Alrund
description: An old god of Kaldheim with a raven named Hakka who reveals that Halvar can wield the Sword of the Realms.

name: Amelia
description: A pirate helmsmage of the Belligerent's crew who ensnares Huatli with canvas.

name: Aminatou
aliases: the child who spins cocoons of fate
description: A planeswalker whose magic revolves around fate and the manipulation of destiny, manifested through wispy, intangible moths.

name: Arashin
description: The Abzan city whose fortifications are being raised for the dragon threat.

name: Ashling
description: A flamekin dancer and pilgrim who was key in Oona's defeat and acted as the Extinguisher.

name: Athreos
description: The Theran god of passage.

name: Basri Ket
description: A planeswalker once utterly devoted to the god Oketra, who now champions her ideals across the Multiverse with one of her arrows as a spear.

name: Bertram Graywater
description: The Sterling Company leader to whom Oko leaked Tarnation's coordinates.

name: Bident of Thassa
description: Kiora's weapon that commands the seas.

name: Blue faerie
description: The faerie that lured the students; it flickers between blue and green and is revealed to be Maralen's brother in his Shadowmoor form.

name: Bruna
description: An angel in blue and white light armor who wields a staff; Sigarda's sister, now speaking in Avacyn's voice.

name: Calamity Beasts
description: Natural-disaster beasts that Glarb wishes to command.

name: Castle Ardenvale
description: The ruined royal castle where Eriette holds her throne and the final battle occurs.

name: Cellarspawn
description: Spindly horrors that unfold from basement shadows and kill quickly.

name: Church of Avacyn
description: The church of Innistrad that serves Avacyn and runs the inquisition.

name: Church of Serra
description: An organization with which Jhoira's crew made a bargain to eradicate the Cabal.

name: Cim
description: One of the three heads of Trostani, who says Oba is a rotten branch and that Trostani will step aside for communion with Mat'Selesnya.

name: Commander Vorik
description: The previous commander-general of the Zendikari army who hired Tazri and named Gideon his successor as he died.

name: Depala
description: Yahenni's best friend, a dwarf who dresses them and inherits their investment portfolio.

name: Dhund
description: A secret Consulate headquarters of tunnels beneath Gonti's night market that holds important prisoners.

name: Downtown
description: The abandoned mining camp whose cenote shaft Malcolm descends.

name: Ephara
description: A god, shown as a tall dark-skinned woman covered in the stars of Nyx, who destroys Cacophony.

name: Eumidians
description: A people of insectoid terraformers on Evendo who share a union-mind and recycle the dead and damaged.

name: Evendo
description: A formerly ice-bound world being terraformed into a Eumidian paradise, once lush with life and now thawing.

name: Extus
description: The Oriq leader who has followed Zimone for years and offers to share the Vorzani Conjecture with her.

name: Felothar
aliases: the new khan of the Abzan
description: An Abzan rebel warrior stripped of her place by Dromoka, who wields the sword Heartsblood and trains a captured loyalist girl.

name: Finneas
description: A rabbitfolk archer who fights skunkfolk with burr-tipped arrows.

name: Futurists
description: The technologists of Otawara.

name: Gerrard Capashen
description: The man Starke seeks, who rescues Starke, fights Maraxus and distrusts Starke while needing him to reach Rath.

name: Gisela
description: A tall angel of the Goldnight flight who wields twin blades; Sigarda's sister, now converted to Avacyn's cause.

name: Goldmeadow
description: The transformed Shadowmoor village toward which the group travels.

name: Grete
description: A cathar in Thalia's company with fire in her eyes when possessed by a geist.

name: Harald
aliases: King of the elves of Skemfar
description: An elf of Kaldheim who counts the minutes waiting for his brother Tyvar.

name: Harvesttide
description: The festival meant to restore the balance of day and night, attacked by Tovolar's wolves at sunset.

name: Harvesttide Massacre
description: The name given by survivors to the wolves' attack on the festival.

name: Heart of Kiran
description: The renegade airship that rises beside the Hub and later hangs over Weldfast.

name: Hedron network
description: The network of stone structures built by Nahiri to form the bars of a worldwide prison, and later used to trap Ulamog.

name: Helga
description: A frogfolk augur who confronts her former master, frees herself with a water-step spell, and decides to stay in Goodhill as a hedgewitch.

name: Hylda
description: A lonely witch who rules a castle of ice at Loch Larent, tests Kellan and Ruby, then gives up her crown and reveals Talion's role in the Slumber.

name: Iroas
description: God of warfare and patron of the Akroans, who grapples with his twin Mogis in the sky above Akros.

name: Isperia
description: The stone corpse of the Azorius sphinx guildmaster, behind which the Gatewatch confer.

name: Izoni
description: A Golgari leader who withers Oba's vines with poison.

name: Jenrik
description: A human who took over a moonfolk planeswalker's journal and was sent to Markov Manor, where he died and was entombed in stone clutching it.

name: Jetmir
description: The wounded boss of the Cabaretti, resting in an Obscura hideout.

name: Kari Zev
description: A captain, accompanied by a monkey, who commentates with Vin and advises the Keelhaulers.

name: Karlov Manor
description: The manor where Teysa's body lies.

name: Kayla bin-Kroog
description: Widow of Urza and ruler of Penregon who discovers she can channel fire, leads an exodus west, and leaves for the western lands after reuniting hope with her grandson.

name: Kaza
description: A cheerful human wizard in Akiri's party who throws firebombs and rides a staff.

name: Khalni Heart
description: An outgrowth of Zendikar's soul that Nissa uses to restore her connection to the plane.

name: Kianne
description: A Quandrix dean who teaches forms and fractals and warns Zimone away from the Vorzani Conjecture.

name: King Glarb
description: The frogfolk king of Fountainport and Helga's former master, who tries to control the Calamity Beast within a stolen egg, and flees.

name: Kitt Kanto
description: A leonin subway busker from the Caldaia who sings to pigeons and, through luck and nerve, wins a slot at the Red Room and a place with the Cabaretti.

name: Kolodin
description: Cloudspire's captain who tells Chandra not to throw away victory.

name: Kumena
description: A River Herald thrown from Orazca's tower and saved by Tishana's wind.

name: Lithoform Core
description: An ancient piece of Zendikar made to undo damage, which heals the plane when Nissa unleashes it.

name: Lorehold
description: The Strixhaven college of history and archaeology, led by Dean Tullus.

name: Lumarets
description: Small luminescent creatures that mirror Lluwen's movements and lend the power that completes the spell.

name: Maha, the Night Owl
description: The Calamity Beast whose egg was stolen; it defeats the Storm Hawk and takes back its egg.

name: Maree
description: Zarek's goblin second-in-command who says even ninety percent of the guilds is not enough.

name: Mavren Fein
description: A vampire leader of the Legion of Dusk auxiliaries, released from imperial dungeons to fight, who helps hold the temple gate.

name: Meditation Realm
description: A shifting realm that is a hub and substrate to all of reality and is Ugin's prison for Bolas; it reshapes itself to those who perceive it.

name: Mm'menon
description: A disgraced former Uthros Combine researcher, adept cloudsculptor and polyglot who serves Tezzeret.

name: Mother Luti
description: An old, respected woman at Keral Keep who tries to teach Chandra and who reappears on Dominaria claiming Jaya's goggles as hers.

name: Multani
description: A tree elemental, semiconscious and hostile near the Sylex dig, who is calmed by Chandra and recovers awareness.

name: Murasa
description: A Zendikari island where a newly risen Skyclave holds the Lithoform Core.

name: Nassari
description: A djinni dean of Prismari and Rootha's former advisor, who is made of flame and uses they/them pronouns.

name: New Argive
description: The nation of Stenn that pledges to mobilize against the Phyrexians.

name: Oba
description: The enraged third head of Trostani, who murdered Teysa and wields the Ravnican Worldsoul as a weapon until Kaya and Etrata bind her.

name: Oiyan
description: A hunter of the party.

name: Ondu
description: A region of Zendikar where Nahiri finds a ruined kor city.

name: Orah
description: A kor cleric in Akiri's party whose hand is infected by oil, who charges the elementals shouting for Zareth.

name: Palladia-Mors
description: A hunting dragon, Nicol's sister, who listens to Nicol's tale of Vaevictis's vulnerability.

name: Phyrexian oil
description: A dark contagion Karn unwittingly introduced, which infects the land and breeds horrors.

name: Professor Vess
description: A necromancer professor imprisoned in a hexed cell at the tower's base, who taunts Tam about her betrayal.

name: Queen's Bay Company
description: One of the queen's ventures, infiltrated by fanatics.

name: Raphaella
description: Alpharael's identical sister, a Monoist who plummets into Sothera in an inevitor and writes final death poems.

name: Rootha Squallheart
description: An orc and perfectionist who feels conflicted after the invasion and fixates on her failures in the Invocation of the Founders.

name: Ruby
description: Kellan's friend who wields an ice sword granted by Hylda and fights Eriette.

name: Salt Road
description: A road on the Tarkir steppes that the Abzan patrol polices.

name: Satoru Umezawa
description: A thief on the crew who disarms the vault trap and plans to triple his fee next time.

name: Ses
description: One of the three heads of Trostani, who weeps for her sister and accepts that Selesnya may end.

name: Shu Yun
description: The ancient Jeskai khan who convenes the khans and offers his life to Ojutai to spare his clan.

name: Sidisi
description: Silumgar's undead naga vizier, whose vengeance plot against the Sultai and the tree Nishang is made to carry out.

name: Skemfar
description: The elven realm of Kaldheim.

name: Slimefoot
description: A thallid who clings to the Weatherlight's powerstone and is rescued by Shanna and Tiana.

name: Sorya
description: A hunter of the party.

name: Subira
description: A caravan master who suspects then defends Teferi, later becoming Niambi's mother.

name: Talion
description: The Faerie Lord who set Kellan's quest and whom Hylda says broke a stalemate by proposing Eriette's sleeping curse to stop the invaders.

name: Tasigur
description: The vain child-khan of the ancient Sultai who bargains with Silumgar and betrays the khans.

name: Te Ju Ki
description: An old holy elder at Arcades's colony who teaches Ugin about planes and cycles of life and death.

name: The Arkbow
description: Vivien's bow containing spirits of beasts that form spectral arrows.

name: The Gods of Amonkhet
description: Animal-headed gods who walk among the people, each overseeing one of the five trials to the afterlife.

name: The Meditation Realm
description: A still-water realm between planes where Ugin meditated and where Bolas killed him.

name: The Roil
description: Zendikar's destructive earth-shaking turmoil that Nahiri suppresses.

name: The Wicked Slumber
description: The curse of sleeping and dream control spread across the Realm.

name: Tinybones
description: A skeleton thief who crosses the light grid to help open the vault.

name: Tolsimir
description: A Selesnya figure whose motionless body lies in Vitu-Ghazi.

name: Vaevictis Asmadi
description: A large bullying dragon who leads his brothers against Nicol's army and is turned on Lividus.

name: Valkyries
description: Winged arbiters of judgement who pour from Koma's rift to fight the demons.

name: Vess Manor
description: Liliana's ruined family home in a corrupted swamp on Dominaria.

name: Vona of Iedo
description: A vampire conquistador who, in the non-canon Legion of Dusk ending, claims Orazca and is eaten by a dinosaur.

name: Wickerfolk
aliases: figures made of wicker woven with flowers
description: Dancing wicker figures that tire never and take dancers' bodies.

name: Wurm Speaker
description: A wrecked science ship in the Wurmwall where Sami and Tannuk met.

name: Yahenni
description: An aetherborn who holds a Penultimate Party, gives away their fortune, and dies on the roof surrounded by friends.

name: Yarus
description: A guild leader who asks whether the fight is over.

name: Aerona
description: Where Arvad was when the Powerstone woke.

name: Aetherspark
description: The prize awarded to the Champions of Amonkhet.

name: Anstruth
description: A being or outcome altered by the object, which Haliya fears applies to her.

name: Beacon
description: Izzet device shut down earlier.

name: Bogardan
description: The volcanic coast where the Weatherlight is moored.

name: Boggarts
description: Goblin-like creatures who raid giants' lairs and fear no death without reward.

name: Borborygmos
description: A cyclops Gruul leader who fights with two maces.

name: Boruvo
description: Rat's centaur godfather who fights in the battle.

name: Boseiju District
description: The great tree over Towashi that once held the plane together and is shattered by Tamiyo's reading.

name: Celestial Palatinate
description: The titanic power behind the Free Company, rival to the Monasteriat.

name: Chimil
description: The god of the Core's sun, restored after Aclazotz's prison is broken.

name: City
description: Dawn's former friend and forager, now an acolyte of the Devouring Father who spared her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.

name: Coin Empire
description: A lost civilization of interest to Quint.

name: Coralhelm
description: A floating landmass ringed by a gorge and roped to the cliff edges, site of Noyan's roilmage retreat.

name: Cosi
description: The merfolk trickster god of old stories, understood as a memory of the titan Kozilek.

name: Cosima
description: The sea goddess who leaps from the river in dolphin form and fights beside Kaya.

name: Cruelclaw
description: A scarred weaselfolk mercenary of the Direshade Company who stole the egg for King Glarb and escapes.

name: Cult of Valgavoth
description: Smiling hosts with screaming eyes who keep guests and read them their holy book.

name: Curse of Wandering
description: The curse raising corpses to roam the streets.

name: Daghatar the Adamant
description: The ancient Abzan khan who destroys the Remembrance and pledges his clan to Dromoka.

name: Danitha Capashen
description: A Dominarian knight who sees a specter of an army on the plain and calls the host of angels to ready.

name: Dawnglove
description: A sacred Shadowmoor flower that is the only cure for Rhain's ailment.

name: Dawnhart Coven
description: The witches whose joined magic raises the Moonsilver Key at the ritual.

name: Demons
description: Winged demons led by Varragoth who attack the clans and are driven off.

name: Dragon's Eye Sanctuary
description: The grandest Jeskai-style sanctuary, where Ojutai teaches from his perch and archives lie beneath it.

name: Dross Pits
description: A layer of rotting necrogen pools ruled by seven thanes.

name: Elves
description: Lorwyn's most favored and feared race, who consider themselves paragons of beauty; in Shadowmoor they are humbled and heroic.

name: Endriders
description: Rugged racers led by Fortune.

name: Fields of Strife
description: A desolate battlefield on Arcavios where the dead relive the Blood Age battles.

name: Forum of Amity
description: A place on Arcavios with a manor, gardens and duelling stages, where ritual has kept the peace for seven hundred years.

name: Fountainport
description: King Glarb's lofty three-tiered soapstone city over Valley's largest pond.

name: Gan Shokta
description: Rat's father who fights in the battle.

name: Gev
description: A lizardfolk fire-mace fighter.

name: Gideon's Irregulars
description: Gideon's band of lost companions on Zendikar.

name: Gideon's sural
description: Gideon's ribbon-like blade weapon.

name: Glyph
description: Nissa's magic for tapping a plane's leyline network so its energy can be channeled through Chandra.

name: Godsend
description: Elspeth's crackling golden blade, a facsimile of the original that works for her.

name: Goodhill
description: Mabel's home town where the party returns to a parade.

name: Great Aurora
description: Oona's braided aurora that locked the plane in one state for centuries.

name: Hanweir
description: Torens's hometown in Gavony, which was swallowed and left an empty pit.

name: Hedron prison
description: A ring of hedrons and leylines that briefly trapped Ulamog and collapses.

name: Hugs
description: A badgerfolk fighter.

name: Hunter Maze
description: A canopy of oily metal-and-flesh trees in New Phyrexia that Vorinclex rules.

name: Ikoria
description: The plane of monsters now under invasion.

name: Illvoi
description: Jellyfish-like cloudsculptors who live in gas giants and repair the Seriema.

name: Immersturm
description: The hot, lava-filled realm of the demons, sealed away long ago by the gods.

name: Jamuraa
description: A continent of Dominaria where armies of Nicol and Arcades fight.

name: Jarad vod Savo
description: A former Golgari guildmaster killed by a Rakdos blood witch in Rix Maadi.

name: Jinnie Fay
description: Jetmir's adoptive daughter and Cabaretti right hand, who captures Elspeth and Vivien and tracks Giada with a spell.

name: Jund
description: A shard of the plane of Alara ruled by tyrannical hellkites and other dragons.

name: Kannah
description: A clan of the Aldergard led by Fynn.

name: Kav
description: The people of Kavaron, whose squads mine and salvage their collapsing homeworld.

name: Kavaron Memorial Navy
description: The Kav navy whose twenty-four irradiated soldiers Sami ferries to safety.

name: Korozda
description: The Golgari maze of concentric circles leading to Svogthos.

name: Kruphix
description: The four-armed, starry god of mysteries and horizons, who tells Kydele that the gods are beliefs that took form in Nyx and fears threats from other worlds.

name: Kylox
description: A paranoid red viashino Izzet inventor and Proft's friend, who is killed by a drugged attacker.

name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
aliases: the plane of light and shadow
description: The twinned plane where the battle is fought.

name: Ludevic
description: A necro-alchemist of Nephalia who builds monsters from animated dead tissue and studies the horror they inspire.

name: Lunarch Council
description: The council of senior bishops that commands the Church of Avacyn, with cathar leaders as advisors.

name: Lys Alana
description: A gilded city of boardwalks and towers in the Gilt-Leaf forest where Morcant rules.

name: Maag Taranau
description: A floating vault above Tarnation with traps, a warded door and a treasure chamber containing a child; it flies into the clouds after being opened.

name: Mallowmass
description: Pinnacle's custom of guest protection that Sami declines to claim.

name: Mana Rig
description: A huge Thran-era walking machine at Shiv with a helm, workshop and mana cannons; Jhoira wakes it and sets its self-destruct.

name: Marina Vendrell
description: A teenage girl whose diary tells how she befriended the bound Valgavoth, was bullied, and let him take four classmates; the House protects her.

name: Markov family
description: Sorin's family, one of whose duelists attacks Arlinn.

name: Mattak
description: A hunter of the party.

name: Mazirek
description: A kraul priest and advisor to Vraska whom Bozak admires and who ends up controlling Bozak's fungus-riddled body.

name: Merrevia Sal
description: A green dragon who crashes into a clearing, injured, is killed by hunters despite killing five of them.

name: Mila
description: Lukka's fox companion.

name: Mogis
description: God of warfare and patron of the minotaurs, the twin and rival of Iroas.

name: Molimo
description: A tree elemental whose seed Jhoira used to regrow the Weatherlight's hull.

name: Monoists
description: Followers of the Immortal Faller who seek supervoids and prepare a suicide assault on the Dawnsire.

name: Mu Yanling
description: A planeswalker with adept command over wind and water, which she uses to travel through the air and in martial combat.

name: Muraganda
description: A jungle plane where Garruk lives.

name: Murasa Skyclave
description: The ruin that reassembles itself after the Core is taken.

name: New Prahv
description: The Azorius guildhall where law runes are written in the sky.

name: Ochran
description: A Golgari group of assassins; Vraska tells the Soldier he is a killer worthy of it.

name: Oliver
description: The mayor of Goodhill who gives a welcome-home speech.

name: Oltec
description: The people of the Core.

name: Omenport
description: A town on Thunder Junction built around an Omenpath, with a half-built relay tower.

name: Orrinshire
description: Kellan's quiet sheep-farming home village.

name: Pachatupa
description: The Sun Empire capital encircled by Phyrexians.

name: Perisophia
description: The current head of the Twelve, the ruling council of philosophers of Meletis, who orders Iris moved to Soli.

name: Point Prime
description: The Monoist holy destination, a lightless supervoid-like place that Reen is making her pilgrimage toward.

name: Quinidad
description: A squire who serves Syr Walker and makes tactical reports during the boarding fight.

name: Radha
description: A Keldon warrior who fights on the Mana Rig with her people's battle cry.

name: Rakshasa
description: Demons who with the naga allow humans to rule the Sultai.

name: Reyhan
description: A military commander who refused to kneel to a dragon, became the last khan of the Abzan, and died protecting other khans in the khanfall.

name: Risona
description: The tall, grave leader of the Uprisers in Sokenzanshi.

name: Sejiri
description: A region ravaged by Ulamog.

name: Selhoff
description: A city on the edge of the world on the Bay of Vustrow, where the story is set.

name: Selvala
description: A well-respected elven explorer whom Adriana asks to be senator of a new Republic of Paliano.

name: Serra's Realm
description: An artificial plane Serra created, where she and her followers lived in peace defended by flights of angels.

name: Sibsig
description: Resurrected undead of the Sultai, once prisoners made to serve, now an honored class.

name: Sigma's Reach
description: A colony on the dwarf world Sigma wrapped in membrawn, fully lit and stocked but empty of life, with traces of people vanishing.

name: Sky Rock
description: The encampment of floating islands around an enormous derelict hedron where the Zendikari gather.

name: Skysovereign
description: The Consulate dreadnought serving as Tezzeret's command deck.

name: Speed Demons
description: Winter's team with glitching vehicle.

name: Stronghold
description: The Cabal's worship hall in Urborg.

name: Sungold Lock
description: The lock joined with the Moonsilver Key to complete the ritual.

name: Sunhome
description: The Boros fortress with blocky towers and flaming pyres; Annex Four is a warehouse for misfits.

name: Suq'Ata
description: A Jamuraan market city where Jhoira finds Shanna.

name: Sword Coast
description: The region where a villainous wizard plans to wage war.

name: Tameshi
description: Kaito's moonfolk Futurist friend and mentor, who is mortally wounded in the warehouse and names Tezzeret before dying.

name: Temmet
description: Oketra's chosen, entombed in a pyramid, whose body is cleansed of corruption by Ketramose.

name: Tenth District Plaza
description: The plaza before the Citadel.

name: The Demon of Duskmourn
description: A skinless demon who tells Winter to bring the Aetherspark or belong to the House.

name: The Emperor of Kamigawa
description: A snow-white-haired girl who rules Kamigawa, forbidden from revealing her name, and who befriends Kaito behind a screen door.

name: The Font
description: A source of Halo guarded by the Cabaretti and moved regularly.

name: The Hours
description: The prophesied era that begins when the second sun settles between the horns.

name: The Joraga
description: The elf tribe of Zendikar's forest to which Nissa belongs, led by Numa.

name: The Metalman's artifact
description: The stone from Sigma held in the Seriema's stasis cask, whose luck and effects the Free Company and Sami debate.

name: The Multiverse
description: The original reality being overlaid by its copy.

name: The Planar Bridge
description: A device in Tezzeret's body that burns his flesh and requires treatment.

name: The Resistance
description: Mirran fighters and Koth's explosives team.

name: The Sanctum
description: The Theorist's sanctum ringed with mage-rings.

name: The Scarab God
aliases: the one with the scarab head
description: A scarab-shaped dark god who leads the Eternals out of the central mausoleum.

name: The Vantoleone
description: The Cabaretti theater with the Red Room, where Kitt debuts.

name: Tilonalli
description: A Sun Empire deity whose light shines on all.

name: Tocatli
description: The imperial citadel in Pachatupa converted to a war room.

name: Torga trolls
description: Giant mossy trolls, some of them animated as undead by the rift, one of which is swept away by Cosima.

name: Ula
aliases: Ula, the sea god of Zendikar's merfolk
description: A god of Zendikar whose bident Kiora holds and calls on.

name: Ulvenwald
description: The forest in Kessig where all roads lead to the Celestus.

name: Useless Island
description: An island in Jace's mind where he retreats.

name: Uthros Combine
description: A rival research outfit whose secret facility in the core of Uthros is thought to hold something big.

name: Venerable Tarrian
description: The author of the scriptures that guide Vito.

name: Vial Smasher
description: A brash goblin of the Kolaghan clan on Tarkir who handles and smashes vials of dragonfire.

name: Vin
description: A commentator who broadcasts the finish-line fight and is saved by Elspeth.

name: Vorel
description: A Simic former Gruul clan leader who fights with a biomantic mace.

name: Werewolves
description: Mad, lattice-marked werewolves that attack Jace on the hill; one mutates when he overloads its mind.

name: Whisperers
description: Hooded mountain folk who remember the dragons and chant of their voices.

name: Worldsoul
description: The living soul of Ravnica that speaks through Trostani.

name: Xander
description: The old vampire-demon leader of the Maestros and curator of its museum, who sends Anhelo to the Crescendo and is killed by the Adversary.

name: Zantafar
description: A legendary lost loxodon city hidden beneath Pillardrop and found by Quint and Asterion.

name: Zoraline
description: A batfolk cleric.

name: Abuelo
description: An Oltec Echo bound to a poncho.

name: Academy
description: The now-disbanded institution whose former masters retreat to private workshops.

name: Adriana
description: The stripped captain of the guard of Paliano who carries Brago's sword and calls on the citizens to defy the usurper queen.

name: Aether Hub
description: Ghirapur's beating heart, directing the city's aether supply, which the renegades capture.

name: Agatha
description: A Kessig widow whose husband Finneas was killed the previous night and who tells Arlinn about the witch.

name: Agency headquarters
description: The Agency's building, wrecked by Anzrag.

name: Agrus Kos
description: A ghost Boros investigator who goes alone to Rix Maadi and is trapped in a crystal skull by Judith.

name: Akal Pakal
description: The Oltec steward who mobilizes the gardeners.

name: Alacrian Quickbeasts
description: A flying beast team.

name: Aldergard
description: A pine forest where the Kannah warriors gather to face Arni.

name: Anathalmanac
description: A catalog of terrors given to Vondam and Haliya that lays out protocols for handling the object, including radiant resignation.

name: Anchin
description: Yasova's sabertooth companion.

name: Angels of New Capenna
description: Angels who defend New Capenna and then fly through portals to protect the Multiverse.

name: Anim Pakal
description: Akal's sister and commander of the Thousand Moons.

name: Annie's nephew
description: A nephew badly injured by Akul during a failed exchange.

name: Anowon
description: A disgraced Malakir vampire sage of House Ghet who joins Tarsa's party to study the Ondu Skyclave, hoping for knowledge and redemption.

name: Anzrag
description: A Gruul harvest god in the form of a giant star-nosed mole, who escapes the evidence locker and wrecks Agency headquarters.

name: Araithia Shokta
description: A Gateless Gruul-born young woman, insignificant by birth magic, who narrates the battle and guards her friends; she loses Hekara's recognition.

name: Archaics
