description: Giant many-armed beings that chant in coordinated patterns; six gather around a snarl in the hollow titan and many act strangely.

name: Argoth
description: The island where the sylex was used and the war ended.

name: Ari Shokta
description: Rat's Gruul warrior mother who lends her an axe.

name: Ashnod
description: An artificer said in one legend to have carved the sylex from a qadir's skullcap.

name: Astelli
description: A luminous species of quantum-probabilistic angels, twin to the Susurians who founded the True Faith, aligned with the Sunstar side.

name: Asterion
description: A spirit summoned into his statue, a noble who died six hundred years ago in a cave while seeking the lost city of Zantafar.

name: Atarka's broodling
description: A red antlered dragon that follows the party, kills the Ojutai broodling, and then attacks the camp before Naiva kills it.

name: Auvernine
description: A Witherbloom friend of Rowan crawling through a root tunnel.

name: Basket hilts
description: Kellan's fae hilts that he uses as a whip of golden vine.

name: Bilagru
description: An Orzhov giant who fights beside Kaya.

name: Birgi
description: A storyteller who is really a goddess, with amethyst eyes and shimmering tattoos, who provokes a brawl between Kannah and Omenseekers.

name: Bloomburrow
description: A plane where a second world appears alongside the first.

name: Bow's End
description: A circular tavern that turns into an arena for duels.

name: Caligo Morass
description: The marsh where the Cabal operates.

name: Calix
description: A planeswalker artificially created on Theros to keep Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld; his Spark ignited when he failed.

name: Candela
description: A flying-city shieldship that escorts and protects the Dawnsire.

name: Captain Vance
description: The Brazen Coalition captain to whom Malcolm must report.

name: Caves of Koilos
description: A cave network on Dominaria, once a Thran prison, where Karn digs for the secret of the sylex.

name: Cecilee
description: Ruzi's sister, once a mute elf girl who became a voice of the Worldsoul, who founds a Selesnya settlement in the Rubblebelt and is killed by Massacre Girl.

name: Cherazad
description: A fast-time bubble that freezes the battle around the Seriema.

name: Clem
description: Mabel's husband, who welcomes her home.

name: Coalition
description: The allied army of many species defending Dominaria from the Phyrexians.

name: Colfenor
description: A yew treefolk whose sapling's death presumably ended the yew subspecies; Rhys was his former apprentice.

name: Compleation
description: The Phyrexian campaign to alter the world of Mirrodin.

name: Consul Kambal
description: The Consul of Allocation who pressures Sram to obey Tezzeret's order and then flees the Hub.

name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
description: A blasted region of Tarkir where the spirit dragons were called, now home to floating hedrons and a gathering dragonstorm.

name: Cryomancer Chandra
description: The Echoverse double of Chandra who freezes the ground and Liliana's dress; she fades to a ghost.

name: Cryptoliths
description: Twisted stones that bend Innistrad's leylines, which Nahiri arranges to hide herself from the Eldrazi-touched monsters.

name: Dack Fayden
description: A human mage from Drakeston on Fiora who became a planeswalker and the greatest thief in the Multiverse.

name: Darka
description: A quiet ainok hunter whom Atarka seizes and eats.

name: Dekatia
description: The academy in Meletis where the finest minds convene.

name: Denzilore Fatehold
description: A three-faced Echoverse sphinx who founded his school to improve outlook for denizens of Arcavios, surrounded by scrolls showing the past, present and future.

name: Domri Rade
description: A planeswalker with an affinity for wild creatures, which he summons, commands and enhances; leader of the Gruul on Ravnica.

name: Dragonsguard
description: An elite group of mages who work directly with the Founder Dragons to support their work.

name: Dreadhorde
description: Bolas's army of undead Eternals controlled by Liliana.

name: Edgewall
description: The town where Kellan and Ruby return and find the Slumber's violet threads everywhere.

name: Elspeth Tyrel
description: A planeswalker sent by Ajani who protects Giada, finds her sense of home and purpose in New Capenna, and receives a Halo-forged sword before wounding the Adversary.

name: Embassy of the Guildpact
description: The ruined site where the ritual takes place.

name: Embrose Lu
description: Silverquill's shadow dean, a poet and Killian's father, who comes to the Forum as mediator.

name: Ertai
description: A Phyrexian-revived mage with doubled arms who was left behind by the Weatherlight; he nearly pulls Karn apart.

name: Eshki Dragonclaw
description: The proud wrestler-leader of the Temur, who rose to lead the rebellion and now leads her clan through a blue curse.

name: Esper
description: A shard of Alara: a hegemony of wizards and sphinxes whose forces seek carmot to create more etherium.

name: Etherium
description: A rare metal that Tezzeret reshapes into a message and gives to Estel.

name: Faeries
description: The only race unchanged by the transformation, who dwell in Glen Elendra and are the fulcrum of the transforming plane.

name: Fateshifters
description: Tokens of Aminatou's power that rewind a fatal choice.

name: Femeref
description: The walled city of Jamuraa where the Council of Voices rules.

name: Foggy
description: One of Mabel's children.

name: Garden of Apeiron
description: A vast uncanny region at the edge of the system where the Inspirit drifts.

name: Gared
description: A geistmage's apprentice with a bulging eye and an asymmetrical body who serves Liliana.

name: Gavven
description: The dour coxswain of The Belligerent.

name: Geyadrone Dihada
description: A devious, power-hungry and untrustworthy shapeshifting conqueror and planeswalker who quickly betrayed her word once she gained an advantage.

name: Ghostfire warriors
description: Jeskai warriors who wield spectral blades.

name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
description: The forest containing the waterfall and a grove Isilu has taken, where dawnglove grows.

name: Gobakhan
description: The plane of Teyo and its diamond storms.

name: Gremlins
description: Aether-eating creatures released to drain the turret.

name: Grenzo
description: A hunched, hulking goblin with a staff who leads goblin lackeys, breaks into Fimarell's villa and burns it, and is locked out of his dungeons by Marchesa.

name: Guns of Kavaron
description: Kavaron's orbital-boost lasers, bounced off stratospheric mirrors, which Tannuk turns against the Free Company and then uses to push the Seriema out of the system.

name: Gvar Barzeel
description: The Kolaghan orc who led the attack on Sandsteppe Gateway and is killed by Anafenza's ancestor spirits.

name: Hadi
description: A Tolarian artificer who works with Tiana to rebuild the Weatherlight.

name: Halimar Sea
description: The sea that Kiora empties to hurl at Nissa.

name: Hapatra
description: A vizier and master of poisons who declines to return to the city and instead leads the survivors to refuge in the sands.

name: Havengul
description: The sterile, industrial city where Geralf works and which the Phyrexians attack.

name: Hedron shard
description: The shard from the Eye of Ugin's inner chamber that traveled back through time and still floats over Ugin's palm.

name: High Moors
description: Chilly highlands where a large, grassy, cracked hill stands.

name: Hopelight warmaker
description: A Sunstar fighter, callsign Flare Three, that pursues the Seriema and is destroyed by the Guns.

name: House Capashen
description: The Benalish noble house whose knights fight in Danitha's army.

name: House Emesh
description: An Abzan house whose old representative wants active defenses.

name: Imbraham
description: A winged Quandrix dean who teaches theory and who once taught Nimiroti.

name: Imodane
description: A wooden-armed knight now fighting for Will, who rejoins the battle against Rowan.

name: Inga Rune-Eyes
description: The leader of the Omenseekers who brings Kaya and Tyvar to the clan council.

name: Ingris Stingerquill
description: A sphinx who reads emotions and influences others with words, teaching followers to draw power from their core; her group is Hexhaven's first line of defense against mage hunters and witchstalkers.

name: Iris
description: The blind Oracle of Ephara of Meletis, whose gift of foresight comes from touch; she falls in love with her bodyguard Alexio.

name: Isidor
description: Cataline's young squire, raised among mirror-makers, who is flensed by the Thinner's tides.

name: Jerren
description: A bishop who is nominal leader of the Lunarch Council and is accused of leading the Skirsdag in communion with Ormendahl.

name: Jiang Yanggu
description: A planeswalker who cannot remember his name, past or family and calls himself Yanggu after the first place he remembers.

name: Jukai Forest
description: The forest where Tameshi hides his makeshift laboratory.

name: Kallist
description: A friend of Jace whose death he regrets.

name: Kamiz
description: An Obscura member of Errant's team who reads tagger's scrawl.

name: Karfell
description: The coldest, most remote realm, where Valki is held.

name: Katsumasa
description: A renowned Futurist engineer of Otawara with a telepathic implant, who builds the Epoch Engine and withholds the truth about it from Kotori.

name: Keld
description: Where the Weatherlight will take Radha home.

name: Khanfall
description: The last battle against the dragons on Tarkir.

name: Kher Ridges
description: The mountain range that separates Penregon and the east from the green west.

name: Kin-tree
description: A sacred tree that binds an Abzan house to its ancestors, whose spirits flower into it; House Fenzala's is young and was planted two years earlier.

name: Kin-trees
description: Abzan sacred plants, half living wood and half golden spirit, that bind the clan to its ancestors.

name: King Lucard
description: The vampire king of Luneau, attacked by an enlarged spider during Vivien's escape.

name: Kithkin
description: The kithkin of Goldmeadow who revert to their original states when the night recedes.

name: Lady Ana
description: A trainer in Liliana's youth with the Forward Order.

name: Lambholt
description: A small farming village in Kessig with a palisade, an inn and a stone town hall, the birthplace of Vadrik's husband.

name: Linden
description: Rowan's stepmother, who appears in her dream.

name: Lisette
description: A Witherbloom dean who helps rescue the twins and tends Will's wound.

name: Living Guildpact
description: The impartial arbiter power over the ten guilds that Jace lost and Niv-Mizzet is to take.

name: Luneau
description: The vampire city of Ixalan, whose palace, ballroom, menagerie and cultural district are wrecked by Vivien and her summoned beasts.

name: Lyra Dawnbringer
description: The commander of the angels of Serra who first refuses Liliana entry to Benalia City.

name: Machine Orthodoxy
description: The Phyrexian order that Ixhel serves.

name: Maestros' Museum
description: The museum of the Maestros in Park Heights, which is being repaired.

name: Mantis
description: A Eumidian Pinnacle officer who diverts an eld so Sami and Tannuk can arm the reactor, and is later said to have been saved by Barrow.

name: Mardun
description: The river that Mishra's force crossed to take the River Wards.

name: Mat'Selesnya
description: The Worldsoul of Ravnica whose power Oba draws on.

name: Matzalantli
description: The sealed golden door and garrison at the entrance to the Core.

name: Merrow
description: Fish-finned bipeds with spears who find Abigale in the stream and sign to her.

name: Mikaeus
description: The lunarch whose body Liliana took in Thraben.

name: Minotaurs
description: The horde that ambushes the Alamon, hunts them deliberately and builds a wall around Akros to besiege it.

name: Mitul
description: Rashmi's vedalken friend and research partner, now with the renegades.

name: Mowu
description: Yanggu's loyal hound.

name: Muzzio
description: A brilliant inventor and professor at the Academy at High Paliano whose constructs spy on the city and who manipulates the board to gain the vice chancellorship.

name: Mycotyrant
description: A fungal overlord whose army is destroyed in the Core but whose spores survive and continue spreading.

name: Naya
description: A shard of Alara: a lush jungle paradise whose forces follow the elves' decrees.

name: Nezumi
description: Rat-like people held captive in wicker cages, including Nashi.

name: Nicanzil
description: A merfolk warrior who meets Malcolm and Breeches and says the Core must be warned.

name: Nido Sanctuary
description: The Brokers' headquarters at the top of Park Heights where Falco's office stands.

name: Nur
description: The Abzan djinni who arrives to back up Ajani's report of Sarkhan's dragons.

name: Nylea
description: A god of Theros who with Heliod bound Polukranos beneath the earth.

name: Nyxborn
description: Creatures with night-sky skin of many shapes, once emissaries of the gods, who attack a bridge-gate and slaughter the narrator's company.

name: Obzedat
description: The ghostly ruling council of the Orzhov guild, made up of dead patriarchs and matriarchs, who dominate Teysa.

name: Ojutai's broodling
description: The slender Ojutai dragon killed in battle; Yasova presents its corpse to Atarka as a kill by the hunters.

name: Onakke
description: An ancient civilization of horned or tusked ogres of Shandalar, wiped out by a purplish cloud in a vision, whose spirits haunt the Chain Veil.

name: Operation Desperation
description: The plan, needing all ten guilds, the leylines and Niv-Mizzet's bones, to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.

name: Order of Saint Traft
description: Thalia's army of rebellious soldiers, cathars and clergy sworn to Saint Traft.

name: Order of the Holly Leaf
description: An order of heroes from the era of great weavers.

name: Ormendahl
description: A demon whose essence appears in the pool of blood and tears, whom Henrika serves as dealmaker, and who sinks back into oblivion.

name: Orzhova
description: The church-city of the Orzhov, with a basilica and a Boros outpost prison.

name: Paradox Gardens
description: A Quandrix research site in the southeast with strange natural and temporal anomalies.

name: Pedron the Wicked
description: A figure the order wanted to protect the Immortal Sun from.

name: Penregon
description: The coastal city that Kayla rules and eventually abandons as the ice age approaches.

name: Peter
description: Ruby's brother, a hunter who lends them cloaks and escorts them most of the way to Loch Larent.

name: Pewter
description: Jace's childhood horse whose horseshoe is in his bedroom.

name: Pharika
description: A god whose virulent poison the satyr compares to worry.

name: Phenax
description: A god who, the satyr says, created worry; worrying is worshipping him.

name: Phyrexian note
description: A note in Teysa's handwriting but written in Phyrexian script, hidden among broken statue pieces.

name: Pip
description: Mabel's youngest child.

name: Plargg
description: A Lorehold dean known for chaotic ways.

name: Plink
description: A Witherbloom friend of Rowan crawling through a root tunnel.

name: Pondside
description: The ruined village, whose villagers fled south toward Haymeadow.

name: Powerstone
description: The Thran powerstone that powers the watchtower and that Stenn uses to broadcast.

name: Prosperity
description: The bustling metropolis on Thunder Junction where the Sterling Company is headquartered.

name: Purphoros
description: A god of Theros whose fury knocked Polukranos from the stars and who forged the Champion's spear in the story.

name: Quint
description: Will's long-snouted, tea-loving friend who knows spells for digs and revels in history.

name: Rat
description: A small Gateless thief and eavesdropper who follows Kaya and Teyo and still mourns Hekara.

name: Ratfolk lorekeepers
description: A community of ratfolk who preserve Bloomburrow's history in an ossuary beneath the marsh.

name: Reality Chip
description: A chip that augments the wearer's powers; it passes from the emperor to Tamiyo, and Tezzeret seizes control of it.

name: Redshift
description: A goblin whose rockets land near Chandra while controlled.

name: Rix Maadi
description: The Rakdos guildhall above the lava pit where Rakdos sleeps.

name: Rosalyn
description: Mabel's eldest child.

name: Ruzi
description: A Selesnya Wolf Rider who finds his sister's settlement slaughtered, kills Massacre Girl's ogre, and resolves to break from Selesnya to destroy Massacre Girl.

name: Saddlebrush
description: A small frontier town where Annie lives, threatened by the rattlewurm.

name: Saint Traft
description: An ancient demon-battling saint whose geist inhabits Thalia and guides, protects and heals her.

name: Seble
description: An elf airborne sentry mounted on a manta who spots the titan.

name: Seedcore
description: The core of New Phyrexia containing a miniature recreation of Elesh Norn's citadel and the root of the World Tree.

name: Sekhar
description: A bead holding a microvoid that, when taken, collapses the wearer into a black hole entangled with Point Prime.

name: Setessa
description: The isolated, fiercely independent polis surrounded by concentric rings of forest, whose people venerate nature.

name: Shadowblayde
description: A dark-skinned elf renegade who runs communications with mechanical butterflies and rescues Gideon from a wrecked Gearhulk.

name: Shadrix Silverquill
description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, a master wordsmith who oversees diplomacy at the Forum of Amity.

name: Shiko
description: The Jeskai spirit dragon Narset wishes could be by her side.

name: Skoti
description: The gods of Kaldheim, whom the elves distrust.

name: Skyclave key
description: The glowing key Nahiri uses to light a path and open the wall of the Core's chamber.

name: Soratami
description: The security-minded moonfolk who guard Otawara.

name: Spark
description: The spark carried in Karn that he uses to filter Nissa and Ajani's sparks.

name: Spectacle Summit
description: The mountaintop where Summitfest and the gallery are held.

name: Stenn
description: A New Argive nobleman who turns out to be a compleated Phyrexian sleeper agent that transmits the sylex's false location to Sheoldred.

name: Sunder Bay
description: The bay below the Skyclave where Akiri's party left their griffins.

name: Sundog
description: The Sunstar palestar that lasers Taro-duend, recovers its troops and leaves on a fusion blast.

name: Sunray Bay
description: A town deserted and marked by the Mycotyrant's spores.

name: Surgical Bay
description: Jin-Gitaxias's sphere where Ixhel makes Vishgraz.

name: Tah crop
description: A group of twenty initiates that Gideon joins to face the Trial of Ambition.

name: Team Cloudspire
description: Chandra's racing team.

name: Terisiare
description: The continent devastated by the cataclysm and slowly freezing.

name: The Adversary
description: A planeswalker demon who holds real control over New Capenna's shadows and runs a lounge as a base of operations; this page does not name him.

name: The Clean Slate
description: An aberration of Jace who carves a path to the Theorist's brain stem.

name: The Core
description: The hollow world under Ixalan where the final battle takes place.

name: The Detective
description: An aberration of Jace who advises Vraska to aim at forty-seven degrees and cuts the Theorist's connection to the weaving.

name: The Drownyard
description: The ring of twisted stone pillars off the coast where Emrakul rises from the sea.

name: The Endstone
description: A stone that changes into a black ovoid and points at Tezzeret; it is carried to the Wurmwall and taken by the Last Thing.

name: The Eye of Ugin
aliases: the chamber of the Spirit Dragon
description: The stone hall in Akoum where the great hedron stands, the nexus point of the hedron network, and where the three Planeswalkers can summon each other.

name: The Flood Gar
description: A Calamity Beast, an enormous silver fish with glowing markings that floods the Docklands.

name: The Floodpits
description: A dripping cool region where Dawn hopes to find the Benefactors.

name: The Folioplex
description: A building at Hexhaven whose back holds a mage-ring.

name: The Great Conduit
description: The aether stream visible above Yahenni during their farewell.

name: The Implicit Maze
description: The Ravnican maze where Jace became the Living Guildpact, visited as a memory room.

name: The Invasion Tree
description: The Phyrexian tree where Jace takes the sylex.

name: The Legacy
description: The only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes, made of many artifacts forged from destruction, many of them stolen from the child Gerrard.

name: The Mending
description: An event several years before this scene after which Teferi wandered.

name: The Necropolis
description: The imposing building beyond the Gate housing the dead and sarcophagi that hide the three gods.

name: The Nexus
description: A whirling pit of magic that makes reality ripple and that Tam falls into.

name: The Nihilist
description: An aberration of Jace who encourages Vraska not to flinch and slams a wall of hopelessness around the Theorist's consciousness.

name: The Returned
description: Soulless, moaning dead who return from the Underworld by forging a new identity.

name: The Scorpion God
description: A corrupted god who pursues Hazoret, loses her arm to poison, and is killed by Hazoret after Samut and the survivors cripple it.

name: The Shattered
description: Chandra's students, a cohort who ambushed the group and now dig alongside it.

name: The Soldier
description: An aberration of Jace who advises killing swiftly and plucks out the part of the Theorist's mind that remembers how to breathe.

name: The Sun Empire
description: The humans of Ixalan whose ancient ruins lie in the jungle.

name: The Tower
description: Jace's tower with a sanctum, orrery and mage-rings.

name: The Vastwood Forest
description: The forest where Nissa keeps vigil.

name: The Void
description: A silenced zone near the Biblioplex where students scream without being heard.

name: The Warden
aliases: the Jace who keeps the lid on the jar
description: An aberration of Jace who forces the Theorist to kneel and fills his mind with visions of his tormentors.

name: The Weft
description: The layered fabric of reality that Drix can walk without an eternity drive.

name: The birth mountain
description: The mountain where the twins hatched, surrounded by dragon-killer settlements.

name: The fang-sword
description: Mabel's flame-wreathed sword.

name: The horns of Nicol Bolas
description: Massive twin horns on the horizon beside the second sun.

name: Thousand Moons
description: The Oltec warriors led by Anim Pakal.

name: Three Tree City
description: A city built in an oak, sycamore and willow along the Long River, with the Docklands and Quilted District.

name: Threefold Sun
description: The Sun Empire's divine triad served by Caztaca.

name: Thune
description: A kingdom on Shandalar.

name: Tolarian Academy
description: The academy where Ulf studies and where the Phyrexians have infiltrated.

name: Troyan
description: A blue-skinned guide and professional wanderer who claims not to be born in Eldraine and gives them frog potions.

name: Undercity
description: The surface district beneath Towashi's skyscrapers where Tameshi's secret meeting takes place.

name: Valley
description: The home of Mabel, saved from Maha.

name: Varragoth
description: A winged demon jarl with an iron axe, long imprisoned, who attacks the ravens and Kaya's group and is killed by Kaya.

name: Voldaren Manor
description: Olivia's manor where the battle is fought.

name: Voldaren family
description: Olivia's vampire house, whose guards and portraits fill the manor.

name: Vona de Iedo
description: A vampire who rejected the church's teachings and whom Aclazotz wants at his right wing.

name: Walker
description: A knight of the Sunstar Free Company who fights alongside Vondam and later secures the nearest inevitor.

name: Wanderwine
description: The river that the group travels, now cut by a line of night.

name: War of the Spark
description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica, which ends with his death.

name: Windfolk
description: Gauzy, tentacle-haired air elementals who come to Baishya to warn her and pass on a message.

name: Xavier Sal
description: The mayor of Downtown, now infected and speaking for the Mycotyrant.

name: Yahenni's penthouse
description: The penthouse where Yahenni's Penultimate Party takes place and where Yahenni dies on the roof.

name: Yoshimaru
description: The Wanderer's dog, reunited with her on Kamigawa.

name: Zacama
description: The three-headed elder dinosaur who answers last, kills Etali and communicates gratitude to Huatli.

name: Zahur
description: The Champions' leader who calls the hippos pulling the chariot over the finish line.

name: Ziatora
description: A dragon and orator of the Riveteers who rallies workers against the other families.

name: Zombies
description: Liliana's undead servants, including tattered sentries.

name: Abbot Serenok
description: The aging abbot of Keral Keep who trains Chandra and dies in his sleep.

name: Abuela
description: Abuelo's wife, restored as an Echo bound to her khipu.

name: Accumulator
description: Ral Zarek's back-mounted device that stores and fires lightning.

name: Aerid Konstrari
description: A sphinx who animates inert materials using heartwood crystals charged from the leyline confluence under Hexhaven and has taught followers to build huge constructs.

name: Aesrias
description: A strong Akroan warrior blessed by Iroas who prefers to fight with his fists, narrating how he is framed and sent to the arena.

name: Aetheric disruptor
description: A device that tears magic from metal, built by Jukai-sworn crafters and used in the trap against the Mukotai.

name: Agnomakhos
description: An immortal archon and tyrant of antiquity whose empire was ended by Kynaios and Tiro.

name: Aiman
description: An old one-eyed Fallaji veteran who lost his eye at the Siege of Kroog and speaks fluent Argivian; he joins Farid's night patrol.

name: Ajani's double
description: The Echoverse double of Ajani, turned to stone by Vraska's gaze.

name: Akoum Skyclave
description: The Skyclave where Nahiri killed the fern elemental.

name: Alena
description: Hal's steady partner, who fights corrupted townsfolk in the Ulvenwald.

name: Alesha
description: The young Mardu khan who joins the summit and afterward refuses to kneel to dragons, choosing instead to follow Kolaghan.

name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
aliases: the young khan of the Mardu
description: The nineteen-year-old Mardu khan who won her war name at sixteen and defeats dragons in battle; she is called a boy by some but knows who she is.

name: Alniul, the Twice Whisperer
description: A Temur whisperer and Eshki's old friend who speaks with ancestral spirits and leads the ritual to heal the curse.

name: Alyse
description: Kellan's mother.

name: Annals of the Sage Eye
description: Shu Yun's private history, a set of scrolls recorded by Quan, partly hidden under Dirgur.

name: Antifex
description: A figure whose hierophants include Vito.

name: Aradara Station
description: A station where Pia and Chandra arrive on their way to the mosaic.

name: Army of Zendikar
description: The ragtag force of kor, merfolk, elves, humans, goblins and vampires that holds Sea Gate.

name: Arni Brokenbrow
description: The grinning leader of the Tuskeri who holds off draugr so Kaya and Tyvar can reach the bridge.

name: Aron Capashen
description: The leader of House Capashen, compleated by the Phyrexians and beheaded by Danitha.

name: Atarka clan
description: The clan that hunts to feed its dragonlord, with Surrak as Hunt Caller.

name: Auntie Grub
description: A boggart sage, matriarch and apothecary with a frog familiar named Smlurf, source of many boggart parables.

name: Avaati Vya
description: An inventor whose prototype aether refiner is at the Museum of Invention.

name: Aven interpreter
description: An aven who translates for the Ojutai broodling and is killed by Naiva's and Yasova's spears.

name: Avtyr
description: A black-winged Valkyrie reaper whom Niko trapped earlier, who accuses Niko before helping and finally saves them from falling.

name: Azorius Senate House
description: Where the second summit of planeswalkers takes place.

name: Baron of Vernot
description: A vampire nobleman and scientist of Luneau who forces Vivien to demonstrate the Arkbow and is bitten in half by the monstrosaur.

name: Barrow
description: A Drix sentinel at the cofferdam who kills an eld with a blackbody divergence and tells Sami to wash away potential matter.

name: Battle for Zendikar
description: The war against the Eldrazi at Sea Gate.

name: Beckett Brass
description: The admiral and governor of the Brazen Coalition, who bursts in to demand recognition for her coalition as a nation.

name: Beledros Witherbloom
description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, a patient observer and the second to leave it to the professors.

name: Benalia
description: The city where Gerrard lives as a master-at-arms and where the Weatherlight docks.

name: Benalia City
description: The well-guarded Benalish capital with stained-glass gates.

name: Benefactors
description: Survivors in patched clothes hiding in a theater who fight the House and welcome Dawn.

name: Beskir
description: The clan led by Sigrid whose stronghold hosts the council.

name: Black Rose
description: A group Vito associates with Bartolomé.

name: Blood Avatar
description: A four-armed war creature summoned from the Snarl, which wrecks the Hall of Oracles and is finally pulled back into the Snarl.

name: Bontu's monument
description: A pyramid holding a sealed chamber where Samut finds the God-Pharaoh's true title.

name: Brago's sword
description: The ghost king's sword, left behind when he dies; Adriana takes it and wields it as a symbol.

name: Bright Sum
description: The Summist doctrine of increasing the light and life of the cosmos through calculation, which Haliya is told to look to.

name: Calamity Beast egg
description: A large velvety blue egg with starry specks, held in a lattice nest in King Glarb's throne room.

name: Candleguides
description: Wax-faced scarecrow guides born of village anxieties, which float in the witches' enclave.

name: Carmot
description: An element Esper needs to create more of its dwindling etherium.

name: Cataphrin
description: A squire, daughter of a minor Cosmogrand, who briefs her bind on the Monoist suicide attack.

name: Cathedral Opulent
description: The Orzhov guildhall where Kaya meets the Triumvirate.

name: Caztaca Huicintli
description: The apex priestess of the Threefold Sun and the late emperor's eldest daughter, who leads a conspiracy to depose Atlacan and avert war.

name: Chaos Wall
description: A wall where Tezzeret was ejected and the Weftwinder makes its home.

name: Chevill's hunters
description: Black-clad exterminators who ambush the Lukka titan.

name: Chief Numa
description: The Chief of the Joraga who sends Nissa and her mother away to protect his tribe.

name: Church of Dusk
description: The vampire church facing schism.

name: Civils
description: Tawnos's automatons, adapted back into war machines for the siege.

name: Cloud Spire
description: Raffine's sanctum high in the clouds.

name: Codex Vocifera
description: A sentient codex on creaky metal legs that knows much of the Biblioplex but is restricted by a redaction spell.

name: Colony's End
description: A huge ruined colonizer ship embedded in a mountain with intact tanks.

name: Commander Faiso
description: The youngest human to command a legion of Dromoka troops, a master of aerial strategy.

name: Conflux
description: The plane-spanning event that united Alara's shards.

name: Cori Mountain Monastery
description: A Jeskai monastery of orange and red pagodas beside a caldera lake, where Asham is a disciple.

name: Cori Mountain Stronghold
description: A Jeskai stronghold where Kela's mentor taught her to believe in herself.

name: Cosima's longship
description: A god's ship that carried Kaya through the Cosmos with no oars or rudder.

name: Cosmium
description: A pink crystal used in Oltec armor, weapons and devices and in the key to Aclazotz's prison.

name: Cosmium eaters
description: Aclazotz's worshippers in the Core.

name: Cosmium reef
description: A dangerous glowing pink trail of metal and cosmium crystals stretching from the broken shell around the sun.

name: Cosmos
description: The starry void around Istfell and the realms where the wolf wanders.

name: Council of Houses
description: The Abzan council of house heads advising the khan.

name: Crescent of Morningtide
description: A relic that Sygg's former friends never returned.

name: Crovax
description: A dark-skinned nobleman obsessed with finding the angel Selenia, whom Starke tricks into leaving his family and who later joins Gerrard.

name: Cursemute
description: A magical edict from Avacyn that gave werewolves the choice to become wolfir or, more rarely, be fully cured.

name: Dakkon Blackblade
description: A warrior and master blacksmith who became a planeswalker after forging a soul-drinking sword for Geyadrone Dihada, who then betrayed him.

name: Dame Exava
description: A Rakdos blood witch present at the guild meeting.

name: Darigaaz
description: A dragon who leads the dragons against the compleated Weatherlight and the Phyrexian dreadnoughts.

name: Dawn
description: A young survivor and inventor of traps who escaped the carnival's fall and now builds weapons in the attic encampment.

name: Dawnheart Coven
description: The witches running the Harvesttide ritual and warding the festival.

name: Dean Nev
description: A merfolk Quandrix dean and twin of Adrix, focused on the physical manifestation of abstract theory.

name: Dean Shaile
description: A compleated owlin dean with a web mouth who seizes Killian.

name: Deeproot Tree
description: The River Herald community Tishana will summon to Orazca.

name: Dellian Fel
description: A Strixhaven professor who walks calmly through falling rubble, conjuring plants.

name: Devils
description: Small demonic servants of Umbris who kidnap Aleksandar and carry out his will.

name: Dierk
description: A geistmage and spirit expert supplied by Olivia who helps Liliana test the Chain Veil and is killed by werewolves, then reanimated.

name: Dires
description: Huge lycanthropes taller than blacksmiths, who fight with hammers in the raid.

name: Dirgur Stronghold
description: The Jeskai stronghold where the five khans meet and are attacked by dragons.

name: Doco
description: An avian inkling that accompanies Killian and communicates through gestures.

name: Domnathi
description: A vampire bloodline serving a demon and attacking the chapel.

name: Dragon tempest
description: A storm that births dragons, passing over the camp.

name: Dragonlords
description: The ruling dragons who mean to obliterate knowledge of the past.

name: Dragons
description: The Founder dragons who arrive roaring and burn the mage hunters.

name: Drasus
description: One of Gideon's Irregulars from Akros, seen in a dementia illusion.

name: Draugr
description: Blue-bladed attackers who steal Lyana's wolf and chain it at their camp.

name: Dromoka clan
description: The clan of the dragonlord Dromoka, whose army includes ainok, humans, and aven.

name: Echo
description: A spirit bound to an object; Echoes counter the fungus by turning themselves into a sickness.

name: Echoverse Chandra
description: A blue-streaked cryomancer version of Chandra in which her father did not die, who attacks the allies.

name: Elder Kolman
description: A holy elder transformed into a monster that chants Emrakul's name, killed by Hal and Alena.

name: Elgaud Grounds
description: The grounds with a small chapel where Arlinn is made an archmage.

name: Elves of Skemfar
description: Brass-armored army led by Harald that comes to join the battle.

name: Emperor Apatzec
description: The emperor of the Sun Empire who plans to invade Fort Adanto and refuses to let Huatli tell her true story.

name: Emperor Apatzec III
description: The Sun Empire's emperor who occupies Orazca and declares a new age of conquest.

name: Emrakul's Cultists
description: Devotees of Emrakul who follow Nahiri and chant at Markov Manor.

name: Erec
description: A Kenrith sibling whom Will says needs them.

name: Erem
description: A kor warrior fighting beside Tazri who is dragged into a seedpod and transformed.

name: Errant
description: A painter and tagger raised among the Maestros who works with the New Capennan resistance, placing charges in the city's core and fighting converter beasts with Halo paint.

name: Ervos Trax
description: A charming criminal boss of the lowlands, Marchesa's longtime business partner, who poisons himself to deny her his death.

name: Esika
description: The goddess who brews the potion of divinity from the sap of the World Tree and is mortally wounded by a monster in her sanctum.

name: Eternal Ice
description: A sacred mountain whose snowfield breaks in an avalanche.

name: Ever-Burning Oak
description: A place Gev wants to holiday at.

name: Falco
description: The aven boss of the Brokers who demands absolute adherence to contracts and is stockpiling Halo for a coming war.

name: Falkenrath
description: A vampire bloodline that has earned a new name for itself.

name: Fallaji
description: The Imperial army of Tomakul under the qadir.

name: Fern Elemental
description: A tall elemental Nissa calls from a fern, which helps them and dies when Nahiri uses the key to stop the Roil.

name: Fort Adanto
description: A walled Legion of Dusk garrison fort on the coast with a church and holding cells.

name: Forward Order
description: A convocation of clerics in Benalia to which the Echoverse Liliana belonged.

name: Founder Dragons
description: Five mighty elder dragons who founded Strixhaven and ended the Blood Age.

name: Freestriders
description: An outlaw group Annie belonged to that robbed Akul.

name: Freyalise
description: A half-elven planeswalker from a bygone era and leader of elven clans who sacrificed her life to save her people.

name: Furnace Layer
description: A burning layer of magma and pyroclastic shelves where the Mirran Resistance camps at Urabrask's pleasure.

name: Fynn Snakehunter
description: The Kannah leader who rides at the head of bear warriors with a Cosmos Serpent scale shield and fears for Starnheim.

name: Garenbrig
description: A giant city from which the Giant King vanished during the invasion.

name: Garruk's double
aliases: the Garruk with the Chain Veil
description: The Echoverse double of Garruk who wields the Chain Veil and beasts, fading to a ghost.

name: Genku
description: Tamiyo's husband who looks after the children.

name: Geth
description: One of the seven Steel Thanes of the Dross Pits, a lich with an organic, incompleat head who deals in contracts and defies the Orthodoxy; Ixhel beheads him.

name: Ghalta the Unstoppable
description: A titanic dinosaur tyrant released from Orazca, the manifestation of nature's consuming hunger, who defended Ixalan and fought Phyrexians when Huatli summoned her.

name: Giant archaic
description: A huge archaic wreathed in star arches that holds Jadzi, is burned by Chandra's fire and tears the ground asunder.

name: Giants of Stormkeld
description: Massive, ancient humanoids who spend much of their time asleep.

name: Gilt-Leaf Empire
description: The elvish realm whose leaders plan to kill Isilu.

name: Gix
description: A demon said in one legend to have pulled the sylex from Old Phyrexia's ichor well.

name: Glimmer
description: The Wanderer's glimmer drifts around her shoulders.

name: Glistening oil
description: The holy oil flowing from Norn's body that erases memory and desire and reorders minds.

name: Glitch ghosts
description: Shuddering, refracting entities that enter the House through reflective surfaces.

name: Gnottvold
description: The troll realm with ancient forests and warrens.

name: God-Eternals
description: Four immense Eternals, once Amonkhet's gods, killed by Bolas and now his servants, who tear apart Vitu-Ghazi.

name: Golden Argosy
description: A ship that carries Jaya, Ajani, Danitha, Radha and their Keldon and Benalish warriors to the Mana Rig.

name: Goldnight
description: A flight of angels and archmages and cathars bound by sacrament to Avacyn.

name: Gonti's night market
description: A hub for contraband aether and renegade inventors across the river, above the tunnels leading to the Dhund.

name: Govan Radley
description: An ogre Gruul warrior in Domri's pack.

name: Grand Arbiter Leonos
description: The Azorius Grand Arbiter for whom a new statue is approved.

name: Great Arashin City
description: The Abzan city from which Paala's family left on the caravan.

name: Great Conduit
description: A force Rashmi sees in the aether and believes guides her toward success.

name: Grimbly Wothis
description: A minotaur dock boss, half-man and half-bull, who employs Merret, bullies him and tries to seize his baby son.

name: Grixis
description: A shard of Alara: an undead-infested hellscape whose hordes assault other shards.

name: Guidelight Voyagers
description: Automaton racers.

name: Guildpact Jace
aliases: the piece of Jace that was once the Guildpact
description: The honest, wise piece of Jace imprisoned in the ruins of the Chamber of the Guildpact, who tells the Theorist he is in over his head.

name: Guum Wilds
description: The wild forest of Bala Ged where Riverroot Village stands.

name: Hakka
description: The raven who rides on Alrund's shoulder.

name: Halimar Basin
description: The valley where the titans are lured and destroyed.

name: Hall of Oracles
description: The oracle hall that collapses during the fight.

name: Halvar
description: The god of battle for whom the Sword of the Realms was meant, who holds a bridge alone and then uses the sword to seal the rifts.

name: Hamadi
description: A dark-skinned human healer and druid from Graypelt who saves Nissa from under a fallen tree and names her Shaya, 'Worldwaker'.

name: Harbin
description: Kayla's son, a pilot who died in the war; rumors say he became a legend of the western sky.

name: Harrier's Wood
description: The forest near Strixhaven where the students vanished.

name: Hazel
description: A Kenrith sibling whom Will says needs them.

name: Hedron cocoon
description: A protective sheath of interlocked stone hedrons around Ugin, bound by a single shard that Sorin destroys.

name: Hedron trap
description: The huge ring of structural hedrons at Sea Gate holding Ulamog, whose energy Ob Nixilis taps.

name: Henrika Domnathi
description: A Domnathi vampire who serves a demon and attacks the chapel to anoint a priest with demon blood and Avacyn's tears.

name: Henzie
description: A Riveteer demolitions expert who built the explosives and plan Operation Falling Star.

name: Hex
description: The family sheepdog who leads Kellan to a portal.

name: Hiroku
description: Nashi's tallest moonfolk sibling who loves books.

name: Hixus
description: A mentor whose advice about choosing between protecting and needing to protect Gideon recalls.

name: Hope of Ghirapur
description: The oversized thopter carrying Chandra into the Spire.

name: Horizon javelin
description: The Palatinate's supervoid-reigniting weapon, which Reen thinks might be trivial compared to whatever she sensed in the ship's core.

name: Hour of Promise
description: The hour when the Hekma is torn down, said to herald paradise.

name: House Fenzala
description: An Abzan house of Qatros Karst, favored by the khan, that grows a young Kin-Tree and adopts krumar orphans.

name: House Gudal
description: An Abzan house whose appointed leader trusts the walls.

name: House Zanhar
description: An ancient Abzan house of djinn represented by Beyza.

name: Hurkyl
description: A woman of the College of Lat-Nam whose meditation made one a conduit for the soul of the land.

name: Immortal Faller
description: The messianic figure of Monoism descending into supervoids, whose transmissions the Monoists glean.

name: Indrelon
description: A magic mirror that reveals information if told something it has not heard before.

name: Inquisitors
description: A group in the church that executes prophets deemed heretics.

name: Isabough
description: The treefolk librarian of the Biblioplex.

name: Ishai
description: The personal attendant of the dragonlord Ojutai, whose word carries his full authority.

name: Istfell
aliases: the realm of the ignoble dead
description: The afterlife of those who lived mundane lives, a pale green tundra and cairn-strewn realm beneath the roots of the World Tree.

name: Jared Carthalion
description: A grizzled swordsman bearing the Mark of the Elder Druid, the prize the Phyrexians are seeking, who rescues Ulf and sends him to Corondor with the book.

name: Jarsyl
description: Kayla's grandson, Harbin's son, who has magic and leaves to join a school of magic and artifice on Ronom Lake.

name: Javy
description: A former Boros soldier and Relov's old friend who was beaten and kept in the healing wards, and who now kills in the name of a new teacher.

name: Jazal
description: Ajani's brother, a kind and just leader struck down during Alara's Conflux Wars while trying to broker peace.

name: Jenna
description: The editor who introduces the story.

name: Jenrik's Journal
description: A dark-leather journal by a soratami scholar recording lunar studies, werewolf dissections and cryptolith findings, which leads Jace to the Drownyard.

name: Jhinu
description: A gaunt ape of a wealthy merchant family whom Sidisi keeps alive as a servant after he framed three goblins for the theft of her crown; he tries to assassinate her with a poisoned dagger.

name: Kalitas
description: A vampire who learned the hard way that the Eldrazi work through allies.

name: Kan
description: Liont's young son, a few years younger than Talia.

name: Karametra
description: A god whose temple's ruling council includes the father of the boy Raissa's son killed.

name: Karlov Cathedral
description: The Orzhov cathedral where Teysa's funeral is held.

name: Kavah
description: A city where Oret was welcomed as a hero after executing Anafenza.

name: Keldons
description: The warriors of Keld who arrive with Radha.

name: Kendrin
description: An Eldrazi expert who was on the brink of a discovery about the leylines and the Eye, and dies at Sea Gate.

name: Kephalai
description: A plane Ugin flees through.

name: Kesenya
description: The tall kor head of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House who wears the Dragon's Frill and has her own doubts about Nahiri.

name: Ketramose
description: A lion-masked, golden-bowed god of Amonkhet who appears to Chandra at the oasis and gives directions.

name: Kheru Temple
description: The temple built around a vast ancient tree and sacred pool where the ceremony for new sibsig takes place.

name: Khuru
aliases: the man who died saving Zahur
description: A raised Amonkheti Champion who rides with Basri and Zahur.

name: Kinjalli
description: A Sun Empire deity whose word the emperor's is said to be.

name: Kjell
description: A Kannah mystic and cleric, auger and land-reader who mentors Niko and hides what he hears from Fynn.

name: Klothys
description: A god who set Calix on his quarry.

name: Koll the Forgemaster
description: The greatest of the dwarves, the only one who can work Tyrite, who was making the Sword of the Realms and was pushed into his forge by Tibalt.

name: Komon
description: Oltec ancestors who left the Core and are presumed ancestors of the Sun Empire.

name: Korlis
description: A neutral merchant city considered as an evacuation destination.

name: Kozilek's spawn
description: Eldrazi with black glass shards that fill the caves, including a dead heap discarded in a chamber.

name: Krunstraz
description: The kraul warriors garrisoning Pevnar.

name: Kuma
description: Ruzi's wolf, who smells the blood, kills the ogre, and guards the baby Zi.

name: Kwia Vigorbloom
description: A sphinx with wings of flowering plants and vines who cultivates plant matter and teaches healers to patch injuries with flora.

name: Kydele
description: The primary oracle of Kruphix who has seen truths about the gods and Theros's place in the Multiverse.

name: Kylem
description: The Kenrith twins' home where Will prepared to leave.

name: Lacuna
description: A gravity-shifting tunnel sustained by nurturing magic that leads from Mirrodin down to the Furnace Layer.

name: Lank
description: A Downtown miner found dead on the road, his body overgrown with mushrooms and black veins.

name: Last Battle
description: The final battle of the Brothers' War on Argoth, where Urza detonated the sylex.

name: Leaking Spire
description: The renegades' symbol, a swirl of motion beneath a pointed spire.

name: Leonin
description: The mostly nomadic cat-folk of Oreskos, led by King Brimaz, who dislike Theros's human gods.

name: Liliana's Manor
description: Liliana's storm-lashed manor with a high tower, guarded by zombies.

name: Loch Larent
description: A frozen loch and its sprawling ice castle that begins to melt once Hylda gives up her crown.

name: Lord Nicolas
description: A man whom Jace and Vraska joke may be a rock collector, in connection with the Immortal Sun.

name: Lorthos
description: An enormous ancient octopus of Murasa whom Kiora summons with the bident to fight the titan.

name: Madara
description: An island chain on Dominaria where Bolas falls after Ugin's death.

name: Maeli
description: A young boy who fled his burning village and is again threatened, this time by Ms. Sadie's transformed form, and prays to Avacyn.

name: Mage Tower
description: A magical sport between college teams with a floating mascot, played before cheering stands.

name: Magosi Falls
description: The tall waterfall along the Umara River Gorge where Verazol lurks.

name: Magosi Portage
description: The rest stop atop Magosi Falls where the caravan begins.

name: Maladola
description: A Boros angel fighting in the sky.

name: Malamet
description: Catlike underground people ruled by Sovereign Okinec Ahau.

name: Man with the metal arm
description: A chrome-armored intruder with a purple-glowing metal claw arm and pink eyes who takes the emperor.

name: Maralen of the Mornsong
description: The elf whose selfish nature Oona used as a mask for her avatar.

name: Marang River
description: The river on whose banks Tasigur meets Silumgar.

name: Maraxus
description: Volrath's masked warlord and mercenary, who draws strength from those around him, hunts Starke with sawtooth ogres and is killed by Starke.

name: Mazik
description: Nissa's loyal elf friend who believes in the animist ways and travels with her to the mountain.

name: Mechanical soldiers
description: Saheeli's automaton garrison commanded by Nissa after Elspeth.

name: Meditation Plane
description: A watery plane where Vraska meets Nicol Bolas.

name: Meria
description: A pale-skinned Yavimayan elf who arrives on a kavu with Jodah and coordinates the elven archers.

name: Mica
description: A human Lorehold historian who studies deep history through fossils, minerals and sediment.

name: Mirage War
description: The war in which Kaervek tried to conquer Northern Jamuraa and Asmira saved Femeref.

name: Miri's Mother
description: Miri's mother, status-conscious but secretly understanding, who gives Miri a Selesnyan crown to present as her prize.

name: Monasteriat
description: The Monoist power at Point Prime, rival to the Palatinate and building a temple at Susur Secundi.

name: Mondronen Howlpack
description: Tovolar's pack, which Arlinn says he rebuilt out of fear.

name: Monstrosaur
description: A dying dinosaur captured and vivisected by the baron; Vivien captures its spirit in the Arkbow and summons it to destroy the baron and Luneau's palace.

name: Monumental Facade
description: A shell the Phyrexians built around Mirrodin, covered in metal sand and monuments, where Phyrexia sends its creations to fight each other.

name: Mordraine Ring
description: The debris ring above Kavaron that the Seriema crosses as it escapes.

name: Moxite
description: A valuable resource compared to which the node is a billion times rarer.

name: Muldrotha
description: A corrupted elemental woven from rotting wood, corpses and mud, summoned by the spirits to fight Yargle.

name: Multiverse
description: The collection of planes that Saheeli and Huatli can no longer reach.

name: Mycosynth Gardens
description: A layer of mycosynth fungus below the Fair Basilica where Realmbreaker's branches reach.

name: Myrel
description: Penregon's scout captain, who reports on the factory fire and later leads the scouts west.

name: Naga
description: Scaled people who cannot produce the dragons' precise language and whom Sidisi hopes will rule these lands.

name: Nakht
description: A young aven boy of the Tah crop who can command water and who is killed by a shadowy horror in the desert.

name: Nearheath chapel
description: The small chapel of Avacyn in Nearheath where Odric stays.

name: New Argive's watchtower
description: A tower in New Argive in lockdown, infested by Phyrexian creatures.

name: Next Eternity
description: The Monoist afterlife reached by falling into a supervoid; Alpharael realizes only hell.

name: Night War
description: A past war with the colonizers commemorated in Oteclan.

name: Nightmares
description: Fear-fed monsters that pour out with the cellarspawn.

name: Nimiroti Wola
description: Zimone's grandmother, a former Strixhaven professor who solved the Vorzani Conjecture, wiped her own memory to protect it from the Oriq, and now lives in a sanctuary.

name: Nissa's elemental
description: A massive elemental of sand and well water that Nissa raises from the riverbank to fight Razaketh.

name: Nived
description: Yahenni's favorite caterer, who paints the renegade symbol on the Museum of Invention and is shocked unconscious by a Consulate enforcer.

name: Nivix
description: The Izzet guildhall with dynamos on its roof.

name: Nolan
description: A captured Outcaster whose mind Ashiok searches and whom Annie and Kellan escort to an oasis.

name: Olexo
description: One of Gideon's Irregulars from Akros, seen in a dementia illusion.

name: One-Eyed Pass
description: A mountain pass where the Akroan squad is ambushed by a minotaur horde.

name: Order of Jukai
description: A fringe group of nature worshippers and anti-technologists operating from decentralized cells.

name: Oret
description: In this alternate timeline, a Dromoka cartographer for Commander Faiso and cousin of Anafenza, who executes her on his dragon's command and later keeps her spirit alive.

name: Orhaft Stoneback
description: An Omenseeker Vedrune (rune-priest) of the Kirda Sea who uses xe/xer pronouns and agrees to send Niko to Starnheim.

name: Otaria
description: The region of Dominaria where the Weatherlight crash-lands.

name: Oteclan
description: The Oltec place where the second Sun Empire delegation arrives.

name: Otepec
description: A city of temples to the Threefold Sun destroyed in the Phyrexian war.

name: Outcasters
description: Hermit wilderness dwellers.

name: Panther warriors
description: Undead warriors raised by Liliana from an old massacre site.

name: Parnesse
description: Errant's wife, an artist who is wounded in the leg and who joins the resistance with her.

name: Pashona
description: A wizened merfolk shaper of the River Heralds who interrogates the newcomers and brokers cooperation.

name: Penultimate Party
description: The pre-death party every aetherborn deserves.

name: Perrie
description: A Broker who negotiated with the angels for Halo and holds some in reserve.

name: Phyrexian Jace Beleren
description: The compleated Phyrexian version of Jace, which takes over his body and which he fights from within his mind.

name: Phyrexian invasion ships
description: White ships on the branches of Realmbreaker filling with Phyrexian warriors.

name: Planeswalking
description: The ability to travel between planes, which something on Ixalan yanks Jace and Vraska back from.

name: Powerstones
description: Thran stones that power the civils and the war machines.

name: Professor Zarek
description: A professor who calls lights out in the cadet dormitory.

name: Project Lightning Bug
description: An Izzet project to track Jace's disappearances by detecting planeswalks as lightning, which Ral secretly sabotages.

name: Qal Sisma Mountains
description: The mountains where the Atarka clan dwells, whose glaciers have melted since Atarka's arrival.

name: Quan
description: Shu Yun's scribe, who records the khans' meeting.

name: Quiet Furnace
description: Urabrask's layer of New Phyrexia where the resistance hides.

name: Raddic of Kroog
description: A scarred veteran and leader of the Talite crusade against machines, who gives Penregon until dawn to drive out its machines.

name: Raffine
description: An ancient, powerful sphinx demon who leads the Obscura from the Cloud Spire and sees visions from the archdemons.

name: Rashmi's matter transporter
description: An aether transporter archway that collapses spatial dimensions to move matter, which Tezzeret takes.

name: Regent Maximum Taman IV
description: The divine emperor of the Celestial Palatinate whose Free Company sails the Candela.

name: Relov
description: An Azorius Arbiter who signs applications without care, dismisses a complainant over a spelling error, and receives a letter from Javy.

name: Rem Karolus
description: A boastful cathar, the blade of the inquisitors, hired to slay werewolves in Lambholt.

name: Rill
description: A forager from the carnival wounded by wickerfolk on a raid.

name: Rocketeers
description: Goblin racers led by Daretti.

name: Roilmages
description: Noyan Dar's mages who are obliterated by reflected fire and earth.

name: Ronald
description: Kellan's stepfather.

name: Royse
description: A weaver with eight eyes and eight arms hidden beneath her human glamor, who shelters Rowan and points her to a castle.

name: Rumi
description: One of Angrath's minotaur daughters, a blacksmith.

name: Sage-Eye Stronghold
description: A Jeskai stronghold where the rest of the Annals are kept.

name: Sana Ahir
description: A nineteen-year-old human inventor who placed third in aeronautical design and receives half of Yahenni's savings.

name: Sand wurms
description: Enormous desert wurms that ambush the group; some are later raised as undead.

name: Sandsteppe Gateway
description: A Dromoka fortress that Gvar stormed with Kolaghan dragons overhead.

name: Sanguitorium
description: The blood cellar where Sorin was thrown and heals.

name: Santaphor
description: A squire of the bind who lectures on looking for the Sum.

name: Sarulf
description: The divine being who sends wolf children to his chosen.

name: Sea Gate Expeditionary House
description: The Sea Gate adventurers' guild led by Kesenya, bearing a Dragon's Frill emblem.

name: Seam-ripper
description: Ghan's blade that parts the Weft to open passages between lamellae.

name: Seekers of Carmot
description: A fraudulent order on Esper that Tezzeret belonged to.

name: Setha
description: A jackal initiate of the Tah crop, twin of Basetha, killed by a trap blade.

name: Sheoldred's Coliseum
description: A gutted bowl built beneath a ribcage where Sheoldred makes Phyrexians and captured Mirrans fight.

name: Shidiqi
description: The naga who abandoned Tasigur and sided with Silumgar.

name: Shieldmage Order
description: Teyo's monastic order from Gobakhan.

name: Shifting Wastes
description: The shifting desert where caravan fortresses travel and where the ambush occurs.

name: Silver
description: A bard who plays at the party.

name: Singing City
description: The ruined kor city where the confrontation occurs, flattened by the Core's blast.

name: Skelle
description: Raiders in spiked black armor who are routed by the Tuskeri in a skirmish.

name: Skywhales
description: Giant creatures that swim in aether currents and ram the Skysovereign.

name: Society of Mishra
description: Gray-robed human acolytes who serve the Phyrexians on Dominaria and tend the staging ground.

name: Spirit dragons
description: Dragons summoned by Narset's ritual during the Tarkir rebellion.

name: Starke
description: A scheming informant who serves both sides, betrayed Sisay to Volrath, and murders Maraxus to protect himself.

name: Stella Lee
description: A woman from Thunder Junction who steals Arcavios artifacts through an Omenpath to sell on New Capenna.

name: Stormnexus Ritual
description: The ritual Narset suspects Sarkhan used, corrupted by a terrible sacrifice, binding the wild dragons to him.

name: Stormplains
description: Plains of Tarkir where the dragonstorms warp the land and from which Narset and Elspeth enter the storm.

name: Strixhaven Snarl
description: A nexus of primordial power that turns crimson during the summoning and which Rowan drains.

name: Strixhaven students
description: The students of Strixhaven who survive in the Echoverse and cheer Emrakul.

name: Suki
description: A Shattered student pyromancer who calls Chandra her teacher and charges to help.

name: Svogthos
description: The subterranean Golgari guildhall, once an Orzhov cathedral.

name: Swift-Arm
description: A kitsune in Imperial armor who runs the elite Golden-Tail Academy for Imperial samurai.

name: Sword Four
description: An avenger left fighting after its pilot died.

name: Sword One
description: A new sword-pattern prototype avenger paired to Sanwell, which fights on after its pilots flee.

name: Sword of the Realms
description: A Tyrite-forged, glass-like sword with swirling blues and greens, made for Halvar by Koll, which can separate the realms.

name: Sygg
description: A merrow schoolmaster who helped take down Oona and holds a grudge about the unreturned Crescent of Morningtide.

name: Sylvene
description: A powerful wizard from Ravnica who explored the Sword Coast decades ago, made allies there, and left with her young son.

name: Tahngarth
description: A minotaur who travels with Gerrard and carries the weakened Starke.

name: Tal
description: A god of Yotia worshipped by the Talite crusaders.

name: Talion's court
description: The false-castled fae realm reached by a portal.

name: Talites
description: Crusaders of the Church of Tal who attack Penregon, later return and serve as mercenaries in the west.

name: Talrand
description: A powerful merfolk mage with drake servants who claims the Kapsho seas as his kingdom and defeats Kalyntri.

name: Tamni
description: A renegade builder who witnessed Pia's arrest and tells Ajani what she saw.

name: Tavver
description: A young, dedicated Oriq agent who delivers a book to Extus and is used as a shield.

name: Temple in the heart of the storms
description: The ancient temple housing the Omenpath, which Sarkhan's dragons tear apart.

name: Temple of Ephara
description: A temple to Ephara, one of which in a deserted city is where Ashiok creates Cacophony.

name: Temple of the Burning Sun
description: The temple in Pachatupa where the emperor receives Huatli.

name: Teval
description: The Sultai spirit dragon and judge of the clan, who watches over the ceremony.

name: Teyeuh
description: A Sun Empire rider on a frillhorn in Huatli's company.

name: The Aether Hub
description: The vital aether distribution center the renegades hold.

name: The Antiquities War
description: Kayla bin-Kroog's epic about the Brothers' War, which Teferi uses to choose his target.

name: The Brittleblight
description: A plague that struck Dina's dryad glade.

name: The Carnival
description: A safe zone of patched tents and lights inside the House that falls to a monster army at the end.

name: The Charter
description: The Paliano charter that Selvala drafted alongside Brago and guided through ratification.

name: The Coppercoats
description: The soldiers of Drannith.

name: The Derby Crows
description: An aeronaut racing society that joined the renegades politically and fought at the Hub.

name: The Dhund
description: Former secret Consulate prison compound being demolished except its core.

name: The Eradia
description: A wasteland nearly a hundred miles wide around the tower, crawling with mage-eating monsters.

name: The Faller
description: The Monoist figure who tumbled past an event horizon into a supervoid and found peace.

name: The Flamekin
description: Hot-tempered, transcendence-seeking people of Lorwyn who become smoking skeletons seeking revenge in Shadowmoor.

name: The Giant Archaic
description: A giant, wounded, eyeless being that howls and flings reality-warping spells in pain.

name: The Glint-Sleeves
description: An inventor society that builds wearable artifice that fits over arms and hands.

name: The Golgari
description: The Ravnican guild Vraska once ruled.

name: The Golgari Swarm
description: The black-green death-worshiping guild controlling a vast undead army and labor force.

name: The Great Aether Boom
description: The era of frenzied invention and celebration spurred by plane-wide availability of refined aether.

name: The Hour of Devastation
description: The event in which Oketra was slain.

name: The House
aliases: the old house on the corner
description: A shifting, rotting house that rearranges itself when unobserved, plays tricks and, per Winter, is the world.

name: The Infinite Consortium
description: Tezzeret's shadowy organization with safehouses across the Multiverse.

name: The Izzet League
description: The dragon-led blue-red guild fusing elemental magic and technology.

name: The Kenrith twins
description: Twins about whom Garruk asks and whom Liliana says she cares for, worrying about the girl.

name: The Legion of Dusk
description: A sinister fleet of vampires seeking to conquer Ixalan.

name: The Locust God
aliases: the second of the insect gods
description: A god atop a spire who sends swarms of locusts to devour the Hekma and mob Kefnet.

name: The Ninth District
description: The Ravnican district where the Izzet League has closed a courtyard.

name: The Nuns
description: The baron's magic-using nuns who conjure the barrier around Vivien, numb the monstrosaur and maintain the containment area.

name: The Onakke spirits
description: Spirits carried by the Chain Veil that fill Liliana's mind with whispers.

name: The Praetors
description: Some of Karn's top lieutenants, whose factions fight for power amongst themselves.

name: The Remembrance
description: A mace imbued with the ancestor spirits of countless fallen Abzan.

name: The Royal Menagerie
description: The palace's collection of captive animals, whose inhabitants Vivien enlarges and frees.

name: The Specials
description: A group whose captain was once Lukka.

name: The Stronghold
description: The Cabal's volcano fortress with a fighting pit, treasure vaults and curtain walls.

name: The Survivor
description: An aberration of Jace who tells Vraska to tuck and roll and stands aside during the reintegration.

name: The Twelve
description: The ruling council of philosophers of Meletis, meeting in the great hall of governance.

name: The Ulvenwald
description: A forest twisted into horror by Emrakul's influence.

name: The Underworld
description: The place on Theros from which Elspeth Tirel was to be prevented from escaping.

name: The Valley of Serenity
description: A huge pastoral cavern region of the House where the cult lives.

name: The Wildcard Saloon
description: The crew's hideout, where they regroup.

name: The bident
description: Thassa's stolen god-weapon, now dried like coral, which lets Kiora control the sea.

name: The eludha
description: Lukka's ability to forge a bond with a creature's mind and dominate it.

name: The false priest
description: A vampire dressed as an Avacynian priest and Lunarch who officiates the wedding.

name: The kami
description: Divine spirits worshipped by Kamigawa's people who began to take form in the material world and attacked.

name: The magic amplifier
description: A metallic red potion that enhances a user's magic, held by Lilah and Obeka.

name: The medallion
description: The six-piece key that opens the vault door.

name: The sixth key
description: An ancient artifact, older than Thran or Phyrexian make, that unlocks the vault and may be more dangerous than a key.

name: The slivers
description: An ever-evolving race with a growing hive mind that threatens to consume Shandalar.

name: Thiago
description: A Benalish knight who escorts Gideon and Liliana.

name: Thief's Folly
description: A vast graveyard of mixed-plane tombs on Thunder Junction, trapped with necromantic sigils.

name: Thoughtweft
description: The empathetic web connecting the minds of all kithkin.

name: Threat
description: A large gray cat belonging to Jutmaw or a boat that plays with Niko's mirrors.

name: Thrun
description: A Mirran with greenish skin who asks after Melira every day.

name: Thura Sail-Rend
description: A splint-mailed warrior of the Beskir clan feasting in Starnheim, whose saga Birgi told.

name: Tibalt's glass sword
description: A sword of shimmering, colorful glass that tears holes between realms and planes.

name: Tien
description: The chief metalworker of the work crew.

name: Tin Street Massacre
description: The mass chaos incident at Tin Street Market that led to Baas's arrest.

name: Tomakul
description: A city near which Teferi witnesses the trench war.

name: Transguild Promenade
description: A bridge and thoroughfare in Ravnica where Rat meets Hekara and Teyo.

name: Transmogrants
description: Chained fusions of dead flesh and metal that the Fallaji march to the attack.

name: Treza
description: A hideout location in which the resistance team has claimed rooms.

name: Tritons
description: The merfolk of Theros who worship Thassa and watch her fight Kiora.

name: Tuskeri
description: A clan of braveswords of the Tusk mountains led by Arni.

name: Udzec
description: The maximum security Azorius prison, said to hold fifty thousand prisoners.

name: Umara River Gorge
description: A deep gorge on Tazeem used by line-slingers on the hookroutes, including Red Route.

name: Underworld
description: The Underworld of Theros where Ashiok sought Elspeth.

name: Ureni
description: The Temur spirit dragon, who sees the threads of the world and watches over the grove, refusing to give direct guidance.

name: Urza's Nine Titans
description: A group united against Phyrexia.

name: Uvilda
description: A Prismari dean who seals escaped students into an emergency dimension.

name: Valentin
description: A huffy dean of Witherbloom College who lets Dina stay at Strixhaven after her failed experiment.

name: Vampires of Guul Draz
description: Drana's vampire warriors who fight in the army and raid Tazeem.

name: Vedalken of Kaladesh
description: Blue-skinned scholars who replace flesh with etherium, one of whom judges Vronos.

name: Vice Chancellor Alendis
description: A former Academy man who told Daretti the Academy was not ready for a goblin and has apparently joined the Custodi; he is next on Daretti's list.

name: Vinack
description: A feared monster-slaying hero, a living legend on the Arkos border, who abused the narrator's family, and who sacrifices himself to the minotaur oracle.

name: Voldaren Estate
description: Olivia's castle, with floating towers, red petals and blood fountains, where the wedding takes place.

name: Volrath
aliases: evincar of the Lord of the Wastes
description: An evincar whose forces hunt Starke and who holds Starke's daughter prisoner.

name: Vorzani Conjecture
description: An ancient unsolved magical and mathematical ritual about infinite sequences of unpredictable mana, said to hold the essence of the universe.

name: Wargate Prison Camp
description: The Boros prison from which Baas was recently released.

name: Whisper
description: A Cabal cleric who tries to kill the pit prisoners and is killed by Radha's thrown knife.

name: Wolf Knight's witchstalkers
description: Fearsome multicephalic wolves that hunt magic-users in packs and can scale the tower.

name: Worrin Betzold
description: A strict old bishop of the Thraben cathedral whom Arlinn knew, now an undead zombie preaching to other zombies; she puts him to rest.

name: Xathrid
description: A shadowed place on Shandalar.

name: Yargle
description: A giant living creature that grips the Weatherlight's bow until Muldrotha fights it.

name: Zagachoir
description: A cheerful Monoist boarder who is mortally wounded by cnidomines and has Alpharael help him take sekhar.

name: Zhalfir time rift
description: The rift Teferi created that removed Zhalfir from the world.

name: Zhalfirins
description: The warriors of Zhalfir who swap planes with New Phyrexia and fight Phyrexia.

name: Zi
description: Cecilee's adopted Gruul infant, found alive hidden in a cradle by Ruzi.

name: Ziva
description: A Vodalian merfolk hired to raise the Weatherlight.

name: Zivan
description: A once-legendary Azorius legislator who fell into Rakdos pleasure houses and was found dead with words carved over his body.

name: Zurgo Bellstriker
description: A huge, short-tempered orc, the other-time khan of the Mardu, now serving as Kolaghan's attendant and bell-striker.

name: Aarav
description: Saheeli's father.

name: Abandoned gold mine
description: A secluded mine beyond the city wall where the Efravan hide and Pallar gives birth.

name: Abatha
description: Zimone's aesthemancer roommate who complains about the open window.

name: Abbot Barrez
description: The head of Teyo's monastery on Gobakhan.

name: Abeena
description: A kor rope-handler who helps Gideon move the waterfall.

name: Aberrations
description: Parts of himself the Theorist carved out, five of whom were sent through portals.

name: Abzan dragons
aliases: the dragons of the Abzan clan
description: The Abzan clan's dragons and riders who join the battle and suffer heavy casualties.

name: Abzan patrol
description: A fifty-strong Abzan patrol that polices the Salt Road and protects shepherds.

name: Academy at High Paliano
description: The academy of Paliano governed by a Board of Senior Advisors.

name: Accounts of the Dawning Age
aliases: Accounts of the Dawning Age: Vortex Formations and Egomagical Adaptations
description: A Blood Age tome with smoky glass-like cover kept in the Vaults of Turrau, which Zarek steals.

name: Adaptationists
description: Simic merfolk who use bioengineering and Upwelling principles, attracting parents away from traditional tenders.

name: Adeliz
description: A friend to whom Jodah sends love.

name: Adia
description: A young Civic Creed acolyte, orphaned by the Keldon War, who fears what war with Phyrexia will cost.

name: Adrasteia
description: One of three weaver sisters of fate, detached and efficient, who snips a snarl of two entwined threads with her crooked shears.

name: Adrasteia's sisters
description: Two sisters of Adrasteia who weave the great tapestry of fate.

name: Adrix
description: Nev's twin and fellow Quandrix dean.

name: Adumbral Gardens
description: The gardens at the Forum where the tea ceremony and duel take place.

name: Aerie of the Unfettered
description: A rocky spire settlement in Dromoka lands that is home only to dragons owed fealty by no one.

name: Aesrias's mother
description: A warrior who fell at the third battle of the Pharagax Bridge after slaying seven, whose sacrifice led Iroas to bless Aesrias.

name: Aether Regulator
description: A medical device that eases dissipation symptoms for aetherborn, presented in Ghirapur.

name: Aether Spire
description: The Consulate's tower where Tezzeret retreats and meets Baan.

name: Aether condenser
description: Rashmi's groundbreaking device for powering matter transportation.

name: Aether heart
description: The mechanical heart in Gonti's chest that pulls aether from the air and makes him immortal.

name: Aetherborn club
description: A forgotten Ghirapur club owned by an aetherborn family that Gonti keeps off Consulate patrol routes.

name: Aetherflux reservoir
description: Ghirapur's aether store that the Phyrexians head straight for.

name: Aetherological Society
description: The society that produced the so-called mana vault.

name: Afra
description: A cleric who befriends the newly created Tiana.

name: Agents of S.N.E.A.K.
description: A kleptocracy of spies that began as a job board and does not know its own purpose.

name: Aggro
description: A large gray cat of Starnheim with polar-light fur that leads Niko to the Valkyries.

name: Aherin
description: A faerie of Maralen's flock who has gone missing while someone else uses his bed.

name: Ai Wen
aliases: Ai Wen of the Sahn Ni family
description: A Temur wanderer and elder of the Sahn Ni family who bested Asham in a sparring bout and defeats him again when he challenges her.

name: Ainok
description: The ainok people, of whom Darka and Rakhan are members.

name: Ainok family
description: A hidden ainok family who do not serve Atarka but answer the hunting horn.

name: Ajani Resolute
description: A leonin planeswalker motivated by his deceased brother's legacy, who mentors fellow planeswalkers and is healing from the pain he caused under phyresis; he prepares to defend the Multiverse against a former friend.

name: Ajani Unrelenting
description: An Echoverse leonin whose battle cry strikes fear, dedicated to vengeance after his brother's death and lashing out at anyone in the Theorist's way.

name: Ajuf
description: A youthful soldier who wants to hear stories of the Guardian.

name: Akamal Cray
description: A Gruul warrior in the pack.

name: Akime
description: A drover of Subira's caravan.

name: Akoum Expeditionary House
description: An expedition organization Tafre worked for as a trapfinder.

name: Akroan army
description: The warrior force of Akros, whose Lukos wolves are among the toughest warriors on Theros.

name: Akroan soldier
description: A soldier on deployment who joked about Zerili's death.

name: Akroan soldiers
description: The soldiers of Akros, whom the narrator was forced to join after being caught stealing.

name: Akroans
description: People of a polis that Perisophia says kills truth with swords.

name: Akroma, Angel of Fury
description: An angel manifested by Nivea from her grief and rage to take vengeance, who hunts those who commit injustice.

name: Aku
description: An ancient tomb city above the Uuserk swamp, home to the Amber Tombs and where Queen Wezna waits.

name: Alabile
description: The tidal metal used in Monoist armor.

name: Alajn
description: A reaper and Njala's sister, who takes cowards and teases Njala about her failed expectations.

name: Alandra
description: A classmate from Shandalar whose father will help with the Omenpath passage.

name: Alaric
description: A friend of Crovax who hides Starke in his wine cellar and is killed by Maraxus's forces.

name: Albiorix
description: A goose the size of a market cart owned by Beluna.

name: Aleksandar
