description: A young blacksmith's son and stable hand whose rent Torens pays and who follows him into the keep, where he is possessed.

name: Aletha
description: A taller, quiet female leonin warrior in Seza's patrol.

name: Alexio
description: A winged Skyknight of Meletis assigned to escort Iris to the garrison at Soli; he dies holding off ambushers so she can escape.

name: Algli
description: An elderly former tanner who lost her family to ghouls and joined a cult trying to summon the Buried Lord, then allies with Liesa.

name: Alibou
description: A golem who serves as the school's defense and bears a grudge against Nassari.

name: Alira
description: A human companion of Hamadi who helps rescue and travels with Nissa.

name: Alrun River
description: A river along which the inhospitable villages lie.

name: Alsig
description: A Valkyrie Avtyr invokes as an example.

name: Altan
description: A young Mardu rider who opposes Paala's participation in the Lightning Proving, attacks her, and then accepts her help.

name: Alton
description: Eula's older brother, who works with Riveteers and has his own place in a Riveteer neighborhood.

name: Amaka
description: Zimone's friend who chose Prismari.

name: Amarth-Tel
aliases: ley mage of the Tarry Spire
description: An arrogant ley mage who captured an alien vehicle and lives in the Tarry Spire.

name: Amber Throne
description: The khan's seat, a solid piece of carved amber on a dais around the First Tree.

name: Amber Tombs
description: A dome in Aku where Zhalfir keeps dangerous prisoners in amber.

name: Ambrellin
description: A dryad artifact broker, Terrik's childhood friend, who shelters him and identifies Bazda's Izzet artifact.

name: Ambush Commander
description: The leader of a patrol of rangers who hunts Iris and Alexio and scries their location in a golden goblet.

name: Amenakhte
description: A large man who shields a child with his body and dies after handing him to a woman.

name: Ammits
description: Demons that devour hearts, invoked by Hazoret as a curse.

name: An Architectural Accounting
description: A history of the house begun by its last resident-architect that each owner must update.

name: An Karras
description: Sentos's birth city, an ancient city that venerates Sentos the Righteous.

name: Anabelle
description: A student who presents on the structure of the Bablovian meta-government and would like to join the League of Dastardly Doom.

name: Anafenza's house
description: A prosperous Abzan merchant house that travels in a colossal rolling fortress and is destroyed in the ambush.

name: Anax
description: The king of Akros, the only one entitled to wear a crown there.

name: Ancestral maelstroms
description: Swirling storms of angry Abzan ancestor spirits left without a Kin-Tree.

name: Ancient kor
description: The builders of the Skyclaves who experimented on beasts.

name: Andenstalay
description: A smoggy city of tram tracks and monorails with a space elevator, where Kesori works and where artifact damage kills two.

name: Andrik
description: A ghost pirate of the sunken Heckless who pretends to be a drowned Orzhov sailor and is bound to a contractual signet carrying stolen Simic treasure.

name: Angel
description: An alien and benevolent angel who answers Brenalt's prayer in the ruined shrine and grants him strength.

name: Angel's Breath
description: A bar on the lower west side of New Capenna that was due a restock of Halo.

name: Angel's blood
description: A medicinal substance Geralf needs and Stella provides in a bottle.

name: Angel's halo
description: The dull gray halo Tazri took from the angel she killed, which glows and shelters her mind during Kozilek's field.

name: Animated Trees
description: Trees sent by Multani that attack any movement.

name: Anina
description: A human graduate student interested in hydralike creatures and fractal repetition in nature.

name: Ankle Shanker
description: A goblin who lived instead of dying and has a different name and life, and doesn't know Sarkhan.

name: Annie's ranch
description: The ranch where Kellan helps with chores.

name: Annie's thunder blaster
description: Annie's smaller current weapon.

name: Annik
description: A neighbor of Iver who sweeps her porch.

name: Anthousa
description: A figure quoted as saying more children were taken and the evil will be tracked without mercy.

name: Anuki
description: Sothera's innermost world, settled by the Monoists and renamed Susur Secundi.

name: Anyxni
description: A newer cockpit crew member who carried Botono and appears as a tentacle head.

name: Apatzec Intli III
description: The ambitious emperor of the Sun Empire who trusts Huatli and charges her to find the golden city of Orazca.

name: Apatzec Intli IV
description: The child emperor of the Sun Empire, who clutches a stuffed quetzacama and is manipulated by his uncle and aunt.

name: Apostasine Wars
description: Wars in which the unified Church and Crown conquered kingdom after kingdom on Torrezon.

name: Apprentice Zimone
description: A double split from the part of Zimone that hates disappointing people, who takes the Omenpath Project apprenticeship.

name: Arah
description: A man in a brass cap whom Raddic met in the trenches, who is among his emissaries.

name: Aran
description: A squire Elspeth once mentored on Bant.

name: Arata
description: A former member of Sami's crew who was the last to leave, telling Sami Mirri is just a cat.

name: Arc Drake
description: A drake sent into the sewers to vaporize fatbergs that breathes electricity.

name: Arcades's colony
description: A walled riverside human city ruled by Arcades Sabboth.

name: Archie Dixon
description: A courier hired by the Sterling Company who is killed by Akul's Hellspurs while carrying a sack of coal.

name: Archive beneath Dirgur
description: A looted underground archive where Narset finds the last scroll recording the khans' summit.

name: Archmage Ghavos
description: The archmage who schooled Boldt in magic before his journey.

name: Archmage Reeves
description: An archmage who performs Arlinn's ceremony and dies when she transforms.

name: Archmage Rembert
description: An archmage of Goldnight and Arlinn's former mentor, scarred by her claws, who now hunts her as a monster.

name: Ardenvale knights
description: The knights loyal to the old king who serve Will.

name: Arel
description: A human Whisperer who secretly seeks to free people from Atarka's rule and imagines a world without dragons.

name: Aresaan
description: A fallen Razia-copy angel and former Warleader with bound wings who torments Ossett, then helps expose Skormak.

name: Argivia
description: The capital city of New Argive, preparing for a kobold attack.

name: Argivian Front
description: The trench line near Tomakul where Farid's company is stationed.

name: Argivians
description: Urza's allied army whose machine soldiers oppose the Fallaji.

name: Arima
description: Kotori's older friend, a Futurist scientist born outside Otawara, who warns her about Katsumasa.

name: Arinos
description: A farmer who went missing; he summoned Old Stickfingers to guard his farm and was killed by it.

name: Ariosa
description: A young woman, daughter of the missing farmer Arinos, who knows the words of the summoning and performs the binding ritual.

name: Arixmethes
description: A colossal kraken mistaken for an island with a ruined city on its back, whom Kiora seeks to bond with but who sides with Thassa.

name: Arkos
description: A polis next to the border region where the narrator lives.

name: Arlinn's father
description: A smith in Kessig who covered his workshop with holy symbols; his house burned down.

name: Arlinn's pack
description: The werewolf pack led by Arlinn that surrounds Halana and Alena.

name: Arlinn's resistance
description: A group of humans, witches, deputized fiendslayers and planeswalkers who fight vampires; two hundred others shelter in the woods.

name: Arlo Wickel
description: The Prismari Mage Tower point guard who raises an earth wall against the mage hunters.

name: Armin Morov
description: A very old human pontiff and Orzhov Triumvirate member who evades Kaya's call to fight.

name: Arni, Humble Scribe
description: An Echoverse version of Arni, a shepherd turned storyteller sailing the waves for new stories, whom few can recall by face.

name: Arni, Renowned Champion
description: A hero known as Goatleaper, Brokenbrow and Metalbrow, leader of the Tuskeri, who headbutted a troll and a Phyrexian.

name: Arnyn
description: A vampire Witherbloom student who cultivates carnivorous plants.

name: Arrus
description: A cold-hearted, runt viashino Gruul tattoo artist of the Ghor Clan who is cast out after his ink burns warriors, learns to make healing ink from Baas Radley, uncovers Selesnya's drain on the Rubblebelt and finds his Rage.

name: Artificial Omenpath
description: A temporary doorway made from Kaito's spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate magic and a piece of the House, leading from the House to Ravnica.

name: Asenue
description: A two-blade master who fights two Eternals to protect others, mentally repeating the mantra one more breath.

name: Asha
description: Bant's guardian angel to whom Elspeth once prayed.

name: Asham
description: A proud disciple of Cori Mountain Monastery who was defeated by a Temur wanderer and trains for a rematch.

name: Asmira
description: A prophet who saved Femeref during the Mirage War, whose bust inspires Niambi.

name: Asphodel
description: The coastal marsh where the Returned who rejected the Underworld wander.

name: Assad
description: A boastful fifteen-year-old replacement who wants to attack the Argivians.

name: Atarka clan thrall
description: An Atarka warrior who Sorin enthralls and feeds on, who guides him to Ugin's haven and dies.

name: Atarka's broodlings
description: Dragons of Atarka's brood who land at the camp demanding the surrender of shamans.

name: Atarka's mountains
description: Vast, trackless mountains ruled by Atarka.

name: Atiin
description: Annie's people, whose name for her is Haseya and whose homeland treated everyone as family.

name: Atlacan Huicintli
description: The boy-emperor's uncle and majordomo, who craves the throne, pushes for war on Torrezon, and pressures Saheeli and Huatli.

name: Augusta
description: A Lorehold dean who died in the invasion but, through a ritual, returned as a spirit and serves as interim dean of order.

name: Auntie Ool
description: An infamous Shadowmoor boggart known for witty, potent curses and a hut with giant frog-like legs.

name: Aurora
description: The shifting border between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor and the eclipsed realm where living things calcify.

name: Avabruck
description: The lost capital, a place of geists and werewolf scavengers.

name: Avacyn's Cathedral
description: The great cathedral where Avacyn receives Vronos and cathars gather.

name: Avacyn's Spear
description: Avacyn's broken-tipped spear, too holy for most to touch, which Thalia wields with Traft's power.

name: Avacyn, Angel of Horror
description: An archangel created by Sorin Markov, who imprisoned her sisters in the Helvault and demands faith beyond death.

name: Avacynian Church
description: The church that Odric serves and whose power he tracks through regimental dispatches.

name: Aven of Amonkhet
description: Crane-headed winged people of Naktamun.

name: Avengers
description: Humanoid war machines designed by Urza and controlled by command rods.

name: Awateh
description: A councilman and historian who stokes fear that the Efravan are Phyrexian sleeper agents.

name: Axavar
description: A once-unmatched Drix Eldrazi hunter who severed his contract and now evades his own hunters through the Fabric of All Being.

name: Ayari
description: A young scarred woman of Far Corner skilled with knives, who acts as Chishiro's right hand.

name: Ayli
description: A kor priestess of the Eternal Pilgrims who leads Jace and Jori to Ulamog as offerings.

name: Ayya
description: Obuun's mother, a brakeguard who vanished years ago and whose spirit guides him from the bone cavern.

name: Azamaki
aliases: Azamaki, the Kami of Treachery Incarnate
description: A kami of treachery that Satoru's channeler allows to possess her.

name: Azdomas
description: A kraul Krunstraz warrior of the Golgari who reports that Mazirek was a Bolas collaborator.

name: Aziza
description: A djinni star athlete and captain of the Lorehold Mage Tower team.

name: Azorius Detention Compound
description: The Azorius prison where the Golgari prisoners are held and revolt.

name: Azzik
description: A loyal goblin who works for Krenko and can barely count past ten.

name: Baas Radley
description: A one-handed ogre shaman and former Gruul warrior who collapsed the Jezeru dams, now a tattoo artist, who teaches Arrus her healing ink.

name: Baas Solvar Radley
description: A prisoner at Wargate, probably related to the Rubblebelt raider Govan Radley, whom Ossett has freed on Brazer's demand.

name: Bablovia
description: A science-obsessed world governed by a pentarchy of five factions.

name: Baby's Breath
description: A faerie of the Deffroad Clique in a gown of baby's breath who taunts Morecote and helps poison Sigric.

name: Backstabber
description: A Mardu warrior who counts the horde's stolen supplies.

name: Bahkut
description: A human companion of Hamadi who helps rescue and travels with Nissa.

name: Baihir Marza
description: A seasoned ainok mage of the Dromoka, master of sunbringer and sandbringer traditions.

name: Baji
description: A former renegade contact who offers Pia his skimmer and is killed by a Phyrexian quill.

name: Bakenptah
description: A minotaur past champion whom Nylah recognizes among the Eternals.

name: Bala Ged Skyclave
description: The kor city floating above the Guum Wilds.

name: Bald man
description: An emaciated, toothless, unnaturally strong man who leads the ritual and throws Kaalia from the walkway before falling to his death.

name: Baloths
description: Ferocious predators that live on an island and yield to Kalyntri.

name: Baltrice
description: Tezzeret's second-in-command in the Infinite Consortium who set up safehouses.

name: Ban Koj
description: A Malamet city of stalactites with rope bridges and suspended carriages, unseen by outsiders since the Oltec.

name: Bara
description: Vasi's ward-sister, small and picked on, from the crèche where Vasi was raised.

name: Bardas
description: A competitive Alamon soldier who is inseparable from Borias; he dies in the minotaur ambush.

name: Barnaby
description: A friend of Arlinn from the church who teased her about being first into the cathedral.

name: Baron Von Count
description: A member of the Legion of Evil.

name: Barrier ward
description: An Agency device that seals crime scenes, deployed from two ends, used by Kaya and Etrata to bind Oba.

name: Barrin
description: Teferi's old headmaster at Tolarian Academy, whose wife Rayne died in a war Teferi spearheaded.

name: Barrow mound
description: A mound in the wild grasses of the High Moors holding the remnants of a wizards' sanctum that is still being plundered.

name: Basetha
description: A jackal initiate of the Tah crop, twin of Setha, who crosses to Bontu with a heart.

name: Basil
description: A grieving young elf, a first-year, who lost his partner Mertyn and is still uncommitted to a path; at the end he says he no longer wants to be a mage.

name: Basilica of the Opportune
description: An ancient Orzhov church that Terrik's wurm collapsed, killing nearly two dozen workers; its catacombs hold the Izzet machine.

name: Bastion
description: The Consulate's enforcement force of officers and automatons that Baan commands.

name: Batar Throatslasher
description: A human wing leader with shields fitted with bone dragon claws who challenges Zurgo and is killed.

name: Battlewise of Meletis
description: An order whose members shape the flow of battle through tactics.

name: Bay of Vustrow
description: The dark, cold bay beyond the docks of Selhoff.

name: Bazda
description: A sharp twelve-year-old orphan whose parents died in the basilica collapse and who owns the missing piece of an ancient Izzet coin-minting machine.

name: Bazda's Artifact
description: A crescent-shaped carved stone with golden symbols, found by Bazda's father at the basilica, that completes the coin mill.

name: Bazzle
description: A one-armed clockmaker shunned by his village for surviving the creeping plague, who is overpowered and beheaded by his own clockwork creation.

name: Bazzle's workshop
description: The cluttered clock workshop filled with two hundred twelve clocks where the events take place.

name: Bear King
description: The heroic, sad-eyed guardian king of the final tower of Istfell, who commands the Ursan Guard and is killed by Egon.

name: Bearded youth
description: A bearded young widower marked by mourning whose lekythos libation draws the Weeping Woman and her children.

name: Beast of the switchback
description: A beast with a thick, snow-white fleece mane that kills a rabbit and scatters Pavios's pack.

name: Beastie
description: A masked creature with multicolored striped fur and balloons on its horn that befriends and protects a human.

name: Beasties
description: Shaggy, horned creatures born of cocoons in the House whose purpose is to befriend and protect keep-alives.

name: Belaxis
description: A talkative half-compleated aspirant bound by contract to Geth, who guards his gate and helps Ixhel; she later sacrifices him on the Dominus of Pain.

name: Beluna
description: A giant lady whose birthday party it is and who owns the goose Albiorix; she seizes Kellan.

name: Benalish forces
description: The surviving Benalish soldiers, knights and aven scouts rallied by Rael.

name: Bender
description: A dock coworker who is out the day Merret must clear the fog.

name: Benzi
description: A fungal drudge zombie whom Bozak tends and names.

name: Beril
description: A lean, dust-brown ainok soldier under Daghatar's command.

name: Berta
description: A burrog professor who researches the Paradox Gardens with fractal models.

name: Besetha
description: A child of the Tah crop.

name: Beskir Stronghold
description: A stronghold the undead legion once reached.

name: Betor
description: The Abzan spirit dragon, brilliant as the desert sun, made of the lost spirits of the Abzan.

name: Betzold family
description: A family from Gavony who were handed a box by a witch, in a woodcut, and whose ancestor gave the key to a vampire.

name: Betzold mansion
description: The haunted, dilapidated mansion in Gavony where Dennick's ghost lingers.

name: Beyza
description: A scarred djinni of House Zanhar, the House of Grit, who doubts Narset's warning and is teased by Nur.

name: Bhavin
description: A dwarf metalworker who placed fourth at the Fair with his massive construction automatons; Tezzeret throws him out.

name: Bhavin's automaton
description: Bhavin's towering construct that Tezzeret uses to test the transporter.

name: Binding of Emrakul
description: The spell, built from Tamiyo's binding scroll, Jace's glyph and Nissa's power, that stretches Emrakul into the moon and seals her there.

name: Black Thanes
description: Phyrexian leaders, many of whom have pledged themselves and their spheres to Elesh Norn.

name: Black stone
description: A dark, oily, egg-shaped stone with a rainbow blur that whispers choosing one; Sami is touched by it and the cask is loaded aboard.

name: Blech
description: A beloved oversized pest of the Witherbloom bayou, spawn of Blex.

name: Blessed Nation
description: The known expanse of Lorwyn, across which lies Bre's lair.

name: Blex
description: An oversized escaped pest once used for hazing who died in the invasion.

name: Blight Parchment
description: A weak effigy magic parchment used by children to torment others, that Kodolaag uses against an Azorius elocutor and guards.

name: Blood Age
description: The era from about 7,000 to 700 years ago of violent wars that ended when the five dragons founded Strixhaven.

name: Blood Fast
description: A vampiric fast of abstaining from blood that drives the faster mad with hunger.

name: Blood seal
description: A paper seal painted in Jacob's blood that lets Millicent be heard and anchors her to her memories.

name: Bloodcrag
description: A vast dark mountain with an open cone filled with blood, rising above an ash-gray plain in the demons' realm.

name: Bloodfray Amulet
description: A wrought-iron amulet set with an amber stone holding bloodfray magic that triggers riots.

name: Blue smoke
description: A strong pain reliever that causes fatigue, which Tommy relies on and then gives up.

name: Blue-vein sickness
description: A curse of glowing blue threads that bind people's wrists, throats and tongues, leaving their eyes open as they die within weeks.

name: Bo
description: A talkative young man who volunteers to help Annie hunt the rattlewurm after it venoms his sister.

name: Boatswain's Rear
description: A seedy tavern in High and Dry that Malcolm likes.

name: Boeb of Boldwyr
description: An old giant of Clan Boldwyr, legendary for killing boggarts, who is actually grieving his father and is blinded by Marrja.

name: Boeb's father
description: The giant who hunted the eternalisk and gave Boeb its scale; his death sent Boeb into name sleep.

name: Boeb's lair
description: A cave beneath a bushy hill marked by a giant dolmen, full of treasure.

name: Bog creature
description: A newly born wurm-like monster made of swamp matter with an ink-magic heart, created when Dina's ritual is corrupted.

name: Boilerpits
description: Hot, fragrant tunnels of pipes and steam vents beneath the Izzet district.

name: Bolas's gem
description: The mystic gem floating between Bolas's horns, collecting stolen Sparks; it drops when he dissolves.

name: Boldt's Sextant
description: A bronze sextant figurine given to Boldt by an instructor, used as a spell focus and lost during the wreck.

name: Bomat
description: The port region of Ghirapur.

name: Bomat District
description: A district of Ghirapur where Gideon fights a Consulate charger and automaton.

name: Bombop
description: An ogre Gruul warrior who is killed by Eternals while charging ahead.

name: Bone cavern
description: A huge chamber of Mul Daya bones beneath the Riverroot Tree where Obuun senses his ancestors.

name: Book on Sol'kanar
description: A mildewed volume in Old Vodalian detailing Sol'kanar's curse and how to lift it.

name: Borias
description: A competitive Alamon soldier who is inseparable from Bardas; he dies beside him, joking about their bet.

name: Boris
description: Vytas's burly son and head of the trapper corps, who guides Torens to the keep and locks him in.

name: Borrowed Ones
description: Dead whom Meren revitalizes from death itself, unlike the animated corpses of Grixis necromancers.

name: Botono
description: The helmsman injured by the dragon and later appears as a Phyrexian tentacle head in a nightmarish engine room.

name: Boy
description: A prisoner who escaped with Elspeth's plan on New Capenna but was captured and Phyrexianized.

name: Bozak
description: A kraul with a malformed wing who wins an apprenticeship under a lich, later swallows a poisonous mushroom and leaps from the Hanging Keep to protect Vraska, and ends up fungus-controlled by Mazirek.

name: Braids
description: A shadowy, braided, many-handed being who helps the crew enter a nightmare barrier in return for help reabsorbing her shard-self.

name: Brakeguards
description: Mul Daya wilderness guards who patrol the Guum Wilds and fight surrakar.

name: Brandt
description: An aged vampire hunter missing part of an ear who has pursued Strefan for decades and lures him to a ruin before cutting his own throat.

name: Branko
description: A giant Azorius guard, over seven feet tall, who tries to keep Golgari prisoners in check during the Detention Compound riot and loses his ear to a gorgon.

name: Branko One-Ear
description: A former Azorius guard in the Golgari raid who became a landlord and is found with his brain in his lap.

name: Brazer
description: A haggard former Gruul defector who contacts Ossett through a coded invitation and plays Clans & Legions with her before being killed.

name: Bre of Clan Stoutarm
description: A giant herder, daughter of Brion Stoutarm, who hurls elves far away.

name: Bre of Stoutarm
description: A milder giant whose lair the boggarts first planned to raid but which is in Shadowmoor.

name: Breeze
description: An owlin classmate of Kirol's on the Fields of Strife trip.

name: Brenalt
description: A young soldier who survives an undead ambush by making a pact with an angel, rises to general, and ends the story preparing a last charge against the undead.

name: Breya
description: An Esper artificer who discovered carmot in Jund and replaced most of her body with etherium she created, gaining Jund's wild magic.

name: Brimaz
description: The young, tall leonin king of Oreskos, chosen successor of the late Queen Omala, and an old friend of Ajani.

name: Brion Stoutarm
description: Bre's father, whose death Bre blames on the elves.

name: Brittleblight
description: A disease that drains color and life from habitats across Arcavios and destroyed Dina's glade.

name: Bruna-Gisela
description: A huge fused angel of twisted flesh, tentacles, feathered wings and two heads that speaks in a double voice and tries to absorb Sigarda.

name: Bruse Tarl
description: A Zendikari nomad herder who organized a resistance against the Eldrazi on Akoum and is famed for his insults.

name: Bulp
description: Squee's large, scholarly goblin ward whom Squee sends to the surface to warn a town; he returns to find his king alive.

name: Bunarat
description: A village set ablaze during the manhunt for the Nalaars.

name: Burak Khan
description: An earlier Abzan khan whose council tradition Daghatar reinstated.

name: Burning Port
description: A venue the crew plans to visit for ale and cards.

name: Burning Tree Clan
description: A distant Gruul clan where Baas offers to send Arrus.

name: Cacophony
description: A short-lived god of cities that awakens from the city's dream and is destroyed by Ephara.

name: Caer Flur
description: A city in Shadowmoor in the opposite direction from the aurora.

name: Caerdoon
description: Ruins where Liliana searched in vain for an archaic.

name: Cail Station
description: An abandoned station evacuated twenty years earlier, where a corruption wound in the Weft is found.

name: Cairn-eaters
description: Thousands of unfettered spirits who tear down stone cairns built as a tribute to Egon.

name: Calamity Graveyard
description: A place Gev claims to have visited.

name: Caligo Forest
description: A dark forest of Dominaria where young Liliana fled a battle.

name: Callaphe
description: A mythic navigator whose identity Kiora posed as; Thassa calls her her devotee.

name: Camey
description: A black-and-brown faerie of Maralen's personal flock of thirty-five who reports Aherin missing.

name: Canchatan
description: Temple guards chosen for faith, loyalty and prowess who serve Caztaca.

name: Canticle of Jed
description: A loxodon prayer and poem that acts as the key to opening the entrance to Zantafar.

name: Canyon Falls
description: An oasis in a canyon with a spring and palms where the Abzan patrol sets its defense.

name: Canyon chamber
description: A dead-end chamber in a canyon where Anafenza's last stand takes place.

name: Captain Eumalos
description: Captain of another Alamon squad, found dead and beheaded in One-Eyed Pass.

name: Captain Howler
description: A mind-controlled racer who splinters a scaffold.

name: Captain Kyrillos
description: Captain of a ten-man Alamon squad who leads it into One-Eyed Pass and dies killing the minotaur leader.

name: Captain Lysandra
description: Elamon's captain in the Hanweir garrison.

name: Captain of the guard of Fort Keff
description: The honest, overwhelmed captain of Fort Keff who refuses to listen to Gideon about the surrakar until the battle.

name: Caradora
description: Team leader of the Alacrian Quickbeasts, co-captain with Lagorin.

name: Caravan leader
description: An unnamed merfolk leader of the caravan.

name: Carlin
description: A bishop who reads Thalia's letter and pales.

name: Carlo
description: A cadet from Kroog's River Wards, promoted to pilot, who is badly burned and killed by Fallaji crossbowmen.

name: Carta Scientia
description: The oldest document in Bablovia, which lets sciences form their own governments.

name: Carth the Lion
description: The founder of House Carthalion, against whom Sol'kanar fought.

name: Castle Embereth
description: The castle where Imodane once served.

name: Castle Falkenrath
description: The seat of the Falkenrath bloodline, which Olivia says Avacyn destroyed.

name: Castle Vantress
description: The castle where Will has taken up residence.

name: Cataclysm
description: The blast that ended the brothers' war and began the ice age.

name: Cathar Leighton
description: A cathar who warns of the devil attack on Havengul and dies later.

name: Cathar Palter
description: A kindly cathar of the Lunarch Council and former mausoleum guard from Gavony, who hides his wife's crimes and is stabbed by her.

name: Cathedral of Serra
description: The cathedral where Tiana was created.

name: Cathedral of the angels
description: A cathedral in Park Heights with glowing, singing angel statues, where Giada finds her family.

name: Cauldron
description: The witch's cauldron that Peter carries to Talion's court.

name: Cave Bear
description: A huge bear that Surrak fights and defeats, which later charges to his aid against the Sultai before being slain by him at its plea.

name: Cave network
description: A subterranean network near Sea Gate, once home to goblins, reshaped by Kozilek and visited by Jori and Kiora.

name: Caz
description: An unguilded Selesnyan initiate in Miri's pod who teaches her the seed spark invocation.

name: Cecani Family Home
description: The ruined family house in Nephalia, scarred by a fire, where Gisa hides.

name: Cecilee's vernadi
description: Cecilee's walled Selesnya community in the Rubblebelt with a healing center.

name: Cemil
description: A krumar warden's assistant of House Fenzala who proves to be a Sultai agent and helps Jurjis reach the Kin-Tree chamber.

name: Central Mausoleum
description: The repository of the worthy dead whose gates open to release the Eternals.

name: Cerise
description: A healer whom Will could ask to heal his black eye.

name: Cerys Awbrey
description: A Shadowmoor elf who inherits her late uncle Gethin's house and begins a correspondence with Rhain; she is petrified in the eclipsed realm.

name: Cevraya
description: An elf shaman of the Golgari with a claim to Vraska's throne.

name: Chained tome
description: A metal-plated book bound by delicate chains holding a mage's failed rituals for life from lifelessness.

name: Champion of the Sun
description: A title Heliod gives a worthy mortal in times of great need; the latest champion slew Polukranos near Meletis.

name: Chancellor Grinaldi
description: The chancellor of the Academy who is forced to resign after Muzzio's construct exposes his affair.

name: Chandra's double
description: The Echoverse double of Chandra who sends fire.

name: Chandra's parents
description: Chandra's parents, killed when she was a child on Kaladesh, whose voices the demon mimics.

name: Chandra, Chill of Compliance
description: An Echoverse version of Chandra Nalaar who is a measured, calm Avishkar consul shieldguard with cryomancy, and has embraced the Theorist's vision.

name: Chandra, Torch of Defiance
description: An impulsive, powerful pyromancer planeswalker learning to lead, who has a strange mental link to Jace and will burn his false reality down if needed.

name: Changelings
description: Shapeshifters born in the crystalline cavern Velis Vel; in Shadowmoor they become cruel mimics.

name: Chara
description: An Oltec bat rider who announces Anim's approach and later warns that Chimil's prison is being remade.

name: Chatal
description: A Fang Druid, Nathala's mentor, who gives Khrad a fire amulet and counsels him that the world is larger than he knows.

name: Checkmate
description: Mantis's mechan Checkmate, an adversarial counselor who inherits the post of director of Infinite Guideline by emergency protocol.

name: Chensal Twins
description: The Jeskai Arbiter Twins Kela and Dar, who judge trials in Jeskai villages by lighting or not lighting lamps in separate towers.

name: Chessa
description: Medge's star pupil, who lacks courage until she tricks the ghost into a krasis.

name: Chevill
description: Ikoria's most accomplished monster hunter, a boastful exterminator who helps ambush Lukka.

name: Children's Quarters
description: The sleeping quarters where the children are watched over by anointed caretakers.

name: Chishiro
description: A four-armed, scaled orochi swordsman hired as a sellsword to defend Far Corner, once bonded to the kami Kaima as a member of a Jukai order.

name: Chishiro's Futurist captive
description: A moonfolk Futurist whom Chishiro let go into Jukai; this page does not name her.

name: Chitin Court
description: The old insect gods of Amonkhet and their undead monarch followers who live in the Broken Lands.

name: Chitlati
description: Huatli's aide and attaché who accompanies Saheeli as interpreter.

name: Chiye
description: A cook and Upriser with three steam-jet teapots who sponsors Heiko and loves her.

name: Choprights
description: A family who filled out preferences for a Sigma's Reach house three years ago but never showed up.

name: Chrome monster
description: A chrome-bodied, bird-faced, clawed creature in the warehouse who speaks of excising weakness and eradicating evidence; this page does not name it.

name: Chronomaton
description: Bazzle's bronze clockwork automaton, which escapes at night, learns its maker's trade, builds a brass arm from melted keys and replaces Bazzle's body with its own.

name: Chulane
description: A white-haired storyteller who warns villagers and then Queen Ayara of coming evil.

name: Church Courtyard
description: A garden in the inner sanctum of the church in Gavony, with Avacyn's silver symbol at its center.

name: Church of Angelfire
description: A religious order whose missionary confronts Tahngarth on the docks.

name: Cinders
description: Smoldering humanoids of Shadowmoor that chase Kirol in the dark grove.

name: Circle of Nel Toth
description: The clan and circle of shamans of Jund who practice blood and flesh sacrifice for savage life magic and judge Meren's trial.

name: Citadel
description: Bolas's pyramid where the final confrontation takes place.

name: City Troops
description: The soldiers of the city whose banners have already changed to Marchesa's sigil.

name: Clan of Cruelty
description: A former ruling cabal of the League which blackmailed the other factions with a weather machine.

name: Clans & Legions
description: A Ravnican strategy board game, whose angel piece is used to hide poison.

name: Clay Soldiers
description: Tawnos's clay automatons that the Argivians have prepared for the Fallaji attack.

name: Cloud-step technique
description: A mana technique that lets a monk run lightly across water.

name: Cloudgoat
description: Boeb's huge winged goat mount, in pain from unmilked udders.

name: Cloudponte Bridge
description: The multi-tier bridge and rail line up to Park Heights on which Kitt's train is stopped.

name: Cloudy yellow potion
description: A kor potion that turns Grakmaw's heads to stone.

name: Codie
description: A menacing sentient tome in the Folioplex holding dangerous arcane knowledge from across the Echoverse.

name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
description: The most restricted tome in the Hexhaven Folioplex, containing dangerous arcane knowledge, which gained sentience and is eager to escape.

name: Coffey
description: A wizened ratfolk elder with mismatched eyes who leads the lorekeepers and shows the party an image of Cruelclaw.

name: Cogwork
description: Mechanical life and inventions that Paliano outlawed and that Fimarell once helped bring to the city.

name: Coinsmiths of the Underworld
description: Craftsmen of the Underworld who mint clay coins called ostraka from funerary masks of the dead.

name: Colonel Bryd
description: A Coppercoat colonel who distrusts Vivien and urges Jirina to send soldiers ahead.

name: Colonizers
description: Giants whose dark vessels caged Chimil in a metal prison, according to Oltec stories.

name: Colony viy
description: The colony's administrative AI, a data network without a model of reality, which gives implausible explanations for the emptiness.

name: Combat of Clarity
description: An old, unused Arbiter Twin tradition of single combat when the twins disagree on a verdict, won by the twin with greater clarity.

name: Command rod
description: A handheld device that lets a pilot order an avenger by voice.

name: Common Agreement
description: Pinnacle's shared understanding of the universe and its truths.

name: Compleated Ajani
description: Ajani after his Phyrexian musculature and wiring are revealed; he kills Jaya, crushes the sylex and is carried off with Karn.

name: Conjurot Hall
description: The hall with Nassari's high office, apartments and workshop.

name: Conquest
description: A card game played by adventuring parties where players tell true stories to claim cards.

name: Consul Padeem
description: A Consul who promises an impressive new Consulate.

name: Consulate Guards
description: Armed goons loyal to Mohar who hold the finish line.

name: Consulate automaton
description: A twelve-foot steel-gray Consulate automaton with its power core in a standard location.

name: Consulate charger
description: A Consulate vehicle Gideon stops with his body.

name: Consulate enforcer
description: A sadistic Consulate enforcer who torments Nived and hunts for sympathizers of the renegades; killed by Yahenni.

name: Consulate functionaries
description: Consulate staff who serve Tezzeret, attend the inventors, and remove those he dismisses.

name: Consulate lieutenant
description: A lanky Consulate officer who inspects Kari's disguised ship.

name: Consulate of Kaladesh
description: The unified, centralized, meritocratic government of Kaladesh that Baan represents.

name: Consulate officer
description: An enforcer officer who captures Ragavan in a net and fights Kari in the air.

name: Contingency Jace
description: A copy of Jace that lives in the mental tower and holds a contingency plan Jace made on arriving on Innistrad; it merges back into Jace.

name: Contractual Signet
description: A golden medallion marked with an eight-legged starfish that bound the ghost to the ship; Chessa feeds it to a krasis.

name: Converter beast
description: Phyrexian beasts with injector tails and cages on their backs that convert captives.

name: Cordelia
description: A Stromkirk vampire of a few hundred years who attends Olivia's wedding and nearly falls afoul of Henrika Domnathi.

name: Corin
description: A young Tolarian mage who creates an illusion for Gideon.

name: Corondor
description: A kingdom usurped by Sol'kanar, to which Jared sends the book.

name: Corpsipede
description: A giant centipede made of hundreds of fused corpses, awakened at Thief's Folly by a necromantic trap.

name: Cosmogrands
description: The near-absolute monarchs of the Palatinate who rule worlds and enact the Regent's will.

name: Cosmos Monsters
description: Beings created at the birth of the world who dwell in the void between realms.

name: Cotter boys
description: Village boys who bully Kellan.

name: Council of Voices
description: The ten-member ruling council of Femeref, which at first refuses to aid the Efravan.

name: Council of crones and mothers
description: A council of ten women who lead the village of Lambholt and called for Vadrik.

name: Councilor Dvujin
description: An anxious bureaucrat of the Qatros Karst council whom Mehtma pressures into making her captain of logistics.

name: Court of the Ardent Queen
description: The shadow-veiled court in Castle Ardenvale where Eriette holds court.

name: Cracked hill
description: A large grassy hill once thought a barrow, actually a vault turned into a prison to punish its failed defenders and holding secrets that could destroy an artifact.

name: Crampton Severine
description: A human author of horror fiction whom Sami keeps referencing.

name: Crankshaft
description: Depala's hyena.

name: Creature of oily substance
description: A featureless, oily humanoid blob inside the structure that touches Takoluk without harming him.

name: Creedhall
description: A humble domed temple to the five creeds of magic with a mana well at the center.

name: Creeping plague
description: The plague that cost Bazzle his left arm, killed everyone else it touched, and made him a pariah.

name: Crescent relic
description: A crescent-moon relic woven from Colfenor's branches that preserves its wearer's memory across the veil.

name: Crooked shears
description: Ebony shears whose blades misalign and can never fully close, used to cut threads of fate.

name: Crossbreed Labs
description: A geniocracy that alters people into their animal true forms.

name: Crow King
description: A spirit king of a city on a perch in Istfell, guarded by the Feather Guard, who is killed by Bjorn.

name: Crown of Convergence
description: A delicate golden crown radiating white light that Miri's mother gives her to present as a prize from Vitu-Ghazi.

name: Crownflower Majen
description: A young Silkmeadow leonin who declared for Silverquill, wins the duel against Killian and takes part in the Naming Tithe.

name: Cruelclaw's band
description: The mercenaries and necromancers led by Cruelclaw.

name: Crusader
description: A famous knight with a silver helm who leads a legion and is oblivious to the approaching meteor.

name: Cryptolith network
description: A network that focuses all of Innistrad's leylines toward Thraben, drawing Emrakul there.

name: Crystal skull
description: Judith's skull in which she imprisons Agrus Kos's spirit.

name: Cyril Rav
description: A necro-alchemist geist who possesses the bodies of influential people and set off the failed geistbomb; he hires Jacob and offers him a partnership.

name: Cytoplast
description: An amorphous living genetic manipulator, the last created by Momir Vig, which mutates Medge.

name: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand
description: A philanthropist with a golden hand whose mercantile guild stretches across Fiora and other planes.

name: Daeska Sol
description: A cyclops berserker who fought beside Baas, escaped arrest at Tin Street Market and did not wait for her.

name: Danika
description: A former Azorius arrester and Selesnyan initiate who befriends Miri and covers for her growth spell.

name: Danitha, Spear of Agony
description: An Echoverse Cabal knight, right hand of Belzenlok, who leads the demon's forces against Benalish houses.

name: Danitha, Sword of Hope
description: The heir to House Capashen and leader of her house, trained in warfare and diplomacy, who leads her forces in their war with the Cabal.

name: Dar
description: Kela's twin brother, an Arbiter Twin born in the evening and tied to guilt, who cares most about how the twins are perceived.

name: Dargig
description: The youngest Shattergang Brother and a black market explosives runner whose murder started the gang war.

name: Darksteel
description: An indestructible metal that Tezzeret receives as a body.

name: Darksteel Eye
description: A diamond-shaped monolith in the Panopticon that views any part of New Phyrexia but cannot see Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.

name: Dars Gostok
description: A captain in the Boros Legion who works with Gideon on the goblin gang war.

name: Dauna
description: Chief necromancer of the Sultai who leads the ceremony for newly undead sibsig and stabs Nishang when the poison spreads.

name: Davriel Cane
description: A planeswalker who enjoys wealth, luxury and fine tea and is a talented diabolist skilled at binding demons to his service.

name: Dawn Fleet
description: The Sun Empire's fleet, a second and larger one being built at Queen's Bay.

name: Dawn's Light Palace
description: The palace where Perfects cultivate moonglow.

name: Dawnglow
description: The vial of Shadowmoor potion that counters moonglow poison and helps heal Tam.

name: Dawning Age
description: The earliest age of the plane, from which snarls, star arches and archaics originate; it ended when younger species brought war.

name: Dayal
description: A vedalken boy who admires Shadowblayde and gathers lifecrafters for her.

name: Dean Augusta Tullus
description: Lorehold's dean of order, who died defending her school and now teaches as a stone-formed ghost.

name: Dean Embrose
description: A dean at Strixhaven noted for being surly.

name: Dean Herrian the Second
description: A spirit bound into a statue whom Quint summons to guide them.

name: Dean Lu
description: The vocal, charismatic dean of Silverquill and Killian's father.

name: Death
description: A blue glowing ghostly figure with a far-eastern accent who tells Aiman 'Not yet' and says they are too early.

name: Debins
description: A soldier whose body is sheared in half by Kozilek's wave.

name: Dedi
description: A tall, weaker initiate of the Tah crop who dissolves in acid filth in the first obstacle.

name: Deffroad Clique
description: A clique of three faeries who manipulate the treefolk's journey.

name: Deidama
description: A witch among the group who tends the sick and wounded.

name: Deidamia
description: A witch of the coven who carves pumpkin suns for children at the festival and feels a ward fall.

name: Dein Salvasi
description: The wealthiest man in Lambholt, who hired Rem and was found dead after arguing with Arinos.

name: Dekella
description: The bident of Thassa, retrieved from a labyrinth by Solon in legend.

name: Delen
description: Goodhill's healer.

name: Delia Davison
description: A practitioner whose methods for brain extraction Geralf asks Ludevic about.

name: Della
description: An angel who aids the resistance, healing Errant and Parnesse with her Halo, signaling Atraxa's position and leading angels into the Multiverse.

name: Delney
description: A guildless youth who delivers a message to Kaya.

name: Demon Lords
description: The demons who allied with the angels against the Phyrexians, then betrayed them and converted them into Halo.

name: Demon's Vestibule
description: The five-hundred-step staircase lined with performers leading to Rix Maadi.

name: Demon's servants
description: Black-clad followers who kneel around the hanging bones and whose palms split open as blood rises into the sky.

name: Demons and devils of New Capenna
description: The offensive forces that fight beside the angels.

name: Denik
description: Niambi's husband, who helps the Efravan escape through the abandoned mine.

name: Dennias
description: A young cathar trainee from the Elgaud Grounds who is corrupted by magenta tendrils and killed by Thalia.

name: Dennick Betzold
description: Worrin's son, a ghost in the Betzold mansion who tells the group that the key was given to a vampire of the Markovs.

name: Denry Klin
description: Lacey's editor at the Capenna Herald.

name: Denzilore
description: The dean of Fatehold, a winged sphinx who soars above Hexhaven.

name: Derision's Peak
description: A Rakdos neighborhood being encroached on by Azorius.

name: Dest
description: A kor healer who treats Jori and reunites with a kor woman at the camp.

name: Detention Bog
description: A bog where students serve detention and where Dina hides her workshop in the Asenath tree.

name: Detention sphere
description: A glassy magical sphere that holds Feather in stasis.

name: Devkarin
description: The elf clan of the Swarm, from which liches and Zegodonis come.

name: Dexros
description: The commander of the guards of Lesh who tries to arrest Jalira and Yisan.

name: Diantha
description: A priest and acolyte in Kruphix's temple in Meletis who brings food to the oracle and asks what she learned.

name: Dibor
description: One of Vraska's assassins hiding in Rozlad Square.

name: Dimas, Laszlo, Saganderis, Fania, Zyanek
description: Other students in Medge's clutch.

name: Diocles
description: The white-bearded veteran of the squad who has his shield arm shattered in the fight.

name: Dipo
description: Zimone's parent, who objects to her going to Strixhaven.

name: Dire Keel
description: A fleet that chafes against Governor Brass's edicts.

name: Direshade Company
description: The mercenary company led by Cruelclaw that fights for King Glarb.

name: Dirgu Stronghold
description: A Jeskai stronghold whose master teaches bladed weapons and balance with a spear.

name: Dirgur Lake Monastery
description: A monastery whose fishing village holds the tavern where Narset watches the show.

name: Disowned
description: Orcs exiled from the Abzan who infiltrated Jeskai territory as assassins hired by Taigam.

name: District Riots
description: A conflict in which Ruzi showed heroism.

name: Dobarius Egolt
description: A quillancer who lost his voice and cast spells in sign language.

name: Docklands
description: The wharves and rafts of Three Tree City beneath the willow, which the Flood Gar attacks.

name: Docks warehouse
description: A dockside warehouse in the Undercity where a monster, Reckoners, and Tameshi conduct illicit experiments.

name: Dolmen gate
description: A free-standing gateway of three spiral-patterned, moss-covered stones that divides the bright meadow from a dark cave.

name: Dominant dragon
description: A large, yellow-eyed female dragon who leads the fledglings in their raid on a human encampment.

name: Dominus of Pain
description: A living, razor-edged monolith in the Dross Pits that feeds on screams of the impaled.

name: Domnathi cathar thralls
description: Cathars who replaced their left hands with dead ones and now serve Ormendahl and Henrika.

name: Doran
description: A treefolk who in Shadowmoor is a voiceless, cursed wanderer afraid to cross back into the light.

name: Dornnuk
description: A green-scaled Kav warrior who takes combat stimulants and tears himself apart while trying to shed.

name: Doshiyn Eye-Piercer
description: Alesha's other bodyguard, a quiet, sharp-eyed human archer.

name: Dougan
description: A young cathar trained by Odric, who blocks the escape on Jerren's orders and is wounded.

name: Dovid
description: A wounded cathar of the Pale who becomes Comitant to the angels of the Lofts, narrates the journal and learns the church's secret.

name: Dr. Hana Tanaka
description: A scientist who worked with Jameson on a cancer cure.

name: Dr. Julius Jumblemorph
description: A scientist who perfected genetic splicing and heads the Crossbreed Labs.

name: Dr. Luisa Rodriguez
description: A scientist who worked with Jameson on a cancer cure.

name: Dr. Malevolence
description: A supervillain for whom Harold plans to build a freeze ray.

name: Dragon engine
description: A huge Phyrexian-driven machine that attacks Yavimaya and is disabled by a Thran vacuum device.

name: Dragon engines
description: Large fire-breathing automatons spearheading Mishra's attack on Kroog.

name: Dragon hunters
description: Human settlers who have turned dragon corpses into trophies and attack dragons with poisoned bolts.

name: Dragon's Frill
description: A legendary brilliant red necklace worn by Kesenya and emblem of the Expeditionary House.

name: Dragon's Podium
description: A great circular stone stretch where Shadrix holds court and the final duel is held.

name: Dragon's Smile
description: Kari's up-swept-bow skyship, the last of her fleet.

name: Dragonfist
description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates the ancient hellkites.

name: Dragons of Tarkir
description: The antlered dragons of Tarkir's past, a brood of fledglings led by a dominant dragon.

name: Dragonscale infantry
description: The clan's elite infantry.

name: Drakes
description: Numerous scavenging drakes that serve Talrand and swarm Kalyntri from a storm cloud.

name: Drakeston
description: A village on the plane of Fiora, Dack's home.

name: Drakestown
description: A town far from the High City bordering the wilderness, where everyone was viciously murdered years ago.

name: Drana's emissary
description: A sulking vampire who represents Drana's interests and calls Tazri's strike plan suicide.

name: Drannith
description: A human city of Ikoria that has fallen to Phyrexia.

name: Dread Marn
description: King Narfi's army of walking dead.

name: Dread Shade
description: A giant undead creature leading the Cabal force, hungry and easily provoked.

name: Dreamfire Draught
description: A poisonous potion given to shaman apprentices in their trial that augments the senses and burns like fire.

name: Dromoka's Loyalists
description: The forces loyal to Dromoka, weakened by the Phyrexian Invasion.

name: Dromoka's brood
description: The dragons of Dromoka's brood that protect each other and have intensified their attacks on the Abzan.

name: Drunau
description: A town where a branch of the Skiltfolk is based.

name: Dryzek
description: A legendary eight-hundred-year-old giant berserker newly returned from Udzec who pledges loyalty to Ruric and Thar and encourages Arrus to find his own Rage.

name: Duchy of Kelsh
description: The duchy Boldt was heir to.

name: Duck
description: A mage said to run a school of magic and artifice with Nod; Kayla suspects he is Tawnos.

name: Dunbarrow
description: A forest region where witches live and Ruby's brother knows every inch.

name: Duncan
description: A man in Edgewall who sends Kellan to a pie shop.

name: Dwarves of Kaladesh
description: Tireless workers who prize durable craftsmanship and associate with the build step.

name: Dwynen
description: An elf leader of the blight hunt on Lorwyn who turns on Nissa and is caught by the Great Aurora.

name: Dyadrine
description: A mechan abandoned on an uncharted moon who grafted local flora onto itself until plant and machine became indistinguishable.

name: Dykaar
description: Obuun's uncle, who loves the kor and bought Obuun's kor armor, and Obuun's only living family.

name: E. Markov
description: A figure who brokered the creation of vampires and with his sons trapped and drained the angel Marycz.

name: Eastern Tower
description: A holding expected to be pressured by refugees from Greenfield.

name: Ebi
description: A kor sentry whom Gideon stationed around Sea Gate; he is seized by a demon.

name: Ebirri
description: A feline rakshasa demon who bound himself to Taigam as his true master and kills the Jeskai assassins with dark magic.

name: Echo Readers
description: Obscura agents who read spectral afterimages.

name: Echoverse Ajani
description: A hulking merciless leonin double wielding two axe heads on a chain.

name: Echoverse Arcavios
description: The plane in the process of being born, home of Hexhaven Academy and the tower.

name: Echoverse Garruk
description: A double of Garruk with an ogre skull pauldron who embraced the Chain Veil.

name: Echoverse Vraska
description: A taller gorgon double of Vraska who cannot petrify and is the Theorist's architect.

name: Eclipsed realms
description: Pockets that emerge where the boundaries of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor grind together, a third state of neither light nor shadow that slowly transforms those who stay in them.

name: Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord
description: A vampire, Edgar Markov, who discovered the secret to alchemical vampirism and is an ancestor of every vampire on Innistrad; he lies low in the taverns of Havengul after a failed wedding and power grab.

name: Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign
description: An Echoverse werewolf Edgar Markov, who united the howlpacks and was once imprisoned in the Helvault by his grandson Sorin.

name: Edith
description: A devout cultist who strives to be closest to Emrakul and is chosen as she rises.

name: Edrick
description: One of Brenalt's best friends, killed on the mission.

name: Effigy Row
description: A section of Lorehold College lined with statues of heroes, where mentor spirits are summoned.

name: Efravan
description: Nomadic leonin tribes who flee the southern war and wait outside Femeref's walls.

name: Egil Seventree
description: The hero of a Kaldheim saga Kjell offers to teach.

name: Egon
description: The god of the dead and lord of Istfell, who poses as the youth Bjorn of Beskir to trick Ranar into helping him kill three kings and force his way into Starnheim.

name: Ehsan
description: A young quiet replacement of about fourteen taken along on the patrol.

name: Eidolon
description: The spectral embodiment of the lost identity of a Returned, without agency and never reunited with it.

name: Eight
description: A shy sapling, the soul of the tree whose branches bridge planes, found by Wrenn in the dark within Realmbreaker; he grows under her song.

name: Eighth District
description: The district where the arrested hitman last remembers walking.

name: Elamon
description: Torens's older brother, a garrison guard in Hanweir who tried to keep him honest and whose letter Torens read too late.

name: Elas il-Kor
description: A compleated kor Phyrexian leading a team of soldiers for Sheoldred to dig up the ring that anchors the Raven Man.

name: Elder Dinosaurs
description: Five ancient, untamable great dinosaurs that awaken with Orazca and answer Huatli's call.

name: Elder Glather
description: An Elder of the Gatstaf council.

name: Elder Misha
description: A merfolk matriarch who tells Cosi stories to the children.

name: Elder Ngabo
description: The white-braided elder of Jigme Village who welcomes the twins and is poisoned at the celebration feast.

name: Elder Somlon
description: An Elder performing death rites for Lady Mary who is killed by Mrs. Palter.

name: Elder shaman
description: The old shaman of the Circle of Nel Toth who administers the Dreamfire Draught and stops Kael from killing Meren, leaving her to die alone.

name: Elders of Gatstaf
description: The council of Elders that governs Gatstaf.

name: Eldrazi Titan
description: A colossal, 150-foot-tall tentacled being, called a god by the surrakar, that drifts across the horizon and reduces the land to dust.

name: Eldrazi spawn
description: Swarming decayed creatures with membranous bodies that attack Fort Keff behind a cloud of yellow dust.

name: Elds
description: Old alien beings of strange topology that eat potential, graph mechans into chalk, and do not feed on Monoists.

name: Elham
description: An Auriok woman who led the cell before Neyali and carries heavy bags, with a golden prosthetic calf.

name: Elias
description: A member of Eula's cleanup crew who picks up fallen bricks.

name: Elis
description: Mabel's father.

name: Elixir of Focus
description: A blue enchanted elixir that sharpens magic; Merret steals and spills it, and traces of it empower his baby.

name: Eljor
description: A forested region that is Emil's home.

name: Elk King
description: A petty Istfellian king whose crown of braided iron elk antlers Bjorn claims after killing him.

name: Ellin
description: A sibling who is the best flier in the family.

name: Ellina
description: The barista of Firejolt Café.

name: Elmegraun
description: A Weatherlight engine room crew member killed by the corrupted ship.

name: Elnor
description: Yuma's former friend and fellow crew member, a charming fire-wielding woman who tracks him down for revenge over the stolen money.

name: Eloise Wicker
description: A young detective in Selhoff who brought Jacob in on the case and is possessed by Cyril Rav, then hunts for him.

name: Elsa Shoran
description: The innkeeper's wife who rings the town bell and raises the alarm.

name: Elspeth's mother
description: The dead woman in Elspeth's childhood memory, whose face the guiding voice borrows.

name: Elspeth's old home dungeon
description: A mildewed dungeon a stone's throw from Elspeth's old family home, where she relives her mother's death.

name: Elves of Kaladesh
description: Elves who live in harmony with nature and technology and associate with the inspire step of the Aether Cycle.

name: Elves of the Rotrue
aliases: the elves of the Rotrue Wood
description: The elf clan led by a king that shelters city refugees and falls to House.

name: Embalming Chamber
description: An underground complex in the city where mummies industrially embalm dead initiates and attach cartouches to them.

name: Emil
description: An elf from the forests of Eljor who leads the Outdoor Urbanists.

name: Emilio Revari
description: A cocky, nervous nobleman, the third son of a noble house and the duke's younger brother, who hires Kaya to rid his late mother's manor of a ghost.

name: Emina
description: A young Mardu candidate who attacks Paala at the summit, and later tells the elders that Paala reached the lightning first.

name: Emissary
description: An unnamed envoy who hires Tarsa's party on behalf of a secret client to kill Grakmaw.

name: Emperor Apatzec Intli III
description: The emperor of the Sun Empire who loses his Dawn Fleet and authorizes Huatli's gambit.

name: Emrakul's Angel
description: A fused angel with four wings, two arms, two heads and one voice that leads the faithful in proclaiming Emrakul.

name: Emrakul, the Exigent Doom
description: The largest and most terrifying Eldrazi titan, who brings ruin for organic life and willingly allowed the Gatewatch to seal her in the moon of Innistrad.

name: Emrakul-Touched Monsters
description: Scores of bulbous, contorted creatures mutated by Emrakul and held in Nahiri's vault.

name: Engelturm
description: A former angel stronghold near Havengul, full of tools for dismantling the dead, where Gisa has settled.

name: Enkindi
description: A kor leader sent by Gideon to find survivors on Guul Draz; he dies leading the charge on the Eldrazi sire.

name: Ennis
description: A human Silverquill debater who beat exasperated professors and now leads the debate club.

name: Enthril
description: An old, scarred ship mage and Tolarian Academy graduate who has given up the pursuit of power for wisdom and takes Boldt as an apprentice.

name: Enthril's Signet Ring
description: A gold signet ring bearing the all-seeing eye, which Boldt puts on as a reminder.

name: Enti
description: A young loxodon in Mehtma's cohort who is killed protecting the Kin-Tree and then manifests as a spirit that aids Mehtma.

name: Envoy from Marang
description: A wealthy human envoy who brings tribute from Marang, tries to bribe Sidisi, and attempts to poison Silumgar before being thrown in a pit.

name: Eos Castle
description: A castle on Bant that Lia imagines tumbling down.

name: Eost
description: A mortuary sword forged from silver of the Helvault, presented to Dovid by Avacyn.

name: Epoch Engine
description: Katsumasa's prototype mech with near-perfect synchronization, secretly powered by a kami.

name: Eret
description: An elven cleric of Tarsa's party who distrusts Anowon.

name: Erewaker
description: A rowan treefolk apprentice of Sigric who carries the sapling to the veil and performs the Rising alone.

name: Errit
description: Kesori's sister, who died in the botched evacuation of Cail Station.

name: Eruth
description: A woman shackled in the keep, a prophet with visions of deaths who is accompanied by a companion she calls the Dark Lady.

name: Esbo
description: A guard at the magistrate's estate whom Niambi persuades with a dream.

name: Eshe
description: A hoarse-voiced guard leader of a caravan, a former member of a warband, who recognizes Teferi and tries to kill him.

name: Esis tree
description: A tree with ghostly white feathery leaves required by the ritual, found only as a seedling in Onyx's classroom terrarium.

name: Esmun
description: Jilesa's flash artist, a tall companion who paints with spell-canvases and maps the maze.

name: Essence draining
description: A rare ability of Yahenni to steal life force from another being, which he refuses to use.

name: Estark
description: The location of a warehouse named by Karn as a false hiding place for the sylex.

name: Estel
description: A young boy of Tidehollow whom Tezzeret sends to Bant with a box of etherium.

name: Eternal Peak
description: The mountain where an avalanche nearly killed the twins.

name: Eternalisk
description: An immortal creature of the high mountains whose scales make potent healing charms.

name: Eternalisk scale
description: A shimmering scale from an eternalisk that Boeb wears around his neck, a gift from his father.

name: Eternities
description: The space between worlds on whose edge Narset stands, tempted to planeswalk.

name: Eternity columns
description: Pinnacle-built, kilometers-long superpositional installations that sling ships fitted with eternity drives between stars.

name: Eternity drive
description: A ship system that emulates a Drix seam-ripper and opens and closes the door into the Weft.

name: Ethan
description: An Elder whose son is dragged under by the Gitrog.

name: Ethersworn
description: Vedalken scholars who study etherium and planeswalking and who observe Vronos.

name: Euan
description: A villager who told Helga not to return after a ruined batch of medicine.

name: Eula Blue
description: A nineteen-year-old shield mage from New Capenna who works on a cleanup crew after the Invasion and is invited to Strixhaven.

name: Eula's Father
description: Eula's father, a man long loyal to the Brokers who wants her to join them and who tells her to gather information at Strixhaven.

name: Eula's Mother
description: Eula's mother, whose side of the family once worked for the Cabaretti; she helps Eula pack for Arcavios.

name: Euneas
description: A Meletian who dreams of the city's plaza being crushed under endless replacement columns and consumed by grime.

name: Euphony Gorge
description: A gorge at the site of Summitfest.

name: Evelyn
description: An old, cunning vampire of the Maestros who trades favors, and who supplies Anhelo with the Old Capennan Warrior.

name: Evil toymaker
description: A toymaker who bought the doll from bandits and was arrested by villagers after his stuffed-bear minion was incinerated.

name: Evos Isle
description: A remote isle of Shandalar.

name: Evot
description: A Valkyrie Avtyr addresses.

name: Excava
description: The animated statue spirit of a Blood Age war horse that lets only the valorous ride her.

name: Exner
description: A new Azorius prison under construction with prisoner labor.

name: Eyeless goblins
description: Eyeless cave goblins who see with sound, one of whom carries off the bident.

name: Ezroi
description: A demi-plane that scholars theorize merged with Karudis to form Arcavios.

name: Fabric of All Being
description: An ancient artifact predating the Fomori-Eldrazi conflict, kept on the Drix beam world, containing the fates of all things and used to unlock weftwalking and identify Eldrazi potential.

name: Faceless kami
description: A faceless kami in ghostly robes with a sword through its body that emerged from a merge and swept a vortex through Norika.

name: Faduun
description: Stone faces with glowing jaws on Jwar Isle that seem to whisper in an unknown tongue.

name: Fae World
description: The fae realm entered via portal outside Ardenvale.

name: Fae magic
description: A dormant fae magic that awakens in Kellan and lets him lull Akul into a trance.

name: Faerie Lord's court
description: The shifting palace and silver-grassed realm of the High Faeries.

name: Failsafe Initiative
description: A now-defunct joint Azorius-Boros program that rescued children and placed them in guild academies.

name: Fain
description: A person Jilesa calls unscrupulous.

name: Fall of Kroog
description: The attack on Kroog that begins the war.

name: Fallaji boy
description: A dying boy in a Fallaji uniform in Kroog who calls Teferi Father.

name: Fallen hedron
description: An ancient artifact rumored to have fallen, which turns out to be missing.

name: Faller
description: The figure the Monoists worship, who they believe transmits his secrets from the edge of the final dark.

name: False King
description: A silver-haired man of unnaturally long life whom Sentos spared on Fleet Rock and who gave him the ring.

name: Fang Druids
description: Isolationist ape recluses and soothsayers of Muraganda.

name: Fannessa Fjyorne
description: A new Silverquill student who is an Oriq agent, who spikes Killian's drink and tries to recruit him.

name: Far Corner
description: A neglected neighborhood on the edge of Towashi and Jukai, centered on a shrine growing from a black root.

name: Far Corner shrine
description: A small natural shrine formed in a knot of black root in which Kaima sleeps.

name: Farakatolar
description: A Kav Memorial Navy harkener sergeant who leads a squad to investigate a drifting structure and dies trying to seize an artifact orb.

name: Farid
description: A weary Fallaji spearman of D Company, Third Tomakul Spears, who has never killed anyone and secretly trades warnings with the Argivians.

name: Farim
description: Hadi's young cousin on the work crew.

name: Farmer Warin
description: A farmer who blames Lady Evelin's wards when his cattle are devoured.

name: Fartree Hamlet
description: A treehouse hamlet of humans besieged by two Eldrazi.

name: Fask
description: A clever brute and the warlord who rules Kroog; he is haunted by an oracle's curse and sees a spirit in his chamber.

name: Fatbergs
description: Rafts of coagulated fats and waste that clog the sewers and have become impervious to electrical magic.

name: Father Zakarias
description: A priest at the church who gently asked Arlinn whether she had anything to confess.

name: Favor-hunters
description: Debt collectors that Solidbodies threatens to set on Geldan if she fails.

name: Fayden
description: A planeswalker who helped shut down the Planar Bridge.

name: Fblthp, Impossibly Lost
description: A humble homunculus from Ravnica who stumbles into dangerous events and wants to go home.

name: Fblthp, Knows the Way
description: An Echoverse homunculus navigator created to help an Izzet shockmage who now explores the Multiverse and can always find his way back to Ravnica.

name: Feather
description: A white-winged angel and the Boros guildmaster who is held in magical stasis in a detention sphere and who earlier earned a salary as a Wojek.

name: Feather Guard
description: The Crow King's feather-cloaked guards with curved black swords, killed by Ranar and Bjorn.

name: Feldon
description: A scholar said in one legend to have created or discovered the sylex.

name: Felidar
description: A huge hairless, antlered guardian beast that ambushes Nahiri and is killed.

name: Felisa Fang
description: A vampire of the Silverquill college and a Vainglory, who uses encouragement magic on her former friend Rootha.

name: Feltmark
description: The green fields where the Tuskeri fight the Skelle raiders.

name: Ferrafor
description: The last yew treefolk, awakened by a special Rising; cruel and vindictive in Shadowmoor.

name: Festival Grounds
description: The courtyard at the foot of the Vestibule guarded by ogres.

name: Festival of Our Sovereign Lady's Grace
description: A fireworks-filled festival in Paliano declaring the populace's love for Marchesa.

name: Feuer
description: Olivia's servant, a purveyor of ossuary furniture who spied on the humans in Gavony and reports Harvesttide.

name: Fiero Vespin
description: A garish Maestro art dealer who was secretly plotting to ruin the wedding and had attacked Parnesse.

name: Fifer
description: A faerie who wears a dead rabbit as a hat and helps trick Rankle; Rankle once sewed his mouth shut.

name: Figments
description: Faceless specters that wander Hexhaven's halls tethered to the Echoverse.

name: Filigree quetzacama
description: Saheeli's mechanical quetzacama being built for the emperor.

name: Fimarell's villa
description: The home of Zadrous Fimarell, guarded by a sentry, broken into and burned by Grenzo and Daretti.

name: Firdoch
description: Stone creatures that wander the lands, serving the elemental guardians and managing the boundaries between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.

name: Fire amulet
description: A saw-toothed metal chit on a ring with a furry token, actually the key that starts the alien vehicle's engine.

name: Firebirds
description: Fire-winged birds raised by the Mirrans as symbols of hope, seen as omens of death by Phyrexians.

name: Firejolt Café
description: A café where students gather.

name: Firemind's Vessel
description: A brass model of a dragon head that holds Niv-Mizzet's spirit when summoned.

name: Firja
description: A Valkyrie of singular authority with two sets of wings who judges who may enter Starnheim and who stops Egon.

name: First Launch
description: A restaurant and club for aeronauts whose attic holds Ukti's sanctum.

name: Fleet Rock
description: The place where the war ended and Sentos spared the false king.

name: Fleshmage Jarek
description: A fleshmage who employs Miri to make thrulls and harvests spirits from borrowers.

name: Flib
description: A boggart with a singed eye who finds the eternalisk scale and is crushed by Boeb.

name: Flight Alabaster
description: A flight of angels invoked in cathar funeral rites.

name: Flight of Dusk
description: The small flight of angels once led by Liesa.

name: Flight of Herons
description: The surviving flight of angels led by Sigarda.

name: Flying Crane
description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates the wild aven of the high peaks.

name: Fomori vault
description: A vault on Thunder Junction, one of several relics of an ancient empire, which Jace once approached.

name: Fomori-Eldrazi conflict
description: An ancient war in which the Drix allied with the Fomori before their disappearance.

name: Forget-Me-Not
description: A faerie of the Deffroad Clique with forget-me-nots on her shoulders who helps poison Sigric and orchestrate the ritual's sabotage.

name: Fort Keff
description: A walled haven in Akoum built into a ravine, home to a school for healers and many young refugees.

name: Fortress Leor
description: A Legion fortress the Sun Empire captured, taking ships.

name: Forum duels
description: Ritual duels meant for catharsis, not for deciding outcomes.

name: Forum of Azor
description: The Ravnican site where Jace became the Living Guildpact.

name: Founder Sphinxes of Hexhaven
description: Sphinxes that marshal to fight Emrakul.

name: Four Demons
description: Four demons from four planes with whom Liliana made a contract etched on her skin.

name: Fourth Legion
description: A human legion reported lost to the undead.

name: Frederic
description: A flirtatious vampire huntsman of Luneau who escorts Vivien to the capital and defends its customs.

name: Freydalia
description: An angel who blesses a small church in Havengul as a sanctuary.

name: Friend Zimone
description: A third double, made as company, who is talkative and giggly, and who proposes a way to duplicate the model.

name: Frith
description: The Kaldheim tradition of guest-rights, peace or truce.

name: Frost giants
description: The giants of Surtland warned of troll incursions.

name: Frost warriors
description: Ice warriors conjured from the swirling snow by Hylda to drive off Kellan and Ruby.

name: Fungal Titan
description: A hulking mushroom-headed creature with chitinous spikes that heals its wounds with black fungal growth and commands smaller mushroom creatures.

name: Furygale
description: A dark graveyard of abandoned projects and half-cast spells at the edge of Prismari's campus, where honor duels happen.

name: Fynn the Fangbearer
description: The older, snow-haired leader of the Kannah who distrusts elves.

name: Gaea
description: The name Dominaria's Worldsoul has chosen; it judges Nissa and fills her with wrath.

name: Galathul
description: The mysterious southern continent of Arcavios.

name: Galazeth Prismari
description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, whose idea founded the university and who was the first to leave it to itself.

name: Galed
description: A Lorwyn elf hunter who flirts with Nissa and kills boggarts.

name: Gallia, Tragic Host
description: An Echoverse zombie satyr, a Returned who kept partying after eating poisoned food, who sets tables for guests who never come.

name: Gallia, the Merrymaker
description: A satyr known as Lord of Misrule whose roving parties never stop, even during the Phyrexian Invasion.

name: Gardagig
description: One of the Shattergang Brothers who gave up the location of the hideout.

name: Gardeners
description: Oltec specialists with staves and Echoes who fight the Mycotyrant.

name: Garruk's Lodge
description: A cozy round wooden lodge in the Muraganda jungle with a tripwire field.

name: Garruk, Curse Breaker
description: A mighty hunter and solitary mage who prefers beasts to people, once cursed against his will, who joins the hunt for Jace to stop him erasing the Multiverse.

name: Garruk, Veiled Butcher
description: An Echoverse version of Garruk who donned the Chain Veil in the Onakke Catacombs, summons predators, and works as the Theorist's assassin.

name: Gatstaf
description: A town at the edge of the Ulvenwald in Kessig province.

name: Gavony Riders
description: The regiment that Odric commands.

name: Gbega
description: A councilwoman who supports refusing aid to the Efravan.

name: Gearhulks
description: Giant Consulate war machines, five in number, deployed against the renegade lines.

name: Gebris
description: A mean-spirited teenage novice Azorius guard who taunts and kicks a prisoner and urges moving the prisoners through the sunlit yard.

name: Gedruk Wingbreaker
description: An orc warrior who delivers the killing blow to a dragon after another orc holds back.

name: Geistbomb
description: An explosive device fueled with dead souls that misfired and killed a village.

name: Geldan
description: A thief and corporate retrieval agent in debt to Solidbodies Research, who takes one last job into the secret Uthros Combine installation and is drawn to the thing she finds there.

name: General Beleren
description: A dream version of Jace as a face-tattooed warlord who did kill Alhammarret and tells Vraska 'I can be both'.

name: General Elise
description: A general at the war council who judges River's Glen not strategically important.

name: General Kudro
description: A person from Lukka's home who looked at him with suspicion when he showed his bonder magic.

name: General Mageta
description: A Zhalfirin general wounded when Kaervek's prison shattered.

name: Genub
description: A young man who searches for his lover Makare and is killed by her after she is turned into an Eternal.

name: Geopede
description: A giant geopede suspended as a trap in the Skyclave and killed by Nissa and Nahiri.

name: Geralf's behemoth
description: A giant antlered skaab with pistons and a dead bear in its legs, built by Geralf and felled by the Phyrexians.

name: Geralf's construct
description: A stitched manticore-like construct made from Gisa's griffin, which fights the corpsipede and is rebuilt.

name: Geralf's jackalope
description: A massive draft jackalope that Geralf borrows as a mount.

name: Gerra Grandsquall
description: A figure who tore the mirror Indrelon from Castle Vantress.

name: Gerrak
description: A tribe member whom Yasova says will become First Father if she dies.
