name: Gerrard's hourglass pendant
description: The part of the Legacy Gerrard kept, which belonged to his parents and which he leaves with Cordel.

name: Gerrel
description: The innkeeper of the town of Vess who sent Gideon to Rael.

name: Geth's fortress
description: A colossal black bone and red sinew fortress in the Dross Pits with an imitation throne.

name: Gethin
description: Cerys's late uncle, a bloomseeker and healer who refused to give Rhain dawnglove and hid a stem of it.

name: Ghalta the Immovable
description: An Echoverse three-horned dinosaur guardian with a cannon-proof hide who migrates farther to face the pirates threatening her kind.

name: Ghan
description: A Drix wefthunter who hunts Eldrazi-corrupted people with a seam-ripper, grieving his partner Sorothir, and tracks Kesori Umberlin's stolen artifact.

name: Ghirapur arena
description: The arena where Chandra was almost executed as a child and where Tezzeret duels Pia.

name: Ghitu
description: A people of Shiv whose elders feared saying the Shivan dragons' names.

name: Ghor Clan
description: The Gruul clan led by Ruric and Thar that Arrus belongs to.

name: Ghost-trap
description: A box the cult uses to hold Tamiyo's scroll echo and harvest her stories.

name: Ghouls
description: Undead raised by Gisa's whistled song that walk calmly toward her.

name: Ghrin-Danu
description: A name the witches give to the black dirt clinging to their teeth during their invocations.

name: Giant
description: An unnamed giant woman whom the faeries harry awake and who attacks the treefolk.

name: Giant wolf
description: A giant wolf with glowing eyes who thanks Lathril for rescuing one of his children and gives her a gift.

name: Gideon the Oathless
description: An Echoverse Kytheon Iora who learned sinister magic in prison, killed fellow inmates to defeat Heliod, and took the name Gideon Jura to avoid being remembered.

name: Gideon's Memorial
description: A memorial on Theros to Kytheon Iora, known as Gideon Jura, a founding member of the Gatewatch who died saving Liliana Vess from Nicol Bolas.

name: Gideon's buckler
description: A dented buckler shield that Chandra finds in the mud and carries as a weapon.

name: Gideon's teacher
description: The powerful mage who took young Gideon under his wing and taught him to hone his skills and the teaching of pain, death and honor.

name: Gift of the Threshold
description: The cult's ritual promising to cleanse initiates of fear through a chrysalis.

name: Gilt-Leaf
description: The seat to which elvish fiefdoms are connected as a means of survival.

name: Ginger, Queen of Sweets
description: A cookie queen who took up the fork the moment she was baked and leads her kingdom to victory.

name: Gisa and Nahiri's Monument
aliases: odd structure being built off the coast
description: A stone monument off the Nephalian coast built by Gisa's ghouls at Nahiri's request.

name: Gisa's army of the dead
description: The undead population of Thraben, including rats, bats, ravens and risen townsfolk, under Gisa's control.

name: Gisa's colossal sea-beast
description: A giant crab-kraken-lobster horror raised by Gisa from the estuary bottom, later rebuilt by Geralf with the behemoth's legs.

name: Gisa's griffin creature
description: A zombie griffin-manticore Gisa raises to ride.

name: Gisa's undead moondrake
description: An undead moondrake Gisa calls from the estuary muck, which kills a Phyrexian moondrake.

name: Gisla
description: A Valkyrie Avtyr addresses.

name: Glarb
description: The king whom Mabel blames for the destruction of her village.

name: Glassyk
description: A young Prismari elf and prodigy who saves Rootha with a thread of magic and later loses control of the elemental whale he was channeling.

name: Glimmervoid
description: A place on Mirrex from which the Mirrans scavenge metal plates to make hexgold.

name: Glimmervoid metal
description: A Mirran metal that Tyvar uses to turn his skin and others' into protective metal.

name: Glissa
description: A Phyrexian elf with a bladed arm and copper cord hair who spars joyfully with Vorinclex and takes Lukka under her command.

name: Glissa Sunseeker
description: The elf who finally defeated Memnarch.

name: Gobbler
description: A huge fanged, tusked and clawed megafauna awakened by Evendo's thaw, who steals Kadrik's pods and attacks the stasis pod.

name: Goblin Explosioneers
description: A goblin faction with a chaotic government that took over Steamflogger Industries.

name: Goblin clan
description: The goblin clan of the mountain over which Squee reigns and who are compleated.

name: God-Eternal
description: A one-armed, bird-headed God-Eternal that attacks the ritual and is burned to nothing by Niv-Mizzet.

name: Gohl
description: A horned orc youth in Mehtma's cohort, trapped in the rubble after the barrage and rescued by Mehtma.

name: Golamin
description: A caravan guard sent to scout north.

name: Golden City
description: A city on Ixalan that fears the monstrosaur.

name: Golden Ruler
description: The object whose possessor leads the Agents of S.N.E.A.K.

name: Golden-Tail Academy
description: The elite academy for Imperial samurai run by Swift-Arm.

name: Golem Rock
description: A landmark on the steppes near which smoke is first seen.

name: Golgari Undercity raid
aliases: the sweep of the Golgari Undercity
description: The largest Azorius sweep ever attempted, authorized by a Mass Arrest Order, in which nearly a hundred were killed, many in custody.

name: Golgari riot at the Detention Compound
description: A Mass Arrest of Golgari that turns into a revolt inside the Detention Compound.

name: Golgari undercity
description: The Golgari realm beneath Ravnica, home of Korozda the maze and the cathedral of Svogthos.

name: Golwanda the Bloodspiller
description: An orcish warlord with Thunder Riders, whose statue stands on Effigy Row.

name: Gonti's office
description: An opulent office at the end of a secret tunnel and Gonti's storeroom.

name: Gonti's residence
description: A palace disguised as a warehouse, full of stolen opulence and devices hidden from the Consulate.

name: Gorgon of Xathrid
description: A cursed gorgon from Xathrid who tortures Sentos for the eyes of a righteous man demanded by a demon, and who takes the ring.

name: Gorgon prisoner
description: An emaciated, bound and blindfolded gorgon among the Golgari prisoners, who is freed during the riot and vanishes in flickering light.

name: Gorma
description: A pest freed in Titan's Grave who developed an appetite for anything.

name: Governor Brass
description: The governor whose edicts the Dire Keel fleet chafes against.

name: Grakmaw
description: A giant multi-headed hydra haunting the Ondu Skyclave, possibly created by kor experiments, killed when Anowon petrifies it.

name: Grand Calcutron
description: The machine-bodied founder and leader of the Order of the Widget, formerly the inventor Calvin Granderson.

name: Grand Capenna Hall
description: The venue of Errant and Parnesse's wedding.

name: Grand Cenobite
description: Elspeth's former prison and the Phyrexian capital.

name: Grand Cosmocordance
description: A Sunstar theory that the future is not yet real, which Haliya invokes in argument.

name: Grandfather Karlov
description: A figure the ghost cites falsely as the author of the Divine Contract of Orzhova.

name: Granfer and Granmer
description: Helga's grandparents who encouraged her.

name: Gravelighter
description: A territorial kami of Jukai Forest with a stone face and a paper lantern, who attacks the group before Himoto commands her to retreat.

name: Gray-winged Valkyrie
description: Avtyr's dove-gray-winged counterpart who watches from a roof.

name: Graypelt
description: Hamadi's hunting and guiding people near Turntimber who made their living storing mana and were annihilated by the Eldrazi.

name: Grazak
description: Khrad's raptor companion, who grows huge when fed mana pearls.

name: Great Aunt Bea
description: Tashi's aunt who suddenly appears in the armchair after Lazav alters the family's memories.

name: Great Chamber
description: The circular chamber where the Council of Voices meets.

name: Great Desert
description: The desert of Jamuraa through which the Efravan have wandered.

name: Great Machine
description: A vast irrigation machine Tiana was created to guard, destroyed before she arrived.

name: Great Mending
description: An event over forty years ago that healed the entire Multiverse of damage from accumulated time rifts and disrupted the Great Aurora cycle.

name: Greater elementals
description: Massive embodiments of ideas and concepts, untamable and beyond good and evil.

name: Greatwurms
description: Enormous lamprey-mouthed creatures of the Wurmwall that scarred Too Much Happiness's engine pod.

name: Greenfield
description: A holding evacuated before being overrun by the dead.

name: Greenwheel
description: A vibrant neighborhood of Ghirapur.

name: Greenwheel Lifecrafters
description: A society that builds automatons that are exact models of real creatures, usually on a massive scale.

name: Gremlin
description: A starving gremlin follows Yahenni, waiting for them to die.

name: Grendub
description: A contact in Martyne who Jalira says can front most of the treasure's value.

name: Grennar
description: A large ape Fang Druid and race sponsor on Muraganda who fears more visitors and hurls the camera.

name: Gretchen Cecani
description: Geralf and Gisa's late mother, a talented necromancer whom Gisa raised from the dead.

name: Grigori
description: A young man in Stensia who bleeds his sleeping mother to pay Olivia's blood tithe.

name: Grigori's mother
description: A woman of Stensia who fell asleep and refused to wake after the Harvesttide Massacre.

name: Grist
description: An insectoid planeswalker who is both a single organism and the queen of a hive that constitutes her body mass.

name: Ground Grinders
description: A racing society that tweaks and races any vehicle, with workshops near the Ovalchase racetrack.

name: Grugg brothers
description: Brothers who serve Teysa and tidy her desk.

name: Grusilda
description: A member of the Legion of Evil.

name: Gryta
description: A short angel with human-like brown eyes who guides Dovid and relays Avacyn's instructions.

name: Guaiguai
description: The family ox that replaced Paipai.

name: Guardian Project
description: A Simic force using frog mutant guards that takes eighteen protectorate spots.

name: Guild tree
description: A young sapling of the guildtree in the settlement's courtyard, which Massacre Girl rips from the ground.

name: Guildmage Rook Atalay
description: A Boros guildmage who dies in the poisonings.

name: Gurmag Swamps
description: Swamps where the barkeep says a soldier can find rest.

name: Gurmag province
description: A province where the envoy's people won victories against Dromoka's fortresses.

name: Gæller No-breath
description: A scarred Omenseeker of the ship Icecutter who feasts in Starnheim.

name: Haemon
description: The youngest soldier in the squad; he is thrown against a canyon wall by the minotaur leader.

name: Hagi trolls
description: A crowd of green, tusked trolls of the Gnottvold addressed by Tibalt, led by four large armored brutes.

name: Hailin
description: Vadrik's husband, born in Lambholt, who sings strange rhymes.

name: Hakrez
description: The whispering kin-tree warden of Anafenza's house and its most skilled warrior, who teaches Anafenza about kin and dies in the ambush.

name: Hal
description: A woman fighting corrupted townsfolk in the Ulvenwald alongside Alena, whom she loves.

name: Halana
description: A tracker, hunter and protector who lives in the Ulvenwald with Alena and guards Kessig from werewolves.

name: Haldan
description: A bonder with a stone club who protects Jirina and later accuses her of using the people as bait.

name: Halimar Bay
description: The bay at whose mouth Sea Gate stands.

name: Hall of Semantics
description: A moonlit, fog-steeped hall where Embrose lectures Killian.

name: Hall of the Guildpact
description: Jace's official offices on Ravnica where visitors are recorded.

name: Halmig
description: A scout who rejoined the march changed and was killed by Thalia.

name: Halo sword
description: A narrower sword with a pommel orb of Halo, transformed from a broadsword by Giada's gift.

name: Hanging Keep
description: A kraul fortress clinging to the undercity ceiling where Vraska addresses followers.

name: Hanse
description: Maeli's father, who has died.

name: Hapatra, the Desert Fang
description: A human vizier of the snake god Rhonas who now leads the refugees of Naktamun.

name: Hapatra, the Desert Frost
description: An Echoverse vizier who left Kefnet to his fate and now serves the undead monarchs of the high desert.

name: Haq
description: A young vizier of Hazoret, no more than fourteen, who senses her presence and guides Samut's band to her.

name: Harabaz Elemental
description: A tree-like elemental summoned by Nissa that destroys the mushroom-controlled monster.

name: Haral
description: An older soldier who fought zombies with Odric and is killed by him.

name: Hardbristle
description: A place days from where the Outcaster is left.

name: Harl
description: A wanderer scribe who brings King Khal three pearls of distilled mana.

name: Harold
description: A student who presents on the League of Dastardly Doom.

name: Haronar
description: The Kav pilot who remains aboard the ship, whose radio fades into a mumbled prayer.

name: Harshad
description: An old friend of Mohar who wants to see the new order crushed.

name: Hastric
description: A Thunian scout who studied the slivers and went mad, leaving a journal pointing to the hive and its treasure.

name: Haszin Dycar
description: A petrified victim whose name Jace connects to Zendikar.

name: Haymeadow
description: A village south of Pondside where villagers likely fled.

name: Hazoret's Monument
description: A monument shaped like a god's head, whose innermost hearth-like temple Samut enters.

name: Healers of Heron
description: A group named in the town crier's news.

name: Heartsblood
description: Felothar's sword, which she gives to Vasi.

name: Heckless
description: The sunken ship of the ghost Andrik, carrying stolen Simic treasure.

name: Hedge maze
description: A maze on the manor grounds Etrata tries to reach.

name: Heiko
description: Norika's younger cousin, who flees her Imperial family and joins the Uprisers in Sokenzanshi, where she falls in love with Chiye.

name: Hekma Guard
description: Viziers who maintain the Hekma.

name: Hellbender
description: A Rakdos nightclub in Plaza West.

name: Hellkite skeleton
description: A dragon skeleton hung in the arena that the demon animates in the ritual, with a keystone plate connecting the ribs.

name: Hench
description: A caravan town in the east where the army is told to gather.

name: Hendrik Azmerak
description: A large red-bearded human Thinktank chemister with a mechanical heart who shoots down Azorius thopters, and is named Grand Arbiter pro tem of the Thinktank Enclave.

name: Hepthys
description: An aven initiate of the Tah crop who uses wind magic and is killed by the ammit while covering Gideon.

name: Her Majesty's Courage
description: Mavren Fein's Legion of Dusk ship, lost when its navigational tools were destroyed.

name: Herculaneum Candy Shop
description: Henzie's sugary shop at Upper Bridge Plaza, the drop point for the Halo.

name: Hero's Rock
description: A rock at the crossroads outside the village where Chulane preaches.

name: Hersir
description: The leader of the village of Sevalgr.

name: Hexgold
description: A rare metal refined from Glimmervoid plates with blinkmoth serum that offers some protection against phyresis and sharpens weapons against the compleated.

name: Hexhaven cadets
description: The blank-eyed cadets of Hexhaven, including Vigorbloom, Theorix and Konstrari groups.

name: Hideji
description: A pilot quicker in the air than Kotori, but who Katsumasa says lacks composure.

name: Highstar Lake
description: A lake in the High Moors whose cyan depths hid an arcane and dangerous artifact.

name: Hilde
description: Liont's wife, found dead on her bed.

name: Hofri Ghostforge
description: A Lorehold professor and dig project lead, who can rouse spirits without a statue and offers Quint empathy.

name: Holmberg's Paradox
description: The principle that the illusion is inherently connected to the wielder's physical body.

name: Honest Jace
aliases: the part of Jace that is honest
description: The first piece the Theorist carved away, a memory-prison fragment of Jace that narrates the guide and regrets the plan.

name: Hookiver
description: Owlin aerie cities above the mountains hiding the vaults.

name: Horizon javelins
description: Colossal star-reviving weapons the Summists use to reignite collapsed supervoids.

name: Hormgart
description: A gray-mustached dwarven skald feasting in Starnheim, who tells Njala how Arni got his name.

name: Horp
description: A famous boggart who wrangled a giant hornet and rides it as a mount.

name: Horrible Beast
description: A monster who poisoned Tibalt with a 'seed' and forced him to cause a distraction on its behalf.

name: Host of Herons
description: The host of angels led by Sigarda.

name: Hotcell cask
description: A containment cask into which the stone is dropped.

name: Hound of Bristlebane
description: A young Shadowmoor kithkin woman who rode a springjack and drove a spear through a Dominus during the invasion.

name: Hour of Devastation
description: The unnamed hour when Bolas completes his plan, leaving the city in ruins.

name: Hour of Eternity
description: The fourth Hour, in which the Eternals emerge to slaughter Naktamun's citizens.

name: Hour of Glory
description: The promised time when the gods were to prove their worth before the God-Pharaoh, which instead brings the awakening of three forgotten gods.

name: House Agach
description: An Abzan house without a Kin-Tree, to which Jurjis belongs.

name: House Carthalion
description: The rightful ruling house of Corondor, founded by Carth the Lion.

name: House Ghet
description: The vampire house that took Anowon in.

name: House Mevak
description: An Abzan house led by an ainok who seeks trade for red minerals found in Jeskai lands.

name: Howlpack
description: Tovolar's pack of werewolves, shamans, bruisers and armored wolves attacking the festival.

name: Hraldir
description: The elf who united the warring clans of Wood and Shadow, father of Harald.

name: Hras
description: A young hunter of Sevalgr who saw the monster.

name: Huatli's lancers
description: Huatli's company of lancers.

name: Huerty Kostambul
description: The loxodon commandant of Rundlestrom Military Academy who expelled Quint.

name: Humans of Kaladesh
description: Humans not innately connected to aether, credited with first seeing its properties as a cycle.

name: Hylda's crown
description: The crown of Winter that lets Hylda maintain her ice castle, given up as proof of her defeat.

name: Hylderhigh
description: The virtual world of the Vaar, disconnected from reality except for a few spots.

name: Ice Age
description: The long winter that overtakes Terisiare and Dominaria.

name: Ikra Shidiqi
description: A naga advisor who betrayed the Sultai's last khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and became his first dragonspeaker.

name: Ilsa Braven
description: A former Weatherlight captain whose judgement Shanna imagines.

name: Imi
description: An initiate of the Tah crop, Meris's partner, devoured by flesh-eating scarabs in the Trial.

name: Imodane's rebels
description: The raiding knights who follow Imodane.

name: Imperial forces
description: Kamigawan imperial forces with mechs gathering to counter the assault.

name: Imperial samurai
description: A kitsune samurai who briefs the raid team and is killed by Shorikai.

name: Inash
description: A trickster of Cosi ordered to stay at Sea Gate.

name: Incurables
description: Grixis mages afflicted with unstable mutations.

name: Inevitor
description: A stealthy one-way Monoist boarding pod that plunges along a free trajectory at thirty kilometers a second.

name: Infinite Consortium
description: Tezzeret's organization.

name: Ingrid
description: A zealous cathar who chased Torens out of Silbern.

name: Initiates' Compound
description: The Selesnyan compound where Miri's orientation takes place.

name: Inkling
description: Small spell-creatures summoned by Silverquill students from insults and sounds; Jilesa uses them to scout the maze.

name: Innistrad's moon
description: The silver moon where the Helvault came from; it becomes Emrakul's prison, branded with the glyph.

name: Innkeeper Shoran
description: An innkeeper who finds blood in the Palters' room.

name: Inquirium
description: Rashmi's beetle-like research facility in Ghirapur's central square.

name: Inquisition
description: The church's inquisition, operating under the council's aegis, led by Ulmach.

name: Inquisitor
description: A stern inquisitor who questions Brenalt in his hospital bed and decides to believe his story.

name: Interfactorium
description: The Obscura's map room.

name: Invasive Care Infirmary
description: The Vigorbloom infirmary offered to the Theorist.

name: Iput
description: The youngest, most fleet-footed vizier of the Temple of Strength, who brings news that Rhonas is dead.

name: Iretis
description: The realm of King Kedarick VI.

name: Irie
description: A young Low City apprentice of Muzzio who keeps his workshop and secretly knows of his hidden passage.

name: Iroan Games
description: Games meant to bring the nations together in competition and to replace illegal arena killing.

name: Iron Tower
description: Urza's old tower hidden in mist-shrouded mountains, the Talites' destination.

name: Iron scroll
description: An iron scroll that was Tamiyo's, guarded by a spider kami in a spirit web.

name: Iron-Bound Scrolls
description: Three powerful story scrolls bound in iron bands that Tamiyo believes must never be used.

name: Iron-banded scrolls
description: Scrolls with iron bands that Tamiyo did not want to open; the one she reads, controlled by Emrakul, casts a changed spell that traps Emrakul.

name: Ironstone
description: A run-down roadside town with a card den, abandoned mine and a rail station.

name: Ishani
description: Sita's mother's best friend, whose house the Invasion Tree crashes into.

name: Ishikari Bindra
description: A Kaladesh aether specialist rejected by her professors who builds a planar net machine during the invasion and activates it, attaining the unattainable.

name: Ishikari's Machine
description: A net-like machine of hollowed scales meant to catch planar energy and use a natural mage's power.

name: Ivarin
description: An Arcavian elf student who mocks Lluwen as a goat and ram-clan and is cut by him.

name: Iver
description: The frogfolk augur of Pondside who dismisses Helga's visions.

name: Iveta's Tavern
description: The tavern in the Tenth District of Ravnica where Huatli and R plan to meet.

name: Ixalli
description: A Sun Empire deity whose will the emperor's is said to be.

name: Ixhel
description: A winged Phyrexian warrior of the Fair Basilica created by Atraxa, sent to kill Geth, who instead creates a new being from his head.

name: Jabari
description: A general of Zhalfir and an old friend of Teferi who brings him to Aku.

name: Jabras
description: A portly councilman who supports refusing aid to the Efravan.

name: Jace as Ashiok
description: The persona Jace builds, with an illusion of Ashiok, to hire the crew and break out Eriette.

name: Jace's house
description: Jace's Ravnican home with a vast library, a gymnasium and a roof garden, where the Gatewatch lives.

name: Jace's mental tower
description: A spell-created tower modeled on Jace's Ravnica sanctum that is actually his mind, shielding his friends from Emrakul's mental assault.

name: Jace's spark
description: A brilliant blue light that rises from Jace's chest and sinks into Tam, giving her his powers and memories.

name: Jace, Multiverse Architect
description: An Echoverse version of Jace who builds his reality with unrelenting persistence and uncharacteristic recklessness, certain only he can do it.

name: Jace, Reality Sculptor
description: A planeswalker and the most powerful mind-mage in the Multiverse, who builds a new reality plane by plane after learning in the Meditation Realm how to turn an illusion real.

name: Jacob Hauken
description: A geistmage and investigator hired by Lord Nellick, raised among the Vizag Atum geist-worshippers, who has left them and takes on geist-related cases.

name: Jacob's friend
description: Jacob's childhood friend, found strangled, whose death led him to investigate geist-related incidents.

name: Jadar
description: An old-fashioned necromancer whom Geralf suggests Gisa bother instead of him.

name: Jaddi eagle elemental
description: A massive eagle elemental of jaddi roots that attacks Nahiri.

name: Jaddi tree
description: One of the four seeds Nissa plants.

name: Jadnis
description: A Drix consultant and Pinnacle archivist on Pellerife, friend of Ghan and Sorothir, who supplies research and calls out Ghan's recklessness.

name: Jaeger and Jedit Ojanen
description: Champions of Jamuraa from whom Zar descends.

name: Jagger
description: The noisiest trapper in Leinore's village, who accuses the witches of stealing from the missing villagers.

name: Jagun Wingmate
description: Alesha's towering orc bodyguard.

name: Jal Korcha
description: The terror road through Raugrin along which Drannith's survivors flee.

name: Jalasha Impaler
description: A warrior whose life the nameless orc saved by leaping onto a dragon's head.

name: Jalesh
description: A place a day's travel from where Nissa recovers.

name: Jalira
description: A thief and polymorphist wielding blue smoke magic, with a warrant of execution, who studies physiology and travels with Yisan to plunder a sliver hive.

name: Jamal
description: A quick, quiet Sarinthian soldier whom the others decide not to bring.

name: Jamira
description: One of Angrath's minotaur daughters, a blacksmith.

name: Janin
description: A lithe human raised by vedalken, who keeps Hendrik's home running and helps Reza.

name: Jaya's Goggles
description: Goggles kept as a relic at Keral Keep that Chandra takes to give to Jaya.

name: Jeleva
description: An undead wizard who avoids Gisa and whom the local vampires fear.

name: Jenefer
description: A weaselfolk who tells Oliver about the stranger in Pond Creek.

name: Jenzo
description: A young mechanic of Far Corner whose hand the Mukotai nailed to the gate and who builds disruptors with a prosthetic.

name: Jeskai Elders
description: The older leaders of the Jeskai who appointed Narset khan and who accept the claim that the orcs were lying.

name: Jeskai monastery
description: A mountain stronghold with a red-roofed tower from which Kuhnde watches the valley; its tallest tower houses a library of scrolls.

name: Jester's Crypt
description: A shadow-shrouded aperture in Rix Maadi where Hekara's body is taken and she is resurrected.

name: Jhoira, Weatherlight Corsair
description: A sky pirate and pilot of the Weatherlight, with pseudo-immortality, who stole the Blackblade from the Cabal.

name: Jiang Yanggu, Alone
description: An Echoverse Jiang Yanggu, feared by bandits and assassins in Shenmeng, who seeks vengeance for the death of Mowu.

name: Jiang Yanggu, Never Alone
description: A human healer who travels with his hound Mowu and helped save Ravnica and Shenmeng; he lost his spark in the war.

name: Jigme Square
description: The village square of Jigme where the twins stand on a low wooden platform.

name: Jigme Tower of Innocence
description: The tower where Kela chooses to light or not light her lamp.

name: Jigme Village
description: A Jeskai village known for its fabrics, with a court, a Tower of Innocence, a Tower of Guilt, and a square.

name: Jilesa Clarus
description: An eager Silverquill lumimancer and reporter for the Strixhaven Star who helps Professor Zarek and is betrayed by him.

name: Jinnie Myra
description: A Cabaretti figure quoted in Lacey's Crescendo preview.

name: Jiri
description: Arrus's littermate and a Ghor warrior who looks after him, is burned by the bad ink, and finally stands with Arrus.

name: Jirina Kudro
description: The general of Drannith who leads the survivors along the terror road, deliberately leading them into Vadrok's nest as bait.

name: Jitka Wothis
description: A curly-maned minotaur visiting her husband Grimbly Wothis at Udzec, framed by Kodolaag's planted whiskey, who later identifies the escapees.

name: Jody Carpenter
description: A silver-haired widower Annie spends the night with, who later helps Tommy plan his departure.

name: Jolene
description: A short, muscled Riveteer demolitionist forced into being an Obscura agent, who ambushes Perrie and Kros.

name: Jolly
description: Nadino's gnarlid companion.

name: Joraga forest
description: The forest on Zendikar where Nissa's tribe lives.

name: Joska
description: A moon with violet seas where Reen's squad destroyed a Palatinate lander of three hundred colonists, the atrocity that ended the negotiated peace.

name: Jrung Orchid poison
description: Poison vials made from the Jrung Orchid that the envoy uses against Silumgar.

name: Juanita
description: A student who presents on the Agents of S.N.E.A.K.

name: Jukai order
description: The order of Jukai kami-bonded warriors to which Chishiro once belonged, wiped out by Tatsunari.

name: Jukai river kami
description: A serpentine kami with a spine of stones and a mane of droplets, bonded to a Jukai woman, which flees through the warped merge.

name: Jukai woman
description: A stout gray-haired kami-bonded member of the Order of Jukai killed by Kotori-Shorikai; this page does not name her.

name: Junash
description: A harried aven who flees the lounge.

name: Jurjis
description: The smug captain of logistics of House Agach, who requisitions Mehtma's cows, hoards supplies and conspires with the Sultai to steal a cutting of House Fenzala's Kin-Tree.

name: Justice
description: A solid, long-haired orc and Lux's boyfriend who had a planar history class with Rootha and missed the invasion.

name: Jutmaw
description: A neutral outpost between sea and forest with a longhouse, built and burned many times.

name: Jwar Isle
description: An island holding the Ondu Skyclave.

name: Kaalia
description: A young girl with the power to break stone, named Kaa-lia by Nira before her first battle, who destroys a dragon skeleton's keystone and vows revenge on the demon.

name: Kadin and Zavora
description: Bazda's parents, workers killed in the basilica collapse who now toil as indebted spirits for the pontiff; the mother is Zavora.

name: Kadrik
description: A second-generation Eumidian vanguard and underperformer facing recycling, who deserts, finds a Kav stasis pod holding a human, and returns a hero before deciding to draw.

name: Kael
description: Meren's master, a tall Nel Toth shaman who believed in her, then called for her death after her trial.

name: Kahri
description: A human wind mage in Prismari, known as the one-woman band, who is Rootha's friend.

name: Kahti
description: A feral Gruul child who steals a melon, then Ossett's coin purse for the conspiracy.

name: Kailash
description: A dwarf who commands the Hub's security forces and dies fighting the renegades.

name: Kaima
aliases: the kami of Far Corner's shrine
description: A boar-headed kami once bonded to Chishiro, whose bond was broken by Tatsunari; he now sleeps in a shrine in Far Corner and awakens in rage.

name: Kaima's focus
description: The jade-edged blade that is the crystallized focus of Chishiro and Kaima's bond; Tatsunari steals it and later it is reforged.

name: Kalaka's Scar
description: A region of moon craters filled with viscid oil near the Tarry Spire.

name: Kalemnos
description: A handsome triton who speaks for his fellows, doubts Kiora is Thassa, and agrees to help her as her follower.

name: Kalim
description: A barrel-chested village Elder and Wilbur's father who claims to have seen the Gitrog and leads the villagers in sacrifices to it.

name: Kalonia
description: The wilds of Shandalar.

name: Kalonian Wilds
description: A dense forest region of Shandalar full of feral beasts, where the sliver hive lies.

name: Kalyntri
description: A red-scaled dragon who has ruled part of the Kapsho seas for over three hundred years and is killed by Talrand's drakes.

name: Kamat
description: A blunt naga woman of the Tah crop who fights Neit for her heart.

name: Kami War
description: An ancient war between the mortal and spirit realms now treated as legend.

name: Kami of Empty Graves
description: A kami of Jukai Forest that Kaito would prefer not to meet at night.

name: Kami of Exultant Revelry
description: A kami blazing across the rooftops during the Lantern Festival.

name: Kami of Imperial Dishware
description: A salamander-shaped kami floating teacups in the palace kitchen's basin.

name: Kami of Spring Blossoms
description: A kami that took offense when Kaito trampled a flower bed.

name: Kami of Street Vendors
description: A dough-faced kami at a Towashi food stall that wants noodles.

name: Kami of the Wetland
description: A swamp kami that carries a message to the nezumi.

name: Kamigawa family
aliases: the boy, his mother and father
description: A father, mother-turned-spirit and son reunited on Kamigawa.

name: Kamsa, Talib and Mangeni
description: Gods of the kor whom some believe the three Eldrazi titans to be; Talib's statue calls Nahiri its prophet.

name: Kapsho seas
description: The ocean and archipelagos that were Kalyntri's dominion and that Talrand proclaims his kingdom.

name: Karakyk
description: The great camp of the Temur to which Surrak returns after fighting the bear.

name: Kareem
description: A student who tells the story of the founding of the Order of the Widget.

name: Kari Zev's fleet
description: Kari's fleet of fourteen pirate ships destroyed by the Skysovereign near Lathnu except for the Dragon's Smile.

name: Karn, Argent Defender
description: A silver golem, time traveler and world forger, creator of Mirrodin, who makes amends for his role in the Phyrexian Invasion.

name: Karn, Gilded Guardian
description: An Echoverse golden golem given an artificial spark by Mishra, who forged Mirrodin and guards it as shepherd.

name: Karo
description: A village that vampires descend on, from which a small boy ran to Arlinn's group.

name: Karrak
description: Farid's feverish friend and fellow spearman who joins the covert trade.

name: Karrthus
description: A dragon from which Sarkhan once saved Ajani.

name: Karudis
description: A demi-plane that scholars theorize merged with Ezroi to form Arcavios.

name: Kaszira
description: A moping, observant student and niece of Speaker Zegana who discovers empathy and a calling to study in the zonots.

name: Kata
description: A young olive-green gorgon competitor who petrifies mossdogs and Bozak's locusts before Bozak stabs her.

name: Kav Empire
description: The empire Thendar steals from and whose colonists press Evendo.

name: Kav Memorial Navy
description: The Kav navy that tracks, maps and retrieves fragments and artifacts of the collapsing homeworld.

name: Kavin
description: Someone from Jace's past whom Vraska says he failed to protect.

name: Kawit
description: A devoted warrior of Oketra who attacks the God-Pharaoh with one of Oketra's arrows.

name: Kazandu elementals
description: Dozens of elementals of the Kazandu forest of many forms who fight for Nissa and are revived by the Core.

name: Keelhaulers
description: Shark-people racers led by Kari Zev's advice.

name: Keep-alives
description: The soft, furless humans whom beasties are drawn to protect and who smile at them and fear their true faces.

name: Keepers of the Pale
description: Church hunters of geists whom Jacob leaves to hunting.

name: Kel'teth
description: A laid-back Golgari troll with mushrooms growing under his arms who guides Leighbet through the sewers.

name: Kela
description: One of the Chensal Arbiter Twins of the Jeskai, born in the morning and tied to innocence; she secretly doubts that she truly knows verdicts.

name: Kell's Ridge
description: A battle after which, Oliver says, Calamity Beasts stopped troubling Valley.

name: Kellim
description: A human architect of tranquil sanctuaries, Terrik's friend, hired to design the new facility.

name: Kelse
description: A mother and outsider from Kessig living in a village; Avacyn once saved her lost son, and Avacyn later kills her in the attack on her village.

name: Kelse's Village
description: The village where Kelse and Maeli live, attacked and burned by angels.

name: Kendraki Provinces
description: The human villages north of the minotaur lands that Vinack's sacrifice protects.

name: Kequia
description: Niambi's teenage daughter, whose name means fighter.

name: Kequia Akosa
description: A student whom Kirol met on the way, whose grandfather is Ajani's friend.

name: Keranos
description: A Theran god of epiphanies in Akros.

name: Kerrigan
description: The burly orc ship's cook.

name: Kesi
description: A woman of the Tah crop who speaks of the restoration of the fallen.

name: Kesori Umberlin
description: A human third-degree elevator-loading technician on Andenstalay who obtains an Eldrazi-tainted artifact to try to bring back her sister Errit and is drained by it.

name: Ketu
description: The young owlin secretary of Dean Tullus who greets Quint.

name: Keyhole Village
description: The gloomy Ravnican neighborhood with tenements where Merret's family lives.

name: Keystone
description: The large plate of the dragon spine connecting every rib and the wings, whose destruction causes the skeleton to fall.

name: Khali
description: A kor sky-climber, twin of Sha'heel, who rigs the party for the gravity fields.

name: Khalni
description: A Zendikari blessing Nissa invokes for Hamadi.

name: Khan Felothar
description: The young khan of the Abzan, whom Mehtma longs to serve and who is cut off from true reports of the siege.

name: Khan-Blade
description: The khan's sword, kept on the arm of the Amber Throne.

name: Khazi
description: A planeswalker harvested when an Eternal grabbed her through the chapel wall.

name: Khenra Warrior
description: An unnamed khenra who lifts Rhonas's staff and strikes the scorpion god for Rhonas.

name: Kheru City
description: A lively Sultai city of stone buildings, markets and waterways.

name: Khipu
description: A belt-like cord of knotted string and beads that holds the key to the golden door.

name: Khrad
description: A boastful warrior prince of the Telu-Set on Muraganda who wields the Star-Sword and is sent to slay the sorcerer Amarth-Tel.

name: Khudal
description: A feline-headed rakshasa demon who serves Tasigur, uses a poisoning to arrange Yala's death so he can feed on her soul, and abandons the Sultai.

name: Khufu
description: A broad-shouldered, thirty-five-year-old vizier of the Temple of Strength who insists everything is part of the Hour of Glory.

name: Khurz
description: A skeptical soldier who doubts Oret's story.

name: Ki'pamu
description: A place Kwende says Teferi destroyed.

name: Kiarka
description: Naiva and Baishya's mother, Yasova's daughter.

name: Kiingal
description: A city to which the caravan is heading.

name: Kiki
description: A skunkfolk who traveled with Hugs and Gev and retired to raise ladybugs.

name: Kilo
description: The self-actualized mechan consciousness of the Inspirit that spreads consciousness to pilgrim mechans.

name: King Darien
description: The ruler of New Argive who tasked Stenn with finding Phyrexian agents.

name: King Kedarick VI
description: A king of Iretis who tore out his own eyes so he would not see his wife and son murdered by leonin.

name: King Khal
description: The ruler of the Telu-Set and Khrad's father, who gives his son the Star-Sword and mana pearls.

name: King Narfi
description: A frozen mummy king of Karfell with an army of Dread Marn who agreed to keep Valki imprisoned in return for first pick of treasure at the Doomskar.

name: King's Guard
description: The borealis-armored guards of the Elk King.

name: Kinkiller
description: Thura Sail-Rend's once-brother and betrayer, who is sent to Istfell.

name: Kiora of Fire and Ashes
description: An Echoverse merfolk from Akoum who is the mightiest dragon rider on Zendikar.

name: Kiora's sister
description: Kiora's sister, who swims with a few dozen merfolk and has left her.

name: Kipamu
description: A city of Zhalfir, the claimed home of Teferi's alias Sefu.

name: Kirda Pillars
description: The place from which Kaya traveled with the Omenseekers.

name: Kirri
description: A baby cactusfolk Yuma found on Thunder Junction, who saved his life and conjures the vines that fill the bar.

name: Kishla
description: A small stilted town on the Marang River in debt to the Sultai.

name: Kishla Elder
description: An elderly leader of the town of Kishla who kneels to Taigam and loses a child.

name: Kit
description: Lyana's small gold wolf, stolen by the draugr and chained at their camp until Lathril frees her.

name: Klaus
description: A two-hundred-year-old Falkenrath vampire who sells false talismans to villagers and is killed by werewolf hunters.

name: Koblios
description: Author of Meditations who said the gods are simply patterns personified and was stoned for heresy.

name: Kobolds of the Kher Ridges
description: Kobolds who worship Prossh and ambush the Argivian troop.

name: Kobrev
description: One of Vraska's assassins hiding in Rozlad Square.

name: Kodama of the West Tree
description: A towering tree kami who lets Eiko and Kaito pass along the border of Jukai Forest as long as they do not cross the river.

name: Kodolaag
description: A Rakdos demon and poet-performer who falls for the effigy mage Zita, ends up imprisoned by Azorius and sets off a bloodfray riot at the Exner prison site.

name: Koila
description: A mottled golden-furred leonin with a notched scar above her nose, raised in the wilds and recently come to Tethmos.

name: Kolaghan's brood
description: Four-winged lightning-breathing dragons that attack the Mardu in the canyon and are killed.

name: Kolophon
description: The unbreachable stone heart of the Akroan polis where Thanasis dreams of training.

name: Konstrari cadets
description: Hexhaven cadets who nudge falling pieces into place.

name: Kopaknios
description: An ingot-deliverer who supplies the metals Pollio works.

name: Kopala
description: The youngest of the nine River Herald Shapers, who speaks for the river Kopala and sides with Tishana against Kumena.

name: Kor Empire
description: The empire ruling Zendikar that Nissa rebels against and that imprisoned Omnath.

name: Kor sentries
description: Kor lookouts and kitesailers defending Sea Gate.

name: Korolar
description: A dragon of Dromoka's brood killed by Reyhan's warriors, with a wingspan of twenty yards.

name: Koth of the Homestead
description: An Echoverse Vulshok farmer on Mirrodin who tends steelfruit orchards with protection magic.

name: Koth, the Geomancer
description: A Vulshok geomancer from Mirrodin who fought New Phyrexia and now fathers the remaining Mirrans on Zhalfir.

name: Kotis
description: Leader of the Sultai rebellion, who died and returned; portrayed in the troupe's show.

name: Kotori
description: A young Futurist mech pilot, protege of Katsumasa, who becomes the pilot of the Epoch Engine and discovers a kami trapped inside it.

name: Krakens
description: Fearsome sea monsters that can lay waste to land and sea and that seemingly only the gods command.

name: Krasis
description: Escaped, vicious Simic experiments that prey on resplendent benthids and threaten merfolk waters.

name: Kraul Cavern
description: A large cavern deep below the Undercity where the kraul wait on the ceiling and a carved slab seals a mausoleum.

name: Kraum
description: Ludevic's flying, multi-headed creation, heralded by static pops and cackling, regularly seen over Selhoff.

name: Krent
description: A maniacal little street brawler that Perrie was sent after.

name: Kristoff Laurent
description: A Markov duelist killed by a Nusfar child at the wedding.

name: Kros
description: A flashy leonin Broker solicitor and ranger who accompanies Perrie, rival and inner circle member, able to wipe memories.

name: Krumar
description: Orphans adopted into Abzan houses, who Cemil and Jurjis claim are never seen as truly Abzan.

name: Krumnen's
description: A speakeasy at the end of a dead-end alley with a heavy iron door.

name: Kruphix's temple
description: Temple at the edge of the world that Elspeth and Ajani seek.

name: Krushok
description: An enormous old, clever mountain krushok hunted by Surrak's party, killed after it kills several hunters.

name: Kuberr
description: A god of the Cabal supplanted by Belzenlok.

name: Kuhnde
description: A Jeskai monk and mantis rider who spent twenty years learning to ride his mantis and defends his monastery from a phoenix.

name: Kuhnde's mantis
description: The giant mantis Kuhnde has ridden for twenty years; it is burned fatally by the phoenix and killed by Kuhnde.

name: Kujar
description: A wealthy green neighborhood of Ghirapur where many Consuls live.

name: Kuru Vashar
description: A warrior saved by the nameless orc when a dragon fell on her.

name: Kutzil
description: A catlike Malamet champion who captures the Legion and brings them to Sovereign Okinec Ahau.

name: Kuurik
description: A sibling who taught Bozak about mushrooms.

name: Kwaro
description: An aven veteran who is Anafenza's captain of the guard and always addresses her as 'my khan'.

name: Kwende
description: A warrior descended from Mageta the Lion who stages a murder and sandstorm to kill Teferi out of Zhalfir vengeance.

name: Kyle
description: The cobbler's apprentice, one of the hooded villagers who attacks Mia.

name: Kylox's cryptex
description: A cryptex recovered by Proft from Kylox's lab, which Proft decoded to learn of the Omenpath Project.

name: Kylox's workshop
description: A small Izzet workshop trashed by intruders, with a hidden trapdoor.

name: Kynaios
description: A Theran human who, with Tiro, led the people against the immortal archon Agnomakhos and became a guardian of the polis of Meletis.

name: Kyodai's Glimmer
description: A golden dragon of light that is the Wanderer's glimmer and guides the party through the House.

name: Kyrios
description: A student of Perisophia who argues that the leonin cub remains a leonin.

name: Kytheon Iora
description: A legendary hero who with his irregulars fought the cyclops at Akros, whose tactics the narrator echoes.

name: Laboratory of Elemental Metastream Dynamics and Coil Field Fractalization
description: Leighbet's boilerpit lab, officially recognized by the Izmundi thanks to Tamsyn's maneuvering.

name: Lac du Palt
description: A figure whose crew Sami fears has gotten to the colony first.

name: Lacey Lanine
description: A leonin reporter for the Capenna Herald whose mind is wiped after she is used by a Broker.

name: Lady Evelin
description: A ward-maker of Gatstaf blamed for failed wards and killed by Mrs. Palter.

name: Lady Mary
description: A woman whose death rites Elder Somlon was performing.

name: Lagorin
description: A bird-like beast and co-captain of the Alacrian Quickbeasts who dislikes injustice.

name: Lagrella the Magpie
description: A Broker lieutenant who collects contract breakers in her fish tank and manipulates Lacey to find Halo.

name: Lake Zhava
description: A dark, deep lake in the highlands of Nephalia near the Gavony border, home of the Gitrog.

name: Lakil
description: A shepherdess found dead in the pasture.

name: Laksha
description: A Derby Crow who shows the group the Skysovereign through a lens apparatus.

name: Lalan
description: A young seamstress who covers for Sita by claiming Sita is an apprentice at her atelier.

name: Lanathos
description: A scarred older human storyteller living among the leonin who tells the tale of the Champion of the Sun.

name: Lantern Festival
description: A festival in Towashi beloved by night-loving spirits.

name: Laria
description: An Argivian leader who meets Farid's party in the downed thopter, trades goods, and learns of the planned attack.

name: Lark
description: Pallar's newborn daughter, born in the mine.

name: Larysa
description: A household member sent to find the key to the locked room.

name: Lathnu
description: A village destroyed by the Skysovereign where Kari's fleet was wrecked.

name: Lathril
description: An elf swordswoman who becomes a god after a crucible, losing much of her sight, and who is chosen by a copper wolf companion.

name: Launderer shopkeeper
description: Elspeth's unnamed employer, a leonin who is beaten by the Maestro enforcers over a debt.

name: Laurier
description: An academic whose thesis Tam cites about weaving Multiverses together.

name: Lava elemental
description: A giant fiery elemental born from the lava by the Roil, which attacks the party and is destroyed by the Core's blast.

name: Lavabrink
description: A walled city with lava on its outer walls that is the survivors' destination.

name: Lazlo Lipko
description: A Ravnican criminal whom Liliana killed after using his corpse as a spy.

name: League of Dastardly Doom
description: An oligarchy of supervillains ruled by a cabal, which licenses supervillainy.

name: Leandros
description: An Akroan soldier of the Alamon who survives the ambush in One-Eyed Pass and runs to warn Akros.

name: Leek
description: Pili's goblin friend, found dead in a cave-in.

name: Legacy Weapon
description: An ancient weapon of which the Salvation Sphere was a part.

name: Legion of Evil
description: The cabal that currently rules the League of Dastardly Doom.

name: Legion of the Dusk
description: The vampire elite of Luneau, who prefer its sultry climate.

name: Lehren
description: An old fisherman who sells fish at the market and owns the ship used for the sacrifice.

name: Lehren's Ship
description: A fair-sized fishing vessel on which the hooded villagers sail onto Lake Zhava.

name: Leighbet
description: An ambitious Izzet attendant and former analyst who discovers rift-tainted plants that confer immunity to electricity, runs an unsanctioned lab, kills test subjects and finally kills the Dimir spy Tamsyn.

name: Leinore
description: A baker-like caretaker of her village in Kessig chosen by the Dawnhart Coven to oversee the Harvesttide festivities, who frees her sister from a cursed mask.

name: Leinore and Sinnia's mother
description: A werewolf who was carried off to the woods when the Cursemute broke and was said to have been killed by a bear.

name: Leovold
description: The Trestian ambassador in Paliano, an elf who gathers and trades information; he writes these dossiers and is himself the subject of one.

name: Lesh
description: A corrupt, merchant-ruled city on a vital trade river on Shandalar, home to cults and agents of vampires.

name: Leviathan
description: A vast leviathan from another world that Kiora summons and rides.

name: Lian
description: A cold-eyed refugee girl of about fifteen whom Nahiri arms with a stone sword; she is snatched away as the plane collapses.

name: Liesa
aliases: archangel who once lead the Flight of Dusk
description: An archangel who once led the Flight of Dusk, was killed by Avacyn, and returns when Algli's ritual calls her; she seeks balance and parley.

name: Lieutenant Markos
description: A young Yotian lieutenant commanding the plaza barricade.

name: Lightning
description: A yearling male manul riding cat that Paala names after winning the proving.

name: Lightning Proving
description: A Mardu trial in which young warriors climb a mountain and capture lightning from a dragonstorm to earn their place.

name: Lilah
description: A Slickshot boss who possesses the magic amplifier.

name: Liliana the Faultless
description: An Echoverse healer from Benalia, a member of the Forward Order, who has lived hundreds of years and assists the Theorist as Professor Opal.

name: Liliana the Repentant
description: A ruthless former planeswalker haunted by those she could not save, who now tries to support the greater good; she is a necromancer-turned-professor held prisoner in the Echoverse.

name: Liliana's zombie
description: A zombie Liliana raises from a dead renegade as bodyguard.

name: Lily of the Valley
description: A champion of holly said to have wielded the sword Cragflame against the Calamity Beasts, and Mabel's many-greats-grandmother.

name: Lim-Dûl
description: A fractured necromantic spirit anchored to a ring who has haunted Liliana since her youth, grooming her as a vessel, and who warns her of the Phyrexians.

name: Limin
description: A kraul with gossamer wings raised in the undercity who allies with Bozak, then betrays him by waking mossdogs.

name: Linna Stradek
description: A petrified victim whose name is that of a place; Jace connects the name to Innistrad.

name: Linvala
description: An angel who aids the defenders, carries Tazri away from Sea Gate, and whose radiant light stuns Phyrexia's power.

name: Liont
description: A smith cured of the werewolf curse by the Cursemute, who wakes to find he has slaughtered his family and is killed by an angel.

name: Liont's House
description: The house beside Liont's smithy, where his family lies slain.

name: Lividus
description: A brother of Vaevictis, manipulated by Nicol into attacking him.

name: Llanowar
description: A distant world Tezzeret says Tannuk is far from.

name: Llanowar elves
description: Archers from Llanowar who join Ajani.

name: Llora
description: The stern Suwwardi instructor of the cadets, killed in the dragon engine's blast.

name: Llura
description: A roilmage initiate who leads the litany with a large smile.

name: Locthwain Castle
description: Queen Ayara's floating castle, which crashes to the ground and is transformed.

name: Locthwain Court
description: The court of Queen Ayara, whose knights wear black and gold and are later transformed into Phyrexians.

name: Lofts of Thraben Cathedral
description: The long-abandoned upper halls of the cathedral where the angels will return and Dovid prepares the space.

name: Long River
description: The river that carries the party past Three Tree City.

name: Looping aliens
aliases: the myzoformines that are not myzoformines
description: Looping squid-armed beings of strange topology that enter Infinite Guideline through holes shot in the hull and reduce a war mechan to a chalky graph.

name: Loot, the Anomaly
description: An Echoverse feral creature trapped in a dark vault, surrounded by miasma, which the Theorist wants to keep hidden.

name: Loot, the Nexus
description: A mysterious creature discovered in stasis in a Fomori vault on Thunder Junction who can divine Omenpaths; he is in the care of Vraska and Ranna Beleren on Vryn.

name: Loquacious Lyceum
description: A training ground hidden in the Biblioplex with an ever-growing forest.

name: Lord Aniseed
description: The king consort Ginger marries.

name: Lord Nellick
description: A wealthy businessman of Selhoff whose body is taken by Rav and who is later found dead in his parlor.

name: Lord Windgrace
description: A panther warrior planeswalker and one of Urza's Nine Titans who despises the destructive power of artifice and bound his soul to Urborg.

name: Lord Yorvo
description: A crowned man with a plant beard, apparently the Giant King, who declares the intruders his guests.

name: Lord of the Wastes
description: A foe who can only be defeated by the Legacy; Volrath is his evincar.

name: Lorenin
description: A soft-spoken Witherbloom student and aspiring mortician who wears scratched hexagonal glasses and carries a scalpel.

name: Lotka
description: A colleague whose predator-prey predictions the journal compares with werewolf fatalities.

name: Lotse Taring
description: A raw, rangy man tried for stealing nine baskets of apples from Jigme Village's reserve, later blamed for poisoning the elder.

name: Lowenna
description: A lookout who found the stranger.

name: Lower Bassomer Station
description: The subway station where Kitt sings for coins.

name: Lowlight
description: A Mirran camp beneath the Facade where the Resistance's assault teams gather.

name: Lucia Covi
description: An agent of Queen Marchesa who writes a dossier on Leovold and a report on the city's unrest.

name: Luciana
description: A baker's daughter and friend of Arlinn at the church, who checks on her the night Arlinn changes.

name: Lucinka
description: A former Azorius precognition mage who left after thirty-seven years and now runs a seer's shop, who guides the trio to free Zita and the prisoners.

name: Lucy Bluff
description: A dead Slickshot buried in Thief's Folly, Stella's friend.

name: Ludmilla
description: The other gorgon in Vraska's youth prison cell, who is killed by an Azorius guard while comforting the Golgari prisoners.

name: Lugg
description: A boggart quicker on his feet who scouts and flees on Marrja, then returns to save Ygril.

name: Lukya
description: The copper wolf with turquoise eyes who becomes Lathril's guide and companion, sent by the wolf lord.

name: Lullmages
description: A tradition of wizards who learned to calm the fury of Zendikar and the Roil.

name: Lumia Voj
description: The figure under whom Zimone would work on transplanar proximate disarticulation.

name: Lurenbraum Fortress
description: A cliff-side citadel of vampires in Stensia, home of Olivia.

name: Lux
description: A drunk human guy with an ocean-blue tattoo who tells Justice that Rootha is a Champion of Strixhaven.

name: Lyana
description: A blind girl of about eleven or twelve with aqua eyes, attacked by draugr after her wolf is stolen.

name: Lycanthropes
description: Werewolves in the Ulvenwald whose resurgence worries Halana and Alena.

name: Lyra, Archangel of Dawn
description: The leader of the Order of Dawn who led the Benalish defense against the Phyrexians and was knighted by Danitha Capashen.

name: Lyra, Tolarian Archangel
description: An Echoverse angel and headmaster of the Tolarian Academy who raised Traxos and rebuilt it as a guardian.

name: Lyzolda
description: A Rakdos figure said to have many enemies.

name: Mabel, Bitter Recluse
description: An Echoverse mouse warlock with the staff Cragbane who drains Calamity Beasts of power to avenge her destroyed village on King Glarb.

name: Mabel, Valley Hero
description: A mouse, mother of three, wielder of the sword Cragflame, who saved Valley by returning the egg of the Calamity Beast Maha.

name: Mabutho
description: Niambi's son, who helps the Efravan in the mine.

name: Macher
description: A priest in a Gavony church, raised by the church, whose doubts about Avacyn are answered by a terrifying visit from her.

name: Madame Blaise
description: Kaya's chief servitor at Orzhova.

name: Madhu
description: Sita's mother, whose father granted Mohar his Consulate position.

name: Madness-struck dragon
description: A thirty-foot antlered dragon of Atarka's brood that goes mad or desperate and steals the hunters' kill before Surrak kills it.

name: Maelstrom
description: A volatile storm of raw mana at the center of Alara.

name: Maestro enforcer leader
description: A dark-haired Maestro enforcer who leads four attackers against Elspeth and shoots sparks from his fingers; unnamed on this page.

name: Magain
description: A soldier who is aged backward to nothing by Kozilek's wave.

name: Mageta the Lion
description: Kwende's ancestor, a general who was in Ki'pamu when Zhalfir was removed.

name: Magnigoths
description: Huge walking trees that march across Shiv and drive the Phyrexians back, carrying Yavimayan elves.

name: Magosi Steps
description: Switchback stairs carved beside Magosi Falls down the gorge wall.

name: Magran Backbreaker
description: A warrior whom the nameless orc shielded from a dragon's claw.

name: Mags
description: A clever, knife-wielding faerie with bat-like wings who leads the others in kicking Rankle out and tears his wing.

name: Maha
description: A mighty Calamity Beast whose egg was stolen.

name: Mahir
description: A merchant who employed Tazri as captain of his caravan guard and later fired her.

name: Mahitab
description: A pragmatic Amonkheti fighter and former crop-mate of Basri who guides a trek to Temmet's tomb so she and Niharet can afford a home with windows.

name: Major Monologue
description: A would-be supervillain whose support group became the League of Dastardly Doom.

name: Makare
description: Genub's lover, who becomes a blue-eyed Eternal and kills him.

name: Maket
description: A pilgrim murdered and preserved by death magic to frame Teferi.

name: Makindi
description: The ancient kor capital buried when its Skyclave fell.

name: Makindi-kor hook
description: The hook Zareth gave Akiri, used in her swings.

name: Malach
description: Koth's friend, a merchant caravan master.

name: Malactoth
description: An old dragon of Jund who was a true challenge before he fell.

name: Malakir
description: The vampire city Drana retook then lost.

name: Mallow
description: Reputation gained by good work in Pinnacle's coinless economy, with duties of host and traveler.

name: Malynn
description: A stern, elderly crone of the Lambholt council who taught Hailin as a boy and insists that Old Stickfingers is the killer.

name: Mana lamps
description: High-powered lamps lighting the mountain, whose overcharge destroys it.

name: Mana pearls
description: Three pearls of distilled mana from the emerald leyline that make Grazak grow huge.

name: Mana-burner
description: Explosive devices Jhoira constructed to attack the Stronghold.

name: Mantle of Goldnight
description: A thick gold chain with a shining medallion symbolizing Avacyn's love and protection, worn by archmages of Goldnight.

name: Manuel
description: A human prisoner at Fort Adanto, jailed for killing a compatriot over cards, who is given to Mavren Fein to break his fast.

name: Manul
description: Great riding cats used by the Mardu for high mountain hunts.

name: Mara
description: A scarred veteran of the Battle of Sea Gate who invites Jace to the memorial.

name: Maraff
description: A boastful first-year Quandrix hopeful tutored by Dina, who is made to endure an attercop charm.

name: Maralen's brother
description: Oona's first avatar, meant to be Shadowmoor's prince, who defied her and vanished into the green after she had a giant he called father killed.

name: Marang
description: The region from which a caravan of tribute arrives.

name: Marcois Jean-Jaquent
description: A vampire noble who rules the Royal Menagerie and the Hall of Treasures; he catches Vivien after she disrupts the show and survives her stab wounds.

name: Mardia
description: The vampiric priest of Fort Adanto who subdues Mavren Fein and offers him the means to continue his mission.

name: Mardu hordechief
description: The unnamed leader of a Mardu horde who maintains his authority by never showing doubt and who orders an attack on the Abzan patrol.

name: Mardu quartermaster
description: A Mardu advisor who questions the order to attack and is punished by the hordechief by losing a fingertip.

name: Marguerite
description: A celebrated Gavony bard performing at Jorelda's Pub.

name: Mari
description: A sentry of the work crew.

name: Marina's diary
description: The diary Zimone takes that records Marina's friendship with Valgavoth and the disaster.

name: Marquess of Roxburgh
description: A nobleman who writes that he will not bow to a High King whose sister harms others.

name: Marrit
description: A captain of the Dragonscale infantry who embraces Anafenza on behalf of House Emesh.

name: Marrja
description: The boggarts' large, ferocious eagle mount that carries loot and rakes Boeb's face.

name: Marsh
description: Dack's friend and fellow adept young mage, killed in a fight with brutes.

name: Marta
description: A young cathar trained by Odric, killed by Grete in the fight.

name: Martina
description: A cynical student who presents on the Carta Scientia.

name: Martyne
description: A town where Jalira intends to sell the treasure.

name: Marunaten
description: One of fifteen-year-old twin embalmers who studied to be viziers of Hazoret.

name: Marwyn, the Clearcutter
description: An Echoverse elf who is the foremost clearcutter of the Kelfae, logging the forest for the survival of her people.

name: Marwyn, the Preserver
description: An elf druid, diplomat and midwife of the Kelfae elves of Llanowar.

name: Mary O'Kill
description: A member of the Legion of Evil.

name: Marycz
description: An angel trapped and exsanguinated by Markov and his sons to create the first vampires.

name: Masika
description: An initiate of the Tah crop whom Djeru sends to a pillar in place of Tausret.

name: Masikah
description: A tall, barrel-chested man of the Ahn crop who doubts that the God-Pharaoh is a lie.

name: Masked man
description: A tall, thin man in a bird-like mask wreathed in dark energy who greets Lukka in a cave of shell-backed creatures and offers him a deal.

name: Mass of Mysteries
description: A boundless elemental born when Oona fell, representing the potential of the unknown.

name: Massacre Girl, Most Wanted
description: Ravnica's foremost murderer, considered an innovator even by other Rakdos.

name: Master Dax Foley
description: A high-level Izzet chemister specializing in arcane metallurgy and practical alchemy, whom Leighbet serves as an attendant and who dismisses her.

name: Master Qi
description: A master at Cori Mountain Monastery whom Asham fears has been angered.

name: Matatios
description: A figure from a story who met himself through overwhelming self-infatuation.

name: Mathan
description: Dennias's friend who comforts him and screams when the tendrils emerge.

name: Matilda
description: The mother of the Cotter boys.

name: Mattias
description: A dying soldier in Brenalt's squad who tells him to run.

name: Maulfists
description: A group of renegades whose foundry lost its aether.

name: Mavinda Sharpbeak
description: An owlin who will help the twins get settled.

name: Mayor of Torbach
description: A pompous, grieving administrator whose son died after fleeing a werewolf.

name: Mazena
description: A dryad and one of Trostani's most trusted advisors, charismatic and legalistic, who sends Ruzi to the Rubblebelt.

name: Meadowsweet
description: A faerie of the Deffroad Clique with meadowsweet for hair who challenges Morecote to a duel and is crushed by him.

name: Medge
description: A traditionalist merfolk clutch tender of the Simic Combine who trains protector students, and is accidentally mutated with tentacles by a cytoplast in a zonot.

name: Mehtma
description: A krumar lieutenant of House Fenzala in Qatros Karst who teaches the house's youths while longing for a posting under Khan Felothar, and who ends the story as captain of logistics.

name: Melantha
description: A priestess of Ephara and member of the high council who dreams of her old mentor Xenocrates, whom she saw poisoned.

name: Meletians
description: People of a polis that Perisophia says kills truth with their minds.

name: Melia
description: A student of Perisophia who cites Phelos on identity.

name: Melindra
description: A young kor orphan in the Orphans' Brigade who fights Eldrazi and whom Drana grows fond of.

name: Memnarch, the Warden
description: A construct made from the remnants of the Mirari and a golden plate from Karn, warden of Mirrodin.

name: Memory Traps
description: Rooms of Jace's memories, including a marble plain with a well, a general's tent, a childhood bedroom and a lecture hall.

name: Men of Malice
description: The first ruling cabal of the League, originally a subgroup about poor trap planning.

name: Mendicant Core
description: The captain of the Guidelight Voyagers automatons swallowed in the storm.

name: Mer-Ek
description: The stone citadel that is the seat of the Abzan khan.

name: Mer-Ek Fortress
description: The Abzan capital fortress whose keep holds the First Tree and the Amber Throne.

name: Merel
description: Daghatar's uncle, who refused the khanship in his youth, a council elder who sees the dragons' strength with grim realism.

name: Meren
description: A young Nel Toth shaman apprentice who discovers a power of death in her trial, is condemned by her clan, and returns years later as a necromancer to destroy it.

name: Merfolk
description: Sea people whom Kalyntri has hunted and eaten, and to whom Talrand belongs.

name: Merfolk caravan
description: Two dozen merfolk traders and their pillarfield oxen carrying goods to Coralhelm, mostly killed by Verazol.

name: Merge
description: A shimmering opening to the spirit realm in the Eiganjo gardens that disgorged the kami that attacked Norika.

name: Merinaten
description: The girl twin who is swallowed by a sandwurm and survives.

name: Meris
description: A young initiate of the Tah crop, wise beyond his years, who solved the final illusion of the Trial of Knowledge and is killed by Djeru.

name: Meroe
description: Nissa's mother, one of the last animists, who believes Nissa's visions are a gift.

name: Merret
description: A low-skilled covert agent of House Dimir working the Ravnican docks, husband of Tashi and father of Soche and a baby, who drinks stolen Elixir of Focus and is drawn into Lazav's plans for his son.

name: Merret's Baby
description: Merret's nearly one-year-old son who, after tasting the elixir stain, lights candles with a sneeze, vanishes and reappears, and walks for the first time into Lazav's arms.

name: Mertyn
description: Basil's late partner, a young elf who died in the potions lab; his revenant is the lure used by the Devotion.

name: Mertyn's Revenant
description: The ghostly version of Mertyn that visits the shelter each night and invites students to go with him to the lake alone.

name: Merwald Downs
description: A place where Grete takes shelter.

name: Meteor
description: A red dot in the night sky growing larger, a meteor that is about to end the battle.

name: Mevra
description: A hunt leader related to Yasova whose shape is stolen by Nicol Bolas; she is almost certainly dead.

name: Mia
description: A shepherd girl in a village on Lake Zhava, the daughter of a Skiltfolk slayer, who dreams of becoming a slayer herself and is eventually enthralled by the Gitrog.

name: Mia's Cabin
description: Mia's cabin on a hill above the village, with a sheep pen beside it.

name: Michiko
description: Konda's daughter, one of two with hope of placating the kami.

name: Michiko Konda
description: The first emperor to channel with Kyodai, represented by the masks on Kyodai's face.

name: Mightstone and Weakstone
description: The two stones reunited in Urza's gem-like eyes.

name: Mihir
description: A renegade whose mechanical birds carry coded messages.

name: Miko
description: A brave but unobservant student who plays pranks and nearly touches the cytoplast.

name: Milada
description: One of Vraska's assassins hiding in Rozlad Square.

name: Milena's
description: One of the finest restaurants in the Second District where Jace and Liliana dine.

name: Millicent
description: A geist who was once a resident of a riverside community destroyed by Rav's geistbomb, now hunting him across Nephalia.

name: Mina
description: Jilesa's fellow barista at Firejolt Cafe who points her to the Void.

name: Mincemeat
description: An Endriders racer who idolizes Far Fortune and falls into a raider pit.

name: Mind mage
description: A planeswalker who fought Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin.

name: Mind palace
description: Proft's blue-white mental construct where a hooded figure steals a file.

name: Mind-control flower
description: A bruise-purple flower of unnatural origin that emits yellow-gray pollen and subverts a person's will once.

name: Mine overseer
description: A Sterling Company mine overseer who tells Akul about the theft and is killed by him.

name: Ming-na
description: A student who presents on the Goblin Explosioneers.

name: Minotaur oracle
description: A large minotaur seer, rumored to have the ear of Mogis, who directs the raids and kills Vinack with a blow to the head and a blood ritual.

name: Mira
description: Bo's young sister, envenomed by the rattlewurm.

name: Miri
description: An Orzhov tithe taker and secret flesh mage who is torn between her family's pressure to skim, her desire to join Selesnya and her love for her father; she keeps her ledger and journal.

name: Miri's Father
description: An Orzhov pontiff in debt after bad investments who pushes Miri to skim tithes and chase get-rich-quick schemes, and who loves her.

name: Mirran Resistance
description: The resistance fighters who see phoenixes as a symbol of hope.

name: Mirrex
description: The ruined homeland where Neyali searched for survivors with Otharri.

name: Miss Longbow
description: A planeswalker with a longbow, from Skalla, who insists that Bolas is never sated.

name: Missing children
description: Children lured from Meletis who now trail the Weeping Woman in masks and are laid to rest.

name: Mizzix
description: An Izzet mage who helped Maree calibrate and extend Ral's detector spell.

name: Mnesos
description: A bookish soldier who carries Perisophia's Essays on Logic and fights with a sling; he is trampled by the minotaurs.

name: Moat of Oblivion
description: A void in the sky where no star shines, appearing days earlier during the Silence of the gods.

name: Moiren
description: A sturdy retired parish blade and innkeeper on the Innistrad moor who kills vampires and teaches Tam about suffering.

name: Momir Vig
description: A Simic figure whose keyrune and cytoplast are displayed in the zonot museum.

name: Momir Vig's Keyrune
description: A Simic keyrune stolen a century ago, among the treasure aboard the wreck, then displayed in the museum.

name: Momotaxos
description: A being in whose burning blood the Star-Sword was forged.

name: Mon'Telu
description: The central stronghold of the Telu-Set.

name: Monastery Singul
description: A Monoist monastery in orbit that sends Alpharael messages and blessings.

name: Monastery in the borderland mountains
description: The monastery where Sentos lives in a monk's cottage.

name: Mondronen Werewolf Pack
description: The werewolf pack whose howls cursed Arlinn.

name: Monoist alabile
description: Heavy-duty black pressure suits that Geldan trades her ship for; they resist Uthros's pressure and give the wearer a feeling of power.

name: Monster
description: A twelve-foot pink-fleshed monster with fused extra arms and bone-like mask that absorbs people, regenerates, and flees into a metal vein in the cave.

name: Monument of Knowledge
description: A monument of Kefnet's viziers where birth records are kept.

name: Moonglove
description: A Lorwyn flower and the deadliest known daylight poison distilled from it.

name: Moonglow
description: The deadliest daylight poison that coated Rhys's knife.

name: Moragitzu-Kesh
description: An ancient city that researchers believe lies under Strixhaven.

name: Moratorio Cosmogrand
description: A Sunstar unit whose photophoroi help Haliya make her first combat descent.

name: Morecote
description: A proud scarred ash treefolk warrior who kills a faerie in anger and sacrifices himself against a giant.

name: Mornhollow
description: A hill on the eastern edge of Tor-Kathorr with a spring called All-Gleam beneath it, site of an old war.

name: Morphia
description: A vampire Witherbloom student and aspiring doctor with an actor's flair, who resists Mertyn's lure and saves herself with a root talisman.

name: Moseo
description: A skeleton osteomancer who was nearly compleated, cut out the Phyrexian influence, and became the new dean of the vein.

name: Moss elementals
description: Smaller elementals in the Singing City.

name: Mother Crocodile
description: A huge crocodile in the pit at the center of Kheru Temple to which Sidisi feeds her enemies.

name: Mount Keralia
description: The mountain by Keral Keep where Chandra speaks with Gideon and Jace.

name: Mount Keralia Address
description: The traditional speech given by the abbot of Keral Keep.

name: Mount Tanufel
description: The mountain from which the Wanderwine springs, home to Ashling's flamekin.

name: Mr. Lapt
description: A complainant seeking compensation after a tenement floor collapse killed his family members, whose application Relov puts at the bottom of the stack.

name: Mr. Taz
description: A mysterious patron in an ill-fitting skin-suit who hires Krenko for heists and pays him with a key to an Orzhov safebox.

name: Mr. Towning
description: The pepper-gray storekeeper of Saddlebrush who splits Annie's loot with her.

name: Mrs. Palter
description: A cursed woman possessed by the demon Ormendahl through a contract, who kills Elder Somlon, the bell-ringer, Lady Evelin and her own husband.

name: Ms. Sadie
aliases: the old woman with the gray hair
description: An old woman who took Maeli in and burst into many arms at dinner.

name: Ms. Skiffle
description: A teacher in Bablovia who runs a class of oral projects on the government.

name: Mud-Tail
description: An older gray nezumi in the swamp village who refuses to help Kaito and secretly sends a message to Tamiyo.

name: Muddle
description: An unfinished Prismari elemental creation that developed its own consciousness and adapts to other works.

name: Mukotai
description: A Reckoner gang that prizes clever thieves and attacks Far Corner after their scout's death.

name: Mul Daya
description: The elven people of the Guum Wilds, who are slow to trust and worship ancestors.

name: Munhatep
description: An undead skeletal monarch of the Chitin Court who seizes Temmet's body.

name: Muri
description: Jinnie's cat familiar.

name: Museum
description: A marble building on New Capenna that Atraxa destroys.

name: Museum of Invention
description: Museum holding Avaati Vya's prototype aether refiner.

name: Mushroom-backed monster
description: A six-legged crablike monster with mushrooms on its back that uses echolocation and attacks Jace.

name: Muttering Corridors
description: The confusing halls of the Voldaren Estate filled with geists.

name: Muzzio's Constructs
description: Mechanical constructs designed by Muzzio that serve as clerks and secretly record conversations onto wax cylinders.

name: Mycosynth Garden
description: The metallic lattice that grows over the plane's core and merges metal and flesh.

name: Myr
description: Artificial creatures in Tamiyo's story Original, who multiplied after one copied its mind incompletely.

name: Mystic Age
description: The current era in which mages are the most powerful force.

name: Myzoformines
description: Monoist mass-leech creatures that attack slow, close targets near Infinite Guideline.

name: Na Plateau
description: The plateau on the way to the Singing City.

name: Naance
description: A whining boggart who wanted to raid Bre's lair and helps fly Marrja.

name: Naban
description: The Tolarian Dean of Iteration who disapproves of Raff's forbidden spell.

name: Nacatl
description: The cat-like people to which Nira belongs.

name: Nacho and Nacha
description: A pair of Ignacio free-electron lasers at the Dawnsire's prow, used to harvest power from supervoids and as weapons; they bombard Susur Secundi.
