name: Nadima
description: A student who presents on the Crossbreed Labs.

name: Nadino
description: A kor wizard of Tarsa's party who casts fire and ice and is grieving a lost partner.

name: Nagashua
description: A Monoist boarder whose best friend, a mechan, has forgotten her; she is killed by a Sunstar foot soldier in the fighting.

name: Nahiri's hedron
description: A delicate layered stone holding Nahiri's planeswalker spark, found in the Skyclave wall and later shattered.

name: Namivi Dens
description: A rival journalist who beat Jilesa twice for the Argent Star.

name: Naomi
description: An Imperial advisor and Norika's mentor, who sends her to command in Sokenzanshi.

name: Nari
description: A Hyozan Reckoner with needle-tipped metal gloves and an expertise in poisons.

name: Narrator's father
description: The narrator's father, who died in an accident with a load of grain or rocks.

name: Narrator's mother
description: The narrator's mother, who married Vinack out of necessity but came to love him, and who died when the narrator was seventeen.

name: Nashi's drones
description: Nashi's small camera drones, which can record and replay magic.

name: Nassor
description: A minotaur initiate who kills Tarik for his heart.

name: Nathala
description: A druid-trained pearl diver of Telu'Ahn who spies on the racers, steals the vehicle's key and drives off with Khrad.

name: Navy
description: An Obscura spy who trades information with Vivien in the Mezzio, but is secretly a double agent for the Adversary and tries to kill her.

name: Nearheath
description: The region of Gavony where Thalia's order gathered.

name: NecroWarfare
description: Geralf's game with rules, played by Gisa and Geralf, which they now use to frame their joint fight against the Phyrexians.

name: Necrogen
description: Glowing green liquid that can transmute the unwary into undead or induce phyresis.

name: Necromancer
description: A gaunt, powerful man in silks escorted by skeletal servants, seen driving the undead at the end.

name: Necromancers of Grixis
description: Mages of Grixis who wield darkness and animate corpses as soldiers and weapons.

name: Needle
description: A Cabal agent who infiltrated New Argive and brings a soul-drinking black sword, dying by Sadage's spell as her reward.

name: Neheb the Worthy
description: A legendary minotaur champion who has become an Eternal wielding a spear of flame, killed by Samut.

name: Neit
description: An initiate of the Tah crop who kills Kamat for her heart in the final room.

name: Nephalia Massacre
description: A massacre whose perpetrators Sigarda's forces hunt.

name: Neriv
description: The Mardu spirit dragon, who brings the clan together and espouses the strength of the collective.

name: Nerys
description: A stern rabbitfolk of Pondside who scolds Helga for wasting time.

name: Neuroprosthesis
description: Imperial prosthetics that grew into Norika's body after her injury, shown as turquoise designs on her skin.

name: New Coalition
description: The alliance forming at Shiv to fight the Phyrexians.

name: New Yotia
description: The first city of the green west, a wooden river city on a mesa above the Mardun where Kayla settles for a time.

name: Neyali
description: A Mirran resistance cell leader and firebird keeper who surrenders herself to Slobad's trap to save her friend Reyana, and then leads the escape.

name: Nezahal
description: The elder dinosaur of the tides who crushes a Phyrexian giant.

name: Nezumi swamp
description: A poisonous bog home to the nezumi villages.

name: Nezumi-Katsuro gang
description: The gang inhabiting the nezumi village that was burned five years earlier.

name: Nezzan
description: An aged Mul Daya and leader of Riverroot Clan who advises Obuun to be patient.

name: Nickers
description: A customer for whom Liont is making a plow.

name: Nightfall Cathars
description: A group whose spell binds the secret journal Dovid finds.

name: Nightmare
description: A tentacled gelatinous being with ghostly heads in its mouth that Jace dissolves by removing the dreamers' fear.

name: Nightmare Elspeth Tirel
aliases: the thing that would be Elspeth Tirel
description: A nightmare simulacrum of Elspeth clothed in Norn's porcelain armor, created by Ashiok from the mire; Norn destroys it.

name: Nightmare Sisay
description: A half-flesh, half-bone nightmare version of Sisay that mocks Shanna and is destroyed.

name: Nightmare barrier
description: A dome of roiling black smoke that shows each person their nightmares and hides a Phyrexian war construct and Shard-Braids.

name: Nightphlox
description: A balsam flower that grows only in Shadowmoor and is good for healing salves.

name: Nightrider
description: The hordechief's advisor, with whom he discusses the horde's next target.

name: Niharet
description: Mahitab's beloved friend who was entombed alive as a dissenter and now secretly follows the Chitin Court; she betrays the party.

name: Nikasios
description: A handsome, skilled spearman of the squad who loses a leg to the minotaur leader but stays to hold the line.

name: Nikya
description: A Gruul leader who claims the adopted boy as kin and demands he be raised Gruul.

name: Nikya of the Old Ways
description: The Gruul leader of the Zhur-Taa clan, who listens to Ruzi and declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime.

name: Nimana
description: The free city where Tarsa's party seeks work.

name: Nira
description: A golden-furred nacatl Sunstriker who recruits Lia as a stonekiller and dies shielding her.

name: Niraj River
description: A river whose tax collection Jhinu sought to monopolize; his home province.

name: Nishang
aliases: Nishang, destroyer of the Sultai usurpers
description: A former soldier of Silumgar's army dying of a wasting disease, who is resurrected as a sibsig and used by Sidisi's agent to poison the Sultai.

name: Nissa, Leyline Tamer
description: An elf rebel who fights the Kor Empire by harnessing their hedron network.

name: Nita
description: A retired Silverquill professor who is now a conciliator at the Forum of Amity.

name: Nitwik
description: A young boggart who keeps interrupting Auntie Grub's story.

name: Niv-Mizzet statue
description: A massive stone statue of Niv-Mizzet animated by the will of Vraska's double in the Implicit Maze.

name: Niv-Mizzet, Ghost Counsel
description: A dragon spirit who died against the nephilim and bought a seat on the Ghost Council, becoming its sole member.

name: Nivea
description: A war mage who manifested Akroma after losing her lover.

name: Njala
description: A Valkyrie of Starnheim who watches mortals to reward the brave, and who grows secretly fond of Arni.

name: Nnanyielugo
description: Zimone's friend who chose Silverquill.

name: Node
description: A swirling blue orb on a pedestal that is a physical node of the Vaar's knowledge, a billion times rarer than moxite, which moves and kills those who seek it.

name: Nomad shaman
description: A mighty nomad shaman, a contender in an epic struggle for power, who carries the doll and battles a famous crusader.

name: Norika Yamazaki
description: Heiko's elder cousin, injured by a kami attack as a child, who becomes an Imperial commander in Sokenzanshi with augments laid into her skin.

name: Noz
description: A human artist and worker in Pinnacle's programming division, held by the Kav and kept in stasis for three years, who is rescued by Kadrik.

name: Nusfar
description: Vampires who look like children but are fierce predators.

name: Nylah
description: An ambitious initiate who, as the city falls, comes to believe fully and gives herself to the Eternals.

name: Nyxborn Prisoner
description: A star-skinned nyxborn agent of Iroas, caged beside Aesrias, who knew Aesrias's mother and grants him a blessing.

name: O-Kagachi
description: The great kami of all things, outraged by Konda's kidnapping.

name: Ob Nixilis's cavern
description: A cavern between two peaks ringed by inward-pointing hedrons and blocked with an iridescent crust, where the demon holds his captives.

name: Ob Nixilis, the Ascended
description: A demonic general freed from his contract by angels in Capenna who vowed to serve them.

name: Obeka
description: A blue-gray ogre time mage and Slickshot mercenary who guards the elixir with an illusion and sends Nashi back into his memories.

name: Objung Swamps
description: The swamps where orchids used for Silumgar's Breath poison bloom.

name: Oboro
description: The ancient palace of Kamigawa, damaged in the invasion and closed to outsiders.

name: Observatory
description: A place where seers may discern the truth.

name: Obuun
description: A young Mul Daya elf raised among the kor on the Bala Ged Skyclave, who returns to Riverroot Village a thousand years before he becomes a powerful spirit and leader, desperate to prove himself.

name: Obuun's father
description: Obuun's father, who disappeared years ago like his mother.

name: Obzedat chamber
description: A jewel-lined chamber beneath Orzhova holding the preserved bodies of the Obzedat, where the Guildpact's law does not apply.

name: Ogan Shieldmender
description: Riza's krumar chief of scales, ordered to form a shield wall at the canyon mouth.

name: Ognis
description: A fire-breathing viashino Riveteer engineer who stops a train and chases Kitt for the Halo.

name: Ojer Axonil
description: An Oltec god of fire and storms.

name: Ojer Kaslem
description: An Oltec god who will aid the gardeners.

name: Ojutai catacombs
description: The catacombs where Shu Yun and his disciples collect secret knowledge.

name: Okiba Reckoners
description: A biker gang made up exclusively of nezumi that trades with swamp nezumi.

name: Okinec Ahau
description: The Malamet sovereign who claims there are no gods in his realm and sentences the Legion to the sand.

name: Oko's crew
description: The team of thieves, witches, necromancers and assassins Oko assembles to rob the vault of Maag Taranau.

name: Oko's portal
description: A swirling portal of interlocking triangles that Hex finds in the woods and Kellan steps through.

name: Ol' Buzzbark
description: The current alpha goblin of the Goblin Explosioneers.

name: Olaylie
description: An angel of Flight Goldnight who protects Arlinn and the boy at Havengul and is killed by Arlinn's werewolf form.

name: Old Capennan Warrior
description: A towering warrior statue or armor with an axe for an arm, used in the museum's Old Capenna exhibit to behead Fiero.

name: Old Laws Library
description: A hard-to-reach library in the Jelenn Column complex holding original Azorius law texts, including Azor's Guildpact draft.

name: Old Stickfingers
description: An ancient guardian hearth spirit, tall and thin with antlers and too many green-glowing eyes, who is summoned by Arinos and kills those he thinks are intruders.

name: Old Zulaport
description: A former coastal port where Jori learned to set bones.

name: Olgard
description: Mia's father, a famed Skiltfolk shieldbearer and slayer based in Drunau who left her behind.

name: Oligarchs
description: The Orzhov elite who receive tithes and whose approval the family seeks.

name: Olrich
description: A frantic little devil who runs the Mockturne, Kodolaag's friend; he swallows the bloodfray amulet and impersonates Dovin Baan.

name: Olutio
description: The gruff leader of the cult and researcher, whose daughter was reanimated by a ghoulcaller; he is killed by the Buried Lord.

name: Omala
description: The former leonin queen who died in battle with humans.

name: Omenpath Project
description: Niv-Mizzet's secret project, run through agents in all guilds, to map and control the Omenpaths and make Ravnica the hub of the Multiverse.

name: Omnath, Locus of the Void
description: An elemental of voracious emptiness that consumes mana and escaped a Kor Skyclave prison.

name: Onakke Catacomb
description: An ancient catacomb or temple on Shandalar where the Chain Veil lay, partly crumbled after Liliana's battle with Garruk.

name: Onakke Catacombs
description: A site on Shandalar where the demon Kothophed called to Garruk.

name: Ondu Skyclave
description: An ancient kor weapons laboratory with a proving room and tessellated walls that function as text and map.

name: Operation Falling Star
description: The resistance's plan to destroy Park Heights' core on Atraxa's head.

name: Operation Golden Scales
description: Saheeli's defensive plan deploying bronze attack lizards across Ghirapur.

name: Opus Walk
description: A campus walk lined with art projects left behind by graduates, including Samara's waterfall.

name: Oracle
description: A dark oracle whose vague visions guide Sorin to Ugin's location.

name: Order of Dawn
description: The order led by Lyra.

name: Order of Heliud
description: A religious organization Gideon once worked for, which eventually tried to kill Chandra.

name: Order of the Silver Heron
description: The order of attendants at the cathedral crèche who raised children of the cleansed.

name: Order of the Widget
description: A technocracy led by the Grand Calcutron whose members upgrade their bodies with technology.

name: Oreskos
description: The leonin homeland on Theros.

name: Oret's scalelord
description: The Dromoka scalelord to whom Oret is bonded, who allows him to execute Anafenza after discovering her necromancy.

name: Orien
description: A former member of Tarsa's party killed by Grakmaw in Ondu.

name: Orla
description: A faerie who helps trick Rankle; he once put bees in her mouth.

name: Orniary
description: The artifice school and yard in Kroog where cadets train with avengers.

name: Orrithia
description: The northern continent of Arcavios, commonly called the Vastlands.

name: Orwell
description: The Gatstaf bell-ringer killed by Mrs. Palter.

name: Orysa
description: A merfolk from the Pinzari Isles who summons elemental creatures and leads the Twirling Turtle Troupe.

name: Orzhov safebox key
description: A silver key with the Orzhov symbol that retrieves Feather's money.

name: Oscillus Cail
description: A figure tied to the botched Cail Station evacuation whom Ghan vows to hunt.

name: Oskar
description: An Obscura agent who befriends rats and finds trash and halo signs.

name: Ossett Weslyn
description: A minotaur clerk of Boros Legion's Sunhome Annex Four who is promoted to Wojek counterintelligence, is framed for poisonings and exposes the true culprit.

name: Otharri
description: Neyali's firebird, a phoenix who frees the caged Mirrans with his flame.

name: Ovalchase
description: A venue in Ghirapur from which renegade inventors with automatons hurry away.

name: Overachiever Zimone
description: A second double split from the part of Zimone that hopes and drives for excellence, who takes several jobs.

name: Overlook platform
description: A platform across a chasm where Chandra confronts Nissa.

name: Ovitzia
description: A place from Jace's childhood memories where he kept a dog.

name: Oyana
description: A young laborer in a Zhalfir fishing line who plans to join the akinji and speaks to Teferi as the father of Zhalfir.

name: Oyster Bay
description: A seaport carved into white chalk cliffs where the peace summit takes place.

name: Paala
description: A young woman of Abzan birth raised among the Mardu who undertakes the Lightning Proving to be accepted as a warrior and is named Paala, clan's aid.

name: Pabkoh
description: A first-generation vanguard who helps carry the pod and arranges a ship for Noz.

name: Padeem
description: A vedalken consul and judge of the Inventors' Fair, once a famed underground quicksmith, who grants Rashmi and Mitul an audience.

name: Page
description: A living piece of parchment that students try and fail to catch, with many rumored origins.

name: Paipai
description: Ru's family ox, which died the previous winter.

name: Palace of Justice
description: The building in Azor's city where he and Ugin plotted.

name: Pallar
description: A pregnant Efravan leonin and Zar's sister, who gives birth to a daughter named Lark.

name: Pallas
description: A tall, muscular, boastful soldier who stays behind to hold off the minotaurs so Leandros can escape.

name: Panopticon
description: A darksteel tower in the Mycosynth Garden housing the Darksteel Eye.

name: Pardia
description: A region near the crash site that Raff jokes they could have landed in.

name: Parhelion II
description: The Boros airship that joins the sky attack.

name: Path Ward
description: A committee established to oversee, approve and vet travel through Omenpaths.

name: Pathrazer
description: A spawn of the titan Ulamog that emerges from under the earth to attack a group of adventurers and is killed by Nissa's elementals.

name: Pavios
description: A young Meletian ambassador's son and former student of the Dekatia, in love with Thanasis, who kills himself after Thanasis dies.

name: Pavios's father
description: An ambassador from Meletis, resentful of his posting in Akros, who plans to marry Pavios to an official's daughter.

name: Peacewalker
description: Huge Consulate rolling war machine draped in banners.

name: Pegasus
description: A pegasus friendly to the Skyguard whom Alexio finds as a mount and who carries Iris away.

name: Pellerife
description: The world of the Pinnacle archives where Jadnis works.

name: Pendulum Year
description: The period after Oona's reign ended when the plane began to fuse together.

name: Pests
description: A family of wart-ridden creatures who are repositories of magical energy and trust Dina; they are lost in the ritual.

name: Pevnar
description: An upside-down fortress garrisoned by the Krunstraz.

name: Phalanx leader
description: A phalanx captain who reports to the Dekatia that the Weeping Woman is now leading three children and could not bring himself to strike them down.

name: Phantom Dean Kianne
description: A translucent image of Dean Kianne made of the House that tries to lure Zimone and attacks Tyvar.

name: Phantom dimensions
description: Dimensions whose auras provide pathways for the transporter; Rashmi finds they are real other realities.

name: Pharagax Bridge
description: Site of a third battle where Aesrias's mother fell.

name: Phelos
description: A thinker cited as stating that identity is the condition of being oneself over time.

name: Phoebe
description: The self-proclaimed current leader of the Agents of S.N.E.A.K.

name: Phoenix
description: A giant burning raptor that attacks the Weatherlight and is killed by Tiana.

name: Phoenix feather
description: A healing feather Ranna uses to restore Vraska, which inspires Jace and Vraska's plan of rebirth.

name: Phyrexian Etali
description: The elder dinosaur Etali, turned by Phyrexia into a storm of engines and lightning, who attacks the Winged Temple.

name: Phyrexian Lukka
description: A compleated version of Lukka riding at the heart of a titan of stolen flesh, who returns to Ikoria to conquer Drannith's survivors.

name: Phyrexian Nassari
description: The half-compleated, metal-fleshed version of Dean Nassari who taunted Rootha during the invocation in the Biblioplex.

name: Phyrexian Tamiyo
description: Tamiyo after being Phyrexianized in the laboratory, now loyal to Phyrexia as her new family; the first Phyrexianized planeswalker.

name: Phyrexian carapace
description: Nissa's cast-off copper Phyrexian skeleton, which Chandra melts and buries.

name: Phyrexian centaur hulk
description: A four-legged Phyrexian construct that Lukka dominates through the eludha and later merges with.

name: Phyrexian compleation
description: The blessed gift of Phyrexian transformation given to Atraxa.

name: Phyrexian dreadnought
description: A huge Phyrexian monstrosity that breaks out of a mountain and is killed by the Keldons.

name: Phyrexian general
description: A winged Phyrexian commander of the white-armored legion, killed by Nissa with seed-bearing stabs.

name: Phyrexian machine
description: A gargantuan mechanical creature that emerged from the desert sand and is marching on Femeref.

name: Phyrexian spy-creature
description: A shape-shifting creature that splits into many pieces and infests New Argive's watchtower.

name: Phyrexian staging ground
description: A Phyrexian base in a vast cavern with surgical tables, a portal ship, skyships and a dragon engine.

name: Phyrexian thrush
description: A varied thrush that is a Phyrexian spy; it attacks Karn with corrosive cables and is caged.

name: Phyrexianized elementals
description: Zendikar's guardian elementals, converted into oil-covered Phyrexian zealots in the Skyclave.

name: Phyrexianized professors
description: Compleated faculty who hunt the students in the Biblioplex.

name: Pia, Aether Ascetic
description: An Echoverse Pia Nalaar who stands against the Consulate and tends a garden she hopes her daughter will one day enjoy.

name: Pia, Determined Rebuilder
description: Pia Nalaar, a human artificer and former revolutionary, Chandra's mother, who leads Avishkar as an assembly member.

name: Pietro Lokosh
description: A sub-lieutenant in Marchesa's organization whom Ervos names as a target for extortion.

name: Pigeons of New Capenna
description: Birds touched by Halo and the angels' power that watch over Kitt, warn her of trouble, and carry her to safety.

name: Pili
description: An injured goblin recruit who insists her friend Leek is still alive.

name: Pillardrop
description: The ridge with caves and a dig site near Strixhaven where Zantafar is hidden.

name: Pilun
description: The corrupt governor of Tynthal who wears a crown, frames Aesrias and has seceded from the true king.

name: Pinzari Isles
description: Islands home to Orysa and the merfolk twins Nev and Adrix.

name: Piru
description: An elder dragon said to have been killed by the Blackblade.

name: Pita
description: An Oriq agent with Extus who argues that destroying Strixhaven would spread magic.

name: Pixies
description: Mischievous fae creatures that laugh at Ruby and Kellan.

name: Planar acclimatization
description: Geralf's theory that magic adapts to the rules of a different plane over time.

name: Pol Cordel
description: Gerrard's older friend in Benalia, who urges him to help his friends and keeps his hourglass pendant.

name: Pollio
description: A metalworker of Akros with a wife and children who dreams of being bound with the city's twine into one mass of flesh.

name: Polukranos
description: A massive fifty-headed celestial hydra bound by the gods, who in the story awakens and is slain by the Champion of the Sun.

name: Pompon
description: Kaito's small tanuki-shaped robot, found by Kaya and returned to him.

name: Pond Creek
description: The stream where Helga collapses.

name: Pondl
description: A loyal goblin who works for Krenko and can barely count past ten.

name: Pontifex Fein
description: The leader who struggles to hold the Church of Dusk together.

name: Poq
description: Okinec Ahau's tawny-furred mythweaver, who uses magic to show a vision revealing the vampires' true nature.

name: Porfirio
description: A batfolk cleric at the party.

name: Port Gizmo
description: A lovely place Calvin visited on a day trip.

name: Precinct Five
description: The district of Ravnica where the inn with the noticeboard stands.

name: Presiding Chamber
description: A cavernous central gallery of the Forum manor with four silver portal archways.

name: Priests of the dour god
description: Hooded priests with small golden whips who chant to quiet the Weeping Woman and the children.

name: Primal Beyond
description: The areas beyond the known and tamed expanse of Lorwyn.

name: Primal Wellspring
description: A mystical pool in a glade where Kopala and Tishana meditate.

name: Primo
description: A wolflike fractal companion that Zimone summoned and never unsummoned, who became her defender.

name: Professor Emralla
description: A professor whose money and estate vanish from the records after Muzzio's constructs alter them.

name: Professor Fimarell
description: A professor on the Academy's Board of Senior Advisors.

name: Professor Goss
description: Jilesa's advisor, who calls her overconfident and impetuous.

name: Professor Mavinda
description: Strixhaven professor who signs the welcome message with the Welcoming Committee.

name: Professor Regness
description: A professor who was on sabbatical and later attends the board.

name: Professor Tulando
description: An ancient professor elected future vice chancellor who resigns after being framed for embezzlement.

name: Proft, Consulting Detective
description: Alquist Proft, a brilliant detective and former Azorius lawmage who maps Ravnica's Omenpaths.

name: Proft, Sinister Mastermind
description: An Echoverse Alquist Proft, said to be an unreal mastermind behind crime in Ravnica.

name: Projektor
description: A brass Agency device that displays notes and sketches, edited with a mizzium-tipped stylus.

name: Prossh
description: A dragon worshipped by the kobolds of the Kher Ridges.

name: Prototype X-8
description: A mechan amalgam of organic and synthetic matter on a moon Pinnacle advises explorers to avoid.

name: Ptero Zallik
description: A senior clutch tender with a crab torso and pincers who is Medge's rival and an Adaptationist.

name: Puppetbeasts
description: Animated wood, stone and clay constructs piloted by Konstrari tethermages.

name: Purael
description: A hard Monoist murderer in the boarding party who believes the Next Eternity has been filled with castoffs and means to enforce discipline there.

name: Purifying Fire
description: A Regatha fire that demanded acceptance of responsibility from Chandra.

name: Purugir
description: The trading post near the Salt Road where Taigam met Ebirri.

name: Purugir Aerie
description: One of the Dromoka's frontline war centers.

name: Pyromancer
description: A planeswalker who fought Sarkhan at the Eye of Ugin and defeated him with Ugin's own fire.

name: QA Cyst Zero-One
description: A soft-walled bladder at a clay-processing shed where unidentified mined objects are stored, containing an inspection pool of shear starch.

name: Qadir
description: The Fallaji ruler who orders the war and the attack.

name: Qatros Karst
description: A grand Abzan haven carved into rock, born from humble refugee caves, now besieged by the Sultai.

name: Queen Ayara
description: Queen of the Locthwain Court, fierce and cunning, who has outlived many husbands; she is later seen transformed by Phyrexia and marshaling its troops.

name: Queen Oura
description: A faerie who proclaimed herself queen by mimicking Oona and is worshiped by many Lorwyn faeries.

name: Queen Salazar
description: The severe vampire queen of Luneau, who appears bored by the tableau.

name: Queen Wezna
description: The queen of Zhalfir, who declares a long wait against Phyrexia and sentences Teferi, then spares him.

name: Queen of Zhalfir
description: The queen beside Teferi in the hidden place, who calls Wrenn an efreet and leads her people as they ready for war.

name: Queen's Bay
description: A port where the second Dawn Fleet is being built.

name: Questing Beast
description: A legendary beast that Rankle and Mags once made cry.

name: Queza
description: Kamiz's cephalid apprentice and the best Exactor in the Obscura, who believes in the angels and keeps a halo talisman.

name: Quiet Wall
description: The border where observation crumbles at the redshifted end of the annular universe.

name: Quilion
description: A lesser bishop who defends Jerren and calls Thalia the only heretic.

name: R. Karolus
description: The rider who delivered the werewolf specimen to the journal's author.

name: Raccoonfolk gang
description: Raccoonfolk who ambush Elspeth in an alley.

name: Racket
description: A goblin Rocketeer whose rickety ride is torn apart by a Cloudspire cycler.

name: Rael
description: An angel who led the Benalish forces against the Cabal in Caligo and agrees to Gideon's plan.

name: Rafiq
description: A Bant knight-general to whom Estel is told to bring the box.

name: Ragavan
description: Kari's begoggled white-furred monkey companion, whom she calls her prince.

name: Rage
description: The berserk fury that Gruul channel, which Arrus cannot feel until the end.

name: Ragefest
description: The Rakdos festival of carnage and revelry during which the story takes place.

name: Ragost
description: A lobsterfolk ship's chef famed for outlandish claims and ingredients too strong for most digestive tracts, who cooks for mechans that want to taste.

name: Raiders
description: Heavily armed lizardmen on dinosaurs who attack the racers on Muraganda and take captives for sacrifice.

name: Rainveil Forest
description: A Temur forest, now silent, where the blue curse flows from a glowing lake at the center.

name: Raissa
description: A satyr mother of Setessa who consults a magical starfish about her son's destiny and is disillusioned with the gods.

name: Rajni
description: Sram's assistant at the Aether Hub.

name: Rajul
description: A great aetherborn inventor who pioneered medical technology for non-organic beings and has a statue in the Statuary Garden.

name: Rakdos ogre
description: A nearly eight-foot-tall ogre in a dented mask armed with hooks and chains, who stays behind and is killed by Ruzi and Kuma.

name: Rakoro
description: A Kav squad member wielding a beam axe, swallowed by a swarm in the structure.

name: Ranaj
description: The Enforcer-Chief whose clumsy soldiers seize the inventions.

name: Ranar
description: An old warrior who died protecting refugee children, wakes as a spirit in Istfell, and is repeatedly named guardian of the realm.

name: Rankle, Master of Pranks
description: A small, mischievous faerie with a bad wing who is thrown out by his friends, falls in love with Queen Ayara and tricks the Phyrexian horde into a chasm.

name: Rarp
description: A goblin stone jockey crushed by a boulder and revealed as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.

name: Rashmi's original transporter ring
description: The ring that was Rashmi's first transporter, used to send her warning note to Mitul.

name: Rath
description: The place where Starke says he saw Selenia and where Sisay is presumed held.

name: Rattlewurm
description: A giant gold-plated serpent that terrorizes Saddlebrush and turns out to have a baby.

name: Rattlewurm baby
description: A considerably smaller rattlewurm that joins the large one at its lair.

name: Raugrin
description: A volcanic region of Ikoria scoured by fire and quakes.

name: Ravnican Worldsoul
description: The living soul of the plane of Ravnica, which Oba turns into a weapon and which resists Kaya's phasing until she appeals to it.

name: Ravos
description: An oracle of Athreos who guides the dead to the Underworld to see his dead lover yearly while secretly defying the god.

name: Ravus
description: A brother of Vaevictis, killed by the sorcerers' disintegration spell.

name: Rayne
description: Barrin's dead wife.

name: Raze-Boar
description: The Gruul deity whom the clan honors with tusk-shaped rubble stacks.

name: Razi
description: Bozak's sister, the best singer in the family, who urges him not to leave the farmstead.

name: Razia
description: The angel whom Aresaan resembles, and for whom the opening move Razia's Folly is named.

name: Razineth
description: A sallow-faced kor inkmaster who proctors the Intention & Subtext II dueling course.

name: Red Iron Mountains
description: The mountains where Danitha has camped and where the Phyrexian cave lies.

name: Red Ridge
description: A ridge in the Tusk mountains whose villages are terrorized by murderous trolls.

name: Red Route
description: A difficult, quick hookroute up the Umara River Gorge that Akiri set during the Battle.

name: Red Wizards of Thay
description: Two Red Wizards on a secret mission into the High Moors, searching for something or someone.

name: Reed
description: A frogfolk who gave Helga clothes.

name: Reen
description: A Monoist gravkill paladin and squad captain from Susur Secundi on a pilgrimage to Point Prime, haunted by her part in the slaughter at Joska and tattooing a ledger of her kills.

name: Refia
description: Paala's younger sister, who tends manul kittens and wants to take their mother's job.

name: Regis
description: Jinnie's dog familiar.

name: Reito
description: A town a few miles from Eiganjo Castle, attacked by the kami.

name: Relay tower
description: A tower being built at Omenport to communicate through Omenpaths, which suffers a power surge.

name: Relio
description: A Voldaren vampire who prattles about Olivia and is killed by Henrika Domnathi.

name: Reliquaries
description: Rare sacred items made from pieces of Eirdu or Isilu that let a bearer keep their form and memories across aspects.

name: Reliquary of Dawn
description: A reliquary that lets a bearer cross the barrier into Shadowmoor, kept in Boeb's lair.

name: Reliquary of Twilight
description: Gethin's bell-shaped lantern reliquary, which lets Cerys cross the aurora until it breaks.

name: Remi
description: A tall blue shopkeeper in Ghirapur whose shop runs out of filaments.

name: Remi's shop
description: A Ghirapur parts shop out of WP series filaments.

name: Rendall
description: Sanwell's younger brother, a cadet in the ornithopter corps stationed at the palace.

name: Renegade Prime
description: An older woman with auburn hair, welding goggles and a handheld welder, called the Renegade Prime by Tezzeret; Chandra recognizes her as her mother.

name: Republic of Paliano
description: The republic Adriana proposes to build with Selvala as a senator to halt the cycle of tyrants.

name: Rescue Girl, First Responder
description: Selesnya's preeminent hero, a first responder with acrobatics and healing magic.

name: Resplendent Benthid
description: A large amphibious sea leviathan killed by krasis.

name: Restless spirit
description: A withered warrior spirit in battle-scarred armor with two spears in its chest that attacks Kirol's group, and later Lluwen's.

name: Revari manor
description: The big manor Revari inherited from his mother, wrecked by the ghost; it has a concealed crawlspace and a floorless bedroom.

name: Revari's Mother
description: The ghost of Emilio Revari's mother, a clawed, needle-toothed old woman who haunts her manor and guards her own hidden corpse.

name: Reyana
description: An Auriok woman and Neyali's childhood friend, who raises firebirds and is shaken by her compleated mother; she goes willingly to Slobad seeking peace.

name: Reyana's mother
description: A compleated Auriok aspirant with a scythe arm who comes for Reyana and is thrown over a ledge by Neyali.

name: Reza
description: A young vedalken Azorius lawmage who is stranded in the Thinktank, befriends its inventors, declares the Thinktank an enclave under emergency law and becomes a mentor.

name: Rezint
description: Geldan's longtime partner, a former student of Illvoi script and former hustler, who accompanies her into Uthros and tries to talk her out of opening the doors.

name: Rhain Breckon
description: A Lorwyn elf scarred by a boggart in an eclipsed realm and slowly calcifying, who corresponds with Cerys and dies with her.

name: Rhonas's Monument
description: An ancient cobra-headed monument by the river where a sphinx sits atop an obelisk.

name: Rhonas's Staff-Serpent
description: A living serpent into which Rhonas's staff is transformed by his last spell, torn apart by the scorpion god.

name: Rhytho
description: A student of Perisophia who argues that identity cannot be given by an outside observer.

name: Rica
description: A stoic Yotian cadet who becomes a pilot and flees with Sanwell.

name: Rider's Lock
description: The prison from which Gisa was being transported.

name: Rigo
description: A young leonin Broker solicitor in a pinstripe vest with a street network, who teleports Perrie to headquarters.

name: Rikkig
description: One of the Shattergang Brothers, a goblin bomb-maker who holds prisoners and escapes Gideon.

name: Riku
description: A mage in a Shandalaran paper who copied himself to learn two fields at once.

name: Rillem
description: A caravan guard sent to scout south.

name: Rinata
description: Moseo's skeleton pest.

name: Ring of Lim-Dûl
description: A ring that anchors the Raven Man and is buried beneath the Vess graveyard, containing great necromantic power.

name: Ring of ceaseless life
description: A ring that grants ceaseless life, given to Sentos by the false king and taken by the gorgon.

name: Rising
description: The ritual by which treefolk gain sentience; the trees hope to perform a new Rising to revive the yew.

name: Rite of Redemption
description: The vampires' rite whose consequences force them to drink blood.

name: Ritual of Arbiter Twins
description: A meditation of slow movements and chanting in which the twins hear a trial and connect to truth and justice.

name: River Herald Merfolk
description: A green-finned merfolk in the tavern who silently protests when Vraska names Orazca.

name: River Wards
description: A district of Kroog along the Mardun taken by Mishra's force.

name: River's Glen
description: Brenalt's home, overrun by the dead.

name: Riverroot Clan
description: The Mul Daya clan living in the Riverroot tree, led by Nezzan.

name: Riverroot Tree
description: The massive tree housing all the elves of Riverroot, whose roots reach into the caves.

name: Riverroot Village
description: The Mul Daya village built in the great Riverroot tree.

name: Riverwalk
description: A Jeskai fighting style that imitates flowing water.

name: Riverwheel
description: A place with an archive Narset searched.

name: Riverwheel Stronghold
description: A Jeskai stronghold that teaches its own variation of Riverwalk magic.

name: Riza
description: An Abzan patrol captain who leads fifty soldiers along the Salt Road and chooses to make a stand at an oasis against a Mardu horde.

name: Rocco
description: An elf bartender at the cabaret who refuses to help Elspeth.

name: Rogel
description: A contact with whom Torens was to finalize a contraband deal.

name: Roilmage initiates
description: Noyan Dar's students at Coralhelm who chant the litany and work the Roil together as a force against the Eldrazi.

name: Romoe
description: A young caravan guard who warns Tazri not to kill the angel and who is later turned inside out by Kozilek's wave.

name: Rose Stage
description: The stage where Razineth's duel takes place.

name: Rowan's father
description: The dead king who appears in Rowan's dream, giving her his crown.

name: Rowan's mother
description: Eriette's sister and a witch, killed by Rowan's father after she tried to drink Rowan and Will's blood.

name: Roxith
description: One of the thanes who sided with Urabrask.

name: Royal Palace
description: King Lucard's palace in Luneau, which collapses during Vivien's rampage.

name: Rozlad Square
description: A dark Golgari-turf plaza near the tunnels of the Stonefare, where petrified victims are displayed.

name: Ru
description: An ainok farmer and Asham's childhood friend, who stayed in the village rather than joining the monastery and who cares for Asham after his defeat.

name: Rubra
description: A brother of Vaevictis who dies from a venom bolt to the eye.

name: Ruby's ice sword
description: A giant sword of eternal ice granted to Ruby by Hylda.

name: Rudra
description: A scarred former guard captain once court-martialed, now hired by Gonti for race security and asked by Mohar to help him.

name: Rufaz
description: A female orc and one of Zurgo's three top wing leaders who doubts the march into Temur lands.

name: Ruined Plaza
description: A plaza strewn with rubble and bodies where the Gatewatch faces Bolas.

name: Rules of the Reeds
description: The Jeskai law that guarantees any Jeskai accused of murder a trial.

name: Rumiyo
description: A companion Tamiyo tells Nashi to take to the market.

name: Runari
description: A trickster of Cosi ordered to stay at Sea Gate.

name: Rundlestrom Military Academy
description: The military academy that expelled Quint.

name: Runo Stromkirk
description: A vampire noble who would sooner give himself to the beings of the sea than marry Olivia.

name: Ruric Thar, Biomagus
description: An Echoverse two-headed ogre crab, one of the Simic Combine's most brilliant biomages, who experiments on themselves.

name: Ruric Thar, Magecrusher
description: An ogre of the Gruul trapped by the Simic with poisoned legs of lamb, who cannot be contained.

name: Ruric and Thar
description: The two-headed ogre chieftain of the Ghor Clan who exiles Arrus and later joins his call for war against Selesnya.

name: Rushdown range
description: Mountain villages with under thirty thousand people that were struck by the bolide Tannuk braked.

name: Rushka
description: A masked Temur shaman with fire magic who is dominated by Sorin and has his head cut off by his own captain.

name: Rustwood
description: A failed ranching town containing the Wildcard Saloon, where Oko's crew meets.

name: Ryan Miller
description: The author of the story, noted as a Magic 2013 designer.

name: Rytva
description: A dove-gray-winged Valkyrie, Avtyr's counterpart, who supports Niko's plan and carries them in the battle.

name: Sacred tree of Kheru
aliases: the sacred waters of the ancient tree
description: The ancient tree whose roots glow beneath the sacred pool used to anoint newly undead.

name: Sadage
description: A cleric of the Cabal who receives Needle's gift for the Scion of Darkness and kills her as a reward.

name: Safe house
description: A warded cabin on Dominaria where the planeswalkers wait for news.

name: Sage Eye Stronghold
description: A Jeskai stronghold on a mountain, with a pavilion plaza for meditation a quarter-mile away and the Annals in its lowest section.

name: Saheeli's construct
description: A metal construct Saheeli shapes around Rashmi to carry her to safety.

name: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight
description: An Echoverse Saheeli Rai who surveys Avishkar through a network of thopter spies.

name: Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar
description: Saheeli Rai, a master inventor who lost her spark and returned to Avishkar after staying on Ixalan with Huatli.

name: Saheena
description: An old one-eyed Vulshok woman and cell member with two sons, who stays with Neyali as honor guard.

name: Saheena's sons
description: Two young Vulshok who accompany Saheena; one sees his father among Slobad's aspirants.

name: Saint Sunsolde
description: A saint of the Summists named in Raphaella's mockery.

name: Sakta
description: A young human hunter and chief scout who is the center of the Wide Whisper among surviving shamans.

name: Salis
description: A student of Perisophia who raises the story of Matatios.

name: Salvage Complex
description: Slobad's prison-like complex with cages, an inverted ziggurat pit and rows of kneeling dead Phyrexians.

name: Salvasi manor
description: The home of the wealthy Salvasi family in Lambholt, found broken open and empty.

name: Salvation
description: An ancient primal force in the form of Squee's toy sphere, which protected his soul, speaks to him in the afterlife and grants him a choice.

name: Samara Squallheart
description: Rootha's mother, a lauded artist-mage of ice and water sculptures whose waterfall stands on Opus Walk.

name: Samia
description: A student of Perisophia who has read Dekatia's Observations and asks about the Returned and the eidolons.

name: Samut, Hazoret's Champion
description: A fast-thinking de facto leader of the living in Naktamun who works with Hapatra and seeks the favor of all the gods.

name: Samut, Tyrant of Naktamun
description: An Echoverse wizard who rules Naktamun with the frozen god and can slow time to the point of freezing.

name: Sanctum
description: Elesh Norn's inner sanctum on New Phyrexia, where portals show invaded planes.

name: Sanwell
description: A young Argivian cadet from Penregon, newly promoted to avenger pilot, who is paired with Sword One during the attack on Kroog.

name: Sarah
description: The blacksmith's wife, who once baked Mia cookies for her birthday and calls for her to be sacrificed.

name: Sarin Mercantile
description: A merchant house whose treasury in Suq'Ata was infiltrated.

name: Sarinth
description: A recently pacified province whose soldiers are among the replacements.

name: Saryth
description: A woman with glowing green eyes whose power is in the mask; she feeds ensorcelled villagers to eggs to call the Coiled One and is swallowed by the chasm.

name: Saskia
description: The sole survivor of a massacre of her village who built a monument for ten years and then led a host to wage war on her enemies.

name: Satoru's channeler
description: A gray-skinned woman who channels Azamaki and serves Satoru; this page does not name her.

name: Savai
description: A plain of Ikoria that was home to great cats.

name: Savaryn
description: A strong loxodon of the Selesnya army, Terrik's friend, who is promoted to director of a new training facility.

name: Sawtooth Ridge
description: A ridge in Akoum near the jaddi grove where Tafre saw a field of flesh.

name: Sawtooth ogres
description: The ogres of Maraxus's platoon, who loot Alaric's mansion and attack Gerrard's group.

name: Sayrah
description: A female panther warrior of the Urborg resistance who gives Jhoira a map and Cabal clothing.

name: Scavenger
description: An augmented black-robed figure who sees Teferi's spirit and asks if he is the one from their dream.

name: Scavrana the Oracle
description: Author of the tome Accounts of the Dawning Age.

name: School of Pearls
description: A Jeskai school without a stronghold whose students manipulate pearls while fighting.

name: Scorching talon strike
description: A dragon-inspired Jeskai martial form of 'release the self, expel breath, and conjure flames' that Asham struggles to complete.

name: Screamreach
description: The central swampland region of the Kolaghan's lands.

name: Scribing board
description: Magical boards by which the friends exchange messages, including the Code Oona alarm.

name: Scribing boards
description: Magical boards through which the friends see each other's handwriting as it is written.

name: Scriv
description: An inkling created at the Forum of Amity to enforce a diplomatic agreement and who now monitors its contracts and treaties.

name: Sea Gate war memorial
description: A platform with six hedrons amid wreckage commemorating the Eldrazi war dead.

name: Second District
description: The elegant district of Ravnica where Liliana walks.

name: Second Lieutenant Devin Sidian
description: Skormak's boss, one of three poisoned officers, who dies.

name: Sedgemoor
description: A necroluminescent swamp landscape at Strixhaven that Liliana loves.

name: Seed
description: The poison with which the Horrible Beast controls Tibalt.

name: Seeta
description: A zealous inquisitor who led the hunt for Thalia and heads the so-called Sinpurged, killed by Olivia.

name: Selenia
description: An angel whom Crovax pursues and whom Starke says he saw once in Rath.

name: Selesnyan Artifact
description: A Selesnyan artifact that appears in Miri's robe pocket and reveals Vitu-Ghazi's hidden weaknesses.

name: Selesnyan settlement
description: Cecilee's walled community in the Rubblebelt, now strewn with bodies and marked with a Rakdos bloodmark.

name: Sen Gael
description: The main island of the Sens, home islands of the orcs, where the secret meeting takes place in a lighthouse cabin.

name: Sentos
description: A twenty-six-year-old veteran of the war in Thune who ended it by sparing a false king, and who is petrified after killing himself fails to go as planned.

name: Serena
description: Errant's late mother, who is mourned by Anhelo.

name: Sergeant Embrel Skormak
description: A flame-kin Boros sergeant and Ossett's boss who secretly orchestrates poisonings of Sunhome officers, including himself, to win promotion, and is extinguished.

name: Sergeant Usman
description: A sergeant who supplies the order chit and demands a full satchel of goods in return.

name: Serpent's Maw
description: The stormy waters crossed to reach Jwar Isle.

name: Setessan Order of Midwives
description: An order of midwives of Setessa who help satyr women give birth and keep a store of symposium wine.

name: Setessans
description: People of a polis that Perisophia says kills truth with arrows.

name: Sevalgr
description: A fishing village that has lost many people to disappearances.

name: Severo
description: A man who impersonates a cab driver to avenge his father, whom Anhelo killed three years earlier; he crashes the car into a Riveteer transport.

name: Sewa
description: A Femeref town serving Zhalfir pilgrims.

name: Sewer Sirens
description: Rabid creatures in the sewers that attack anyone who puts a hand in their mouth.

name: Seza
description: A young gray-furred female leonin patrol leader with a large axe who escorts Ajani to Tethmos.

name: Sha'heel
description: A silent kor sky-climber, twin of Khali, who communicates by hand signals and attacks the Pathrazer with a kitesail.

name: Shadow Generator
description: A gadget that Toluz won, which lets her bring darkness and strike unseen.

name: Shadowgrange
description: The village where Strefan sees Brandt ride past after years.

name: Shadress
description: Elnor's girlfriend and a tailor in Yuma's old crew, calm and wise, who bought the building and is now dead.

name: Shaile Talonrook
description: An owlin dean of Strixhaven who interrupts Liliana after the masked intruder vanishes.

name: Shana
description: Deidamia's witch friend who first spots the heroes arriving.

name: Shann Dilara
description: A petrified victim whose name Jace connects to Shandalar.

name: Sharaman
description: The spirit of the general who led Urza's armies, who sabotages the Temporal Anchor to prevent Urza's war machine from being restarted.

name: Shard-Braids
description: A split-off shard of Braids hiding in the nightmare barrier, who attacks the crew and is reabsorbed.

name: Sheeza and Jahdeera
description: Viashino twin Gruul warriors in the pack.

name: Shella
description: An Askari who beheads Vorinclex and helps Teferi up.

name: Shen
description: A skeptical, devoted trickster of Cosi who follows Kiora and is killed by her after being controlled by Kozilek.

name: Shenmeng
description: The plane of Jiang Yanggu.

name: Shevara
description: An elf warrior and scout of the Rotrue clan who counts the windows of House from the trees and is the first to see that it has entered the forest.

name: Shilgengar
description: A demon who devised with Markov the formula that turned men into vampires.

name: Shintan
description: Narset's personal guard, who also watches that she observes ceremony, and who fights off the Disowned orcs beside her.

name: Shivan dragons
description: Dragons of Shiv whose names the Ghitu elders only whispered; Vivien intends to lure one.

name: Shorikai
description: A kami with a black aura and many hollowed faces, bound by metal spikes and glowing threads inside the Epoch Engine, who takes control of the mech and offers to take their own path with Kotori.

name: Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest
description: The youthful-looking, ancient leader of the Jeskai, a ghostfire warrior who collects secret knowledge with disciples in the Ojutai catacombs.

name: Sidar Kondo
description: A knight and horseman from Jamuraa on Dominaria who led in the Mirage War and was killed by his own son Vuel.

name: Sidar Teshunda
description: The aged magistrate and general of Femeref, who bars the Efravan until Niambi's dream interpretation and the sight of the refugees move him to accept them.

name: Siege of Penregon
description: A single-day assault on Penregon by Talite crusaders combined with an uprising by hidden cultists inside the city.

name: Siege of Qatros Karst
description: The Sultai siege of Qatros Karst, with artillery and necromancy causing hunger and ruin.

name: Sifa Grent
description: Dack Fayden's planeswalking partner.

name: Sigarda's Solar
description: Sigarda's private chamber at the top of an abandoned tower in a Kessig forest.

name: Sigiled knights
description: Knights glimpsed in Elspeth's vision of Eldraine defending against Phyrexians.

name: Sigma
description: The world rich with ores but no miners where the Endstone was buried.

name: Sigric
description: An old elder treefolk and Erewaker's mentor, poisoned by faeries, who sacrifices his bark for the ritual.

name: Sigrid, God-Favored
description: The leader of the Beskir whose fortress hosts the war council.

name: Silas Brotten
description: An esteemed docent of Old Vodalian who is revealed as a Phyrexian agent, chases Ulf for the book and is killed by Jared.

name: Silas Renn
description: The heir of the House of Renn on Esper, a mage among the Seekers of Carmot honored with the first etherium heart.

name: Silburlind River
description: The river and estuary beside Havengul from which the Phyrexians emerge and in which Gisa finds a huge buried beast.

name: Silence of Kruphix
description: A period when the gods fell silent and are said to have gone away from mortals.

name: Silumgar's Breath
description: A rare, expensive, incurable poison distilled from orchid stems.

name: Silumgar's court
description: The dragon's treasure-filled throne room and fortress where Sidisi serves.

name: Silundi Sea
description: A sea on Zendikar.

name: Simma
description: An old Monoist miracho (a deleter or killer) in the boarding party who fights dirty and attacks Syr Vondam.

name: Sinnia
description: Leinore's younger sister, who puts on a strange snake-fanged mask, becomes possessed by Saryth's power, and is later freed.

name: Sinnia's mask
description: A scale-crusted deep-gold mask with snake-like sticks and wooden fangs that holds all of Saryth's power and fuses to Sinnia's skin.

name: Sinpurged
description: Seeta's deformed inquisitors in heron masks who claim their transformations are sin purged from their bodies.

name: Siren Sea
description: The sea near Meletis where Kiora arrives.

name: Sissoko's Law
description: A law that grips the Theorist as he is launched into the sky and out into the Blind Eternities.

name: Sister Alina
description: An attendant in the crèche who hummed songs from her Stensian home.

name: Siulogma of Valdrasheen
description: A celebrated scholar spirit who was Hofri's mentor and disliked him.

name: Six
description: Wrenn's tree partner, a treefolk who asks to return home and becomes an oak in the Kessig forest.

name: Sixth Precinct
description: A Golgari warren under the city.

name: Skaabs
description: Shambling stitched-together corpses created by Geralf, used as bodyguards, couriers and an attack force.

name: Skaal Kesh
description: An ancient dragon that Meren unearthed and reforged as a weapon bound to her, which she calls down to kill Kael.

name: Skarrg
description: The Gruul's immense underground playground, the cratered remains of an ancient palace.

name: Skeletal dragon
description: A reanimated dragon guarding a hoardgrave that attacks the Weatherlight and is shot down.

name: Skelle clan
description: A vicious Bretagard clan promised the return of their demon master.

name: Skep
description: Creatures that the rambling Thunian scout begs people to be warned about, which Yisan boasts of killing.

name: Skiltfolk
description: An organization of slayers, one of whose branches is based in Drunau.

name: Skin Witches
description: Death mages who wear the skins of their living victims, serving Josu.

name: Skirsdag
description: A demonic cult accused by Thalia of being led by Bishop Jerren.

name: Skitterlings
description: Small clinging Phyrexian creatures that Ixhel kills.

name: Skola Valley
description: The satyr home, where carefree revels take place.

name: Skyclave hook
description: Etched hooks from the Skyclave ruins that Zareth gives to Akiri.

name: Skywise
description: Followers who soar around Narset in celebration when she is named master.

name: Slaughter of the Arches
description: A rain-soaked battle in which the doll was pierced by a golden blade and questioned its purpose.

name: Slavomir Zoltan
description: A handsome vampire tithe-master and Triumvirate member who avoids the cost of war.

name: Sleepers
description: People controlled by the Wicked Slumber who fight for Eriette and Ashiok.

name: Slickshot Gang
description: A criminal gang that encourages loyalty among members.

name: Slickshots
description: A criminal organization that operates from the Voyager Grande, whose members like flashy duels.

name: Sliver Hivelord
description: A massive sliver twenty times the size of a man that is the source and liege of the slivers, and who lets the pair take its hoarded treasure.

name: Sliver Weftwinder
description: An apex sliver that can burrow beyond the tangible and hollow the Weft, living within the Chaos Wall.

name: Slobad
description: A goblin Phyrexian embedded in a golem-like Phyrexian body who runs the Salvage Complex and lures Mirrans with promises of reunion.

name: Smlurf
description: Auntie Grub's frog familiar.

name: Snarl
description: An overlapping tangle of ancient power hidden beneath the school.

name: Sobeslav
description: A Golgari elf and assistant to Guildmaster Jarad who answers Mazirek's invitation and is killed by the kraul.

name: Soche
description: Merret and Tashi's oldest child, a brave girl who throws wooden blocks at Wothis.

name: Society of Vile
description: A former ruling cabal of the League.

name: Sohemus
description: A shaven-headed envoy, with the look of a Jeskai pilgrim, who translates Dromoka's Draconic and serves 'the Eternal'.

name: Sokenzanshi
description: A cold mountain city where the Uprisers hold sway.

name: Sol'kanar
description: A figure of myth, once a maro-sorcerer and forest guardian, cursed by Geyadrone Dihada to be the Demon King of Corondor.

name: Soli
description: A garrison where Iris is to be moved for safety.

name: Solidbodies Research
description: A research company that holds Geldan in a web of favors and sends her to spy on its rival at Uthros.

name: Solon
description: A man said to have braved a labyrinth to retrieve Dekella, the bident of Thassa.

name: Soovril
description: An orc chronomancy student who restores historical artifacts to pristine condition.

name: Sorothir
description: Ghan's late partner in hunting and in love, who died in the line of duty.

name: Spark Powerstone
description: A small Powerstone Jhoira made at the Thran Mana Rig, holding Teferi's planeswalker spark.

name: Spatial Rift
description: A black rift floating in the sewer water whose magic makes nearby plants, and later Leighbet's serum recipients, immune to electricity.

name: Spear of Hazoret
description: A two-pronged spear stabbed into Bolas's chest by Niv-Mizzet.

name: Sphinx
description: A sphinx perched on an obelisk that has taken a vow of silence.

name: Spice Isles
description: An archipelago, destination of Boldt's passage ship, that holds the Tolarian Academy.

name: Spindlewight
description: The first leader of the beasties, a six-legged, three-armed blue-green furred beast who wore a bone mask and found the first keep-alives.

name: Spire Inquirium
description: The pristine Consulate workshop in the Spire where winning inventors are kept and work under Tezzeret.

name: Spirit Dragon's tomb
description: A rumored resting place of the Spirit Dragon in the Temur mountains where Vol is said to have gone.

name: Spirit Warriors
description: Semi-transparent figures in ancient Abzan armor that Vasi calls from the sand.

name: Spirit guardians
description: Luminous ghostly dragons that guard Ugin and harry Sarkhan before being called off.

name: Spot
description: A pet of Geralf's, of which only part remains.

name: Spurna
description: The head of the embermages, a compleated sleeper agent who stabs Squee and throws him from the platform.

name: Squee
description: An immortal goblin, former Weatherlight cabin boy and now king of a mountain goblin clan, who is compleated by Ertai, destroyed, and chooses to return to life.

name: Squee's mountain
description: The cave-system mountain where Squee's goblin clan lives and which is destroyed.

name: Squirrelfolk necromancers
description: Two black-clad squirrelfolk necromancers searching Pondside's rubble who summon skeletons and flee toward the Long River.

name: Sram
description: A dwarf, chief architect and senior edificer of the Aether Hub, who chews on pliers while he thinks and yields it to the renegades.

name: Sruta
description: A scornful cultist with crafts and tools who leaves the failed ritual and is eaten by the Buried Lord.

name: Ssata
description: The world where Kesori and Errit once lived in a one-room apartment.

name: Stanton
description: One of Brenalt's best friends, killed on the mission.

name: Star arches
description: Gravitational anomalies that hover around the giant creature like jewels in a crown.

name: Star-Sword
description: The Telu-Set's only pure-steel blade, from sky-fallen ore, which can cut even souls.

name: Starfield Orb
description: A black crystal orb in a silver cage, made by Urza with soul energy and Thran script, that strengthens Sharaman's spirit.

name: Statuary
description: The chamber in Svogthos lined with statues of Vraska's petrified victims.

name: Steamflogger Industries
description: A steel mill company taken over by goblins.

name: Steel Thanes
description: The seven rulers of the Dross Pits.

name: Steel-eyes
description: An Omenseeker sailor who insults the Kannah and starts the brawl.

name: Stem Sword
description: Nissa's staff-and-sword weapon, cleansed of oil.

name: Sterling Company headquarters
description: The fortified headquarters and prison at the edge of Prosperity.

name: Steward Baird
description: The Steward of Argive who leads a troop against Prossh's kobolds with a pyromancer's help.

name: Stewart
description: A student who ignores his assigned topic to claim squirrels secretly run Bablovia.

name: Stickfingers' mobile
description: A mobile of twigs and bark hung from Arinos's porch that binds Old Stickfingers as guardian of the house.

name: Stinkdrinker Warren
description: A warren of friendly, colorful boggarts in a swamp on the Wanderwine who host Maralen and lend a boat.

name: Stomper
description: A six-legged beast frozen and turned to sand by the key's power.

name: Stonefare
description: Tunnels near Rozlad Square in Golgari territory.

name: Storm Crane
description: The Jeskai's flying monastery, a ruined temple ship with a school in its belly, famous for its healers.

name: Storm elemental
description: A lightning-veined predator from another plane that emerges from a portal, attacks the village and is finally dissolved into rain.

name: Stormcutter Mountain
description: The peak split by Rowan's lightning bolt.

name: Stormkeld
description: The giants' castle at the top of the beanstalk.

name: Stormwreck Sea
description: The sea where Vraska captained her ship in a remembered scene.

name: Storrev
description: An undead Golgari lich sorceress, one of Vraska's Erstwhile, who welcomes Ral and Kaya to Svogthos.

name: Story Scrolls
description: Scrolls of stories that Tamiyo invokes to cast magic, such as He Who Frightens the Sun, Original and Winter's Howl.

name: Story magic
description: Tamiyo's magic of reciting stories from scrolls, which Nashi struggles to control.

name: Stratians
description: Warriors of the Akroan army, a detachment of which is stationed at Tynthal.

name: Strefan Maurer
description: A vampire lord who has outrun death, hunted for decades by Brandt, and is trapped in a haunted ruin that is his family's manor.

name: Strefan's family manor
description: A ruin on a snowy steppe that rises as a vibrant mansion when Brandt's blood is spilled and traps Strefan; it was his family's home.

name: Strefan's father
description: Strefan's father, whose death led Strefan to choose never to die and whose likeness the Hladvora wears.

name: Strefan's mother
description: Strefan's long-dead mother, whose likeness the Hladvora imitates.

name: Stromkirk
description: A vampire bloodline with prophetic sermons.

name: Stuffed bear
description: A stuffed minion possessed by the spirit of a murdered man, incinerated in its first battle with villagers.

name: Stuffy Doll
description: A burlap-and-cotton doll that has survived countless battles and torments, wonders whether it was made to suffer, and now follows a nomad shaman.

name: Sultai palace
description: The great palace of the Sultai where Tasigur holds audience.

name: Summitfest
description: A three-week festival of spellcasting at Spectacle Summit with a showcase at month's end.

name: Summotank
description: A Kav city of four million on a drainage lake, saved when Tannuk braked a bolide.

name: Sun Chaser
description: Kari's first ship and one of the illusory fleet.

name: Sun Coast
description: The eastern coast where the Sun Empire fights invaders.

name: Sun Empire Soldier
aliases: a soldier of the Sun Empire
description: A captured Sun Empire soldier who reveals pirate and sun champion movements toward the Golden City and is drowned by Kumena.

name: Sun Hawk
description: A Calamity Beast illustrated in King Glarb's tome, which Helga's drawing resembles.

name: Sun's Champion
description: A human who slew Nylea's pet hydra, bringing about the Silence.

name: Sunhome Guard Minotaur
description: A gold-armored minotaur guard in league with Skormak who killed Brazer and planted evidence; she flees when exposed.

name: Sunlight elementals
description: Captive elementals held in elf reliquaries to shield the elves from night; they bow to Isilu and flee when freed.

name: Sunset
description: A forager from the carnival with an injured ankle.

name: Sunstrikers
description: A band of nacatl loyal to Ajani that hunts the demon and is lost in the attack.

name: Suraj Chaudry III
description: A mason's son who built a Grand Prix platform and loves racing and the night minister.

name: Surrak's second
description: An enormous man who is Surrak's second-in-command on the hunt and later tries to blame him to Atarka.

name: Surrakar
description: A sickly green, tailed, scaly creature in the caves beneath the Riverroot Tree, which attacks Obuun and is killed when he kicks it into a waterfall.

name: Surrakar caves
description: The cave system beneath Riverroot that holds a cavern of Mul Daya bones.

name: Surrakar prisoner
description: A captured surrakar who speaks of coming gods and begs to be killed, and whom Gideon has released to guide the survivors out.

name: Surtland
description: The realm of frost giants.

name: Susurians
description: Massive beings born from the Lip of Susur who founded Monoism and command gravitational threads.

name: Suture Bishops
description: Phyrexian priests who dissect Karn.

name: Sweet-face
description: An Omenseeker who questions whether Fynn can prove what he claims.

name: Sword Five
description: An avenger left fighting after its pilot died.

name: Sword Three
description: Carlo's avenger, which is pulled down while idle.

name: Sword Two
description: Rica's sword-pattern avenger, destroyed by Fallaji bomb lances.

name: Sword of Avacyn
description: Odric's silver sword with Avacyn's symbol on the hilt that glows with moonlight.

name: Sydri
description: A dropout of the Academy whose patron Muzzio is rumored to be.

name: Sylex blast
description: The ancient event Ulf is assigned to research for class.

name: Sylvene's crypt
description: A grand crypt built in a verdant land to commemorate her allies, where she hid valuable treasures.

name: Sylvene's demiplane
description: A refuge Sylvene created for her family.

name: Sylvene's grandson
description: Sylvene's careless grandson who seeks relics of her power in the Realms, harming others along the way.

name: Syr Cataline
description: A Sunstar knight and hero of Maledikt who worships the brown dwarf aspect of the Sum and fights the Thinner.

name: Syr Joshua the Beast Tamer
description: A knight under the Slumber's control who attacks Rowan with a warhammer.

name: Syr Saxon
description: A ranger under the Slumber's control who attacks Rowan with a bone axe.

name: Szarel
description: A Eumidian lead officer of the current terrasymbiosis stage on Evendo who defends it against Kav colonists, knowing he will not see completion.

name: Tafre
description: A scarred adventurer and storyteller, a trapfinder for the Akoum Expeditionary House, who shares his fire with Gideon and tells of a field of flesh.

name: Tagan
description: A brindle-furred sphinx lawmage and Reza's mentor, who encourages him to travel and later steps down so he can mentor others.

name: Taivas
description: Vytas's great-grandfather, the sorcerer who founded Traublassen and bound Umbris in the keep.

name: Tajic
description: A Boros knight who is Teysa's ally and who tunneled secretly to the Obzedat's record room; he hates ghosts.

name: Takeshi Konda
description: The proud daimyo and most powerful warlord, who ruled the Towabara Plains from Eiganjo and secretly began the war.

name: Takoluk
description: A Kav squad member with a scanner and energy blades, whose skull is mysteriously smashed.

name: Talas Corsairs
description: Pirates who ambush the passage ship with new chain-shot weaponry.

name: Talia
description: Liont's daughter.

name: Talon
description: A city and its docks at the edge of Ervos's lowland criminal empire.

name: Talruum
description: A race of minotaurs to which Tahngarth belongs.

name: Tam, the Possibility Gorgon
description: A gorgon created by Jace Beleren, his spy and agent, who is figuring out who she is and beginning to doubt his methods after meeting Strixhaven students.

name: Tameshi's compound
description: The compound on Otawara containing the lab where kami are experimented on and the Reality Chip's machine.

name: Tamiyo's memory
description: A being of floating characters created by Tamiyo years ago and sealed in a scroll, which survives as her memory and speaks with her old warmth.

name: Tamiyo's scroll
description: A scroll bound by an iron ring containing the story of Phyrexia's victory, which Tamiyo reads over Towashi.

name: Tamiyo, Upriser Crowned
description: A moonfolk who stirred the Uprisers to attack and now rules Kamigawa reluctantly as Emperor.

name: Tamsyn Sweene
description: A shapeshifting Dimir spy who poses as a blastseeker to infiltrate Leighbet's lab and steal her serum, then tries to kill her.

name: Tan Jolom
description: An Oltec figure who sends Echoes to help.

name: Tana
description: An elf abandoned as a child and raised by fungal saprolings, who now hunts trespassers to feed them.

name: Tanazir Quandrix
description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, a visionary thinker focused on systemic solutions.

name: Tanuki prototype
description: A metal tanuki drone built by Tameshi that Himoto bonds with and that becomes Kaito's mask.

name: Tapestry of fate
description: A great tapestry whose threads carry the destinies of all in Theros.

name: Tar Ooze
description: A mammoth tar ooze given shape by skeletons and bones that serves Amarth-Tel.

name: Taram
description: A gaunt, sun-bronzed soldier who dislikes talk of spirits and leaves.

name: Tarangrad
description: The town where Vis was imprisoned.

name: Tarik
description: An archer initiate killed by Nassor for his heart.

name: Tarsa
description: The swordsman leader of a brutal, coin-focused expedition party in Nimana.

name: Tarsa's party
description: A mercenary expedition crew from Nimana of Tarsa, Nadino, Eret and the lost Orien.

name: Tashi
description: Merret's wife, who brews healing salves to sell at market and is injured protecting her baby.

name: Tasigur, the Golden Fang
description: The young, pampered heir to the Sultai fortune, a cruel hedonist carried on a platform by zombies.

name: Tatsunari
description: A human Mukotai leader riding a corpse-swallower toad who, as a boy, poisoned Chishiro's order and tried to force a bond with Kaima.

name: Tausret
description: A strong warrior of the Tah crop.

name: Taweret
description: A mighty mage past champion whom Nylah recognizes among the Eternals.

name: Taz's glowing shiv
description: An enchanted glowing dagger Taz gives Krenko, used to smash the detention sphere.

name: Team Avishkar
description: The informal alliance of Chandra, Pia and Sita after the race.

name: Tears of Avacyn
description: Divine drops of the dead angel's tears kept above the altar, used to enhance spells and heal wounds, which Henrika wants for an unholy anointing.

name: Teeth of Akoum
description: The mountain range from which the three Eldrazi progenitors emerged.

name: Teferi's people
description: The armed Zhalfirin warriors, mages and scholars who answer Teferi's call.

name: Telu'Ahn
description: A coastal land in the Coral Canyons, home of Nathala.

name: Telu-Set
description: The Muragandan people of Mon'Telu, trained to hunt mages and wary of magic.

name: Temilo
description: A Sun Empire scout garrisoned in Orazca who leads the company to the Winged Temple.

name: Temple of Aclazotz
description: A ruined jungle temple with a cenote, catacombs and a golden door sealed by blood magic.

name: Temple of Knowledge
description: Kefnet's temple in the city, fronted by a giant ibis-headed statue, within which the Trial of Knowledge takes place.

name: Temple of Kruphix
description: Kruphix's true temple at the edge of the world, with two great trees overlooking a waterfall that borders Nyx.

name: Temple of Strength
description: Rhonas's temple, whose interior is an extensive wildlife preserve training ground called the Holding.

name: Temple of the Gods
description: The divine temple in Nyx where Heliod wounded Elspeth.

name: Temur Captain
description: The leader of a Temur band who leads an attack on Sorin and is drained by a vampire thrall.

name: Temur Guide
description: A Temur warrior whom Sorin enthralls to lead him to Ugin's domain.

name: Temur mountains
description: The snowy mountain land Yasova rules, with bare steaming rock and high ridges.

name: Temur tundra
description: The vast snowy Temur tundra where Sarkhan arrives in the past.

name: Tenihas
description: A vampire of House Ghet who took in Anowon and taught him to value histories.

name: Tenri
description: A tall kor woman with a scarred shoulder who heals Nahiri's hands and tells her of the Eldrazi.

name: Tenth District
description: The district where the Orzhov bought every pyrowork.

name: Tenth District Sewers
description: The vast sewers beneath Ravnica's Tenth District where fatbergs have become immune to electrical magic.

name: Tergrid
description: A goddess of nightmares and shadows invoked in an oath.

name: Terrance
description: Veryl's younger brother, who attacks Mia with a sword.

name: Terrasymbiosis
description: The process by which Eumidian seed pods make a planet habitable.

name: Terrik
description: A disgraced Selesnyan elven wurmcaller who accidentally collapsed the Basilica of the Opportune with his wurm and tries to redeem himself by helping the orphan Bazda and his friends.

name: Terrik's Wurm
description: A young wurm Terrik raised from a hatchling and hid as his bed, who flees at the sound of the pontiff's captive wurms and later carries the group out.

name: Tersa Lightshatter
description: A Mardu warrior of old who climbed to catch the lightning when there were no rules.

name: Tethmos
description: The largest leonin den on Theros and seat of King Brimaz.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
description: A hunted woman who opens magical doorways to slip refugees out of Phyrexia's clutches and is on the run again.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer
description: An Echoverse bounty hunter who uses a magical net to teleport lawbreakers into stasis spheres.

name: Tetzimoc
description: The elder dinosaur of death who leads armored quetzacama.

name: Teutamos
description: Asterion's father, lord of Pallad Reach, who condemned Vis to the stockade.

name: Tevesh Szat
description: A draconic planeswalker and member of Urza's Nine Titans whose betrayal Urza predicted and used to engineer Phyrexia's demise.

name: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage
description: An Echoverse Teyo Verada who became a diamondblade assassin after harnessing diamondstorms.

name: Teyo, Lightshield Expert
description: Teyo Verada, sole survivor of diamond storms in Gobakhan, who learned shield magic and now protects Gobakhan with unorthodox techniques.

name: Teysa's uncle
description: A more recent member of the Obzedat whose preserved body Teysa greets in the chamber; he told her the bodies were burnt.

name: Tezzeret's planar portal
description: A ring within a ring of whorls and pipes that Tezzeret has activated.

name: Tezzeret's scrap construct
description: A hulking construct of sharp-edged metal that defends Tezzeret.

name: Thalia, the Survivor
description: The founder of the Order of Saint Traft, who works with Arlinn Kord to set up defenses across Innistrad after the Phyrexian Invasion.

name: Thallids
description: Mushroom-like beings from Yavimaya; Slimefoot's sprouts are little thallids.

name: Thanasis
description: A blacksmith's son in Akros who dreams of becoming a Lukos, befriends Pavios, and dies on the outcropping by Pavios's sword.

name: Thanasis's father
description: A blacksmith who forbids Thanasis from joining the Akroan army and who quarrels with Pavios's father.

name: Thanasis's mother
description: An independent artisan who died three months before Pavios arrived, apparently taken by a beast.

name: The Academy
description: An institution in Paliano that Daretti's schemings caused to be disbanded; some former members are lying low.

name: The Acolyte
description: A young man in pale robes in the temple anteroom who tries to read Nissa's mind and announces the Trial of Knowledge; this page does not name him.

name: The Aether Cycle
description: An innate five-stage process of invention: inspire, innovate, build, liberate, reclaim, with humans credited as synthesizing it.

name: The Aether Revolt
description: The uprising on Kaladesh that ended the Consulate's old rule.

name: The Agency
description: The investigative body that held a meeting at Vitu-Ghazi and employs Kaya, Kellan and Proft.

name: The Alabaster Host
description: Armored legions of the Fair Basilica that guard its avenues.

name: The Alamon
description: The wandering soldiers, in many small squads, who are as vital to the defense of Akros as its walls.

name: The Ancestors
description: The spirits of the Abzan dead who guide and strengthen their descendants through the Kin-Trees.

name: The Angel of the Trial
description: An illusory angel of the Trial of Knowledge, reminiscent of Emrakul, who tells Nissa to stop being a piece and be the hand that moves.

name: The Angels
description: Angels in the sky who overlook the chaos and announce that the Eternals come.

name: The Anima
description: Source of prophetic visions that Naya's forces march out of the jungle to answer.

name: The Aradaras
description: The mother-and-son team who perfected the aether-propelled train and started the tradition of inventor statues.

name: The Arena
description: The great arena where the final Trial is held.

name: The Argent Etchings
description: Norn's holy teachings, rendered in metal.

name: The Assassin
description: The part of Vraska's past self that killed too many names to remember; she joins Vraska's fall and shares that she knows how to gift a kind death.

name: The Attic Encampment
