description: A settlement in the attic that sheltered Dawn and is wiped out in an attack.

name: The Aviaries
description: A cluster of rooftop hangars atop some of the tallest buildings in Ghirapur.

name: The Avishkar Assembly
description: The new planar government that unites Avishkar after the revolution.

name: The Azorius
description: The guild of law whose legislation Jace reads.

name: The Azorius Senate
description: The white-blue guild, primary lawmakers on Ravnica.

name: The Big Idea
description: A member of the Legion of Evil.

name: The Black Rose
description: A figure Muzzio is rumored to be an agent of.

name: The Blood Age
description: A time of endless war whose dead still fight in the Fields of Strife.

name: The Boilerbilge
description: A hot part of the House where the narrator has claimed a dining room.

name: The Boilerbilges
description: A deep region of the House where the foragers were ambushed.

name: The Brazen Coalition
description: Treasure-hungry pirates who arrived on Ixalan as outsiders.

name: The Broken Lands
description: The desert crossed by the party, now home to Chitin Court followers.

name: The Brothers' War
description: The savage war between Urza and Mishra that devastated Dominaria and plunged it into an ice age.

name: The Buried Lord
description: A deathless demon summoned by the cult who is hungry rather than protective and who once parleyed with Liesa.

name: The Buried Lord's cult
description: A dwindling group of worshippers led by Olutio who try to summon the Buried Lord to keep the dead at rest.

name: The Cabaretti
description: A Family of New Capenna that Eula's mother's relatives used to work for.

name: The Cail artifact
description: A blood-brown gnarled Eldrazi-tainted device that corrupts Drix weftwalking secrets, lets a human tear through space and time, and drains its user.

name: The Cataclysm
description: The blast that ended the brothers' war, bringing earthquakes and tidal waves.

name: The Caves of Koilos
description: The place where Urza and Mishra discovered ancient stones of power.

name: The Chamber of the Guildpact
description: The Guildpact's office, scarred by a huge hole gouged from stone.

name: The Church of Avacyn
description: The human church named for its leader, the archangel Avacyn, which humans brandish against the horrors.

name: The City of Ravnica
description: A vast metropolis whose name has become synonymous with the entire plane, where the guilds vie for power.

name: The Coiled One
description: A huge serpent-like being called up by Saryth and fed with villagers, which retreats into the earth when the mask is torn off.

name: The Coin Empire
description: A mysterious empire that spanned planes and cultures for ages, vanished overnight and left coin motifs behind.

name: The Coin Mill
description: An ancient Izzet stone machine in the catacombs that mints gold coins from copper, missing a crescent piece that Bazda holds.

name: The Cosmos
description: The light of Kaldheim that reinforces the elves, opening a doomskar and carrying fleets.

name: The Cotter boys
description: Village boys who bully Kellan with yew and cold iron.

name: The Countless Gears
description: An inventor society fascinated with micro-scale artifice.

name: The Cult of Rakdos
description: The demon-led black-red guild delighting in thrill-killing and pleasure-seeking.

name: The Curse of Wandering
description: A curse making the dead rise unless they decompose, called the plane's gift.

name: The Cursemute
description: A spell that had cured many werewolves; when it broke, the werewolves' bloodlust carried them off, including the sisters' mother.

name: The Daemogoth
description: A demon of Arcavios that feeds on negative emotions, lurks in Titan's Grave and attacks the students.

name: The Dark Lady
description: A companion whom only Eruth perceives, who gives her information and saved her from the madness.

name: The Dawning Archaic
description: The most powerful and dangerous archaic, formed from the soul of the last-ever oracle and suffering paradoxical fluxes from temporal instability.

name: The Desert Wastes
description: The desert outside the Hekma where ruins, a half-buried statue, a shrine and monsters are found.

name: The Devotion
description: A grief-hungry water spirit with a mossy skull in its head, which lures grieving students to the lake through the revenant of one they lost.

name: The Dire Waves
description: A dark, whitecapped stretch of sea beyond the Perimeter, home to a vast leviathan.

name: The Dojir Nomads
description: Recruits from the Calcite Flats who joined Gideon's army.

name: The Door
description: A strange, unlocked door in the Ninth District that leads into the House of Duskmourn and vanishes behind whoever enters.

name: The Dragon
description: A fire-breathing dragon that attacks Ghirapur during the race's end, part of a primordial storm.

name: The Dragonlords
description: Five legendary dragons who now rule the defeated clans.

name: The Easternmost Valley
description: The first place Yanggu can remember, after which he named himself.

name: The Elder Dragon Wars
aliases: the wars between the elder dragons
description: A long war among dragons on Dominaria that Bolas says he left behind.

name: The Eldrazi Awaken
description: The arc in which the Eldrazi are released onto Zendikar.

name: The Eldrazi sire
description: A hundred-foot Eldrazi lord leading the host pursuing the vampires, killed after Drana drinks from its heart.

name: The Elemental Whale
description: An enormous cerulean humpback whale construct of elemental magic from the Whale Trench that goes out of control and floods the gallery.

name: The Empress of Kamigawa
description: Kamigawa's empress, a childhood friend of Kaito.

name: The Eternal Pilgrims
description: A cult of priests who worship Ulamog and offer travelers to it.

name: The First Aberration
description: A younger-faced piece of Jace in a blue cloak, carved out when he dared counter the plan, who was kicked through a portal.

name: The First Tree
description: The tree growing from the rooftop plaza of Mer-Ek Fortress, beneath which the khans are buried, in whose plaza the Amber Throne stands.

name: The Five Families
description: The five powerful Families of New Capenna that every citizen dreams of joining.

name: The Five Trials
description: Trials on the path to the afterlife, established by the God-Pharaoh to purify and perfect the people; each cultivates an aspect of mortal perfection.

name: The Fomori
description: Mysterious multiversal colonizers lost to time, whom Quint investigates.

name: The Fools' Tomb
aliases: monument to the fallen of the Phyrexian invasion
description: A defaced monument to the Phyrexian invasion's fallen, as the Cabal calls it.

name: The Founder Sphinxes
description: Five elder sphinxes, formed from harmonious mana, who founded Hexhaven Academy and now act as aloof deans.

name: The Gallery
description: A cluster of wagons and caravans at the edge of Spectacle Summit where artisans trade and sell.

name: The Gitrog
description: A giant, webbed, frog-like monster of Lake Zhava that drives people to sacrifice and swallows villagers whole with its tongue.

name: The God of Destiny
description: The god on Theros who artificially created Calix.

name: The God-Eternals
description: Immortal beings that Chandra says were smaller than the Invasion Tree.

name: The God-Pharaoh
description: The wise and benevolent ruler of Amonkhet who promises the people a perfect afterlife, secretly Nicol Bolas.

name: The Gods of Theros
description: An awe-inspiring pantheon whose petty whims and wrath mortals fear.

name: The Grand Exhibition
description: The finale of the Fair where Tezzeret challenges Pia to a duel.

name: The Great River
description: The river system of Ixalan, whose nine tributaries share their names with the Shapers.

name: The Great Trespasser
description: The being who decimated Amonkhet and twisted its gods.

name: The Great Work
description: Avacyn's plan to cleanse Innistrad of the impure, beginning with the slaughter of humans.

name: The Gruul
description: A faction on Ravnica led by Domri, which revels in chaos and destruction.

name: The Gruul Clans
description: The red-green guild of beggars, gangs and raiding parties driven by base urges.

name: The Guardian
description: A ghostly woman soldier made of sand said to save Dromoka soldiers, whom Oret identifies as Anafenza.

name: The Hall of Treasures
description: A hall of taxidermied extinct animals in Luneau.

name: The Hauntwoods
description: A region of the House associated with cellarspawn.

name: The Haven
description: The canyon of blackened granite, warped by energy, where Ugin lies in a hedron cocoon.

name: The Hearthhull
description: An ancient, living Eumidian grown into a conscious transport vessel carrying seed pods, protecting its brood on Evendo from the Kav.

name: The Helvault
description: A prison in which Griselbrand trapped Avacyn; it was later sundered.

name: The Hladvora
description: A shapeshifting creature that lives in the ruined manor, lures prey, takes over bodies and feeds on fear and blood.

name: The Huge Archaic
description: A gigantic archaic carrying Jadzi, which Chandra believes Jace plans to incarnate into.

name: The Insect Gods
description: The three insect-headed gods who awakened from the Necropolis and killed the other gods.

name: The Inspectors
description: Faceless armored Consulate enforcers.

name: The Inspirit
description: A fabled self-aware eternity ship adrift in the Garden of Apeiron, a temple to mechan pilgrims seeking consciousness.

name: The Invocation of the Founders
description: A living spell of letters that describes Strixhaven and was crafted from the power of the five elder dragons, which the students cast to drive back Phyrexia.

name: The Kami War
description: The war begun when kami set upon Reito, lasting twenty years as spirits ravaged the plains.

name: The Kathorran Conciliator
description: The scarred orc in charge of the Kathorr delegation and Verdis's grandmother.

name: The Kathorran Delegation
description: The Tor-Kathorr contingent at the Forum, feuding with Silkmeadow over water and security.

name: The Keldon War
description: A past war that cost Zhalfirin families and orphaned Adia.

name: The Kenriths
description: The royal family of Eldraine's courts, said by Torbran to be gone.

name: The Khans
description: The five powerful clan leaders who would have ruled Tarkir in a different present; the dragons hunted them down and destroyed them.

name: The Kin-Tree
description: A burned stump with golden new growth through which the ancestors speak and to which kin bind themselves by blood.

name: The King of the Elves of Kaldheim
description: Tyvar's older brother, in whose shadow Tyvar always lived.

name: The Knight
description: A previous planeswalker the Ethersworn observed.

name: The Kolophon
description: The walled capital where the king is, to which Aesrias intends to travel.

name: The Kraul
description: An insectoid race that recently pledged allegiance to the Golgari after centuries unguilded and who serve as laborers.

name: The Lake
description: A miles-wide saltwater lake where the Devotion dwells.

name: The Last Guardian
description: The being who entrusted the Immortal Sun to the River Heralds to keep hidden and unused.

name: The Last Thing
description: A beautiful genderless metal android with a green-mask face and a pale-light interior that steps out of the sky into the Seriema's galley and takes the Endstone, saying it is the last thing.

name: The League of Aeronauts
description: The first and most esteemed aeronaut society in Ghirapur, with invitation-only membership and green coats.

name: The Legion of Dusk Captain
description: A golden-armored vampire captain who fights Vraska and is petrified into a figurehead.

name: The Lich
description: A newly named Devkarin elf lich who holds the apprenticeship contest and secretly plots with Boros soldiers to frame Vraska for the Tin Street massacre.

name: The Lithomancer
description: A planeswalker who helped Sorin and Ugin seal the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin is troubled by her silence.

name: The Living Flame
description: A sphere of red and orange wild magic that Rootha made and holds under control of her will; it gives off no heat.

name: The Machine Orthodoxy
description: The Phyrexian order that Phyrexian Nassari served.

name: The Maelstrom
description: An aetheric chaos where Ajani once defeated Bolas.

name: The Mardu clan
description: The clan in which Sarkhan gained status as a warrior.

name: The Masked Boy
description: A masked child with a knife and wound-giving magic who attacks the Theorist and is thrown through a portal.

name: The Merge
description: The ongoing merging of the mortal and spirit realms, with merge gates.

name: The Metalspinners
description: A temperamental group of artists from the Weldfast zone who make kinetic sculptures and rogue artwork.

name: The Millennial
description: An aerial platform with the most coveted views in Ravnica where Krenko meets Taz.

name: The Mirage War
description: A past war that took family from most Zhalfirin.

name: The Mobile Garrison
description: A desert camp of loyalists that the rebels attack at dusk.

name: The Mockturne
description: Olrich's club in Derision's Peak where Kodolaag performs.

name: The Monsoon
description: Callaphe's living ship-serpent that carries Elspeth and Ajani toward the edge of the world.

name: The Monster in the Moon
description: An ancient entity trapped in Innistrad's moon that prunes worlds by eating planes and tries to learn where the Echoverse is.

name: The Mural
description: A painting on the attic walls made by the first keep-alives that shows the beasties' history and is neutral ground.

name: The Muse
description: An enormous stone woman overlooking the mountainside, rumored to be a rock formation.

name: The Museum of Invention
description: A Ghirapur museum covered in Consulate banners, where Nived paints the leaking spire.

name: The Mutemoors
description: A region of echoes Dawn passes through.

name: The Naming Tithe
description: A long, arduous Forum ritual, unused for half a century, in which delegates name themselves and each other.

name: The Narrator
description: An unnamed survivor of Duskmourn who keeps a dining room in the Boilerbilge and coaxes guests to sit and stay so the House will leave them be.

name: The New Capenna train heist
description: A heist on a train in New Capenna, where Elnor fought off Brokers muscle, the beginning of the end for the crew.

name: The Night of Flame
description: The night Rootha and Nassari's combined flames destroyed the rogue elemental whale, later a Summitfest tradition.

name: The Object
description: A large invisible celestial mass above the Drownyard that the journal says is pulling the tides and moon, appearing to Jace as a blind spot.

name: The Ochran
description: The Golgari assassins whose dagger kills Jace.

name: The Ochran dagger
description: A dagger Vraska plunges into Jace's heart to end the overlay and gift a kind death.

name: The Official Accord and Guidance of the Guilds of Ravnica
description: The law book Teysa wrote before the Maze.

name: The Omenpath Project
description: A Izzet research program studying the Omenpath network that offers Zimone an apprenticeship.

name: The One Who Whispers Twice
description: The clan elder who gives Surrak a greatspear and later speaks the invocation naming him First Father of the Temur.

name: The Orphans' Brigade
description: A band of orphan children that Drana lets name themselves and uses as bait for the sire.

name: The Orzhov Pontiff
description: A desperate Orzhov pontiff who binds spirits and trespassers with contract magic, using a staff and wurms to dig for the missing piece of a coin-minting machine; he fuses a thrull to his leg.

name: The Orzhov Syndicate
description: The white-black guild, a rigid hierarchy of pomp and ritual, slaves to deals and coin.

name: The Parabox
description: A Theorix test chamber Tam plans to use.

name: The Pelakka wurm
description: A spectral Pelakka wurm summoned from the Arkbow that devours guards.

name: The Perfumed Court
description: The perfumed aristocratic quarter of Luneau.

name: The Perimeter
description: A line of buoys with chained skeletons that marks the edge of the Dire Waves and lights up with accusatory shrieks.

name: The Phoenix
description: A large fire bird the size of a mantis that hides inside a concealed amber orb and attacks the monastery.

name: The Phyrexian War
description: The coming war that Zhalfir has prepared for over generations.

name: The Phyrexian evangels
description: Compleated former planeswalkers sent to spread Phyrexia's gospel.

name: The Piper
description: A rat-catcher expected to have his work cut out for him with the swarming rats.

name: The Pontiff's Thrull
description: The pontiff's attendant thrull, who jumps into the hole after him and is fused to his leg.

name: The Prophecy
description: A prophecy locked in a vault below Nido Sanctuary, foretelling that New Capenna will die when its Halo runs out.

name: The Proprietor
description: A vampire cafe owner in Luneau's cultural district who eavesdrops on two officers before the animal stampede reaches his street.

name: The Reality Chip
description: A module dripping with glistening oil that Jin-Gitaxias uses against Tezzeret.

name: The Reaper, King No More
description: A deadly scarecrow contraption, ruler of scarecrows of Shadowmoor, who has lost much of its domain.

name: The Rebel Caverns
description: The caverns where the rebels camp and train.

name: The Rebels
description: Abzan dissenters opposing Dromoka who raid her garrison and tend the Kin-Tree.

name: The Reverent Army
description: The army that defends Meletis.

name: The Risen Dissenters
description: Rotting corpses that rise from an oasis and sands and attack the children, said to be dissenters returned by the curse of wandering.

name: The River Heralds
description: The merfolk of Ixalan.

name: The Riveteer Foreman
description: A big, barrel-chested ogre and Riveteer who leads Eula's crew and offers her an apprenticeship with his Family.

name: The Rotrue Wood
description: An ancient forest, believed to be the last free forest in the world, where the Rotrue elves live.

name: The Rousing
description: Lorehold's most important archaeomancy spell that projects the caster's will back through time and calls spirits into statues.

name: The Ruin
description: The catastrophe that tore Kavaron in two and threw subcontinents into orbit.

name: The Sanctuary of the Lost
description: A safe haven for those affected by magic where Nimiroti lives.

name: The Satyr
description: A stout, playful, unnamed satyr who teaches Zosimos that worry is Phenax's creation and that a hero leaves behind goodness, and who gives him a rusty knife.

name: The Satyrs of the Skola Valley
description: Satyrs of Theros for whom pleasure, revelry and mischief are virtues of the highest regard.

name: The School of Constructive Arts
description: A Hexhaven school of puppetbeast builders and tethermages.

name: The School of Esoteric Mathematics
description: A Hexhaven school of impossible math and portals located near the top of the tower.

name: The School of Future History
description: A Hexhaven school of divination and prophecy located at the base of the tower.

name: The School of Invasive Healing
description: A Hexhaven school of healing by grafting plant matter into flesh.

name: The School of Painful Words
description: A Hexhaven school of battlepoets who use emotion and words.

name: The Scrappers
description: An inventor society that pits fighting automatons against each other.

name: The Selesnya Conclave
description: The green-white guild honoring selflessness, nurturing and spiritual congregation.

name: The Shadow Multiverse
description: A solid duplicate of the Multiverse that Zimone's model reveals, mirrored above Arcavios.

name: The Shadowy Horror
description: A towering shadowy monster with a mask-like bone face and a glowing rhombus eye that withers Nakht in the desert.

name: The Shattergang Brothers
description: Goblin explosives-makers who declare war on Krenko and threaten the Boros.

name: The Shelter
description: An overgrown mobile laboratory shelter near the lake where the group stays.

name: The Silence
description: The absence of the gods after Kruphix spoke and they retreated into Nyx.

name: The Silkmeadow Conciliator
description: The imperious leonin who leads the Silkmeadow contingent and is Crown's mother.

name: The Silkmeadow Delegation
description: A region of golden grass on Arcavios and home of Crown's delegation.

name: The Simic Combine
description: The green-blue guild of researchers who maintain and modify nature to survive.

name: The Singing City
description: Ancient ruins on Zendikar where telepathic noise torments the group and the Warden is found.

name: The Skyclave
description: An ancient floating weapon of Nahiri's people, ringed by hedrons.

name: The Spy
description: A woman in Selesnyan robes pleading before Jarek claiming knowledge of a vulnerability at Vitu-Ghazi, believed to be a Dimir spy.

name: The Starfish
description: A magical, opalescent starfish in a tidal pool that gives Raissa visions in return for offerings of clams, and is impaled by her son.

name: The Statuary Garden
description: A massive arboretum near Aradara Station lined with statues of Ghirapur's most famous inventors; the renegades hide in a statue there.

name: The Storm Hawk
description: A four-winged, lightning-wreathed dragon from another plane in animal form, who attacks Fountainport and is driven off by Maha.

name: The Sural
description: Gideon's whip-like, multi-bladed weapon.

name: The Tangled Vales
description: A region of Bala Ged where Nissa once hunted.

name: The Tarry Spire
description: Amarth-Tel's bone-and-tar tower at the edge of Kalaka's Scar where leylines bunch.

name: The Tenth
description: The Izzet district of Ravnica over which Ral conjures his drizzle field.

name: The Thinner
description: A gravkill paladin and best of the armor fati, beloved of the Monasteriat, who grips Cataline in his tides.

name: The Thran Empire
description: The empire that once ruled Dominaria.

name: The Threefold Sun
description: The Sun Empire's triune sun god, which has set and not risen.

name: The Throne of the God-Pharaoh
description: The God-Pharaoh's throne in the heart of the city above which the sky tears open for Bolas.

name: The Towabara Plains
description: The plains ruled by Konda.

name: The Trial of Strength
description: A trial for initiates that Rhonas judges.

name: The Trials
description: Competitions that the youth train for in hopes of a triumphant afterlife.

name: The Undead of Umerilek
description: Undead in lace and rings who rise from their coffins in Umerilek.

name: The Undercity
description: The shadowed district of Towashi where Satoru's den lies.

name: The Unwritten
description: A spiritual vision of the future recorded by the ancient Temur, in which the sar-khan raved of a world without dragons.

name: The Ur-Sphinx
description: A godlike sphinx avatar whose blood and magic course through every sphinx; a powerful telepath second only to Jace.

name: The Vaar
description: An old myth of beings who fled the Eldrazi into a virtual world, the Hylderhigh, and whose knowledge persists in physical nodes.

name: The Vehicle
description: An alien steel racing vehicle with a flaming crocodilian look, called a beast, relic and vehicle by different people.

name: The Voyager Grande
description: A tall entertainment megaplex and hotel that hides the Slickshot headquarters.

name: The War of the Spark
description: The earlier war on Ravnica when Vraska reopened the memory of Jace.

name: The Way
description: The Jeskai monastic path, which Ru says holds there is more to it than fighting and that one can lose and remain honorable.

name: The Whale Trench
description: A narrow fissure in the mountains through which elemental whales migrate.

name: The Whisperers
description: The Temur spiritual elders who say Surrak's battle cry was once screamed by dragons.

name: The World Tree
description: The tree of Kaldheim being strangled by a Phyrexian serpent.

name: The World-Eater
description: The corpse of a reality-bending titan embedded in the core of Uthros behind the doors, which the Illvoi seem to be trying to turn into a weapon; its pull overwhelms Geldan.

name: The Zendikari refugees
description: The survivors and refugees who gather at Sky Rock.

name: The aether turret
description: A huge aether-powered cannon at the Spire's base that destroys anything flying.

name: The akinji
description: Warriors of Zhalfir whom Oyana plans to join.

name: The ammit
description: A lion-bodied, alligator-headed demon near impossible to kill, which kills several initiates.

name: The anchor
description: The means that connected Teferi to the others, which has failed.

name: The animists
description: A people who angered Zendikar; Nissa and her mother are among the last.

name: The archmage
description: The head of the Lat-Nam academy, who in the final scene transforms into a gray-skinned, tentacled woman who is pleased by Jared's involvement.

name: The assault force
description: Cathars, priests, witches, archers and farmers who storm Voldaren Manor.

name: The beetle inquirium
description: Rashmi and Mitul's workplace where they first succeeded at matter transport and where Mitul works.

name: The bonders
description: People of Ikoria bonded with monsters.

name: The brontodon
description: A juvenile brontodon held captive aboard Frederic's ship for the Royal Menagerie.

name: The canyon
description: The canyon with bluffs where the Mardu ambush Kolaghan's brood.

name: The catacombs
description: Underground caverns once meant to safeguard the dead, now empty.

name: The chief's second wife
description: The chief's second wife, a mage who first ensorcelled venom, who murders the chief and later marries and dies with the son.

name: The chief's son
description: The neglected firstborn son of the chief, who killed a dragon and, goaded by Nicol's whispers, takes the throne.

name: The dandelion field
description: A shortcut full of dandelions and hedge parsley where the dragon-hawk attacks.

name: The dark knot
description: The writhing darkness inside the highest peak of Akoum that hurts Zendikar and Nissa sees in her visions.

name: The demons
description: The four demons to whom Liliana owes her soul; two remain.

name: The doomed plane
aliases: a plane whose name is lost to history
description: A plane whose name is lost to history, more than 6,000 years ago, where Nahiri and Sorin defend refugees until it is unraveled by the Eldrazi.

name: The dragon claw staff
description: The staff that once marked Yasova as clan chief, hidden in a secret cave while a fake was given to Atarka.

name: The dragon killer chief
description: The human chief and his heirs in Tae Jin's story who preyed on dragons.

name: The dragon-hawk
description: A four-winged, crested, lightning-wreathed bird-like creature, said by Ral to be an animal-shifted dragon from another plane, who attacks the party.

name: The dragon-killer chief
description: An old human chief who killed Merrevia Sal, rules by decreeing that dragon-killers become heirs, and is murdered by his second wife.

name: The elder dinosaurs
description: Ixalan's elder dinosaurs, embodiments of the plane.

name: The fall of Mirrodin
description: The earlier collapse of Mirrodin that Karn blames on himself.

name: The fire monks of Keral Keep
description: The pyromancer monks of Keral Keep who chant and dance to make fire.

name: The five creeds
description: The five creeds of magic that guide Zhalfir, including the Shaper and Civic creeds.

name: The five elder dragons
description: Dragons whose power was melded into the invocation.

name: The fleeing woman
description: A woman captured after shouting that the trials, the gods and the hours are lies and that the return will bring devastation.

name: The geists of Voldaren Manor
description: Hundreds of spirits of Olivia's victims who materialize and attack their oppressors.

name: The girl from the tree
description: A watchful Jigme child who admires the twins, explains the dragon's eye mark, and helps Kela find her resolve.

name: The goblin riots
description: Riots in Paliano that Daretti helped instigate to overturn the current leadership and root out former Academy members.

name: The good king
description: The slain king of Eldraine and Rowan and Will's father.

name: The great shadow
description: A vast, blind, shadowy creature whose wing beats storm eggs out of the sky; progenitor of the dragons in the vision.

name: The heart trees
description: Ancient trees that mate for life, linked by shared vines.

name: The hedron field
description: The hedrons hanging above Tazeem where Gideon moves the survivors.

name: The hedron network
description: The network of hedrons that binds the Eldrazi titans' shadows to Zendikar.

name: The hedron prison
description: A ring of hedrons with leylines in an unnatural pattern that held Khalni Heart captive.

name: The hellion
description: A giant lava-swimming monster that attacks the monks in the lava field.

name: The hidden sanctuary
description: A warm hidden valley and cavern where whisperers' headpieces and carvings are hidden from Atarka.

name: The high plateau
description: The treacherous open land on Tarkir where the party travels toward Ugin's grave.

name: The humans of Fartree Hamlet
description: A tribe of tree-dwelling humans who communicate through chatter sloths.

name: The hydra
description: A spectral green hydra summoned from the Arkbow that kills nobles.

name: The jackal-headed god
aliases: the figure with a golden headdress
description: A towering jackal-headed being with a golden headdress and two-pronged staff who destroys the undead wurms and saves the Gatewatch.

name: The keep
description: A ruined keep above Traublassen built by Taivas with an ossuary of memories beneath it where Umbris is bound.

name: The leaking spire
description: The renegade symbol: an upside down Consulate symbol with flourishes emptying out of the bottom, representing hope that aether is returned to the people.

name: The map to Tarnation
description: A map hidden in a sealed crypt in Thief's Folly.

name: The marshy cave
description: A cave downriver where the party washes ashore and is surrounded by ratfolk.

name: The massacre of Drakestown
description: The vicious murder of everyone in Drakestown years ago, their lives lost to an unknown scheme.

name: The meeting rocks
aliases: site of the first battle with Dromoka
description: A rocky outcropping in the dunes, site of the first battle with Dromoka where a thousand Abzan fell, and the meeting place for the parley.

name: The merfolk refugees
description: A hundred merfolk survivors from many tribes fleeing the Eldrazi.

name: The monstrosaur
description: A tortured monstrosaur with pulled teeth, displayed at the Tourdion gala; it survives chaos to crush a guard in triumph.

name: The moonfolk
description: Allies who helped Konda kidnap a kami.

name: The nulls
description: Slavering creatures that haul the refugees' sleds.

name: The old country
description: The ruined old plane beneath New Capenna reached by a manhole and ladder.

name: The orphan boy
description: A child newspaper seller who broke a Broker contract by spying near an Obscura meeting point and is placed with wardens.

name: The outcropping
description: A secluded rock outcropping outside Akros with an emonberry tree, where Pavios and Thanasis meet.

name: The pale noblewoman
description: An alabaster-wigged vampire noblewoman with a beauty mark who speaks with Frederic about the gala.

name: The physician
description: A woman physician whose body Rav briefly possesses to spy on Jacob.

name: The planes
description: Other worlds that powerful individuals can walk between.

name: The portal
description: A blue rift on the hill that the storm creature emerges from and that hums with Zendikar's leyline song.

name: The progenitor
description: The shadowy being whose wing-beats birthed the dragons.

name: The ratfolk village
description: A system of ancient burrows beneath the marsh where the lorekeepers live and store lore.

name: The renegade warehouse
description: A cavernous warehouse where the skyship is built and dedicated.

name: The ruins
description: The ruins in the mountains where the demon holds the village captive for the ritual.

name: The sarcophagi
description: Ancient painted coffins in a forbidden alley.

name: The seeds
description: Seeds from trees wiped out by the Eldrazi, given to Nissa by a vampire as the world's last hope.

name: The six keys
description: Six pieces of one key, five held in Akul's medallion and the sixth stolen by Oko.

name: The snake demon
description: A summoned snake demon coiled around Elnor's arm that breathes jets of flame.

name: The soul of Amonkhet
description: The voice of the dying plane that Nissa senses, speaking of its curse and its stolen catacomb dead.

name: The soul-drinking sword
description: A sword Dakkon forged for Dihada over ten years, quenched in the blood of his slaves, into which Dakkon's shadow and soul were absorbed.

name: The surrakar
description: Territorial reptilian beasts that once nested in the caves of Bala Ged.

name: The train to Prosperity
description: A Sterling Company train carrying Nolan that goes over a destroyed bridge.

name: The undead of Amonkhet
description: Desiccated undead that burst from the sand, including jackal-headed warriors.

name: The unseen archer
description: A mysterious archer whose blazing white arrow kills the wurm threatening Liliana.

name: The vampire envoy
description: An unnamed vampire who knows Nissa's name and asks her to carry four seeds to another plane on Anowon's behalf.

name: The vampires of Guul Draz
description: Drana's vampire army and the mortal refugees traveling with them.

name: The vampires of Zendikar
description: Hooked, red-painted vampire-like creatures who worship Ulamog and whose blood rituals disrupt the hedron network.

name: The vault child
description: An infant with orange fur and horns, held in a glass pod in Maag Taranau, taken by Jace.

name: The vision
description: A vision of a kitten hiding the cream, corvidae and gold in the water, with halos everywhere, seen by seers across New Capenna but not by Raffine.

name: The witch of Edgewall
description: A witch who runs the charms shop in Edgewall, sends Rankle on a quest for a love flower and is leaving to join forces with others against the coming doom.

name: The wolf at the end of the world
description: A titanic wolf in the Cosmos whose eyes shine like twin green suns over Istfell and who watches Ranar and Bjorn.

name: Thendar
description: A Kav former imperial moxite miner fired for skimming ore who now steals from the empire.

name: Theriad
description: The collection of stories about the Champion of the Sun.

name: Thieves' Quarter
description: A crowded district of Paliano where Adriana makes her speech against Marchesa.

name: Thinktank
description: A thirty-block tract of Ravnica run by rogue Izzet chemisters, with disputed jurisdiction, later declared an enclave.

name: Thinktank Electrical Elemental
description: An eighty-foot electrical elemental that emerges from a rift in the Thinktank and is subdued by Azorius nullmages.

name: Thinktank Jurisdictional Fallacy
description: A first-year lawmage problem about four guilds' competing claims to the Thinktank.

name: Third Path
description: An esoteric order of mages based at Terisia City whose writings reach Penregon.

name: Third Tomakul Spears
description: Farid's regiment.

name: Thom
description: A young Tolarian student who attacks Jodah with death magic and is subdued.

name: Thorna Grabbler
description: The head of Steamflogger Industries who recruited the goblins and formed the Goblin Explosioneers.

name: Thousand Steps
description: The long stair from the lowlands up into the High City.

name: Thousand-Year Elixir
description: A golden potion in a labeled phial in Boeb's lair that Ygril wonders about.

name: Thran
description: The ancient civilization whose prisoners and technology are buried in the Caves of Koilos.

name: Thran Mana Rig
description: The place where Jhoira made the spark Powerstone.

name: Thran vacuum globe
description: A silver globe with golden tracery that creates a spherical vacuum, killing the dragon engine's organic parts.

name: Thranegeld
description: A dwarven artificer and docent who sets Ulf to research Corondor and is found dead afterward.

name: Thrasios
description: A triton of Meletis who believes he has Thassa's blessing and pilgrimages to the ocean's depths, claiming to have visited Olantin.

name: Thrissik
description: A Phyrexian thane who builds cairns to bring about his Destroyer.

name: Thrull
description: A servant creature of the Orzhov that Karlov summons to take Tajic to the dungeon.

name: Thunder bow
description: Yuma's heavy crossbow that channels lightning bolts.

name: Thunder rifle
description: Annie's rifle, which she digs up from a hidden grave.

name: Tidehollow
description: The forsaken underground of Esper where Tezzeret was born.

name: Tin Street Market
description: A Ravnican market Vraska wants to show Jace.

name: Tinybones, Pocket Nuisance
description: A magical thieving skeleton who steals as an art form and keeps the spirits of Urborg safe.

name: Tiro
description: A Theran human bound to Kynaios by love for him and for freedom, who helped defeat Agnomakhos and guards Meletis.

name: Titanbones, Towering Heart
description: An Echoverse skeleton who defends the wilds of Yavimaya, especially the birds.

name: Tithing Hike
description: Orzhova's raised tithes to thirty percent, which sparks rioting that ends with a settlement at eighteen percent.

name: Titsui
description: Nishang's late second-in-command, a purple vulture-like warrior whose form is impersonated by a rakshasa; the real Titsui was murdered by a Sultai priest.

name: Titsui impersonator
description: A blue-skinned, four-armed rakshasa who impersonates Titsui and Sidisi to recruit Nishang and later controls his body through a piece of his soul.

name: Tivan Desert
description: The desert where the monument stands.

name: Tivash
description: A professor whose notes about Maraff Dina reads and whose notebook Dina returns.

name: Tivit
description: A winged sphinx fortune-teller of the Obscura who is struck by the prophecy and whose shop is later wrecked.

name: Tola
description: A trickster of Cosi ordered to stay at Sea Gate.

name: Tolaria
description: The time-shattered isle of Dominaria.

name: Tolumnus
description: Yisan's lyre made of insectoid chitin.

name: Toluz
description: An Obscura information broker with a shadow generator and a cane, mother of Parnesse, who demands Anhelo kill Fiero in exchange for information.

name: Tomakri
description: A baker of Akros who makes the sweet cinnamon rolls Pollio's wife loves.

name: Tomas
description: One of Brenalt's best friends, killed on the mission.

name: Tomik, Izzet Sparkmage
description: An Echoverse Tomik Vrona, a talented Izzet sparkmage with a considerable temper, and husband of Ral.

name: Tomik, Orzhov Lawmage
description: Tomik Vrona, raised by Orzhov advokists, Teysa's second in command, and husband of Ral Zarek.

name: Tomlin
description: Rootha's youngest brother, whom she hurt with her magic as a child.

name: Tommy
description: Annie's nephew, who lives in chronic pain from a past mistake of hers and decides to leave Saddlebrush for real medicine and their people.

name: Too Much Happiness
description: An android mechan captain and body-ship who carries Reen to Point Prime, affected by glitches and a strange presence met in the Wurmwall.

name: Topizielo
description: The region the Komon left the Core to explore.

name: Tor-Kathorr
description: A desert region of Arcavios and home of the Kathorran delegation.

name: Toralf
description: A warrior god named alongside Halvar.

name: Torbach
description: A village where the mayor's son died fleeing a werewolf.

name: Torbran
description: A red-bearded dwarf with a magical golden wishing ring who needs the ring to lure the invaders into a chasm.

name: Torches of Enlightenment
description: Stone torches where the Codex meets Zimone at night.

name: Torens
description: A former Mausoleum Guard and cathar turned peddler of dubious goods who carries a stolen holy mace and agrees to investigate a keep for Vytas.

name: Torens's mace
description: A holy weapon Torens stole from the cathars that sheds white light and tingles in the presence of spirits and fiends.

name: Toski
description: The squirrel messenger of the gods.

name: Tourdion with the Truculent Thunder
description: A famous Luneau gala at which tortured animals are displayed.

name: Tove
description: A Valkyrie Avtyr addresses.

name: Tover Giants-Blood
description: A huge, tattooed Kannah warrior who fights Arni in an honor duel with an iron axe.

name: Tovolar's wolves
description: Dozens of wolves who pour into Voldaren Manor and fight the vampires.

name: Tower of Guilt
description: The separate tower where Dar lights or does not light his lamp.

name: Training hall
description: A combination obstacle course and classroom where Ruzi teaches.

name: Traublassen
description: A village near the Kessig-Stensia border founded by Taivas and ruled by Vytas, with a keep above it.

name: Traveler's Noticeboard
description: A warded bulletin board outside an inn in Precinct Five of Ravnica that only planeswalkers can see, used for trades and messages.

name: Traxos, Academy Guardian
description: An Echoverse dragon engine raised and rebuilt by Lyra to protect Tolaria.

name: Traxos, Scourge Eternal
description: A dragon engine known as the Scourge of Kroog, which led Mishra's legions and later deemed Phyrexian invaders enemies too.

name: Treefolk
description: Sentient trees with humanoid features, the oldest creatures native to the plane.

name: Trest
description: An elven city-state that sent Leovold as its ambassador to Paliano.

name: Trial of Ambition
description: Bontu's deadly Trial, a pyramid gauntlet that ends in a toll of one heart from each surviving initiate.

name: Trial of Knowledge
description: Kefnet's trial, an illusory nightmare trap of leyline magic in a blue-lit chamber that traps unworthy initiates in eternal nightmare.

name: Trial of Zeal
description: Hazoret's final Trial in which initiates must kill the dissenters, after which the Hours begin.

name: Tricksters of Cosi
description: Merfolk devotees of Cosi who are skeptical of gods and follow Kiora's story.

name: Triumvirate
description: Three Orzhov leaders (Morov, Zoltan, Maladola) who assumed power after the Obzedat's fall.

name: Trokair
description: Ruins on Sarpadia named by Karn as a false hiding place for the sylex.

name: Trostad
description: The place where Geralf's laboratory lies in ruins.

name: Trygve
description: A burly Kaldheim hunter with braided beard, skilled at throwing axes but a poor bowman.

name: Trystan
description: Morcant's elf poison master and horticulturist who secretly despises her.

name: Tucker
description: A molefolk lorekeeper in spectacles who serves tea and guides the party out.

name: Tuktuk
description: The goblin leader of the Tuktuk tribe, made of rocks, whom Zada says she ate.

name: Tuktuk tribe
description: A tribe of goblins who lived in Akoum under Tuktuk.

name: Turi
description: Kiora's younger sister, who studied at Sea Gate and waits for Kiora to return.

name: Turntimber
description: The great forest near Hamadi's home of Graypelt.

name: Tusk mountains
description: Mountains of red stone crags where the Tuskeri live and where Arni fights a hellkite and trolls.

name: Tuya
description: Hapatra's huge basilisk familiar, magically bonded to her, which she rides into battle.

name: Twenty-Three Texts
description: The holy texts of the Ethersworn, studied for the key to planeswalking.

name: Twist Fandango
description: One of Akul's inner circle, who captures the crew in a Tarnation saloon.

name: Tymna the Weaver
description: A blind Theran mortal who mastered the magic of the Fates after a career as one of the Battlewise of Meletis.

name: Tynthal
description: A large city north of One-Eyed Pass, governed by Pilun, with a detachment of Stratians.

name: Tyreus
description: Sylvene's grandson, whose greed for power knows no bounds and who is drawn to her hidden treasures.

name: Tyrite
description: The hardened sap of the World Tree used to forge the Sword of the Realms.

name: Ugin's Chasm
description: An icy canyon of blackened granite in the mountains where Ugin's skeleton lies.

name: Ugin's ally
aliases: winged creature with a man's bearded face and a big cat's paws
description: A winged sphinx-like creature in a city of glass and stone who agrees to help Ugin trap Bolas.

name: Ugin's canyon
description: The canyon where Ugin's hedron cocoon lay, now filled with rune-etched rubble.

name: Ugin's gem
description: A gleaming jewel suspended between Ugin's horns whose power Jace steals to take control of the realm.

name: Ukti
description: An old dwarven woman who runs First Launch and guards her secret sanctum.

name: Ulaten
description: A newer cockpit crew member who carried Botono and appears as a tentacle head.

name: Ulf
description: A Tolarian Academy student with little magic but a knack for research, who finds a lost book on Corondor and flees with it.

name: Ulmach
description: The Chief Inquisitor of Nephalia whose inquisition burns children at Elgaud.

name: Umbris
description: A spirit bound by the sorcerer Taivas in the keep who takes the townsfolk's fears and sorrows each night and possesses Aleksandar's body.

name: Umerilek
description: An ancient mausoleum with hundreds of stone coffins whose undead rise when Mazirek opens the slab; he calls it the salvation of the kraul.

name: Umeyo
description: Nashi's kind cousin who shares ices and takes him to roll rice balls.

name: Undead
description: The endless armies of the dead that overrun humanity's holdings and rise again from the fallen.

name: Undercity henchmen
description: Hired Undercity fighters who ambush Kaito and Tamiyo.

name: Undercity ninjas
description: Hired Undercity ninjas who fight for Jin-Gitaxias.

name: Undertaker's Corner
description: A perilous cliffside section of road overlooking a grange.

name: Unseen presence
description: A warped humanoid of man, beast and tree that follows them and is banished by Teferi's magic but leaves a tangled time spell.

name: Urabrask's rebellion
description: A Phyrexian civil war against Elesh Norn's rule that distracts forces in the Dross Pits.

name: Urgoros
description: A powerful lich that has never been human, riding a dragon-like beast, sent by Belzenlok against the Weatherlight.

name: Ursan Guard
description: The Bear King's armored guards, killed by Ranar and Bjorn.

name: Urza's Crystal Orb
description: A dark crystal orb in a cage of silver vines hidden in the monument, one of Urza's devices that could help repair a time rift.

name: Urza's Monument
description: A trapped stone monument in the Tivan desert, younger than Teferi, which sinks after its artifact is taken.

name: Urza's pocket dimension
description: A hidden space made to look like Urza's cabin in the Ohran Mountains of Gulmany.

name: Vadrik
description: A reclusive astronomancer and archmage of Nephalia who is called to Lambholt to deal with a killer and works with the inquisitor Rem Karolus.

name: Vadrok
description: A catlike dragon, the apex monster of Raugrin, who attacks the Phyrexian titan and tears Lukka out of it.

name: Val
description: A human Pinnacle scout whose ship crashed on an unexplored jungle world after Kav scrappers attacked and who daily transmits a distress message.

name: Valkas
description: A peak on Shandalar.

name: Valki
description: The god of lies, tricked and chained by Tibalt, who was imprisoned in King Narfi's palace in Karfell while Tibalt used his guise.

name: Valkmir
description: The black mirror lake of Starnheim, 'blood and bone' of the Valkyries.

name: Valko
description: The ratlike maitre d' of Milena's restaurant.

name: Vampires of Luneau
description: The undead aristocracy of Luneau who drink mortal blood as a payment.

name: Vann
description: A neighbor who made chamomile fizzy drink and blackberry punch.

name: Varolz
description: A fungal-hided troll of the Golgari with a claim to Vraska's throne.

name: Varryvort
description: An Izzet goblin chief chemister who carries the Firemind's Vessel; Lazav was impersonating him.

name: Varuk
description: An old but clever orc, Zurgo's closest advisor, who turns the horde against him and leads it home to Wingthrone.

name: Vasi
description: A gifted young loyalist girl captured by the rebels, who trains with Felothar and learns to commune with the ancestors.

name: Vasil
description: An unguilded Selesnyan initiate in Miri's pod who coaches her on the Chant of Vitu-Ghazi.

name: Vault constructs
description: Stone guardians holding spears and shields that attack intruders carrying stolen items.

name: Vaults of Turrau
description: Hidden vaults at the base of the mountains below Hookiver where Blood Age artifacts are stored under guard.

name: Vauti
description: Mehtma's loxodon aide, who brings her coffee and helps her in the rescue and the aftermath.

name: Veil-embraced Garruk
description: The Theorist's Multiverse's double of Garruk who tackles his twin into a portal.

name: Veilshapers
description: Professional Futurist spies and agents in layered robes and illusory masks.

name: Velena
description: The weapons officer of the Weatherlight, who is killed by the corrupted ship's powerbolts.

name: Velmenon
description: A jellyfish-like Solidbodies Research contact who gives Geldan the job and the sensor gear.

name: Velomachus Lorehold
description: One of the five elder dragon founders of Strixhaven, who documents history without interfering and collects artifacts.

name: Venkat
description: A former high-ranking Consulate commander who defected to Pia's renegades and wears a stolen lieutenant's uniform.

name: Venser, Fervent Forger
description: A magical thief who teleports into vaults and joined Jhoira's crew.

name: Verazol
description: A legendary two-headed serpent of the Magosi, a beast hundreds of feet long that devours the caravan.

name: Verdis Fa-Ulla
description: A blue-skinned Kathorran orc, a grad student and grandchild of the Kathorran conciliator, who is Crown's childhood friend.

name: Verity circle
description: An Azorius spell that compels truthful answers though it cannot compel speech.

name: Verna
description: A flower girl who charges Mia with a pitchfork.

name: Veryl
description: A fisherman with greasy blond hair who claims to have seen the Gitrog and who boasted of kissing an angel.

name: Viashino ally
description: A viashino who bursts through a wall to save Ulf, holds back Brotten and is later found dead, called an old friend by Jared.

name: Vickus
description: A fourth-year Witherbloom student and Dina's date who duels Killian out of jealousy.

name: Village Elders
description: The ruling council of the lakeside village, who suspend fishing on the lake.

name: Vinack's stepson
description: A farmer and the narrator, who hated his stepfather Vinack, runs the farm after his mother's death, and lets Vinack walk to his death before the minotaurs.

name: Vineclinger
description: A hulking, long-haired, musk-smelling creature that is wounded by the bog creature.

name: Vis Svokunol
description: A loxodon veteran and Asterion's childhood caretaker, accused of being a mercenary and put to death in a stockade.

name: Vishgraz
description: A being Ixhel creates from Geth's head, with Belaxis's body, and arachnid limbs including her own wings; she names him and frees him.

name: Vizag Atum
description: The group of geist-talkers that raised Jacob and revered geists as sources of true wisdom.

name: Vizier Ahmose
description: A vizier whose words about the Harvest Samut quotes.

name: Vizier Eknet
description: An aven vizier of the Hekma Guard who repairs the barrier and is bluffed by Jace.

name: Vizier Heqet
description: A vizier who teaches the children and yells at them.

name: Viziers of Bontu
description: Soldiers including a minotaur who pursue the fleeing woman.

name: Voja
description: A massive white wolf Kaya knows, loyal to Tolsimir.

name: Vorik's camp
description: A refuge camp in a ravine, destroyed by the Eldrazi.

name: Vraan
description: One of the thanes who sided with Urabrask.

name: Vraska's Assassin Victim
aliases: the woman in the jade green cloak
description: A hooded human assassin in Vraska's employ whom Vraska petrifies in Rozlad Square.

name: Vraska's double
description: The Echoverse double of Vraska who commands a stone Niv-Mizzet, is turned to stone, and later helps the Theorist; she was never known pain.

name: Vraska's old apartment
description: A small undercity flat filled with trinkets from other planes where Vraska recovers her memories of Jace.

name: Vraska, Soul of Stone
description: An Echoverse gorgon raised under the guilds of Ravnica who can animate statues, remains unguilded, and is a valuable ally to the Theorist though not a replacement for his Vraska.

name: Vraska, the Cutting Glare
description: A gorgon and former assassin who believes Jace is dead, keeps the young Loot out of harm's way, and resolves to stop Jace when she hears he may have survived.

name: Vraska, the Multiverse's double
description: A double of Vraska made by the Theorist's Multiverse who serves him and prepares a knife; the Theorist feels she is a construct without something to fight for.

name: Vronos
description: A cathar and elite inquisitor of Avacyn who became a planeswalker after a werewolf attack, studied with the Ethersworn, and is tasked to capture Garruk.

name: Vu
description: The ancient capital and last imperial city of the Kav on Kavaron Before.

name: Vuel
description: Sidar Kondo's blood son, consumed by envy and bitterness, who killed him.

name: Vv'viza
description: An Illvoi who took over Uthros Combine leadership after Mm'menon's exit and counters Mm'menon's attempts to glean its secrets.

name: Vytas
description: The wealthy, coercive lord of Traublassen who hires Torens to investigate the keep and who is attacked by the townsfolk at the end.

name: Vytas's hunters
description: Vytas's trapper corps and associates who capture prisoners to give to Umbris.

name: Vígniút
description: A flame-bearded berserker of the Tuskeri feasting in Starnheim.

name: Wallader the Eventual
description: A diminutive turtlefolk courier who delivers Zimone's mystery packages.

name: War name
description: The name a Mardu warrior earns by proving themselves in a brutal act of honor, usually killing an enemy.

name: Wardens
description: Women in black who run an orphan school and wipe the boy's memory under contract with the Brokers.

name: Warlord Ajani
description: The Theorist's Multiverse's double of Ajani who tackles his twin into a portal.

name: Warped merge
description: An unstable meld between utsushiyo, the material realm, and kakuriyo, the spirit realm, left in the hideout wall.

name: Warwick
description: A dock coworker whom Merret suggests could clear the fog.

name: Wasp's Nest
description: A rough tavern where Kaya meets Revari's soldier before being taken upstairs to see Revari.

name: Wasting disease
description: A disease that rots the body and mind, killing Nishang.

name: Waterdeep
description: A city Sylvene explored on the Sword Coast.

name: Way of the Wandering Warrior
description: A Jeskai rite Narset undertook, during which she learned about the other clans through observation and fighting.

name: Weeping Woman
description: A gold-masked dead woman of Asphodel who, in an endless search for her dead, lures living children away.

name: Weftwalking
description: The ability of cats and Drix to step between places and stars without ships.

name: Wellspring Magic
description: The underlying magic of things that Boldt learns to ask rather than command.

name: Whipsaw
description: Hekara's favorite hellhound, calmed by Hekara.

name: Whisper Mind
description: The mind-to-mind skill of the whisperers, taught by Ugin to the ancestors.

name: White structure
description: A twenty-kilometer white construction of smooth arcs that reseals itself and contains a vast spherical space, a node, and swarms; it is not a memorial vault.

name: White-clad Liliana
description: A woman in a white gown who has Liliana's own face and arrives at her office to talk.

name: Widdershins Hall
description: The living-tree main hall of Witherbloom College with labs and an infirmary.

name: Wide Whisper
description: A trance communion that links the surviving Atarka shamans secretly.

name: Widow of Bitterheart Hill
description: An outcast woman whose cottage was destroyed and who was found dead without wounds.

name: Wife Warin
description: Warin's wife who reports the possessed cow and accuses Lady Evelin.

name: Wilbur
description: A fisherman's apprentice who has just turned fifteen, Kalim's son and Mia's close friend; he believes in the Gitrog and joins the villagers' patrols.

name: Wild dragon
description: A huge ice-breathing wild dragon that gores its way through the hull of Storm Crane into the school and is driven off after Elspeth cuts its mouth.

name: Wild dragons
description: Dragons born from the dragonstorms who are bound to Sarkhan by the corrupted ritual.

name: Wildfire Wolf
description: A Calamity Beast whose fang is said to have formed the sword.

name: Wilhelt
description: A woodsman who died and rose as a ghoul with his own army, who marches on Thraben to win Gisa's love.

name: Wilhelt's army
description: A legion of ghouls raised by Wilhelt that marches on Thraben and is defeated.

name: Will's knights
description: The army of knights led by Will to Castle Ardenvale.

name: Willowdusk
description: The oldest dryad and a faculty member Dina most wants to be like, who advises her to let students fight for themselves.

name: Winged Temple of Orazca
description: A temple in Orazca with three hundred steps leading to a recitation chamber.

name: Wingthrone
description: The Mardu home territory to which Varuk leads the horde.

name: Winter, Team Player
description: An Echoverse survivor and cunning leader in Duskmourn who hunts Marina Vendrell to rescue her from herself.

name: Winter, Tormented Loner
description: A survivor cursed to serve Valgavoth in Duskmourn, finding a glimmer of hope.

name: Wishing ring
description: Torbran's magical golden ring that grants wishes, though not ones too powerful or far-reaching for the plane.

name: Witchbane Orb
description: An orb used as a spectral antenna in the experiment, owned by Olivia.

name: Witchbane's orb
description: A magical ward against curses created by the widow, used as a lure in Odric's trap.

name: Wittal Parish
description: A parish near the ruins of Estwald where Thalia says she found a witch with Jerren's letter.

name: Woe-reapers
description: Mardu who chant ancient rites over the dead to keep them still in death.

name: Wojek
description: The Boros peacekeeping and counterintelligence branch to which Ossett is promoted.

name: Wolf Riders
description: Selesnya riders bonded to wolves from youth, trained by Ruzi.

name: Wolfir
description: Werewolves transformed by the Cursemute into wolven servants and helpful allies of Avacyn.

name: Worshipers of Eirdu
description: Followers who wear sunburst armor and seek to convert the entire plane into Lorwyn.

name: Worshipers of Isilu
description: Followers who wear moon-motif armor, hold vigils over their dead and seek to convert the entire plane into Shadowmoor.

name: Wothis's Wife
description: Grimbly Wothis's minotaur wife who catches Merret in her kitchen and is made oblivious to him by his magic.

name: X
description: A shadowy figure paid by various sources to steal the Golden Ruler.

name: Xander's Archives
description: A hidden archive in the Maestros' museum holding Capenna's histories and a cache of Halo.

name: Xander's museum
description: The Maestros' museum in Park Heights where Elspeth catalogues questionable art.

name: Xandril the Executioner
description: A kor war hero and enemy of Golwanda, whose statue stands on Effigy Row.

name: Xantcha
description: A construct in Urza's pocket dimension modeled on his companion; the real Xantcha's memories are in the golem Karn.

name: Xanthos
description: A steadfast soldier of the squad who is split in two by a minotaur's axe.

name: Xenocrates
description: An early mentor of Melantha at Ephara's temple who appears in her dream, coughing blood and speaking forbidden theories about the gods.

name: Xu-Ifit
description: A Monoist surgeon at Susur Secundi who experiments on acolytes in order to rescue her wife, frozen in the supervoid by time dilation.

name: Xyrun-Jed
description: The last loxodon emperor, credited with the Canticle of Jed and with the fall of Zantafar.

name: Yadira
description: The leader of Lathril's elven clan who tells her she has been summoned.

name: Yala
description: A Sultai woman from a backwater region honored as a hero for killing a dragon, falsely accused of poisoning Tasigur's food and killed by him.

name: Yamazaki household
description: The Imperial family that raised Norika and Heiko.

name: Yamno
description: The Thinner's miracho, burned through by Cataline.

name: Yantis
description: A Viashino dockworker who operates the crane and is subjected to Merret's nightmare spell.

name: Yar-Kul
description: A man Belzenlok transformed into a maggot.

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
description: A frog spirit with an insatiable appetite, kept in check by Muldrotha and fused with Multani during the Phyrexian attack.

name: Yargle, Terror of Otaria
description: An Echoverse frog spirit feared by the people of Otaria, who devastated Cabal forces in the Second Brothers' War.

name: Yasova's mark
description: Two sweeping curves Yasova gouges into stone at intervals, a trail charting the storms that Bolas asked for to find Ugin.

name: Yavimaya elves
description: Elves of Yavimaya led by Meria who eventually join the coalition.

name: Yavimayan elves
description: Elven archers who ride kavu and Magnigoths into the battle.

name: Yawning Chasm
description: A chasm off the coast of Ondu, home of the horned rift octopus.

name: Yeffa
description: A broad veteran soldier and storyteller who witnessed the Guardian on the battlefield.

name: Yenai
description: An old, scarred Sejiri merfolk who leads the refugee group heading to Murasa.

name: Yeran
description: A smooth-faced young Temur warrior who questions Yasova's plan.

name: Yesha
description: A trickster of Cosi who accompanies Kiora and notes that if Ulamog leaves he can return.

name: Yew sapling
description: A yew sapling grafted on Sigric and carried by Erewaker, which takes its first breath at the Rising.

name: Ygril
description: A bold boggart who leads the raid on Boeb's lair, grows into a giant with a potion and is nearly boiled in milk.

name: Yidris
description: A Grixis ogre mage afflicted by unstable mutations who was driven into the Maelstrom, which stabilized him as a conduit of chaos.

name: Yisan
description: An eyepatched bard who charms with music on his carapace lyre Tolumnus, and who stays behind to study the slivers' music.

name: Yolotzin
description: A warrior-poet from centuries ago whose story Huatli tells Saheeli.

name: Yomu
description: A person who told the boy Perrie would hurt him.

name: Yoshimaru, Beloved Companion
description: The Emperor's faithful hound, who guarded Kamigawa's empty throne until her return.

name: Yoshimaru, Scrappy Stray
description: An Echoverse street dog, leader of a Towashi pack, called the Stray Emperor by some.

name: Yotia
description: The land of many gods, whose capital Kroog is under attack.

name: Yotians
description: The defenders of Kroog.

name: Young Elspeth
description: The child version of Elspeth in the dungeon memory, who speaks with a voice without youth and is revealed to be Elspeth herself.

name: Young elf student
description: A young elf wolf-rider student in her first training session who falls from the beam.

name: Young wild dragon
description: A young, playful dragon newly born from the storms, killed by Sarkhan for its heart.

name: Yuma
description: The narrator, a former Riveteer weaponsmith from New Capenna who fled to Thunder Junction and now owns a saloon with his cactusfolk friend Kirri.

name: Yuma's saloon
description: Yuma's bar in Thunder Junction, run collectively, where the fight with Elnor takes place and where Kirri's vines grow.

name: Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty
description: An Echoverse warrior who pledged loyalty to Tamiyo and remains her devoted living shield.

name: Yuriko, Hope from the Shadows
description: A former orphan and smuggler who strangled an Imperial guard and stalks Towashi as the Tiger's Shadow.

name: Zada
description: A strong, cheerful goblin of Slab Haven who fights with a pestle and mortar, grinds hedrons for magic, and guides Jace to the Eye of Ugin.

name: Zadrous Fimarell
description: An old, paranoid former Academy academic who brought cogwork to Paliano and built his career on Daretti's stolen words; he is thrown from his window.

name: Zaffai
description: A human grand maestro of the Strixhaven Orchestra of the Arcane who forms the Tempests at Summitfest.

name: Zahr Gada
description: An explorer who once compared maps with Jori and told her of the goblin-inhabited cave network.

name: Zar Ojanen
description: A strong Efravan warrior and descendant of Jaeger and Jedit Ojanen, who leads the caravan's flight.

name: Zara
description: A young dwarf fan who asks Saheeli to sign her autograph booklet.

name: Zdenya
description: One of Vraska's assassins hiding in Rozlad Square.

name: Zegodonis
description: A gaudy Devkarin elf competitor who survives a woodwraith attack and also wins an apprenticeship under the lich.

name: Zendikari bait army
description: The soldiers from kor, vampires, goblins, elves and others who lure the titans into the valley.

name: Zendikari hedron
description: Stone from Zendikar that Nahiri recognizes in the statue of Tyvar.

name: Zendikari hedron charm
description: A small etched stone from Zendikar among Tyvar's charms.

name: Zendikari scouts
description: A small wounded party of scouts and foot soldiers, including a vampire and a kor, led by Tazri.

name: Zerili
description: A young scholar who argued for a treaty with the minotaurs and was found mutilated a week later.

name: Zetalpa
description: The elder dinosaur of dawn who tackles Etali and brings the sun.

name: Zhalfirins and Mirrans
description: The villagers and warriors of the new village who defend it from the beast.

name: Zhur-Taa
description: The Gruul clan led by Nikya, which worships ancient gods of old Ravnica.

name: Zihir
description: Zimone's father.

name: Zimone's Multiverse Model
description: A three-dimensional illusory predictive spell model of the Multiverse that Zimone built in her bedroom.

name: Zita
description: A human effigy mage and shopkeeper in Rakdos territory who befriends Kodolaag, is arrested, and helps him break her out of Udzec.

name: Zonots
description: Huge sinkhole habitats leading down to Ravnica's oceans, each a distinct Simic culture with a speaker.

name: Zoritt
description: Kadrik's broodmate and only real friend, a med-lab scientist who tends the human.

name: Zosimos
description: A young human who walks toward Meletis worried about winning glory and the gods' favor, and is awakened as a hero by a satyr's teaching.

name: Zulaport
description: The safehold Vorik and Tazri plan to evacuate to.

name: Zurgo Stormrender
description: Leader of the Mardu rebellion, portrayed in the troupe's show.

name: Æther
description: The substance from which the Eldrazi's true forms are made and from which they cast physical projections.
